project.name: g6
project.description: G6 is an open-source Python library of checkable AI components for reasoning, evidence, checks and action control, exposed through an MCP server, with a Django site; its first use is reviewing a coding agent's Python patch by running the requirement tests inside an operating-system boundary.

nodes.name: AGENT_GUIDE.md
nodes.summary: Guide written for AI coding agents using G6 over MCP or Python: the discover-describe-invoke flow, label rules (never upgrade a label, blocked-escalated means stop), sensitive-op and isolation rules, a table of starting-point calls including g6_review_patch, and model/provider configuration.

nodes.name: assurance_worked_example.py
nodes.summary: Reproducible local worked example of the cognitive bridge's assurance orchestrator: a stubbed registry behind G6's checked door, an in-process truth-table checker with positive and negative controls, and output written as an illustrative candidate dossier JSON.

nodes.name: blue_ocean_research.py
nodes.summary: Offline synthetic illustration of a CognitiveAgent choosing between two market hypotheses with an LLMProposer driven by a scripted fake model and a synthetic interview tool.

nodes.name: illustrative_candidate_dossier.json
nodes.summary: Generated output of the assurance worked example: a qualified-draft candidate dossier (explicitly not a G6 promotion certificate) recording a truth-table check with its control tests, verifier manifest hashes, documentary sections and limitations.

nodes.name: mixed_methods_research.py
nodes.summary: Demonstrates MethodRouter planning a claim that needs graph, causal and formal evidence; execution through MixedMethodExecutor and the real registry runs only if an operator flips an explicit approval flag.

nodes.name: ml_to_explicit.py
nodes.summary: Shows the cognitive bridge turning scikit-learn models into explicit, inspectable rules: a decision tree transcribed directly and a random forest distilled into a surrogate tree with a fidelity report.

nodes.name: demo_1_persistent_state.py
nodes.summary: Demo of harness state across sessions: a check that failed in one process makes the next refuse a standard that dropped it, with an empty-state control run.

nodes.name: demo_2_evidence_revision.py
nodes.summary: Demo of claim checking through the MCP reply path: unbacked sentences come back blocked-escalated, a supplied source yields qualified-draft, and a conflicting figure is reported as a conflict.

nodes.name: demo_3_governed_change.py
nodes.summary: Demo of governed harness modification: a failing task is diagnosed, two template changes are each tested in their own git worktree against project and held-out suites, and govern_patch_promotion rejects the bad diff and merges the good one.

nodes.name: demo_4_agent_discovery.py
nodes.summary: Demo of the g6_find, g6_describe, g6_invoke path a coding agent follows to check an email before sending it: grounding of claims, then the action gate that blocks until a verification plan is supplied.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Index of the four offline demonstration scripts with what each shows and the note that the demos do not show agent uplift on real work.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Project overview of G6: the three result labels and the rule for earning them, install and setup with OS-boundary isolation, the first patch review flow, MCP/CLI/Python surfaces, component families, capability status table, and published study results.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package root declaring the version and the public g6.invoke door, which runs one component op through the checked door and the cloud-consent guarded registry with per-call sensitive-op allowances.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package marker for allowance infrastructure; the public records and display API live in g6.allowance.

nodes.name: advice.py
nodes.summary: Pure advisory pacing for provider quota windows: a validated Settings policy and advise(), which turns a reading into a recommendation about optional parallel agents, never a launch boundary.

nodes.name: hook.py
nodes.summary: UserPromptSubmit hook that emits one context line with cached Codex and Claude allowance advice only when the advice changed, without refreshing providers.

nodes.name: programs.py
nodes.summary: Resolves the absolute path of a program to start, searching only absolute PATH folders so a file in the working directory is never launched (a Windows lookup hazard).

nodes.name: readers.py
nodes.summary: Allow-listed adapters that normalise Codex and Claude rate-limit payloads into Reading/Window records, treating provider text as data and keeping Claude support undeclared until a real capture.

nodes.name: statusline.py
nodes.summary: Owner-installed status-line wrapper that starts the person's renderer first and a detached, time-budgeted observer process that captures only the rate_limits block, with preview and rollback of the status-line config.

nodes.name: store.py
nodes.summary: Transactional SQLite advisory cache of allowance readings, refresh claims, change notes and profile bindings, plus background Codex refresh; writers order by observation time.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package docstring for the Context Engine, the core (non-component) code composing the knowledge family's members to serve the g6_knowledge_* MCP tools.

nodes.name: _dispatch.py
nodes.summary: Scoped onboarding dispatcher: declares the exact/structure/meaning/relations search routes, decides which are ready per generation, is the one place that opens the managed Elasticsearch backend, and answers structured counts and aggregations.

nodes.name: _engine.py
nodes.summary: The Context Engine's main paths: preview and commit a folder after acceptance, scoped search with re-read checking and fusion, budgeted context assembly, passage fetch, refresh, revoke, checked deletion and source listing, all on local SQLite indexes.

nodes.name: _envelope.py
nodes.summary: Versioned Pydantic search envelope (g6.knowledge.search.v1): request, response, passage items with redacted views, per-backend state reports, contributions and denial records.

nodes.name: _fuse.py
nodes.summary: Reciprocal rank fusion keyed by canonical passage id that keeps every backend contribution, discounts duplicate lexical votes, groups near-duplicates with number/negation cautions, and refuses over-budget or too-many-candidate inputs.

nodes.name: StubRegistry
nodes.summary: Stand-in for the G6 registry's invoke contract that answers a formal check_validity call with a qualified-draft Success.

nodes.name: _evaluate
nodes.summary: Evaluates a small propositional expression under an assignment of Boolean symbols.

nodes.name: independent_truth_table_check
nodes.summary: Enumerates every valuation of the artifact's symbols to confirm the entailment, rejecting any countermodel.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Builds the claim, rubric and frozen verifier, runs the assurance orchestrator, and writes the candidate dossier JSON with a summary.

nodes.name: ScriptedModel
nodes.summary: Fake model returning a fixed probe JSON so the example is deterministic and offline.

nodes.name: approved_interview_reader
nodes.summary: Placeholder research tool returning a synthetic positive Observation for the interview question.

nodes.name: PlainPredictions
nodes.summary: Adapter that exposes a black-box model's predictions as a plain list for the bridge's distillation.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Runs the remembering and control sessions in separate processes and prints how the stored failed check changed the outcome.

nodes.name: _show
nodes.summary: Calls the claim check through the MCP reply path for one set of sources and prints the label and reasons.

nodes.name: _suite
nodes.summary: Runs the project's or held-out test suite in a repository and reports pass results.

nodes.name: _propose
nodes.summary: Applies one template change in its own git worktree, evaluates it, and lets the promotion governor merge or roll it back with its record kept.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Sets up a temporary git repo, runs the failing task, proposes the bad and good changes, and shows the later task using the merged change.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Walks the discovery path: finds and describes components, checks the email's claims, then gates the send action with and without a verification plan.

nodes.name: invoke
nodes.summary: Python door matching g6_invoke: merges per-call allowances with configured sensitive ops and calls invoke_checked through GuardedRegistry so labels and cloud consent are enforced.

nodes.name: Settings
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass of pacing policy numbers (reserve share, refresh interval, near-full share, parallelism cap) validated on construction.

nodes.name: advise
nodes.summary: Computes per-window pacing against weekly fractional objectives and returns a recommendation with reasons, defaulting to no extra optional agents when support or continuity is unknown.

nodes.name: context_note
nodes.summary: Formats the two providers' recommendations into one note and returns it only if its digest changed in the store.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Hook entry point printing the UserPromptSubmit additionalContext JSON, swallowing all errors.

nodes.name: absolute
nodes.summary: True for a path that names its own root, including the drive or share on Windows.

nodes.name: program
nodes.summary: Returns the absolute path to start for a command, looking only in absolute PATH folders and refusing relative paths.

nodes.name: _label_digest
nodes.summary: Hashes a provider-supplied label so its text is kept only as a digest.

nodes.name: _append_window
nodes.summary: Adds a normalised window to the list, handling ambiguous duplicate identities.

nodes.name: instant
nodes.summary: Parses a provider timestamp value into an aware UTC datetime, or None.

nodes.name: _window
nodes.summary: Builds one Window record from a raw provider window with declared semantics.

nodes.name: _normalise_window
nodes.summary: Validates and normalises allow-listed window fields (share used, reset time) into a Window.

nodes.name: codex_reading
nodes.summary: Turns a Codex rate-limit payload into a Reading for a profile.

nodes.name: claude_reading
nodes.summary: Turns a Claude status-line rate_limits payload into a Reading, keeping support undeclared.

nodes.name: capture_block
nodes.summary: Extracts only the allow-listed rate_limits block from a status-line payload for capture.

nodes.name: decode_renderer
nodes.summary: Decodes the base64-encoded renderer command token.

nodes.name: shell_argv
nodes.summary: Builds the argv that runs a command string through the given shell.

nodes.name: _quote
nodes.summary: Quotes an argument list for the target shell (POSIX or Windows forms).

nodes.name: preview
nodes.summary: Returns the proposed status-line config that wraps the person's existing renderer, without editing settings.

nodes.name: rollback
nodes.summary: Restores the original status-line config from the current one.

nodes.name: _observation_generation
nodes.summary: Looks up the profile binding generation an observation belongs to, within a timeout.

nodes.name: observe_payload
nodes.summary: Records a status-line payload's rate_limits block as an observation for the profile and generation.

nodes.name: observe_in_worker
nodes.summary: Starts a detached observer process under its own time budget and hands it the payload.

nodes.name: run_wrapper
nodes.summary: Runs the person's renderer first on the caller's handles, then the observer, never letting observer failure change renderer output.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Command-line entry dispatching wrapper or --observe mode from parsed arguments.

nodes.name: exit_code
nodes.summary: Maps the renderer's ending to the wrapper's exit code, with Windows handling.

nodes.name: _load
nodes.summary: Deserialises a stored JSON body into a Reading with its Window records and datetimes.

nodes.name: Store
nodes.summary: SQLite-backed store of readings, refresh claims, change-note digests and profile bindings, with transactional saves ordered by observation time and Claude observation capture.

nodes.name: refresh_codex
nodes.summary: Starts the Codex program at an absolute path to fetch its rate limits and saves the normalised reading.

nodes.name: start_refresh
nodes.summary: Claims a refresh slot and runs refresh_codex in a background thread when the interval has passed.

nodes.name: Route
nodes.summary: Frozen Pydantic record naming a search route, its backend and the operations it supports.

nodes.name: route
nodes.summary: Looks up a declared Route by name.

nodes.name: routes
nodes.summary: Reports every route for a project with whether it is ready and why not.

nodes.name: routes_for
nodes.summary: Selects the routes usable for a generation and destination, honouring local-only restrictions.

nodes.name: answered
nodes.summary: True when a generation's record says the backend read back what was written.

nodes.name: usable_registrations
nodes.summary: Lists the source registrations an access may use at a given time.

nodes.name: open_route
nodes.summary: Opens a route's backend for one generation, the only place the managed Elasticsearch backend is opened, filtered to permitted registrations.

nodes.name: _filters
nodes.summary: Builds the generation and registration filter clauses for an Elasticsearch query.

nodes.name: count
nodes.summary: Answers a scoped document count from the managed Elasticsearch generation, refusing partial shard answers.

nodes.name: aggregate
nodes.summary: Answers a typed aggregation over a closed set of fields, or unsupported when no managed generation exists.

nodes.name: checkpoint
nodes.summary: Named checkpoint hook used to observe engine steps.

nodes.name: Preview
nodes.summary: Record of a folder preview shown to the person before commit: counts, exclusions, nonce, expiry and retention.

nodes.name: copies_sentence
nodes.summary: Phrases where copies of the indexed content will be kept for the preview.

nodes.name: held_sentence
nodes.summary: Phrases what will be held and for how long for the preview.

nodes.name: _preview_of
nodes.summary: Builds a Preview from a walked folder, nonce, expiry and backends.

nodes.name: excluded_counts
nodes.summary: Counts excluded files by reason.

nodes.name: preview
nodes.summary: Walks a folder and writes a listing for the person to accept, returning the Preview.

nodes.name: discard_preview
nodes.summary: Removes a shown preview's listing file through the checked removal step.

nodes.name: _listings_of
nodes.summary: Finds preview listing files belonging to a project.

nodes.name: _carry
nodes.summary: Carries unchanged members from the previous generation into a staged one.

nodes.name: _purge
nodes.summary: Deletes a path and reports whether it is gone.

nodes.name: _build_generation
nodes.summary: Converts, chunks and indexes a registration's files into a new staged generation, in batches.

nodes.name: commit
nodes.summary: Registers and indexes a folder after the person accepted an unchanged preview.

nodes.name: shared_with
nodes.summary: True when a registration is granted to the access's destination.

nodes.name: scope_of
nodes.summary: Decides from the registry and grant ledger which registrations an access may read now, and which are withheld.

nodes.name: _reread
nodes.summary: Reads a member file again and converts it for comparison with an indexed hit.

nodes.name: reread_passage
nodes.summary: Returns the current passage text if it still matches the index, else marks it changed.

nodes.name: _route_hits
nodes.summary: Runs one route's search inside the scope on the published generation and reports the backend state.

nodes.name: _fused
nodes.summary: Core search loop: scope, route hits with oversampling, re-read checks with changed tombstones across rounds, then fusion into redacted items.

nodes.name: search
nodes.summary: Public search returning a SearchResponse for an access and request.

nodes.name: context
nodes.summary: Assembles a budgeted context pack for a task and saves it per destination.

nodes.name: pack
nodes.summary: Reloads a saved context pack, re-checking scope for the destination.

nodes.name: fetch
nodes.summary: Fetches one passage by id after scope and re-read checks.

nodes.name: _revoke_sharing
nodes.summary: Revokes cloud-consent grants tied to a registration.

nodes.name: revoke
nodes.summary: Marks a source registration revoked and withdraws its sharing.

nodes.name: refresh
nodes.summary: Rebuilds a registration's index generation from its current files.

nodes.name: delete
nodes.summary: Deletes a source and every file holding its bytes or names, reporting removal only when nothing is pending.

nodes.name: sources
nodes.summary: Lists the registered sources visible to an access with their states.

nodes.name: Denied
nodes.summary: A passage known to the destination that may no longer be used, with the reason.

nodes.name: Contribution
nodes.summary: One backend's rank and weight for a passage in fusion.

nodes.name: Checked
nodes.summary: Record that a passage was re-read and compared in the call that returned it.

nodes.name: PassageItem
nodes.summary: A search result item holding a redacted view of a passage, its citation, rank and contributions.

nodes.name: BackendReport
nodes.summary: A backend's state for a search (answered, empty, unavailable, failed, partial, unsupported, refused).

nodes.name: SearchRequest
nodes.summary: Versioned search request: query, routes and top_k.

nodes.name: SearchResponse
nodes.summary: Versioned search response carrying items, backend reports, withheld sources and denials.

nodes.name: Fused
nodes.summary: Fusion result: ranked items, contributions, backend reports, presentation groups, cautions, omissions and token count.

nodes.name: tokens_of
nodes.summary: Estimates the token cost of a passage item for budgeting.

nodes.name: fuse
nodes.summary: Reciprocal rank fusion of backend hits by passage id with deterministic tie-breaks, lexical double-vote discounting, near-duplicate grouping and budget/candidate refusals.

nodes.name: _graph.py
nodes.summary: First half of the Context Engine's passage-linked graph: builds scoped document/section/module nodes with 'contains' and static 'imports' edges, each tied to a witness passage, and traverses them while re-checking witnesses, registry use and disclosure grants so withheld nodes never leak through a path.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Python's ast module to find import statements and flags run-time imports (importlib, __import__) as unknown rather than guessing.

nodes.name: Node
nodes.summary: Frozen pydantic model for one graph node (document, section or module) scoped to a single source registration.

nodes.name: Edge
nodes.summary: Frozen pydantic model for a 'contains' or 'imports' edge carrying its witness passage id, offsets, hash and source version.

nodes.name: Path
nodes.summary: Model of one traversal result path: an ordered sequence of nodes and edges returned by traverse.

nodes.name: _imports
nodes.summary: Parses a Python text with ast and returns the modules named in import statements with their offsets, plus offsets of run-time import calls.

nodes.name: build
nodes.summary: Builds the graph for the published generation from usable registrations, checking before every file and before keeping the result that each source may still be used.

nodes.name: ensure
nodes.summary: Returns the stored graph for the current generation, building it when absent.

nodes.name: _witness_holds
nodes.summary: Re-reads an edge's witness passage and confirms the witnessed text and hash are still present.

nodes.name: traverse
nodes.summary: Walks contains/imports edges from a start node within hop and path limits, dropping any path with an unusable node or edge and refusing rather than truncating at limits.

nodes.name: _jobs.py
nodes.summary: Background indexing jobs that copy a source's passages into the optional managed Elasticsearch backend with per-item acknowledgements, resumable across server restarts and stopped as soon as the source is revoked or expired.
nodes.languageNotes: Jobs run on threading.Thread with a module-level lock and registry; idempotent upserts keyed by passage id make re-runs converge.

nodes.name: Job
nodes.summary: Pydantic record of one indexing job: backend, generation, state (queued/running/published/partial/failed) and unread files.

nodes.name: elastic_gate
nodes.summary: Builds the action gate for the managed Elasticsearch writer so each write proceeds only on g6.action_gating's allow decision.

nodes.name: status
nodes.summary: Returns a job's stored state, resuming jobs a stopped server left queued or running.

nodes.name: _passages
nodes.summary: Re-reads a registration's files and yields the passages to send, listing files that could not be read again.

nodes.name: run
nodes.summary: Executes one indexing job: batches passages to the backend, checks the source may still be used before every batch, reads back acknowledgements and records published, partial or failed.

nodes.name: start
nodes.summary: Queues and starts a job thread for an accepted backend of a usable registration, refusing backends the person's preview did not list.

nodes.name: ensure_running
nodes.summary: Restarts a queued or running job whose thread is no longer alive in this process.

nodes.name: resume
nodes.summary: Runs again every job a stopped server left queued or running; jobs for a superseded generation end failed.

nodes.name: held
nodes.summary: Lists every optional backend that received passages of a registration, with index and record counts, for deletion dialogs and receipts.

nodes.name: _lexical.py
nodes.summary: Scoped lexical reader over the SQLite FTS5 passage index: restricts matching to registrations in scope and scores hits itself with a scope-local BM25 so results never depend on out-of-scope sources.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses FTS5 only for row matching and computes its own BM25-style term weights, avoiding bm25() whose statistics span the whole table.

nodes.name: ScopedLexical
nodes.summary: FTS5-backed reader that lists held passage ids and finds top-k passages for a query restricted to in-scope registrations, excluding changed files before ranking and failing on timeout.

nodes.name: _planner.py
nodes.summary: Rule-based search planner that reads query features with regexes, orders admissible routes by fixed priorities, tracks per-need coverage (found/conflicting/missing/unknown) within fixed limits and logs hashed decision events.

nodes.name: Need
nodes.summary: An evidence need declared before a search, tracked for coverage.

nodes.name: Features
nodes.summary: Query features read by regular expression, with None for anything the planner cannot tell.

nodes.name: DecisionEvent
nodes.summary: Record of a planner run: routes chosen, coverage per need, limits and counts, stored as hashes without query or passage text.

nodes.name: features_of
nodes.summary: Extracts query features using regular expressions only.

nodes.name: admissible_routes
nodes.summary: Returns the search routes admissible for given query features.

nodes.name: plan
nodes.summary: Orders the admissible routes by a fixed priority rule in which each feature changes the order or admissibility.

nodes.name: _typed
nodes.summary: Reads a model's reformulation reply into typed search fields only, so it cannot name a source, filter or limit.

nodes.name: run
nodes.summary: Executes planned search rounds within fixed budgets and the access scope, optionally asks a consent-guarded model to reformulate, tracks coverage and returns a DecisionEvent.

nodes.name: _refresh.py
nodes.summary: Refresh pipeline that re-walks accepted folders, tombstones changed or removed files immediately, stages a new index generation with per-item receipts and publishes it atomically so no half state is ever served.

nodes.name: Reread
nodes.summary: Receipt of one re-read of a registration: the source version seen and when.

nodes.name: commit_of
nodes.summary: Returns the git commit a folder is at when it lies in a repository under permitted roots and is exactly that commit, else an empty string.

nodes.name: _compare
nodes.summary: Re-walks a registration and compares file hashes with its membership to find changed and removed files.

nodes.name: refresh
nodes.summary: Entry point for a refresh: compares active registrations, tombstones changes, stages and publishes the next generation, and reports content unavailable on failure.

nodes.name: _publish
nodes.summary: Publishes a staged generation in one transaction once every listed passage was read back.

nodes.name: _stage_and_publish
nodes.summary: Copies the current index into a staging generation, removes old passages of changed files, re-reads and adds new passages with receipts, then publishes.

nodes.name: _registry.py
nodes.summary: Per-project SQLite registry for the Context Engine holding source registrations, passage membership, generations, tombstones, receipts, snapshots, graphs, jobs and normative grants; ProjectStore.use is the single check every return path calls.
nodes.languageNotes: Every mutation is a BEGIN IMMEDIATE SQLite transaction so concurrent server processes observe a single event order.

nodes.name: Refused
nodes.summary: Exception carrying a stable G6_E_* code for refused registry operations.

nodes.name: Registration
nodes.summary: One folder a person accepted in the client dialog, with a random stable id, accepted backends, retention and expiry; never reactivated once revoked.

nodes.name: Member
nodes.summary: One file of one registration in one generation, with its hash and the ids and offsets of its passages.

nodes.name: Generation
nodes.summary: A staged, published or abandoned index generation number and state.

nodes.name: Tombstone
nodes.summary: Record written before deletion that denies a registration's (revoked) or one file's (changed) passages.

nodes.name: Receipt
nodes.summary: Per-item backend receipt with pending, acknowledged or read_back status.

nodes.name: Dependent
nodes.summary: A stored consumer (snapshot, grant, graph) registered against a source so it is invalidated when the source is revoked, changed or deleted.

nodes.name: may_use
nodes.summary: The registry's single predicate: returns an empty string when a registration may be used at a given time, or the reason it may not (revoked, expired, unknown).

nodes.name: is_kept
nodes.summary: Says whether a registration's retention keeps bytes for audit.

nodes.name: ProjectStore
nodes.summary: SQLite-backed per-project store with ~60 methods for registering and revoking sources, staging/publishing generations, receipts, pending removals, retained bytes, snapshots, graphs, proposed edges, jobs, normative grants, dependents, erasure and the use() check.

nodes.name: _relations.py
nodes.summary: Second half of the passage-linked graph: a consent-guarded model proposes typed relations between things a passage names, kept permanently as proposed leads, and leads() follows them to cited passages without granting them evidential weight.

nodes.name: Limits
nodes.summary: Budgets for extraction and lead following, including model-call count (default zero).

nodes.name: Mention
nodes.summary: A string a passage names, located by offsets in the canonical text.

nodes.name: ModelEdge
nodes.summary: A model-proposed relation between two mentions in one passage, always marked proposed and possible and bound to an exact source version.

nodes.name: _edge
nodes.summary: Turns one model-proposed row into a ModelEdge only when both mentions occur in the passage's canonical text.

nodes.name: extract
nodes.summary: Sends redacted passage views to a model through consent_callers.guard under cloud_consent.request_sources and stores the grounded proposed edges; off without a caller and budget.

nodes.name: leads
nodes.summary: Follows proposed edges from the things a query names inside the access scope, returning cited passages and proposal-marked paths; contradicts edges never compose.

nodes.name: _scope.py
nodes.summary: Host-bound scope for the Context Engine: builds a Binding from the server's start folder and the person's G6_KNOWLEDGE_ROOTS, and Access objects that can narrow but never widen what one operation may read.

nodes.name: ScopeDenied
nodes.summary: Exception raised with code G6_E_KNOWLEDGE_SCOPE when a binding is absent or a path lies outside permitted roots.

nodes.name: Binding
nodes.summary: Host facts for this server process: the project folder and the permitted roots the person listed.

nodes.name: Access
nodes.summary: One operation under a binding for one disclosure destination, optionally narrowed to some registrations; local() tells whether the destination is local.

nodes.name: _plain_folder
nodes.summary: Resolves a folder and rejects drive roots, the home folder and links.

nodes.name: host_binding
nodes.summary: Makes the process Binding from host facts only, denying when the start folder is unresolvable, the home folder or a filesystem root.

nodes.name: bound
nodes.summary: Returns the binding or raises ScopeDenied when it is absent.

nodes.name: access
nodes.summary: Creates an Access for one operation and destination, narrowed to given source registrations.

nodes.name: inside
nodes.summary: Resolves a path to its real location only when it is within a permitted root with no link on the way; otherwise raises ScopeDenied.

nodes.name: consent_scope
nodes.summary: Maps an access to the cloud_consent scope used for disclosure checks.

nodes.name: _snapshots.py
nodes.summary: Audit snapshots of search results for registrations with 'audit' retention, recording hashes, rendered views and component versions, and reconstructing excerpts later from content-addressed retained bytes or answering unavailable with a reason.

nodes.name: Snapshot
nodes.summary: Stored record of a search result for later reconstruction: items, grant revision, generation and versions.

nodes.name: versions
nodes.summary: Collects the converter, chunker, index schema and G6 versions for a generation.

nodes.name: write
nodes.summary: Writes a snapshot for audit-retained items of a search response and registers it as a dependent of its sources.

nodes.name: reconstruct
nodes.summary: Rebuilds rendered excerpts from retained bytes and compares them with the snapshot, or reports unavailable when the snapshot, bytes or source are gone or changed.

nodes.name: _support.py
nodes.summary: Attaches cited passages to behaviour-question candidates with separate relevance, byte-match and authority records, and records normative grants only from a person's confirmed answer so a passage may settle a question in one narrow case.

nodes.name: NormativeGrant
nodes.summary: A person-confirmed grant that a source version is normative for a repository and scenario; a stored consumer invalidated by revocation or change.

nodes.name: Support
nodes.summary: A passage beside a candidate with its relevance, byte_match and authority recorded separately.

nodes.name: designation_rule
nodes.summary: Formats the rule line offered in the behaviour form for designating a passage as normative.

nodes.name: support_for
nodes.summary: Searches under an access for passages that may accompany a candidate record and returns each with its three separate records.

nodes.name: may_suppress
nodes.summary: Allows a passage to settle a question only when it is normative and has no unresolved conflict.

nodes.name: designate
nodes.summary: Turns a confirmed rule answer from the question store into a NormativeGrant for a still-usable passage and registers it as a dependent.

nodes.name: _view.py
nodes.summary: Redacted views, the only form in which source text reaches a model-bound reply: applies g6.context.redact masks and keeps a span map back to canonical offsets.

nodes.name: View
nodes.summary: Masked text with a masked-count and spans mapping unmasked view runs to canonical offsets.

nodes.name: view_of
nodes.summary: Applies every redaction mask to a text and returns a View whose spans map back to canonical positions.

nodes.name: _walk.py
nodes.summary: Folder walker deciding which files may be indexed and why others may not (credentials, git-ignored, links, cloud placeholders, size and count caps), checking names and status before opening and hashing read files.

nodes.name: FileEntry
nodes.summary: A readable file found by the walk: relative path, size and hash.

nodes.name: Excluded
nodes.summary: A file the walk refused, with the reason it was excluded.

nodes.name: Walked
nodes.summary: Walk result: files, exclusions, enumerated/read/read_bytes counts, ignored_by source and note.

nodes.name: folder_rule
nodes.summary: Returns why nothing is read under a folder of a given name ('credential' or 'ignored'), or an empty string.

nodes.name: named_under_refused
nodes.summary: Checks textually whether a path names or lies below a refused folder, normalising Windows trailing dots, spaces and stream suffixes.

nodes.name: shown_name
nodes.summary: Renders a file name for display, escaping invalid Unicode units.

nodes.name: read_file
nodes.summary: Reads a file up to a byte limit, refusing when its status changed since it was listed or it could not be read to the end.

nodes.name: tracked
nodes.summary: Asks git (via ctx_git's hardened runner) for non-ignored files under a root inside a permitted repository, or returns None and the reason.

nodes.name: walk
nodes.summary: Walks a folder under the binding, applying every exclusion rule before opening a file, then reads and hashes allowed files and reports counts.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package entry for abstraction engineering over costly black-box search; documents the capability and its limits and lazily imports public names (PEP 562) so the package loads without numpy or Hypothesis.
nodes.languageNotes: Module-level __getattr__/__dir__ (PEP 562) map public names to submodules on first access and raise an install hint when optional dependencies are missing.

nodes.name: __getattr__
nodes.summary: Lazily imports a public name from its submodule, raising an ImportError with the install command when optional extras are absent.

nodes.name: abstractions.py
nodes.summary: Defines the Abstraction interface (fit, covers, bound, prune, refine, spec) and its incremental combinator mechanisms Quotient, Project, Sufficient and Product, plus from_spec which validates untrusted specs against resource limits.
nodes.languageNotes: Incremental fitting absorbs only new trace records, keeping streaming refits linear rather than quadratic.

nodes.name: Abstraction
nodes.summary: Base class for abstractions with incremental fit over a domain trace, coverage, cell bounds, safe pruning, CEGAR refine, spec and MDL bits.

nodes.name: Quotient
nodes.summary: Ball-based quotient abstraction grouping nearby configs with Lipschitz-style bounds; refines by halving a radius.

nodes.name: Project
nodes.summary: Projection abstraction keying configs by binned selected dimensions; refines by doubling resolution.

nodes.name: Sufficient
nodes.summary: Sufficient-statistic abstraction over one dimension's arms using UCB-style bounds.

nodes.name: Product
nodes.summary: Composite abstraction combining two abstractions' cells and taking the tighter bound.

nodes.name: from_spec
nodes.summary: Constructs an abstraction from a JSON spec after validating it against hard resource limits, treating the spec as untrusted input.

nodes.name: cegar.py
nodes.summary: CEGAR loop for abstractions: collects soundness counterexamples from the gate and replay regret plus precision counterexamples, refines until none remain within an iteration cap, and tightens Lipschitz constants under gate and robustness checks.

nodes.name: CexReport
nodes.summary: Report of soundness and precision counterexamples for an abstraction.

nodes.name: RefineResult
nodes.summary: Outcome of refine_until: final abstraction, iterations and remaining counterexamples.

nodes.name: TightenResult
nodes.summary: Outcome of tighten_until: the tightened abstraction and Lipschitz scale reached.

nodes.name: find_counterexamples
nodes.summary: Runs the gate and replay to gather soundness counterexamples and finds wide-range cells as precision counterexamples.

nodes.name: refine_until
nodes.summary: Repeatedly applies the abstraction's own split operator on the worst soundness counterexample until none remain or the cap is hit.

nodes.name: tighten_until
nodes.summary: Scales down Lipschitz constants while the gate passes and bootstrap replay stays regret-free, keeping the tightest sound version.

nodes.name: diagnostics.py
nodes.summary: Self-diagnosis of the abstraction harness: audits library entries and domains for inert mechanisms, miscalibrated bounds, staleness, winner's curse, degenerate entries and underpowered meta-domains, each finding naming the next tool call.

nodes.name: Finding
nodes.summary: One diagnostic finding with code, severity, explanation and remediation tool call.

nodes.name: Diagnosis
nodes.summary: Collection of findings with a serialisable summary.

nodes.name: diagnose
nodes.summary: Runs every diagnostic check over a Library and its domains and returns a Diagnosis of machine-actionable findings.

nodes.name: domain.py
nodes.summary: Concrete stratum for abstraction search: parameter specs, evaluated records and ConcreteDomain loaded from rows, CSV or JSON, with the objective treated strictly as data (evaluator isolation).

nodes.name: ParamSpec
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass describing one search-space dimension with validation and normalisation.

nodes.name: Record
nodes.summary: One evaluated configuration and its objective value in trace order.

nodes.name: ConcreteDomain
nodes.summary: Parameter space plus evaluation trace with constructors from rows/CSV/JSON, score direction, best record, vectorisation, append and describe.

nodes.name: hyperparam_trace.csv
nodes.summary: Example evaluation trace of 120 hyperparameter configurations (lr, batch, depth, wd) with validation bits-per-byte as the objective, used as a sample ConcreteDomain input.

nodes.name: g6_adapter.py
nodes.summary: Adapter that wraps abstraction-MCP verdicts in the G6 wire envelope, mapping the module's status lattice down-only onto qualified-draft or blocked-escalated (never the `verified` state) with a warning card, evidence, request_id and run_id.

nodes.name: surface_state
nodes.summary: Total, deterministic down-only map from a module status to (completion_state, badge, oracle_strength), failing closed on unknown statuses.

nodes.name: _entry_data
nodes.summary: Extracts the gate, replay, robustness and MDL data of a library entry for the envelope.

nodes.name: _json_safe
nodes.summary: Recursively converts values to JSON-safe forms, replacing non-finite floats and unknown types.

nodes.name: _hard_blocked_envelope
nodes.summary: Builds a blocked-escalated envelope used when the verdict cannot be read safely.

nodes.name: attach_abstraction_envelope
nodes.summary: Public entry that attaches a G6 envelope to an abstraction tool payload, falling back to the hard-blocked envelope on any error.

nodes.name: _build_envelope
nodes.summary: Assembles completion_state, warning_card (counterexamples and regret events), evidence (calibration, robustness, MDL) and ids for an entry.

nodes.name: gate.py
nodes.summary: Property-based gate that empirically checks an abstraction's extensivity, monotonicity and bound soundness (failing closed on aborted checks), plus counterfactual replay of the recorded trace to measure value gain, evaluations saved and regret events.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Hypothesis for property-based checks of proof obligations.

nodes.name: GateReport
nodes.summary: Result of the gate: pass/fail per obligation, counterexamples and calibration data.

nodes.name: run_gate
nodes.summary: Discharges extensivity, monotonicity and bound-sound obligations with property-based testing and returns a GateReport.

nodes.name: _run
nodes.summary: Runs one Hypothesis property and reports whether it held, aborted or failed.

nodes.name: ReplayReport
nodes.summary: Counterfactual replay result: best with/without the abstraction, evaluations saved, regret events and value gain.

nodes.name: replay
nodes.summary: Replays the trace in order, skipping configs the abstraction would prune and refunding their budget, and records regret when a pruned config beat the incumbent.

nodes.name: library.py
nodes.summary: Persistent abstraction library with a status lattice (rejected, degenerate, provisional, checked) assigned from gate, replay, bootstrap robustness and MDL results, with staleness tracking, leaderboard and JSON persistence.

nodes.name: LibraryEntry
nodes.summary: One evaluated abstraction with status, scores, evaluation trace length and staleness, serialisable to and from dicts.

nodes.name: Library
nodes.summary: Evaluates abstractions through gate, replay, bootstrap and MDL to assign a status with Bonferroni-adjusted selection pressure, and offers leaderboard, promotion, instantiation and save/load (mapping legacy 'verified' to 'checked').

nodes.name: lift.py
nodes.summary: The Lift functor: featurises abstraction specs into a meta-domain whose objective is recorded library scores, so trace-generic mechanisms apply at the meta level, with a liftability check on referenced dimensions.

nodes.name: _featurise
nodes.summary: Flattens a possibly nested abstraction spec into numeric features (kind, depth, radius, lipschitz, bins, arms).

nodes.name: meta_domain
nodes.summary: Builds a ConcreteDomain from library entries using featurised specs as configs and their scores as the objective.

nodes.name: referenced_dims
nodes.summary: Collects the dimension names a spec reads, including inside compositions.

nodes.name: liftable
nodes.summary: Says whether an abstraction is trace-generic and every dimension it names exists in the meta-domain.

nodes.name: lift
nodes.summary: Applies a liftable abstraction to the meta-domain, refusing ineligible ones.

nodes.name: mdl.py
nodes.summary: Two-part MDL proxy for abstractions: compares raw trace code length with cell naming plus residual precision plus spec length, for relative comparison of candidates on the same trace.

nodes.name: _bits_per_config
nodes.summary: Raw bit cost of one configuration at full precision per parameter type.

nodes.name: MDLReport
nodes.summary: MDL result with raw and abstracted bits, compression ratio and net bits saved.

nodes.name: score
nodes.summary: Computes the MDLReport of an abstraction fitted on a domain's trace.

nodes.name: pruning.py
nodes.summary: Guarded prune/no-prune advice for fresh configurations, shared with the MCP advise_pruning tool; every guard (support distance, status, staleness, session evidence) can only turn pruning off.

nodes.name: support_distance
nodes.summary: Normalised L-infinity distance from a config to the nearest evaluated record.

nodes.name: advise_pruning
nodes.summary: Returns prune advice for candidate configs from a library entry, applying guards that can only veto pruning and naming the re-evaluation needed for stale evidence.

nodes.name: robustness.py
nodes.summary: Robust valuation against winner's curse and ordering luck: bootstrap replay over trace permutations reporting the benefit distribution, total regret and a Bonferroni selection-adjusted lower confidence bound.

nodes.name: RobustReport
nodes.summary: Bootstrap result: benefit distribution, total regret across permutations and selection-adjusted lower bound.

nodes.name: bootstrap_replay
nodes.summary: Replays a fresh copy of the abstraction under K trace permutations and summarises benefit and regret into a RobustReport.

nodes.name: server.py
nodes.summary: FastMCP stdio server exposing the reflective abstraction harness as tools: load a trace, propose and gate abstractions, evaluate, CEGAR refinement, leaderboard, guarded pruning advice, self-diagnosis and state persistence. File tools are refused unless the operator allows them via G6_MCP_SENSITIVE and paths stay inside ABSTRACTION_MCP_DIR.
nodes.languageNotes: Wraps mcp.tool() so tool descriptions use inspect.cleandoc, keeping docstrings identical across Python 3.12 and 3.13; disables FastMCP's implicit .env loading.

nodes.name: FileRefused
nodes.summary: ValueError subclass raised when a file tool or path is not allowed by the operator, carrying a stable G6_E_* error code.

nodes.name: _inside_dir
nodes.summary: Resolves a path and checks that it lies inside the operator-declared ABSTRACTION_MCP_DIR directory.

nodes.name: load_dataset
nodes.summary: MCP tool that loads a trace of evaluated configurations and scores (CSV/JSON) from an allowed path into a named ConcreteDomain.

nodes.name: describe_domain
nodes.summary: MCP tool returning a description of a loaded concrete domain.

nodes.name: list_combinators
nodes.summary: MCP tool listing the available abstraction combinators (Quotient, Project, Sufficient, Product) and their spec shapes.

nodes.name: propose_abstraction
nodes.summary: MCP tool that parses an abstraction spec, builds it and runs the soundness gate, returning gate feedback.

nodes.name: evaluate_abstraction
nodes.summary: MCP tool that gates, replays and scores an abstraction spec on a domain and records it in the library with a status.

nodes.name: find_counterexamples
nodes.summary: MCP tool searching for counterexamples to a library entry's abstraction.

nodes.name: refine_abstraction
nodes.summary: MCP tool running counterexample-guided refinement on a library entry until it passes or iterations run out.

nodes.name: leaderboard
nodes.summary: MCP tool returning library entries ranked status-first, optionally including superseded ones.

nodes.name: advise_pruning
nodes.summary: MCP tool giving guarded pruning advice for candidate configurations against an incumbent; guards can force prune=False with reasons.

nodes.name: record_evaluation
nodes.summary: MCP tool appending a new evaluated configuration and objective to a domain's trace (active mode).

nodes.name: revalidate
nodes.summary: MCP tool re-evaluating a library entry's spec against the current trace.

nodes.name: lift_abstraction
nodes.summary: MCP tool lifting an abstraction to the meta-domain of the search over abstractions.

nodes.name: tighten_abstraction
nodes.summary: MCP tool iteratively tightening a library entry's bound using the CEGAR tighten loop.

nodes.name: self_debug
nodes.summary: MCP tool running rounds of diagnose-and-remediate over the harness's own decisions, applying machine-actionable fixes.

nodes.name: diagnose
nodes.summary: MCP tool auditing the harness's own verification decisions (inert mechanisms, staleness, winner's curse, miscalibration).

nodes.name: save_state
nodes.summary: MCP tool persisting domains and library state to an allowed file path.

nodes.name: load_state
nodes.summary: MCP tool restoring domains and library state from an allowed file path.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Entry point that runs the FastMCP server over stdio.

nodes.name: SKILL.md
nodes.summary: Agent skill guide for g6.abstraction: when to use abstraction engineering for costly black-box search, the Python API, reading results, composition, failure modes caught, blind spots, requirements, examples and open problems.

nodes.name: __init__.py

nodes.name: action_gating_block.py

nodes.name: BudgetPolicyInput
nodes.summary: Pydantic input model for an operation-budget policy request.

nodes.name: ActionGatingInput
nodes.summary: Pydantic input model for the action-gating block covering the action, op selector and budget fields.

nodes.name: ActionGatingBlock
nodes.summary: AIBlock that runs evaluate_action or budget operations on its input and returns a gate decision envelope; never executes the action.

nodes.name: audit_store.py

nodes.languageNotes: Domain-separated hash chain (prev_hash plus record JSON) makes any edited or deleted row detectable on verify.

nodes.name: ActionGateAuditStore
nodes.summary: SQLite-backed append-only audit log with hash chaining, lookups by audit/action id, recent listing, chain integrity checks and anchor export; offers a process-wide default instance.

nodes.name: audit.py
nodes.summary: Action-gating audit logger that keeps records in memory and optionally persists them to the durable ActionGateAuditStore, raising on durable-write failure so the gate fails closed.

nodes.name: audit_required
nodes.summary: Decides whether a capsule and its gate decision must be audited.

nodes.name: ActionGateAuditLogger
nodes.summary: Builds ActionGateAuditRecord entries with provenance and capability data, storing them in memory and in an optional durable store.

nodes.name: capabilities.py
nodes.summary: Discovers which action-gating capabilities are available and normalises missing ones into DegradationNotice records with severity levels.

nodes.name: build_degradation_notice
nodes.summary: Builds a DegradationNotice for missing or unavailable capabilities with severity and an execution-blocking flag.

nodes.name: degradation_level
nodes.summary: Maps a degradation notice to its severity level.

nodes.name: discover_capabilities
nodes.summary: Reports the action gate's available capabilities (including audit availability) and any degradation.

nodes.name: classifiers.py
nodes.summary: Deterministic classifiers that rate an action capsule's reversibility and impact into an ImpactAssessment.

nodes.name: classify_reversibility
nodes.summary: Classifies whether an action capsule is reversible, costly to reverse or irreversible.

nodes.name: classify_impact
nodes.summary: Computes an impact assessment and risk level for a capsule from its declared side effects, reach and reversibility.

nodes.name: component_metadata.yaml
nodes.summary: Component registry metadata for action_gating: license, owner, docs path, medium risk level, no allowed autonomy and extension-revert rollback.

nodes.name: decision_engine.py
nodes.summary: Core of the action gate: normalises an action, classifies risk, runs factual-precondition, verification-contract, coordination, weak-signal, hypothesis, scope and safeguard checks, and folds them into a GateDecision with reason codes, warning card, evidence and a fail-closed audit record.
nodes.languageNotes: Decisions only ever tighten via tighten_decision/_raise_severity, so optional checks and declared context can raise but never lower a hold.

nodes.name: _confirmation_phrase
nodes.summary: Derives the exact confirmation phrase a person must type for a confirmation-gated action.

nodes.name: _warning_card
nodes.summary: Builds the cross-surface warning_card for a completion state and degradation.

nodes.name: tighten_decision
nodes.summary: Raises a gate decision to a stricter outcome and appends a reason code and item, never loosening it.

nodes.name: _precondition_criticality
nodes.summary: Determines how critical a capsule's factual preconditions are given its risk.

nodes.name: _evaluate_factual_preconditions
nodes.summary: Checks declared factual preconditions against their evidence and returns the decision tightening they require.

nodes.name: _is_material_action
nodes.summary: Decides whether an action is material (external, irreversible or real-world).

nodes.name: _not_evaluated
nodes.summary: Produces the block or review outcome for a material action that omitted a check's required context.

nodes.name: _evaluate_verification_contract
nodes.summary: Runs the action_logic verification-contract control over the capsule's declared contract.

nodes.name: _evaluate_coordination
nodes.summary: Runs the coordination control from action_logic on the capsule's coordination context.

nodes.name: _evaluate_weak_signals
nodes.summary: Evaluates world-state weak signals and threshold breaches through action_logic controls.

nodes.name: _evaluate_hypotheses
nodes.summary: Evaluates declared hypotheses against evidence when the hypothesis gate is enabled.

nodes.name: decide_gate
nodes.summary: Main decision function combining risk, scenarios, mitigation, uncertainty matrix, user model, safety QA, degradation and key approval into a GateDecision with completion_state, warning card and evidence.

nodes.name: evaluate_optional_checks
nodes.summary: Applies optional harm-judge and CSF finite-model checks that can only tighten an existing decision.

nodes.name: _default_audit_logger
nodes.summary: Builds the default audit logger backed by the durable audit store, degrading if it is unavailable.

nodes.name: evaluate_action
nodes.summary: Public entry point: normalises an action dict, classifies it, builds scenario/mitigation/uncertainty/QA models, decides the gate, applies safeguards and scope, and writes the audit record.

nodes.name: explain.py
nodes.summary: Renders a plain-language risk message for a person from an action capsule and its gate decision.

nodes.name: render_user_risk_message
nodes.summary: Formats the gate decision, risk and required confirmation into a human-readable message.

nodes.name: honesty.py
nodes.summary: Registers two honesty detectors for the action-gating block that flag metadata inheriting an unproven parent and simulated execution presented as real.

nodes.name: detect_alias_inherits_unproven_parent
nodes.summary: Detector flagging block output whose metadata discloses a review-pending, unproven-parent inheritance.

nodes.name: detect_simulated_presented_as_real
nodes.summary: Detector flagging output that reports a `verified` completion state while its execution result is only simulated.

nodes.name: mitigation.py
nodes.summary: Decides when a mitigation plan is required and builds a MitigationPlan for risky actions from the capsule and scenario model.

nodes.name: mitigation_required
nodes.summary: Predicate deciding whether a capsule at a given risk needs a mitigation plan.

nodes.name: build_mitigation_plan
nodes.summary: Builds a MitigationPlan listing safeguards and rollback steps for a risky action.

nodes.name: native_ops.py
nodes.summary: Constrained backend-native operations for the gate: discover, describe, dry-run and evaluate backend ops, issue single-use gate tokens bound to a capsule hash, and execute an op only against a valid, unconsumed token in a simulated executor.

nodes.name: GateToken
nodes.summary: Dataclass holding an issued gate token, its capsule hash and expiry.

nodes.name: _envelope
nodes.summary: Builds the standard response envelope with completion_state, G6_E_* error code, evidence and extras.

nodes.name: discover_backend_ops
nodes.summary: Lists the native operations a backend exposes.

nodes.name: describe_backend_op
nodes.summary: Returns the descriptor of one backend-native operation.

nodes.name: dry_run_backend_op
nodes.summary: Dry-runs a backend op through normalisation and gating without executing it.

nodes.name: evaluate_backend_op
nodes.summary: Runs evaluate_action on a backend op converted to an action capsule.

nodes.name: issue_gate_token
nodes.summary: Issues a single-use, expiring gate token bound to an allowed capsule's hash and persists it in the token store.

nodes.name: execute_backend_op
nodes.summary: Executes a backend op only after checking global safety approval, audit availability and a valid unconsumed gate token matching the capsule hash; returns an envelope.

nodes.name: normalizer.py
nodes.summary: Normalises a raw action dict into an ActionCapsule: applies per-action-type risk profiles and safety floors that declared facts can only raise, flags secret-looking paths, normalises preconditions and verification contracts, and assigns a stable action id.

nodes.name: has_profile
nodes.summary: Reports whether an action type has a built-in risk profile.

nodes.name: _secret_looking
nodes.summary: Detects whether a file path looks like it holds secrets or credentials.

nodes.name: secret_looking_path
nodes.summary: Returns whether a capsule targets a secret-looking path.

nodes.name: _checkpoint
nodes.summary: Classifies a request/target into a checkpoint category used by the profile lookup.

nodes.name: _floors
nodes.summary: Computes safety floors for an action type that declared fields cannot go below.

nodes.name: _normalize_preconditions
nodes.summary: Normalises raw factual preconditions into FactualPrecondition models.

nodes.name: _normalize_verification_contract
nodes.summary: Normalises a raw verification contract into its model.

nodes.name: _normalize_optional_model
nodes.summary: Normalises an optional declared-context model, tolerating missing values.

nodes.name: normalize_action_capsule
nodes.summary: Builds a fully normalised ActionCapsule from a raw action dict, applying profiles, floors and stable ids.

nodes.name: operation_budget.py

nodes.name: BudgetRefused
nodes.summary: Exception raised when an operation exceeds its budget.

nodes.name: BudgetResult
nodes.summary: Result of a budget check with decision, completion state and envelope serialisation.

nodes.name: _result
nodes.summary: Builds a BudgetResult for an operation check with remaining count and code.

nodes.name: _exclusive_ledger_lock
nodes.summary: Context manager taking an exclusive cross-process file lock on the budget ledger.

nodes.name: OperationBudget
nodes.summary: Holds per-run policy limits, checks and records operation use against the ledger, reports usage and offers a guarded wrapper.

nodes.name: provenance.py
nodes.summary: Canonical evidence-provenance vocabulary (model, tool, formal, human approval) so audit records state what backed each entry, covering both the action-gating trail and CSF safety decisions.

nodes.name: EvidenceProvenance
nodes.summary: Enum of provenance classes ranked human approval, formal, tool, model.

nodes.name: classify_provenance
nodes.summary: Picks the most authoritative provenance class from approval, formal and tool signals.

nodes.name: classify_audit_record
nodes.summary: Classifies a stored audit record's provenance from its approval receipt and actor/backend fields.

nodes.name: classify_csf_provenance
nodes.summary: Classifies a CSF decision as formal when Z3 or Lean checks backed it.

nodes.name: provenance_for_decision
nodes.summary: Returns the provenance class for a capsule and its gate decision.

nodes.name: qa.py
nodes.summary: Builds the SafetyQAAssurance checklist for an action from its mitigation plan, degradation and required confirmation phrase.

nodes.name: run_safety_qa
nodes.summary: Assembles safety QA assurance results for a capsule, mitigation plan and degradation state.

nodes.name: safeguards.py

nodes.name: Outcome
nodes.summary: StrEnum of safeguard outcomes ordered by strictness.

nodes.name: _freeze
nodes.summary: Recursively freezes mappings and sequences into immutable structures for the interaction context.

nodes.name: InteractionContext
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass describing the proposed action that safeguards inspect.

nodes.name: Safeguard

nodes.name: fold
nodes.summary: Folds a set of safeguard outcomes to the strictest one.

nodes.name: InterceptionResult

nodes.name: Interceptor

nodes.name: scenario_modeler.py

nodes.name: scenario_required

nodes.name: build_action_scenarios
nodes.summary: Builds the scenario model for an action from its capsule fields and risk.

nodes.name: schema.py

nodes.name: FactualEvidenceRef
nodes.summary: Reference to evidence supporting a factual precondition.

nodes.name: FactualPrecondition

nodes.name: VerificationContractModel

nodes.name: WorldStateModel
