nodes.summary: Assembles the final review-record envelope with code, reason and evidence state.

nodes.name: SKILL.md
nodes.summary: Agent skill guide for the G6 action gate: when to gate outward actions, the ops (evaluate, budget, scope, safeguards), reading the decision result, composition, failure modes caught, blind spots, requirements, examples and open problems.

nodes.name: token_store.py
nodes.summary: SQLite-backed durable gate-token ledger persisting policy decisions and audit records and atomically consuming single-use gate tokens.

nodes.name: ActionGatingStore
nodes.summary: SQLite store that persists gate authorisations, loads them and consumes gate tokens exactly once.

nodes.name: uncertainty.py
nodes.summary: Decides when an uncertainty analysis is needed and builds a RumsfeldMatrix of known and unknown factors for a risky action.

nodes.name: rumsfeld_required
nodes.summary: Predicate deciding whether a capsule at a given risk needs a Rumsfeld uncertainty matrix.

nodes.name: build_rumsfeld_matrix
nodes.summary: Builds the known/unknown uncertainty matrix for an action from its declared fields.

nodes.name: user_model.py
nodes.summary: Builds a templated user mental-model note for risk communication from an action capsule's declared flags; nothing about the user is measured, so no confidence is reported.

nodes.name: estimate_user_mental_model
nodes.summary: Returns a UserMentalModelEstimate whose goal, assumptions, misunderstandings, missing acknowledgements and consent quality are fixed text chosen from whether the capsule has external, irreversible or real-world effects.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package entry for the action-logic component: declares its G6 component metadata (block, mitigated failure modes) and re-exports the deterministic Doerner controls, hypothesis controls, schema types and the core decision-record and objective-contract primitives.
nodes.languageNotes: Python package __init__ used as a barrel plus module-level dunder declarations (__g6_component__, __g6_mitigates__) read by the G6 registry.

nodes.name: block.py
nodes.summary: Generic-invoke block over the action-logic controls: each op rebuilds frozen records from caller JSON, calls the existing deterministic control unchanged and answers in the action gate's notice/review/block severity vocabulary.

nodes.name: _fields_ok
nodes.summary: Checks that a caller-supplied record holds only the fields its frozen dataclass accepts and has every required field, raising a refusal with a stable error code otherwise.

nodes.name: ActionLogicInput
nodes.summary: Pydantic input model for the action-logic block: the op name and the caller-declared records (contract, actions, world state, hypotheses, outcome) each op needs.

nodes.name: ActionLogicBlock
nodes.summary: AIBlock subclass that dispatches an ActionLogicInput to the matching control op and wraps the answer, or a field refusal, in a Result envelope.

nodes.name: component_metadata.yaml
nodes.summary: Component metadata for action_logic: Apache-2.0 licence, reliability-platform owner, its design doc path, related components, high risk level, no allowed autonomy and stateless rollback.

nodes.name: controls.py
nodes.summary: Deterministic, LLM-free action-logic controls after Doerner's Logic of Failure: blocks ballistic material actions without a verification contract, detects collisions between concurrent actions, sequences separable ones, flags deteriorating weak signals and checks crisis monitoring.

nodes.name: evaluate_verification_contract
nodes.summary: Blocks a material action whose verification contract lacks a monitor, verification window, rollback or future horizon (ballistic-action prevention, G6-INV-05).

nodes.name: _interval
nodes.summary: Parses an ISO-8601 interval time window into a start/end pair, returning None for opaque bucket tokens.

nodes.name: _windows_overlap
nodes.summary: Decides whether two action time windows overlap, comparing ISO intervals or equal bucket tokens and treating anything unparseable as overlapping.

nodes.name: detect_conflicts
nodes.summary: Finds collisions between a proposed action and active ones: contradictory objectives, duplicate effects, resource contention in overlapping windows, combined budget breaches, invalidated assumptions and reused ids.

nodes.name: evaluate_coordination
nodes.summary: Turns detected conflicts for a material action into a severity and reason codes (coordinated interventions, G6-INV-08).

nodes.name: sequence_if_separable
nodes.summary: Returns a one-at-a-time order of action ids that removes resource contention, or None when single-action budget breaches, duplicate effects or reused ids make ordering insufficient.

nodes.name: is_deteriorating
nodes.summary: Reports whether a control variable's trend is moving toward its threshold.

nodes.name: is_breached
nodes.summary: Reports whether a control variable has already crossed its threshold.

nodes.name: assess_weak_signals
nodes.summary: Raises review or block severity for a world state with deteriorating or breached control variables a material action does not address, or with no future horizon.

nodes.name: check_crisis_monitoring
nodes.summary: Blocks when monitoring coverage during a crisis falls below its baseline in any dimension and asks for review when the baseline records nothing (G6-INV-06; not called by any gate).

nodes.name: assess_material_action
nodes.summary: Runs the verification-contract, coordination and weak-signal controls together for one action and combines them monotonically so the most restrictive severity wins.

nodes.name: hypotheses.py
nodes.summary: Deterministic hypothesis-reflection controls: apply outcomes to hypotheses (success only supports, disconfirmation falsifies stickily), flag disconfirming evidence for review and block reliance on a falsified hypothesis without a well-formed replacement.

nodes.name: update_on_outcome
nodes.summary: Returns a new hypothesis record updated by an observed outcome: confirmation moves it to supported with capped confidence, disconfirmation or harm falsifies it, and a falsified one stays falsified.

nodes.name: apply_disconfirming_evidence
nodes.summary: Records a disconfirming note on a hypothesis, halving its confidence and marking it weakened unless it is already falsified.

nodes.name: disconfirming_evidence_severity
nodes.summary: Answers review when an active hypothesis carries disconfirming evidence and is not yet falsified (AT-08).

nodes.name: _is_valid_replacement
nodes.summary: Checks that a replacement hypothesis is well formed, has a new statement and brings new non-blank evidence of its own.

nodes.name: reauthorisation_severity
nodes.summary: Blocks an action relying on a falsified hypothesis unless a new, well-formed, evidence-backed hypothesis replaces it (AT-12).

nodes.name: reauthorisation_severity_from_registry
nodes.summary: Looks up the relied-on hypothesis in a caller-supplied mapping and delegates to reauthorisation_severity.

nodes.name: _with
nodes.summary: Builds a copy of a frozen hypothesis with a changed status, confidence and evidence lists.

nodes.name: schema.py
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass input/output types for the action-logic controls (verification contracts, action intents, conflicts, control variables, world state, monitoring coverage, hypotheses, outcomes, assessments) plus the shared notice/review/block severity ladder.
nodes.languageNotes: Plain frozen dataclasses (not Pydantic) keep the control floor a pure, deterministic function set.

nodes.name: raise_severity
nodes.summary: Monotonically combines two severities so an already raised severity is never lowered.

nodes.name: VerificationContract
nodes.summary: Closed-loop plan for a material action (monitor, verification window, rollback, horizon) with checks for which elements are missing and whether it is complete.

nodes.name: ActionIntent
nodes.summary: Declared action with its objective, effects, resources, budget costs, time window, idempotency and assumptions, used for conflict detection.

nodes.name: ActionConflict
nodes.summary: One detected collision between two actions, with its kind and detail, serialisable to a dict.

nodes.name: ControlVariable
nodes.summary: A monitored world variable with its current value, threshold and trend.

nodes.name: WorldState
nodes.summary: Caller-declared snapshot of control variables and future horizons for weak-signal assessment.

nodes.name: MonitoringCoverage
nodes.summary: Monitoring coverage across dimensions, compared between a baseline and a crisis.

nodes.name: HypothesisStatus
nodes.summary: Enum of hypothesis states (active, supported, weakened, falsified and so on).

nodes.name: Hypothesis
nodes.summary: Frozen hypothesis record with statement, status, confidence and supporting/disconfirming evidence, a well-formedness check and dict serialisation.

nodes.name: Outcome
nodes.summary: An observed outcome label and evidence applied to a hypothesis.

nodes.name: ActionLogicAssessment
nodes.summary: Result of a control: severity, reason codes and evidence items, with a blocks() test and dict serialisation.

nodes.name: SKILL.md
nodes.summary: Agent skill for g6-action-logic: when to check a large or hard-to-undo step for a complete observe/stop/rollback plan, collisions, ignored warnings or reliance on a disproved hypothesis, with the op list and how to read the notice/review/block answers.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Marks the agents family package, whose sub-packages are extensions that run other agent runtimes behind one interface with permissions, limits and the action gate; the package itself is not a component.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Barrel for the agents family's shared runtime, re-exporting the task model, ToolGate, run_agent and AgentRuntime, CliAgentRunner, GatedCalls, the circuit breaker and the stable G6_E_AGENT_* codes that every adapter imports.

nodes.name: breaker.py
nodes.summary: Thread-safe, model-free three-state circuit breaker for one agent adapter, treating rate limits and timeouts as transient back-offs and server errors as failures so a probe is always released.

nodes.name: is_transient_provider_error
nodes.summary: Classifies an error as transient (HTTP 408/429 or rate-limit/timeout wording) so it backs off without counting toward opening the circuit.

nodes.name: CircuitState
nodes.summary: Enum of the breaker states CLOSED, OPEN and HALF_OPEN.

nodes.name: CircuitBreaker
nodes.summary: Dataclass circuit breaker with injectable clock: opens after consecutive failures, half-opens after a cooldown for one probe at a time, and records successes, failures, inconclusive and transient outcomes under a lock.

nodes.name: cli.py
nodes.summary: CliAgentRunner, the single way a user-installed command-line agent is started: located on PATH or via its env variable, run through component_process with a clean environment, prompt on stdin from a file, output to a capped file and a deadline that ends its process tree.

nodes.name: clean_environment
nodes.summary: Returns only the BASE_ENV variables a program needs to start and find its own credentials, plus any the adapter keeps, so no G6 key or token is passed.

nodes.name: CliRun
nodes.summary: Record of one command-line agent run: exit code, output tail, timing and whether the process tree was cleaned up.

nodes.name: CliAgentRunner
nodes.summary: Locates an outside program, prepares a scratch session folder and clean environment, and runs it as a bounded child process that is stopped by the deadline, G6's stop or the output cap.

nodes.name: codes.py
nodes.summary: Stable G6_E_AGENT_* codes for how an agent run ended and what the gate decided about each tool call, with the action a person should take for each.

nodes.name: action
nodes.summary: Looks up the human-readable action a person should take for a given agent code.

nodes.name: consent.py
nodes.summary: Cloud-consent boundary for coding agents with their own file tools: maps programs to providers, admits a session through g6.core.cloud_consent, and refuses to start when model calls are disabled or G6's stop is engaged.

nodes.name: register_program
nodes.summary: Lets a host adapter declare which cloud coding provider its outside program belongs to, rejecting unknown providers and conflicting registrations.

nodes.name: program_provider
nodes.summary: Resolves the consent provider for a program, with Claude Code and Codex built in and cloud:unknown as the fallback.

nodes.name: process_admission
nodes.summary: Context manager that admits a coding-agent session under cloud consent for its prompt and working directories, converting a consent LLMError into an AgentRefusal.

nodes.name: consent_run
nodes.summary: The single start of a cloud coding client session: refuses under G6_DISABLE_LLM or an engaged stop, passes the stop to the runner and runs it inside process admission.

nodes.name: gate.py
nodes.summary: ToolGate, which decides run, dry_run or refused for every tool call an agent proposes, checking stop, declaration, permissions, workspace containment, safety_engine ceilings and action_gating, and records each decision.

nodes.name: ToolGate
nodes.summary: Ordered tool-call gate: refuses while stopped, for undeclared tools, missing permissions or paths outside the workspace, beyond the trusted safety_engine ceilings or when action_gating does not allow; turns outward calls into dry runs unless told otherwise; keeps the decision record.

nodes.name: model.py
nodes.summary: Shared Pydantic types for every agent adapter (Permissions, Limits, ToolSpec, AgentTask, ToolCall, ToolDecision, AgentEvent, AgentOutcome) plus workspace and limit helpers; outcomes top out at qualified-draft and agent self-reports stay in claimed_status.
nodes.languageNotes: Every model forbids extra fields, so an approval or risk level cannot be smuggled into a task or call.

nodes.name: effective_limits
nodes.summary: Caps a task's step, tool-call and wall-clock limits by the trusted RuntimePolicy ceilings.

nodes.name: _homes
nodes.summary: Collects the home and G6 state folders that a workspace must never be or contain.

nodes.name: workspace_problem
nodes.summary: Explains why a declared workspace cannot be used (not an absolute existing folder, a drive root, a home folder, G6's own state or installed code), or returns an empty string.

nodes.name: model_named
nodes.summary: Reports the model name a g6.core.llm caller declares, for plans and outcomes.

nodes.name: versioned
nodes.summary: Reports whether a folder is under version control, which a write run requires.

nodes.name: resolve_in
nodes.summary: Resolves a raw path against the workspace, following .. and symbolic links.

nodes.name: inside
nodes.summary: Tests whether a resolved path lies inside the workspace.

nodes.name: Permissions
nodes.summary: The workspace and kinds of access (read, write, shell, network) a person grants an agent, validated so file access needs a workspace.

nodes.name: Limits
nodes.summary: Step, tool-call and wall-clock limits for an agent run.

nodes.name: ToolSpec
nodes.summary: Declared tool with its effect, telling whether it acts outward, is gated and needs the network.

nodes.name: AgentTask
nodes.summary: The task a person sets: prompt, permissions, limits and one ToolSpec per tool.

nodes.name: ToolCall
nodes.summary: A tool call an agent proposes, with its id, tool name, arguments and the paths it touches.

nodes.name: ToolDecision
nodes.summary: The gate's verdict on one call (run, dry_run or refused) with its code and reason.

nodes.name: AgentEvent
nodes.summary: An event an adapter yields while running: step, tool_result, message or finished.

nodes.name: Availability
nodes.summary: Whether an adapter can run on this machine and why not.

nodes.name: AgentRefusal
nodes.summary: Exception an adapter raises with a stable code and detail when it cannot go on.

nodes.name: AgentOutcome
nodes.summary: How a run ended: qualified-draft or blocked-escalated with code, output, claimed_status and detail, renderable as the library envelope with a warning card.

nodes.name: run.py
nodes.summary: The AgentRuntime protocol every adapter implements and run_agent, the one way G6 runs an adapter: it checks stop and limits before each event, gates tool results, feeds the circuit breaker and turns every failure into a blocked-escalated outcome.

nodes.name: run_agent
nodes.summary: Refuses non-adapters, stopped runs, unusable workspaces and open circuits, builds the ToolGate and drives the adapter to an AgentOutcome that is never a raised error.

nodes.name: _drive
nodes.summary: Iterates the adapter's events, enforcing stop, step and time limits, rejecting malformed events and tool results the gate never allowed, and closing the generator at the end.

nodes.name: as_executor
nodes.summary: Wraps an adapter and task as the executor g6.harness.run accepts.

nodes.name: AgentRuntime
nodes.summary: Runtime-checkable protocol for an agent adapter: a name, available() and run(task, gate, usage, stop) yielding events.

nodes.name: _Record
nodes.summary: Mutable record of a run in progress that collects events and usage and produces the final AgentOutcome.

nodes.name: AgentRunBlocked
nodes.summary: Exception carrying a blocked AgentOutcome, raised by the harness executor.

nodes.name: AgentExecutor
nodes.summary: Callable that runs an adapter and task through run_agent for g6.harness.run, raising AgentRunBlocked when the run does not finish.

nodes.name: tools.py
nodes.summary: GatedCalls, how a framework adapter calls a tool: each call goes through the run's ToolGate first, then a Python callable or a G6 component op through the registry's untrusted-caller door, with refusals returned as the tool result.

nodes.name: declared
nodes.summary: Reads a G6 component op's own sensitive and read-only declarations to decide whether it may be called and whether it counts as changing something.

nodes.name: GatedCalls
nodes.summary: Dispatches named tool calls through the ToolGate, runs allowed ones as callables or component ops via the door, and keeps the ids of the calls that ran for tool_result events.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package entry for the AutoGen agent extension: declares component metadata (sensitive run_team, required action_gating and safety_engine, the agents-autogen extra) and lazily exposes the AutoGen-dependent chat client and gated tool.
nodes.languageNotes: Module-level __getattr__ (PEP 562) defers importing the optional AutoGen dependency until G6ChatClient or GatedTool is asked for.

nodes.name: adapter.py
nodes.summary: AutoGenRuntime adapter that runs a round-robin, selector or swarm AutoGen team in its own thread, pausing after each message so run_agent can check stop and limits, and refusing user-built teams G6 cannot inspect.

nodes.name: missing
nodes.summary: Lists the AutoGen packages that are not installed, for availability checks and refusals.

nodes.name: team_problems
nodes.summary: Inspects a user-built AutoGen team and lists why it cannot run: wrong team type, participants that are not plain AssistantAgents, non-G6 model clients, ungated tools or memory.

nodes.name: AutoGenRuntime
nodes.summary: Agent runtime that builds or accepts an AutoGen team, answers a plan on dry runs, streams each message as a step event from a worker thread and reports a qualified-draft or step-limit outcome.

nodes.name: agent_autogen_block.py
nodes.summary: Registry and MCP door for the AutoGen adapter with ops check_team (plan only) and run_team (sensitive; asks the configured model, dry run by default), answering in the library envelope.

nodes.name: _check
nodes.summary: Builds the check_team answer: the team's pattern, agents, trusted-capped limits, tools and gate treatment, and whether AutoGen is installed, without running anything.

nodes.name: AgentAutoGenInput
nodes.summary: Pydantic input for the AutoGen block: op, team spec, task, deadline, dry_run and request/run ids.

nodes.name: AgentAutoGenBlock
nodes.summary: AIBlock subclass dispatching check_team and run_team to the AutoGen adapter.

nodes.name: client.py
nodes.summary: G6ChatClient, an AutoGen ChatCompletionClient over one injected g6.core.llm caller that writes tools into the system text and parses a JSON tool_calls reply, and GatedTool, an AutoGen tool whose every call goes through GatedCalls.

nodes.name: render
nodes.summary: Flattens AutoGen messages and offered tools into one system text and one transcript for a text-only g6.core.llm caller.

nodes.name: tool_calls
nodes.summary: Parses a model reply in the fixed {"tool_calls": [...]} JSON form into AutoGen function calls, returning None for plain text.

nodes.name: G6ChatClient
nodes.summary: AutoGen ChatCompletionClient implementation that sends rendered messages through a G6 LLM caller, maps tool-call replies, and reports zero token usage since the caller reports none.

nodes.name: GatedTool
nodes.summary: AutoGen tool wrapper that routes each call through the current run's GatedCalls and refuses outside a G6 run.

nodes.name: SKILL.md
nodes.summary: Agent skill for g6-agent-autogen: when a task suits an AutoGen team under G6's gate and message limit, when not to use one, the run_team and check_team ops and how to read their qualified-draft or blocked results.

nodes.name: spec.py
nodes.summary: TeamSpec and AgentSpec, the typed-data form of an AutoGen team over MCP: pattern, agents with instructions, tools and handoffs, ToolSpec tools, permissions, message limit and stop text.

nodes.name: AgentSpec
nodes.summary: One agent in a team spec: a validated name, its instructions, the tools it may call and whom it may hand over to.

nodes.name: TeamSpec
nodes.summary: A team's pattern, agents, tools, permissions, message limit and stop text, validated so names are unique and every referenced tool and handoff exists.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package entry for the Claude Code agent extension: hands a coding task to the user-installed claude CLI with read tools only unless edits are granted (never shell or web), dry run by default, and declares its sensitive ops, required components and failure modes.

nodes.name: adapter.py
nodes.summary: ClaudeCodeRuntime adapter that runs Anthropic's Claude Code CLI on one workspace through the agents family runtime, stating a fixed permission posture (named read/edit tools, shells, web tools and MCP denied, hooks off) on every run and keeping its result as a claim.
nodes.languageNotes: Builds the CLI argv from module-level tuples (READ_TOOLS, WRITE_TOOLS, NEVER_TOOLS, POSTURE) so the posture is data, not scattered string literals.

nodes.name: _result
nodes.summary: Scans Claude Code's output from the end for the last JSON line of type 'result' and returns it, ignoring anything printed before.

nodes.name: ClaudeCodeRuntime
nodes.summary: AgentRuntime implementation for Claude Code: builds the task and tool list, checks availability, composes the restricted argv, plans dry runs and runs the program through CliAgentRunner, mapping exits and results to stable G6 codes.

nodes.name: agent_claude_block.py
nodes.summary: Registry and MCP door (AIBlock) to the Claude Code adapter, exposing sensitive 'run' and 'available' ops behind a per-process circuit breaker and answering in the reliability envelope (qualified-draft at best).

nodes.name: AgentClaudeInput
nodes.summary: Pydantic input model for the Claude Code block: op, goal, workspace, writes flag, model, max_turns, deadline and dry_run with their bounds.

nodes.name: _run
nodes.summary: Handles the 'run' op: requires a goal, builds a ClaudeCodeRuntime task and runs it through run_agent with the shared circuit breaker.

nodes.name: AgentClaudeBlock
nodes.summary: AIBlock subclass registered for agent_claude that dispatches ops in infer() and returns a Result envelope.

nodes.name: SKILL.md
nodes.summary: Agent skill (g6-agent-claude) describing when and how to hand a coding task to Claude Code through G6: the tool posture, dry runs, versioned-workspace rule for writes, and why its report stays a claim.

nodes.name: CodexRuntime
nodes.summary: AgentRuntime implementation for Codex: builds the task, checks the program, composes the sandboxed argv, plans dry runs and runs it via CliAgentRunner, mapping exits to G6 codes.

nodes.name: agent_codex_block.py
nodes.summary: Registry and MCP door (AIBlock) to the Codex adapter with sensitive 'run' and 'available' ops, a circuit breaker and reliability-envelope answers.

nodes.name: AgentCodexInput
nodes.summary: Pydantic input model for the Codex block: op, goal, workspace, writes, model, deadline and dry_run.

nodes.name: _run
nodes.summary: Handles the 'run' op: requires a goal, builds a CodexRuntime task and runs it with run_agent behind the circuit breaker.

nodes.name: AgentCodexBlock
nodes.summary: AIBlock subclass registered for agent_codex that dispatches ops in infer() and returns a Result envelope.

nodes.name: SKILL.md
nodes.summary: Agent skill (g6-agent-codex) explaining when to hand a coding task to OpenAI's Codex through G6, its read-only default, sandbox modes, dry runs and how its report is kept as a claim.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package entry for the agent_langgraph extension: documents durable resumable graph runs, re-exports LangGraphRuntime, call_tool, list_checkpoints, GraphSpec and the block, and declares component metadata.

nodes.name: adapter.py
nodes.summary: LangGraphRuntime adapter that compiles a GraphSpec (or a user StateGraph) with G6's SQLite checkpoint store, runs it with sync durability so threads resume after a stop or crash, and gates every tool call.
nodes.languageNotes: Node behaviour is generated as closures (_node/_router) from typed spec data, and a typing.TypedDict is built at runtime for the graph state.

nodes.name: missing
nodes.summary: Returns install instructions when LangGraph cannot be imported, or an empty string when it can.

nodes.name: _tools
nodes.summary: Fetches the run's GatedCalls from LangGraph's runnable config, refusing when called outside a node of a G6-run graph.

nodes.name: call_tool
nodes.summary: Public helper that lets a user-written node call a declared tool, decided first by the run's gate.

nodes.name: _node
nodes.summary: Builds the callable for one spec node (set, append, increment, llm, tool, pass/branch), filling templates from state, enforcing value size caps, consent-guarding llm calls and gating tool calls.

nodes.name: build
nodes.summary: Turns a GraphSpec into an uncompiled LangGraph StateGraph: adds nodes, the entry point, edges and conditional branch edges.

nodes.name: list_checkpoints
nodes.summary: Lists a thread's stored checkpoints from G6's checkpoint store, up to a limit.

nodes.name: LangGraphRuntime
nodes.summary: AgentRuntime for LangGraph graphs: binds a spec or builder to a thread, refuses restarting a thread or resuming with a changed graph, plans dry runs, and streams each super-step as a step event.

nodes.name: agent_langgraph_block.py
nodes.summary: Registry and MCP door (AIBlock) to the LangGraph adapter with run_graph, resume and list_checkpoints ops, bounded input sizes and reliability-envelope answers.

nodes.name: AgentLangGraphInput
nodes.summary: Pydantic input model for the LangGraph block (op, graph spec, thread id, input, limits) with a validator capping the input size.

nodes.name: _run
nodes.summary: Handles run_graph and resume: builds a LangGraphRuntime for the thread and runs it through run_agent.

nodes.name: _list
nodes.summary: Handles list_checkpoints: returns a thread's checkpoints via the adapter's list_checkpoints.

nodes.name: AgentLangGraphBlock
nodes.summary: AIBlock subclass registered for agent_langgraph that dispatches ops in infer() and returns a Result envelope.

nodes.name: checkpoints.py
nodes.summary: SQLite-backed LangGraph checkpoint saver under G6's state folder, deserialising only with LangGraph's strict (no pickle) serializer, tracking thread-to-graph digests and capping checkpoint and thread sizes.
nodes.languageNotes: Implements LangGraph's BaseCheckpointSaver sync and async methods over a single WAL SQLite connection.

nodes.name: strict_serializer
nodes.summary: Builds LangGraph's JsonPlusSerializer in strict mode, allowing only safe types plus those the caller names.

nodes.name: Checkpoints
nodes.summary: BaseCheckpointSaver implementation storing checkpoints, pending writes and g6_threads rows in SQLite, with thread claiming, size limits and sync/async get, list, put and delete.

nodes.name: SKILL.md
nodes.summary: Agent skill (g6-agent-langgraph) on running resumable LangGraph workflows through G6: typed specs, checkpointing, resume rules, gated tool calls and model handling.

nodes.name: TooLarge
nodes.summary: Exception raised when a filled or written value would exceed its size cap.

nodes.name: size_of
nodes.summary: Measures a value's size in characters (text directly, other values by their JSON), stopping early past a limit.

nodes.name: GraphNode
nodes.summary: Typed graph node (set, append, increment, pass, llm, tool, branch) with a validator requiring each op's own fields.

nodes.name: GraphEdge
nodes.summary: Typed edge from a source node to a target node or END.

nodes.name: GraphSpec

nodes.name: lookup

nodes.name: fill

nodes.summary: Package entry for the agent_nanoclaw durable agent-mailbox extension: documents usage, re-exports the Mailbox and block, and declares component metadata.

nodes.name: AgentNanoclawInput
nodes.summary: Pydantic input model for the mailbox block: op, group, members, schema, sender, recipient, body, cursors and limits.

nodes.name: _run
nodes.summary: Dispatches a mailbox op to the matching Mailbox method after checking its required fields.

nodes.name: AgentNanoclawBlock
nodes.summary: AIBlock subclass registered for agent_nanoclaw that dispatches ops in infer() and returns a Result envelope.

nodes.name: mailbox.py

nodes.name: Mailbox

nodes.name: SKILL.md
nodes.summary: Agent skill (g6-agent-nanoclaw) describing the durable agent mailbox: groups, typed messages, at-least-once delivery, acknowledgements and when not to use it.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package entry for the agent_runtime extension, which puts the agents family's shared runtime checks on the registry and MCP; re-exports the block and declares component metadata.

nodes.name: agent_runtime_block.py
nodes.summary: Registry and MCP door (AIBlock) to the agents runtime with two read-only ops: check_task (limits capped by trusted ceilings, tool permissions) and decide (the gate's verdict for one proposed tool call).

nodes.name: AgentRuntimeInput
nodes.summary: Pydantic input model for the runtime block: op, task, proposed call and dry_run.

nodes.name: _check_task
nodes.summary: Validates a task's workspace and reports its effective limits under the trusted RuntimePolicy plus what each declared tool may do.

nodes.name: _decide
nodes.summary: Asks a fresh ToolGate to decide one proposed tool call (run, dry_run or refused) and returns the verdict with code and reason.

nodes.name: AgentRuntimeBlock
nodes.summary: AIBlock subclass registered for agent_runtime that dispatches check_task and decide in infer().

nodes.name: SKILL.md
nodes.summary: Agent skill (g6-agent-runtime) on the agents family's single runtime: declared tasks, capped limits, gated tool calls, stop checks and failure codes, with guidance on writing new adapters and what the runtime is not.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package entry for the agent_smolagents extension: documents gated tool-calling and sandboxed code agents, re-exports the runtime, block and AgentSpec, lazily exposes G6Model/G6Executor, and declares component metadata.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a module-level __getattr__ (PEP 562) so optional smolagents-dependent classes load only on access.

nodes.name: adapter.py
nodes.summary: SmolagentsRuntime adapter that builds a smolagents ToolCallingAgent (gated tools) or CodeAgent (sandboxed code steps) from an AgentSpec and runs it step by step under the family runtime's stop, step and time limits.

nodes.name: missing
nodes.summary: Returns install instructions when smolagents cannot be imported, or an empty string when it can.

nodes.name: SmolagentsRuntime
nodes.summary: AgentRuntime for smolagents: builds the agent, checks declared tools exist, plans dry runs and yields each agent step as an event, reporting step-limit exhaustion and sandbox records.

nodes.name: agent_smolagents_block.py
nodes.summary: Registry and MCP door (AIBlock) to the smolagents adapter: a read-only 'check' op describing limits, sandbox, OS isolation and tool gating, and a sensitive 'run' op using the configured model (dry run by default).

nodes.name: AgentSmolagentsInput
nodes.summary: Pydantic input model for the smolagents block: op, agent spec, task, deadline and dry_run.

nodes.name: _check
nodes.summary: Handles the 'check' op: reports the agent kind, capped steps, sandbox imports and memory, OS isolation status, per-tool gate treatment and whether smolagents is installed, without running anything.

nodes.name: AgentSmolagentsBlock
nodes.summary: AIBlock subclass registered for agent_smolagents that dispatches check and run in infer().

nodes.name: models.py
nodes.summary: smolagents integration shims: G6Model (smolagents Model over an injected g6.core.llm caller), G6Executor (PythonExecutor over G6's SandboxSession) and gated() tools routed through the run's GatedCalls.

nodes.name: render
nodes.summary: Flattens smolagents chat messages into one system text and one role-labelled transcript for a G6 llm call.

nodes.name: G6Model
nodes.summary: smolagents Model subclass that calls the injected G6 llm caller and cuts the reply at the first requested stop sequence.

nodes.name: G6Executor
nodes.summary: smolagents PythonExecutor that runs each code step through a SandboxSession instead of in process.

nodes.name: gated
nodes.summary: Wraps a passed-in tool or a G6 component op as a smolagents Tool whose every call goes through the run's GatedCalls, returning the verdict when not allowed to run.

nodes.name: sandbox.py
nodes.summary: Code-step execution for smolagents code agents: an AST allow-list screen (imports, names, attributes) followed by a bounded child process via g6.core.sandbox with an audit hook, replay of earlier steps and a confinement record.
nodes.languageNotes: Screens code with Python's ast module against an allow-list of node types, and installs a sys.addaudithook prelude in the child process.

nodes.name: refuse_event
nodes.summary: Audit hook that raises on refused events (starting programs, ctypes, socket connections) inside the sandboxed child.

nodes.name: CodeRefused
nodes.summary: Exception raised when the screen refuses a code step's construct.

nodes.name: CodeFailed
nodes.summary: Exception raised when a screened code step fails while running in the sandbox.

nodes.name: _rule
nodes.summary: Checks one AST node against the allowed syntax, import list, refused names, private names and frame attributes, returning the broken rule if any.

nodes.name: screen
nodes.summary: Parses a code step and walks its AST, raising CodeRefused with the construct and line for the first rule it breaks.

nodes.name: SandboxSession
nodes.summary: Per-run session that screens and runs code steps via run_script, replays earlier clean steps with a fixed random seed, and records the limits and OS isolation each step ran under.

nodes.name: SKILL.md
nodes.summary: Agent skill guide for the G6 smolagents adapter: when to run a tool-calling or code agent through the agents runtime, its run and check ops, how to read the qualified-draft envelope, failure modes caught, blind spots and open problems.

nodes.name: spec.py
nodes.summary: Defines AgentSpec, the frozen pydantic model describing a smolagents agent as typed data (tool-calling or code agent, tools, permissions, step and time limits), refusing a code agent that declares tools.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package entry point for g6.algebra, the SymPy computer-algebra component: documents the parser-only input language, the independent re-check of every answer, worker time limits and optional SageMath, and re-exports the public op functions.
nodes.languageNotes: Module-level __g6_* dunder constants declare the component's block, sensitive ops and failure-mode codes for G6's registry.

nodes.name: algebra_block.py
nodes.summary: AlgebraBlock, the registry and MCP door to g6.algebra: a typed AlgebraInput dispatches each op to one public package function and returns its labelled envelope, with SageMath ops flagged as sensitive.

nodes.name: build.py
nodes.summary: Builds SymPy objects from G6's own parse tree through SymPy constructors (Rational, Symbol, Add, Mul, Pow and a fixed function table), so caller text never reaches SymPy's string readers.

nodes.name: checks.py
nodes.summary: G6's independent re-checks of SymPy answers: numeric agreement at seeded random points via mpmath, exact rational legs, substitution of solutions, numeric limits and series, and matrix inverse/determinant/eigenvalue checks, each producing a passed, refuted or undecided verdict.

nodes.name: engine.py
nodes.summary: The SymPy work of each algebra op, run inside G6's worker: compute() builds SymPy objects, asks SymPy for the answer (solveset, linsolve, nonlinsolve, integrate, limit, series, matrix ops) and returns it with its re-check function, refusing unevaluated or oversize answers.

nodes.name: envelope.py
nodes.summary: Stable G6_E_ALGEBRA_* codes and finish(), the single place an algebra result is labelled qualified-draft or blocked-escalated with its warning card and evidence; it never yields the verified state.

nodes.name: inputs.py
nodes.summary: Reads each algebra op's parameters into a Problem: every expression through G6's parser, every number, name and choice checked against size limits, in pure Python without SymPy.

nodes.name: integers.py
nodes.summary: G6's own pure-Python integer certificates: Miller-Rabin primality with deterministic bases, factorisation multiply-back checks, is_prime cross-checks against SymPy, and gcd shown by Bezout coefficients.

nodes.name: language.py
nodes.summary: g6.algebra's dialect of the core formula parser: defines the allowed numbers, declared symbols with assumptions, operators, function tables and constants, and exposes declare() and parse() that refuse everything else with a code, line and column.

nodes.name: numeric.py
nodes.summary: G6's own numerics for re-checks, independent of SymPy: mpmath evaluation of the parse tree at two precisions, exact rational evaluation and Taylor coefficients in fractions, seeded random points honouring symbol assumptions, and tolerance comparison.

nodes.name: ops.py
nodes.summary: Public Python functions for the SymPy ops of g6.algebra (simplify, expand, factor, differentiate, integrate, solve, limit, series, matrix and integer ops); each validates limits and input, checks SymPy is installed, runs the worker and assembles the labelled result from its streamed lines.

nodes.name: runner.py
nodes.summary: The only g6.algebra module that starts programs: runs G6's isolated SymPy worker and optional SageMath under component_process with a temp directory, minimal environment, time, output and memory caps, confining SageMath through g6.core.confine.

nodes.name: sage.py
nodes.summary: SageMath as an optional external program: finds the sage executable, re-renders G6's parse of the caller's expression as Sage text, writes a nonce-marked script file, runs it under limits and parses the version and answer.

nodes.name: schema.py
nodes.summary: Defines the frozen Recheck and AlgebraResult dataclasses, the one labelled result of g6.algebra, whose completion_state admits only qualified-draft or blocked-escalated.

nodes.name: SKILL.md
nodes.summary: Agent skill guide for g6.algebra: when to use SymPy computer algebra instead of one's own working, each op and how it is re-checked, reading the result, failure modes, blind spots, requirements and examples.

nodes.name: worker.py
nodes.summary: G6's SymPy worker process (python -I -m g6.algebra.worker): reads one JSON request from stdin, lowers its own resource limits on POSIX, re-parses input, computes the answer and re-check, and streams JSON stage lines to stdout.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package entry point for g6.algorithm_design: documents bottom-up algorithm search, fusion with the change-impact map, cost estimates and checked kernels, declares component metadata, and re-exports the block, catalogue, fusion, IR and search APIs.

nodes.name: architecture.py
nodes.summary: Conservative complexity-planning obligations for large codebases: a list of architectural principles and review_codebase(), which derives an ArchitectureReview of large files and heavy dependencies from a codebase IR and impact map.

nodes.name: autonomous.py
nodes.summary: Bounded autonomous algorithm-design and repair controller for a host-approved repository: a proposing agent edits one candidate file while G6 holds frozen intent, approval via the operator queue, isolated mutant test runs, evidence digests, the coding gate and a hash-chained ledger.

nodes.name: block.py
nodes.summary: AlgorithmDesignBlock, the registry and MCP door to g6.algorithm_design: typed input dispatches primitives, ontology, search, estimate, fuse, list_kernels and run_kernel ops, returning blocked-escalated replies with stable codes instead of raised errors.

nodes.name: catalog.py
nodes.summary: A small, inspectable catalogue of classical algorithm patterns (linear scan, sorting, binary search and more) as AlgorithmPrimitive records with representations, preconditions, cost and proof obligations.

nodes.name: checked_kernels.py
nodes.summary: Deterministic, bounded algorithm kernels (graph search, shortest paths, flows, spanning trees, DP, matching, covers, TSP, sorting, treewidth DP) each checking its own output against a separately written instance certificate.
nodes.languageNotes: Each kernel returns a CheckedResult pairing the answer with a witness and an independent certificate check; inputs are bounded and validated before any work.

nodes.name: codes.py
nodes.summary: The stable G6_E_ALGO_* error and reply codes used by g6.algorithm_design replies.

nodes.name: AgentSpec
nodes.summary: Frozen pydantic spec of a smolagents agent: type, tools, permissions, step, tool-call and code time limits, with a validator forbidding tools on code agents.

nodes.name: AlgebraInput
nodes.summary: Typed input model for the algebra block naming the op and its permitted fields; unknown ops and fields are refused.

nodes.name: AlgebraBlock
nodes.summary: AI block exposing g6.algebra ops through the registry and MCP, dispatching infer() to the package functions.

nodes.name: expression
nodes.summary: Recursively converts a G6 parse-tree node into a SymPy object via constructors and the function table.

nodes.name: symbols
nodes.summary: Builds SymPy Symbol objects for declared names with their assumptions.

nodes.name: difference
nodes.summary: Builds the left-minus-right SymPy expression of an equation node.

nodes.name: Context
nodes.summary: Re-check context carrying the seed, symbol table and limits, with a factory and a seeded random generator.

nodes.name: _numeric
nodes.summary: Numeric leg: compares G6's mpmath evaluation of the original with SymPy's answer at seeded usable points.

nodes.name: _exact
nodes.summary: Exact leg: compares rational values at random integer points or exact Taylor coefficients in fractions.

nodes.name: _verdict
nodes.summary: Combines leg results into a passed, refuted or undecided Recheck.

nodes.name: equal
nodes.summary: Re-checks simplify, expand or factor answers against the original numerically and exactly.

nodes.name: derivative
nodes.summary: Re-checks a derivative against mpmath numeric differentiation and exact Taylor coefficients.

nodes.name: antiderivative
nodes.summary: Re-checks an antiderivative by differentiating it back and comparing with the integrand.

nodes.name: definite
nodes.summary: Re-checks a definite integral against mpmath quadrature of G6's evaluation.

nodes.name: _substitute
nodes.summary: Substitutes a solution into equations and measures the residual at a given precision.

nodes.name: _one_solution
nodes.summary: Checks one solution (or solution family) by substitution at 60 digits, confirming at 100 digits before refuting.

nodes.name: solutions
nodes.summary: Re-checks every solution of an equation system and aggregates the verdict.

nodes.name: whole_set
nodes.summary: Re-check entry for a solution set returned as the whole domain.

nodes.name: limit
nodes.summary: Re-checks a limit by approaching the point numerically from the requested side(s).

nodes.name: _approach
nodes.summary: Evaluates an expression along a sequence of points approaching a target to judge a limit.

nodes.name: series
nodes.summary: Re-checks Taylor series coefficients against exact or numeric derivatives.

nodes.name: _series_numeric
nodes.summary: Numeric fallback comparing series coefficients with derivatives at random parameter values.

nodes.name: fraction_det
nodes.summary: Exact determinant by fraction-based Gaussian elimination.

nodes.name: determinant
nodes.summary: Re-checks a determinant against mpmath and exact elimination.

nodes.name: inverse
nodes.summary: Re-checks a matrix inverse by multiplying back to the identity.

nodes.name: eigenvalues
nodes.summary: Re-checks eigenvalues via det(A - lambda I) vanishing and mpmath's own eigenvalues.

nodes.name: compute
nodes.summary: Dispatches a Problem to the right SymPy routine and returns the answer with its re-check function.

nodes.name: _integrate
nodes.summary: Computes an indefinite or definite integral and refuses unevaluated results.

nodes.name: _limit
nodes.summary: Computes a limit and refuses one that does not exist.

nodes.name: _solve
nodes.summary: Chooses solveset, linsolve or nonlinsolve for an equation or system and records completeness.

nodes.name: _solveset
nodes.summary: Solves one equation in one unknown with solveset, expanding finite sets and image-set families.

nodes.name: _matrix
nodes.summary: Computes determinant, inverse or eigenvalues of a matrix, refusing singular inverses.

nodes.name: Refusal
nodes.summary: Exception carrying a stable algebra code and reason, turned into a blocked-escalated result.

nodes.name: labelled
nodes.summary: Wraps an op's work so any Refusal or failure becomes a labelled envelope with request and run ids.

nodes.name: finish
nodes.summary: Builds the labelled AlgebraResult from what a run recorded, deciding the completion state and warning card.

nodes.name: _decide
nodes.summary: Chooses the completion state and code from engine run, answers and re-check status.

nodes.name: _answer_card
nodes.summary: Builds the warning card text describing the engine, re-check and completeness.

nodes.name: Problem
nodes.summary: Parsed, checked representation of one algebra op's inputs with a display helper.

nodes.name: read
nodes.summary: Reads an op's raw parameters into a Problem, parsing expressions and enforcing per-op limits.

nodes.name: miller_rabin
nodes.summary: Strong probable-prime test of n against a set of bases.

nodes.name: primality
nodes.summary: Trial division then Miller-Rabin with 13 bases, deterministic below about 3.3e24.

nodes.name: check_factorisation
nodes.summary: Checks a factorisation multiplies back to n with every factor prime.

nodes.name: check_is_prime
nodes.summary: Cross-checks SymPy's primality answer, treating large primes as undecided.

nodes.name: bezout
nodes.summary: Extended Euclidean algorithm returning a gcd and Bezout coefficients for several numbers.

nodes.name: check_gcd
nodes.summary: Checks a claimed gcd divides every number and is reached by Bezout coefficients.

nodes.name: declare
nodes.summary: Declares caller symbols with assumptions after checking their names.

nodes.name: parse
nodes.summary: Parses an expression or equation with the algebra dialect of the core formula parser.

nodes.name: Point
nodes.summary: A sample point holding exact values with mpmath and SymPy views and a display form.

nodes.name: evaluate
nodes.summary: Evaluates a parse tree on mpmath for given symbol values.

nodes.name: _evaluate
nodes.summary: Recursive mpmath evaluator over parse-tree nodes and functions.

nodes.name: stable
nodes.summary: Evaluates at 30 and 60 digits and keeps the value only if both agree and are usable.

nodes.name: to_mp
nodes.summary: Converts exact or SymPy values to mpmath numbers at a precision.

nodes.name: sympy_value
nodes.summary: Evaluates SymPy's answer at a point and converts it to mpmath.

nodes.name: draw
nodes.summary: Draws seeded random points honouring each symbol's assumptions.

nodes.name: is_rational
nodes.summary: Tests whether a parse tree is a rational expression eligible for exact checks.

nodes.name: exact
nodes.summary: Evaluates a rational expression exactly in fractions at integer points.

nodes.name: sympy_exact
nodes.summary: Evaluates SymPy's answer exactly at a rational point.

nodes.name: taylor
nodes.summary: Computes exact Taylor coefficients of a rational expression by truncated power-series arithmetic.

nodes.name: run
nodes.summary: Common path for every SymPy op: checks limits and input, confirms SymPy is installed, calls the worker and labels the result.

nodes.name: read_lines
nodes.summary: Consumes the worker's JSON stage lines into run state, handling time-limit stops during answer or re-check.

nodes.name: simplify
nodes.summary: Public op returning the re-checked, labelled simplification computed by G6's SymPy worker.

nodes.name: expand
nodes.summary: Public op returning the re-checked, labelled expansion computed by G6's SymPy worker.

nodes.name: factor
nodes.summary: Public op returning the re-checked, labelled factorisation over the rationals computed by G6's SymPy worker.

nodes.name: differentiate
nodes.summary: Public op returning the re-checked, labelled derivative of an expression computed by G6's SymPy worker.

nodes.name: integrate
nodes.summary: Public op returning the re-checked, labelled indefinite or definite integral computed by G6's SymPy worker.

nodes.name: solve
nodes.summary: Public op returning the re-checked, labelled solution set of an equation or small system computed by G6's SymPy worker.

nodes.name: limit
nodes.summary: Public op returning the re-checked, labelled limit at a point computed by G6's SymPy worker.

nodes.name: series
nodes.summary: Public op returning the re-checked, labelled Taylor series computed by G6's SymPy worker.

nodes.name: determinant
nodes.summary: Public op returning the re-checked, labelled matrix determinant computed by G6's SymPy worker.

nodes.name: inverse
nodes.summary: Public op returning the re-checked, labelled matrix inverse computed by G6's SymPy worker.

nodes.name: eigenvalues
nodes.summary: Public op returning the re-checked, labelled matrix eigenvalues with multiplicities computed by G6's SymPy worker.

nodes.name: factor_integer
nodes.summary: Public op returning the re-checked, labelled prime factorisation of an integer computed by G6's SymPy worker.

nodes.name: is_prime
nodes.summary: Public op returning the re-checked, labelled primality of an integer computed by G6's SymPy worker.

nodes.name: gcd
nodes.summary: Public op returning the re-checked, labelled greatest common divisor of integers computed by G6's SymPy worker.

nodes.name: Run
nodes.summary: Record of one out-of-process run: exit status, output, timing and limit flags.

nodes.name: _execute
nodes.summary: Executes a program under component_process with time, memory and output caps, optionally confined.

nodes.name: call_worker
nodes.summary: Starts the isolated SymPy worker, passing the request as a stdin file in a fresh temp directory.

nodes.name: run_sage
nodes.summary: Runs SageMath on a G6-written file in a fresh directory with a sanitized environment and confinement.

nodes.name: find_sage
nodes.summary: Locates the sage executable from G6_SAGE or PATH.

nodes.name: to_sage
nodes.summary: Renders a G6 parse tree back as fully bracketed SageMath text.

nodes.name: build_file
nodes.summary: Writes the Sage script declaring symbols and printing version, answer and LaTeX between nonce marks.

nodes.name: read_output
nodes.summary: Parses Sage output between nonce marks into version, answer and LaTeX.

nodes.name: sage_version
nodes.summary: Runs sage --version and returns a labelled version result.

nodes.name: sage_evaluate
nodes.summary: Parses, renders and runs one SageMath expression under limits, returning an unre-checked qualified-draft answer.

nodes.name: Recheck
nodes.summary: Frozen record of one re-check: status passed/refuted/undecided, methods, points, failures and why.

nodes.name: AlgebraResult
nodes.summary: Frozen labelled algebra result with envelope fields; its state type excludes verified.

nodes.name: _limit
nodes.summary: Lowers the worker's own address-space, CPU and file-size limits on POSIX.

nodes.name: handle
nodes.summary: Handles one request: re-reads inputs, computes, emits answer, partial and re-check stages.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Worker entry point reading the JSON request from stdin and streaming results.

nodes.name: ArchitectureReview
nodes.summary: Dataclass of architecture obligations: principles, large files and heavy dependencies found.

nodes.name: review_codebase
nodes.summary: Derives complexity obligations from a codebase IR and impact map using size and dependency thresholds.

nodes.name: ApprovalRef
nodes.summary: Reference to the operator-queue approval item authorising a mission.

nodes.name: DesignMission
nodes.summary: Frozen mission spec: repository, target file, frozen intent, tests and limits, with a fingerprint bound to its approval.

nodes.name: PatchProposal
nodes.summary: A proposed candidate source with a fingerprint.

nodes.name: AgentBrief
nodes.summary: Brief given to the proposing agent each round: intent, file, observations and limits.

nodes.name: ProposalAgent
nodes.summary: Protocol for a provider-independent agent that proposes a patch from a brief.

nodes.name: NoEngineer
nodes.summary: Null proposal agent that reports no engineer is available.

nodes.name: TestObservation
nodes.summary: Record of one test run: outcome, isolation, digests and receipt.

nodes.name: CandidateRunner
nodes.summary: Protocol for running baseline and candidate tests.

nodes.name: RepoTestsRunner
nodes.summary: Runs baseline in place and candidates as isolated mutants via repo_tests, checking source and checker digests and frozen approval.

nodes.name: AgentReport
nodes.summary: Final mission report: outcome, rounds, observations, approver and ledger references.

nodes.name: run_agent
nodes.summary: Public entry that validates approval and ledger then runs a bounded design mission.

nodes.name: _run
nodes.summary: Core bounded propose-test-repair loop: baseline, proposals, static checks, isolated runs, gate decisions and ledger entries.

nodes.name: _patch_problem
nodes.summary: Checks a proposed patch for a target and repetition problems before it runs.

nodes.name: DeviceIn
nodes.summary: Typed description of the caller's device limits for cost estimates.

nodes.name: AlgorithmDesignInput
nodes.summary: Typed input for the algorithm design block naming the op and its fields.

nodes.name: AlgorithmDesignBlock
nodes.summary: AI block exposing algorithm-design ops through the registry and MCP.

nodes.name: _ontology
nodes.summary: Answers the bundled ontology metadata for the ontology op.

nodes.name: _fuse
nodes.summary: Fuses one candidate with a change-impact map's frozen intent and replies with the check plan.

nodes.name: _estimate
nodes.summary: Estimates a candidate's cost for stated sizes on the caller's device.

nodes.name: _run_kernel
nodes.summary: Invokes one fixed checked kernel and replies with the answer and its check.

nodes.name: primitives
nodes.summary: Returns the tuple of catalogued AlgorithmPrimitive patterns.

nodes.name: ContractError
nodes.summary: Raised when inputs violate a kernel's published contract or budget.

nodes.name: CheckedResult
nodes.summary: Kernel result pairing an answer with its witness and certificate check.

nodes.name: _edges
nodes.summary: Validates and normalises an edge list against size, weight and direction rules.

nodes.name: _verify_potentials
nodes.summary: Certifies shortest-path distances via potential and tight-parent conditions.

nodes.name: bfs
nodes.summary: Breadth-first search distances with a checked layering certificate.

nodes.name: dijkstra
nodes.summary: Dijkstra shortest paths with a potentials certificate.

nodes.name: kahn
nodes.summary: Kahn topological sort or a checked cycle witness.

nodes.name: weighted_interval_dp
nodes.summary: Weighted interval scheduling by dynamic programming with a checked optimum.

nodes.name: vertex_cover_2approx
nodes.summary: Matching-based 2-approximate vertex cover with a cover and matching check.

nodes.name: gale_shapley
nodes.summary: Gale-Shapley stable matching with a checked no-blocking-pair certificate.

nodes.name: tree_independent_set
nodes.summary: Maximum-weight independent set on a tree by DP with a checked solution.

nodes.name: edmonds_karp
nodes.summary: Edmonds-Karp maximum flow with a min-cut certificate.

nodes.name: kruskal
nodes.summary: Kruskal minimum spanning tree/forest with a cut-property check.

nodes.name: subset_sum_mitm
nodes.summary: Meet-in-the-middle subset sum returning a checked witness subset.

nodes.name: knapsack_dp
nodes.summary: 0/1 knapsack by dynamic programming with a checked selection.

nodes.name: bellman_ford
nodes.summary: Bellman-Ford shortest paths with a negative-cycle witness or potentials certificate.

nodes.name: vertex_cover_fpt
nodes.summary: Fixed-parameter bounded-search vertex cover of size at most k.

nodes.name: set_cover_greedy
nodes.summary: Greedy set cover with a coverage check.

nodes.name: sequence_align_dp
nodes.summary: Edit-distance sequence alignment by DP with a checked alignment.

nodes.name: huffman
nodes.summary: Huffman prefix code with prefix-freeness and cost checks.

nodes.name: held_karp_tsp
nodes.summary: Held-Karp exact TSP by subset DP with a checked tour.

nodes.name: randomized_quicksort
nodes.summary: Seeded randomized quicksort with a sortedness and permutation check.

nodes.name: treewidth_independent_set
nodes.summary: Maximum-weight independent set by DP over a supplied tree decomposition, checking the decomposition and solution.

nodes.name: ontology.json
nodes.summary: Bundled algorithm-design ontology (version 0.1.0) listing problems with input representations, output contracts and recognition features, plus algorithms, design patterns, agent operators and workflows that the knowledge loader reads as metadata only.

nodes.name: skiena_problem_index.json
nodes.summary: Index of 75 textbook problem entries, each described in G6's own words and cited by book, section and printed page, used as a reference catalogue for algorithm design rather than an implementation source.

nodes.name: fusion.py
nodes.summary: Fuses a top-down change-impact intent (CIR) with one bottom-up design candidate into a FusionResult that lists normative and algorithm proof obligations, uncertainty and a check plan, without ever approving the change.

nodes.name: invocation.py
nodes.summary: Host-controlled entry point for G6's 22 fixed algorithm kernels: it accepts only plain data up to a depth limit, runs the chosen kernel under a time deadline, and returns the kernel's self-checked result.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses sys.settrace with a callable deadline object to bound kernel run time in-process.

nodes.name: ir.py
nodes.summary: Typed intermediate representation for algorithm construction: frozen dataclasses for design problems, algorithm primitives, candidates and search results, with digest-based fingerprints.
nodes.languageNotes: Frozen dataclasses with __post_init__ validation and Literal-typed status fields form an immutable IR.

nodes.name: kernels.py
nodes.summary: Exact algorithm kernels (subset-sum dynamic programming, earliest-finish interval scheduling, stable merge sort) that each check their own answer against an independent bounded oracle or output property.

nodes.name: knowledge_bridge.py
nodes.summary: Conservative bridge that turns bundled ontology metadata for a problem into catalog insights and, for manually reviewed signatures only, typed AlgorithmPrimitive entries for the design search.

nodes.name: knowledge.py
nodes.summary: Loads and validates the bundled ontology and Skiena problem index from package data and exposes a ranked ontology lookup by problem id and established features.

nodes.name: ontology_adapter.py
nodes.summary: Reads a user-authored ontology as plain metadata and ranks catalogued algorithms for a problem by how many recognition features the caller has not established.

nodes.name: resources.py
nodes.summary: Conservative, hard-coded resource planner that estimates abstract operation counts and memory for catalogued algorithms against a host-supplied device budget and ranks which options fit.

nodes.name: search.py
nodes.summary: Deterministic bottom-up breadth-first composition of catalogue primitives from a problem's representations to its target, under explicit depth, expansion and candidate budgets, recording refused primitives.

nodes.name: SKILL.md
nodes.summary: Skill guide for the G6 algorithm designer: when to use it, its ops (primitives, ontology, search, estimate, fuse, list_kernels, run_kernel), the Python API, failure modes, blind spots and examples.

nodes.name: allowance.py
nodes.summary: Reports Claude and Codex provider allowance windows as advice only, modelling quota windows and readings with timezone-aware validation and opaque profile tokens, and never carrying user data.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Core bundle framework: defines Field, BundleResult and Bundle, the weakest-state reduction over reliability labels, the bundle catalog and the awaiting-certificate check used by every ready-made harness.

nodes.name: __main__.py
nodes.summary: Module entry point that forwards `python -m g6.bundles [<id>]` to the G6 CLI's bundle command to start a bundle's local page or list bundles.
nodes.languageNotes: Python package __main__ module enabling `python -m g6.bundles`.

nodes.name: agent_change.py
nodes.summary: Bundle that checks whether a coding agent really fixed something: it reads the change from git, runs the relevant tests, reruns original test files, detects weakened tests and shortcuts, and runs mutation checks before holding the agent's report to the evidence.

nodes.name: bookkeeping_check.py
nodes.summary: Offline bundle for Australian bookkeeping that matches bank and ledger lines, checks each line's GST coding against the 1/11 rule, and recomputes BAS figures G1, 1A and 1B against any reported values.

nodes.name: check_claims.py
nodes.summary: Offline bundle that checks every sentence of a pasted draft against pasted sources with the grounding claim checker, labelling each as found, contradicted or not found.

nodes.name: code_review.py
nodes.summary: Model-backed code review bundle that requires a quote for every finding and confirms each quote exists in the pasted code, marking unlocatable findings as unconfirmed.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Offline GDPR and HIPAA compliance gap bundle that triages a requirement table from user answers and computes breach-notice and request deadlines from dated incident records; listed as awaiting its certificate.

nodes.name: contract_review.py
nodes.summary: Contract review bundle that quotes the document for clause types, undefined or unused defined terms, dangling cross-references and word-versus-figure mismatches, and optionally keeps model-proposed issues only when their quotes are in the original text.

nodes.name: grounded_answer.py
nodes.summary: Model-backed bundle that answers only from pasted sources, screens sources for instruction-like text, then checks each answer sentence against the sources with the grounding checker.

nodes.name: ml_check.py
nodes.summary: Offline ML result check bundle that detects train/test leakage, scores predictions (or a sandboxed prediction script) against held-back labels with confidence intervals and a baseline gate, and compares claimed scores.

nodes.name: premortem.py
nodes.summary: Model-backed pre-mortem bundle that asks for failure stories about a plan, requires each to name an early warning sign and a cheap test, and marks claims as from the plan or assumptions.

nodes.name: runbook.py
nodes.summary: Runbook safety bundle where a model only parses steps into structured facts and G6 passes every step through action gating, requiring a named backup for irreversible steps and checking for rollback and final checks.

nodes.name: FusionResult
nodes.summary: Frozen result of fusing a candidate with a change intent, carrying digests, matched target, obligations, uncertainty, check plan and completion state, plus a guard saying it is never ready for unrestricted action.

nodes.name: fuse
nodes.summary: Combines a CIR's normative obligations with a candidate's proof obligations, records unknowns such as a target mismatch, and returns a FusionResult check plan.

nodes.name: _legacy
nodes.summary: Wraps an older KernelResult-returning kernel so it rejects unknown parameters and returns the shared CheckedResult contract.

nodes.name: _Deadline
nodes.summary: A sys.settrace callback that raises KernelUnavailable once a kernel runs past G6's time bound.

nodes.name: KernelDescriptor
nodes.summary: Frozen description of a kernel: its id, entry point, how its answer is checked, allowed customisation and whether it is trusted code.

nodes.name: list_kernels
nodes.summary: Returns descriptors for all fixed kernels in sorted order.

nodes.name: _plain
nodes.summary: Recursively checks that a value is plain data (scalars, lists, tuples, string-keyed dicts) within a maximum nesting depth.

nodes.name: invoke
nodes.summary: Runs a named kernel on plain-data parameters under the deadline tracer and returns its CheckedResult, refusing unknown kernels and non-plain inputs.

nodes.name: algorithm_purity_contract
nodes.summary: Returns the stated purity contract of kernel invocation: no file writes, processes or network access.

nodes.name: DesignProblem
nodes.summary: A problem stated declaratively by representations, target output, established properties and constraints, validated on construction.

nodes.name: AlgorithmPrimitive
nodes.summary: A catalogue primitive with consumed and produced types, preconditions, postcondition, claimed complexity and proof obligations.

nodes.name: DesignCandidate
nodes.summary: A composed sequence of primitives reaching a target, with aggregated complexity claims, proof obligations and provenance.

nodes.name: DesignSearch
nodes.summary: The outcome of a design search: candidates, expansion count, truncation flag, refused primitives and a digest fingerprint.

nodes.name: KernelResult
nodes.summary: Frozen record of a kernel's output, how it was checked, its witness, checked instance count, guarantees and limitations.

nodes.name: KernelUnavailable
nodes.summary: ContractError subclass raised when a kernel cannot run on the given input or exceeds its bounds.

nodes.name: subset_sum_dp
nodes.summary: Exact subset-sum by dynamic programming over reachable sums, returning a witness subset and cross-checking small inputs with a brute-force oracle.

nodes.name: interval_earliest_finish
nodes.summary: Greedy earliest-finish interval scheduling that checks non-overlap and, for small inputs, optimality against an exhaustive oracle.

nodes.name: merge_sort
nodes.summary: Stable sort with an optional key and reverse flag that checks the output is an ordered permutation of the input.

nodes.name: CatalogInsight
nodes.summary: Frozen view of one ontology algorithm for a problem: status, missing features, assumptions, complexity claim and source references.

nodes.name: CatalogPlan
nodes.summary: Bundle of catalog insights, reviewed typed primitives, agent operations and a workflow id for one problem.

nodes.name: catalog_plan
nodes.summary: Builds a CatalogPlan for a DesignProblem from the bundled ontology, promoting only manually reviewed signatures to AlgorithmPrimitive entries.

nodes.name: _load
nodes.summary: Reads one of the two allowed bundled JSON files from package data with a size limit and version check.

nodes.name: bundled_ontology
nodes.summary: Loads the bundled ontology and checks it has problems and algorithms lists.

nodes.name: bundled_problem_index
nodes.summary: Loads the bundled Skiena problem index and checks its declared count matches its entries.

nodes.name: search_bundled_ontology
nodes.summary: Ranks the bundled ontology's algorithms for a problem id by missing features.

nodes.name: CatalogMatch
nodes.summary: Frozen match of a catalogued algorithm to a problem, with complexity, proof obligations, missing features and assumptions.

nodes.name: retrieve_ontology
nodes.summary: Filters ontology algorithms that solve a problem and sorts them by how many recognition features are not established.

nodes.name: read_ontology
nodes.summary: Reads an ontology JSON file from disk with a size cap and object-type check.

nodes.name: DeviceBudget
nodes.summary: Host-supplied device limits (RAM, scratch, operations, cores, accelerator) and permissions for pseudo-polynomial, exponential and external-memory algorithms.

nodes.name: ResourceEstimate
nodes.summary: Estimated operations and memory for one algorithm on a device, with eligibility, reasons and a derived completion state.

nodes.name: estimate
nodes.summary: Computes conservative operation and memory estimates for a known algorithm from input dimensions and checks them against the device budget, recording why it does not fit.

nodes.name: rank_options
nodes.summary: Estimates each listed algorithm and sorts them with eligible, cheaper options first.

nodes.name: search_algorithms
nodes.summary: Breadth-first enumeration of type-correct primitive paths to the target within budgets, refusing primitives with unestablished preconditions and returning a DesignSearch.

nodes.name: number
nodes.summary: Returns whether a value is a finite non-boolean number.

nodes.name: aware
nodes.summary: Returns whether a datetime is timezone-aware.

nodes.name: ahead
nodes.summary: The single rule that a timestamp after the present comes from a clock that was ahead.

nodes.name: profile_token
nodes.summary: Validates an opaque local profile token and refuses anything that looks like an account identifier.

nodes.name: Window
nodes.summary: One provider quota window with usage, reset time and semantics, validated on construction and able to say whether quota blocks work and how much remains.

nodes.name: Reading
nodes.summary: A dated reading of a provider's allowance windows, validated for schema and timezone awareness.

nodes.name: utc_now
nodes.summary: Returns the current UTC time.

nodes.name: display
nodes.summary: Formats an allowance reading for display.

nodes.name: report
nodes.summary: Builds the both-provider allowance report as advice, optionally refreshing readings, without calling any model.

nodes.name: Field
nodes.summary: Declares one form field of a bundle's local page.

nodes.name: BundleResult
nodes.summary: A bundle's result: a reliability state, summary, rows and notes, validated against the allowed completion states and serialisable to a dict.

nodes.name: weakest
nodes.summary: Reduces a list of reliability states to the weakest one so a bundle never claims more than its parts established.

nodes.name: Bundle
nodes.summary: A ready-made harness: id, title, form fields and a run(inputs, llm) callable returning a BundleResult.

nodes.name: catalog
nodes.summary: Returns the shipped bundles.

nodes.name: awaiting_certificate
nodes.summary: Says whether a bundle is listed only as awaiting its certificate, based on its vetting declaration.

nodes.name: _as_run
nodes.summary: Runs the chosen tests in the repository and converts pytest's per-test report into a run record.

nodes.name: _mutations
nodes.summary: Runs a time-bounded mutation check on the changed code to see whether the named tests notice injected faults.

nodes.name: run
nodes.summary: Bundle entry that reads the git change, runs and reruns tests, checks for weakened tests and diff shortcuts, runs mutations and returns labelled rows with the weakest state.

nodes.name: _lines
nodes.summary: Parses bank or ledger CSV text into dated money lines, reporting unreadable dates and amounts instead of reading them as zero.

nodes.name: _match
nodes.summary: Matches bank and ledger lines one to one on exact amount within a date window, keeping amount-only pairs as suggestions.

nodes.name: run
nodes.summary: Bundle entry that reconciles bank and ledger, checks GST coding per line, recomputes BAS figures and compares reported ones.

nodes.name: parse_sources
nodes.summary: Splits pasted source text into separate named sources.

nodes.name: run
nodes.summary: Bundle entry that checks each draft sentence against the sources with the grounding checker and returns labelled rows.

nodes.name: locate
nodes.summary: Finds where a reviewer's quoted line occurs in the pasted code.

nodes.name: run
nodes.summary: Bundle entry that asks the model for quoted findings and confirms or marks each as unconfirmed by locating its quote.

nodes.name: Requirement
nodes.summary: One GDPR or HIPAA requirement row with id, citation, title, requirement text and expected evidence.

nodes.name: When
nodes.summary: A parsed instant from an incident or request record, with its original text.

nodes.name: _answer_row
nodes.summary: Turns a user's yes/no/unknown answer and evidence for one requirement into a labelled row.

nodes.name: _deadline_row
nodes.summary: Builds a row comparing an event's deadline with when it was done or the as-of date.

nodes.name: _gdpr_breach
nodes.summary: Checks the GDPR 72-hour supervisory authority breach notice deadline for one incident record.

nodes.name: _hipaa_breach
nodes.summary: Checks HIPAA individual, media and HHS breach notice deadlines for one incident record.

nodes.name: _request
nodes.summary: Checks the GDPR one-month (or extended) data subject request deadline for one record.

nodes.name: _parse_record
nodes.summary: Parses one incident or request line into fields and ISO timestamps, reporting what it cannot read.

nodes.name: _pointers
nodes.summary: Optionally uses a model to point requirement rows at passages of the user's text, keeping only located quotes.

nodes.name: run
nodes.summary: Bundle entry that triages chosen regulations' requirement answers and computes record deadlines into labelled rows.

nodes.name: _span
nodes.summary: Returns a quoted span of the document around a match, widened to a readable radius.

nodes.name: _clauses
nodes.summary: Splits the document into numbered clauses for quoting and cross-reference checks.

nodes.name: _focus
nodes.summary: Finds the user's named focus items in the document and records where they occur.

nodes.name: _counts
nodes.summary: Counts occurrences of each defined term in the document by stem.

nodes.name: _defined_terms
nodes.summary: Extracts defined terms and reports ones used but undefined or defined but unused.

nodes.name: _cross_references
nodes.summary: Finds references to clauses or schedules whose numbering is absent from the pasted text.

nodes.name: _words_value
nodes.summary: Converts a sequence of English number words into an integer.

nodes.name: _number_in_words
nodes.summary: Reads the numeric value of the words before a bracketed figure.

nodes.name: _figures
nodes.summary: Reports amounts where the words and the bracketed figure disagree.

nodes.name: _read_closely
nodes.summary: Lists vague terms and wide phrases to read closely, without calling them defects.

nodes.name: _model_review
nodes.summary: Asks the model for issues with quotes after the instruction tripwire, keeping only issues whose quotes are in the original document and marking legal opinions as unchecked.

nodes.name: run
nodes.summary: Bundle entry that runs clause, defined-term, cross-reference, figure and close-reading checks plus optional model review into quoted rows.

nodes.name: run
nodes.summary: Bundle entry that screens sources for instructions, has the model answer from them, and checks each sentence with the grounding checker, escalating sentences backed only by flagged sources.

nodes.name: _leaks
nodes.summary: Detects leakage: duplicated train/test rows, columns that equal or perfectly predict the target, and shared identifier values.

nodes.name: _intervals
nodes.summary: Computes exact binomial or bootstrap confidence intervals for a metric.

nodes.name: _beats_baseline
nodes.summary: Decides whether predictions beat a training-data baseline by a paired interval gate.

nodes.name: _claims
nodes.summary: Parses the score claims a user pasted.

nodes.name: _predictions
nodes.summary: Obtains predictions from pasted values or by running a prediction script in the sandbox without the target column.

nodes.name: run
nodes.summary: Bundle entry that checks leakage, scores predictions with intervals and a baseline gate, and compares claimed scores.

nodes.name: run
nodes.summary: Bundle entry that asks the model for failure stories and holds each to an observable warning sign and cheap test, tagging plan claims.

nodes.name: _backups
nodes.summary: Parses the user's named backups per target from the backups field.

nodes.name: run
nodes.summary: Bundle entry that has the model structure each runbook step, gates every step through action gating and checks for rollback and final checks.

nodes.name: safe_actions.py
nodes.summary: Offline "Safe agent actions" bundle that parses one proposed agent action per line (type, target, reversibility/reach facts) and gates each through g6.action_gating.evaluate_action, returning per-action advice and the weakest completion state without executing anything.

nodes.name: server.py
nodes.summary: Local bundle runner that serves a token-protected private page on 127.0.0.1, checks Host/Origin headers, stores provider/model settings with owner-only permissions, records the isolation choice for bundles that run untrusted code, and runs a bundle on posted inputs.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses the stdlib http.server ThreadingHTTPServer with a handler class built in a closure (make_handler); the launch token travels only in the URL fragment so the browser never sends it to the server.

nodes.name: shipped.py
nodes.summary: Registry tuple of the eleven bundles shipped in this version (agent change check, safe actions, check claims, grounded answer, premortem, runbook, code review, ML check, bookkeeping, compliance gap, contract review); a bundle is listed only once it has an offline end-to-end test.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package barrel for g6.causal, the DoWhy-backed causal inference component: re-exports graph reading, the pure-Python criteria, ops, estimate_effect and CausalBlock, and declares component metadata (no sensitive ops, mitigates correlation_as_cause and wrong_adjustment, optional dowhy extra).
