nodes.languageNotes: Module docstring doubles as the design record: what was and was not ported from the archive dowhy_mcp, and why the best reachable state is qualified-draft.

nodes.name: causal_block.py
nodes.summary: CausalBlock, the registry and MCP door (g6_invoke) to g6.causal: a typed CausalInput model routes each op to one public function and returns its labelled envelope, so refusals become blocked-escalated results rather than raised errors.

nodes.name: checks.py
nodes.summary: Cross-engine checks for g6.causal: compares pure-Python and DoWhy answers on d-separation, backdoor paths and identification, judges each DoWhy refuter against the confidence-interval half-width, and recomputes linear-regression estimates by least squares with numpy.

nodes.name: criteria.py
nodes.summary: Exact pure-Python graph criteria for causal inference: d-separation via moralised ancestral graphs, open and backdoor path search, minimal adjustment sets, instruments, frontdoor sets, estimand strings and the identify routine, all with candidate/path size limits and deadline checks.

nodes.name: dowhy_engine.py
nodes.summary: Adapter for DoWhy as the second causal engine: lazily imports it, builds networkx graphs and DataFrames itself, and wraps every call in a session that captures warnings and logs for the evidence and seeds then restores numpy global random state.

nodes.name: envelope.py
nodes.summary: Stable G6_E_CAUSAL_* codes, the Refusal exception and finish(), the single place a causal result is labelled qualified-draft or blocked-escalated, with warning cards for graph answers and estimates.

nodes.name: estimation.py
nodes.summary: estimate_effect: validates inline rows against the graph, checks G6 identification, has DoWhy identify and estimate the effect with a confidence interval, recomputes linear regression independently, and runs placebo, random-common-cause and data-subset refuters judged by G6.

nodes.name: graph.py
nodes.summary: Causal graph data model and G6 own parser for JSON or a strict DOT subset, refusing cycles, self-loops, undeclared names and oversized graphs with distinct error codes; CausalGraph provides parents, children, ancestors, descendants and edge-removal views.
nodes.languageNotes: Hand-written recursive-descent tokenizer/parser (_Dot) for a deliberately narrow DOT subset; anything outside the subset is refused with line and column rather than skipped.

nodes.name: ops.py
nodes.summary: The g6.causal graph operations (d_separated, backdoor_paths, adjustment_sets, instruments, identify), each running the pure-Python criteria and optionally DoWhy under a time limit, requiring the engines to agree and returning one labelled CausalResult.

nodes.name: schema.py
nodes.summary: Pydantic CausalResult model, the one labelled result of g6.causal, whose completion_state accepts only qualified-draft or blocked-escalated.

nodes.name: SKILL.md
nodes.summary: Agent skill guide for g6-causal covering when to use and not use it, the ops, how to read results, composition, failure modes caught, blind spots, requirements, examples and open problems.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package barrel for g6.cegis, counterexample-guided synthesis that fills holes in a Python code sketch with every candidate run out of process; re-exports holes, sketch, runner, verify, Z3Verifier and template fitting, and declares beta component metadata.

nodes.name: _child.py
nodes.summary: Child-process entry point for CEGIS (python -I -m g6.cegis._child): reads one JSON request on stdin, lowers its own resource limits, AST-filters and compiles candidate source with a small builtins table, and evaluates or searches hole controls (exhaustive or seeded hill-climb).
nodes.languageNotes: Applies POSIX resource.setrlimit before running candidates; it is a resource bound plus AST pre-filter, not an OS sandbox.

nodes.name: hole.py
nodes.summary: Hole definitions for CEGIS sketches: integer (??), boolean (??b) and finite string set (??{...}) kinds, their value enumeration and acceptance, and extraction of holes from sketch source.

nodes.name: loop.py
nodes.summary: The CEGIS loop (Solar-Lezama Algorithm 1): fit examples, check the candidate on an explicit domain, optionally ask a verifier, feed back counterexamples; CegisResult reports a bounded status and maps it to a qualified-draft or blocked-escalated envelope with the isolation boundary.

nodes.name: runner.py
nodes.summary: Out-of-process runner for candidate code: the Runner protocol and SubprocessRunner, which launches g6.cegis._child via g6.core.component_process inside g6.core.confine where a backend exists, with wall-clock limits, tree kill and refusal when required isolation is unavailable.

nodes.name: sketch.py
nodes.summary: Sketch: a pure representation of a Python function with holes that builds instantiated source text and a wire format, validating source but never executing it.

nodes.name: SKILL.md
nodes.summary: Agent skill guide for g6-cegis explaining when to fill sketch holes by counterexample-guided synthesis, the Python API, reading results, composition, failure modes, blind spots, requirements, examples and open problems.

nodes.name: templates.py
nodes.summary: Numeric parametric template fitting (linear, polynomial, power, exponential, clamp, rational, piecewise-linear and scaled-sigmoid families) that proposes a sketch by least squares or curve fitting and checks it on holdout and a negative control through g6.distillation admission, as a proposal only.

nodes.name: verify.py
nodes.summary: Explicit input domains, table oracles and the candidate check for CEGIS, counting oracle-unanswered inputs as skipped and treating a check that compared nothing as inconclusive; defines the Verifier protocol and its Counterexample/NoCounterexample/Inconclusive answers.

nodes.name: z3_verifier.py
nodes.summary: Z3Verifier: translates a candidate return expression and the input domain into SMT-LIB through g6.formal and asks Z3 for a domain input breaking the spec, answering Counterexample, NoCounterexample or a degraded Inconclusive.
nodes.languageNotes: Reads the candidate via the Python ast module (never runs it) and maps a closed grammar of int/bool arithmetic, comparisons and conditionals onto SMT-LIB terms.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: The g6 command-line entry point: argparse subcommands for init, setup, components, find, describe, invoke, home, state snapshots, bundle serving, doctor and skill installation, dispatching to the registry, discovery, door and bundle server.

nodes.name: _parse
nodes.summary: Parses one action line into action type, target words and reversible/reach/backend/external facts, recording problems with unrecognised facts.

nodes.name: run
nodes.summary: Bundle entry: gates every parsed action through evaluate_action, builds advice rows and open questions, and returns a BundleResult with counts and the weakest state.

nodes.name: load_settings
nodes.summary: Reads the bundle model settings JSON from G6 state, falling back to defaults when absent or malformed.

nodes.name: save_settings
nodes.summary: Validates the provider and writes provider/model settings to an owner-only-permission JSON file.

nodes.name: public_settings
nodes.summary: Returns the settings shown to the page: provider, model and whether a key is present, never the key itself.

nodes.name: caller_from_settings
nodes.summary: Builds the model caller from saved settings or the environment provider.

nodes.name: isolation_state
nodes.summary: Reports whether a bundle that runs untrusted code can be confined by an OS boundary and what the person has chosen if not.

nodes.name: run_bundle
nodes.summary: Runs a bundle with string inputs and the configured caller, converting exceptions into a BundleResult and attaching a run id.

nodes.name: render_page
nodes.summary: Renders the HTML page for a bundle, escaping its fields, inputs and awaiting-certificate note.

nodes.name: make_handler
nodes.summary: Builds the HTTP request handler class enforcing token, Host and Origin checks and serving the page, settings, isolation and run endpoints.

nodes.name: start
nodes.summary: Starts a threaded HTTP server on 127.0.0.1 with a fresh random token and returns it.

nodes.name: serve
nodes.summary: Starts the runner, prints the tokenised link, opens the browser and blocks until interrupted.

nodes.name: CausalInput
nodes.summary: Typed pydantic input for CausalBlock naming the op, graph, variables, data rows, method, refutation and run identifiers; unknown fields are refused.

nodes.name: CausalBlock
nodes.summary: AIBlock subclass that lists the ops or dispatches an op to its g6.causal function and returns the labelled result.

nodes.name: compare_backdoor_paths
nodes.summary: Compares the two engines backdoor path lists and open/blocked status, recording differences.

nodes.name: compare_identification
nodes.summary: Checks agreement on identifiability, directed path, backdoor sets, instruments and frontdoor sets, validating DoWhy picks with G6 criteria.

nodes.name: judge_refutation
nodes.summary: Judges one DoWhy refuter result against a tolerance from the confidence-interval half-width, keeping DoWhy p-values as reported.

nodes.name: not_run
nodes.summary: Records a refuter that could not test the estimate, so it never counts as a pass.

nodes.name: design
nodes.summary: Builds the least-squares design matrix (intercept, treatment, adjustment set) from row columns with numpy.

nodes.name: recompute_linear
nodes.summary: Independently recomputes the linear-regression treatment coefficient by numpy lstsq and compares it to DoWhy within tolerance.

nodes.name: d_separated
nodes.summary: Decides d-separation by moralising the ancestral graph of the involved nodes (Lauritzen criterion) and searching for connectivity.

nodes.name: path_status
nodes.summary: Determines whether a given path is open under a conditioning set, listing colliders and blocking nodes.

nodes.name: render_path
nodes.summary: Renders a path as text with arrow directions between nodes.

nodes.name: open_path
nodes.summary: Finds a path left open by the conditioning set via depth-first search, judged node by node, under a deadline.

nodes.name: backdoor_paths
nodes.summary: Lists every backdoor path from treatment to outcome with open/blocked status, refusing when paths exceed the limit.

nodes.name: is_backdoor_set
nodes.summary: Checks the backdoor criterion: no treatment descendants and treatment/outcome d-separated once outgoing treatment edges are removed.

nodes.name: _minimal_sets
nodes.summary: Enumerates minimal subsets of a candidate pool satisfying a predicate, smallest first, under a deadline.

nodes.name: adjustment_sets
nodes.summary: Lists every minimal observed adjustment set meeting the backdoor criterion from ancestors that are not treatment descendants.

nodes.name: is_instrument
nodes.summary: Checks the graphical instrument criterion for one candidate variable.

nodes.name: has_directed_path
nodes.summary: Tests for a directed path between two nodes, optionally avoiding a set of nodes.

nodes.name: is_frontdoor_set
nodes.summary: Checks Pearl frontdoor criterion for a set of mediators.

nodes.name: frontdoor_sets
nodes.summary: Lists every minimal observed mediator set meeting the frontdoor criterion.

nodes.name: backdoor_estimand
nodes.summary: Writes out the backdoor adjustment estimand formula as text.

nodes.name: iv_estimand
nodes.summary: Writes out the instrumental-variable estimand formula as text.

nodes.name: identify
nodes.summary: Decides whether the effect is identifiable by backdoor, frontdoor or instrumental-variable criteria and returns the estimand or the reason it is not.

nodes.name: _Records
nodes.summary: logging.Handler that collects DoWhy log records for the evidence instead of the console.

nodes.name: available
nodes.summary: Reports whether DoWhy and its dependencies can be imported.

nodes.name: session
nodes.summary: Context manager around DoWhy calls that captures warnings and log records and seeds then restores numpy global random state.

nodes.name: nx_graph
nodes.summary: Builds a networkx DiGraph from a CausalGraph for DoWhy, marking unobserved nodes.

nodes.name: summarise
nodes.summary: Summarises a DoWhy identified estimand into backdoor, instrument and frontdoor fields comparable with G6 own answer.

nodes.name: identification
nodes.summary: Runs DoWhy identify_effect on the graph with an empty frame and returns the summary.

nodes.name: Refusal
nodes.summary: Exception carrying a stable G6_E_CAUSAL_* code and reason, used to refuse input or work at any step.

nodes.name: finish
nodes.summary: Labels a causal result: decides completion state from the code and engines, builds the warning card and evidence, and validates through CausalResult.

nodes.name: _graph_card
nodes.summary: Builds the warning card for a graph answer, noting whether one or both engines ran and that the graph cannot be confirmed by data.

nodes.name: _estimate_card
nodes.summary: Builds the warning card for an effect estimate, covering method, refutation status and recomputation.

nodes.name: _value
nodes.summary: Validates one row cell as a finite number or boolean, refusing anything else.

nodes.name: _columns
nodes.summary: Validates inline rows against the graph (consistent columns, observed nodes only, row/column limits) and returns column vectors.

nodes.name: _route
nodes.summary: Maps the requested estimation method to its identification route and refuses methods that do not apply.

nodes.name: estimate_effect
nodes.summary: Public estimator: validates input, identifies with G6 and DoWhy, estimates with a confidence interval, recomputes and refutes, returning a labelled CausalResult.

nodes.name: CausalGraph
nodes.summary: Immutable causal DAG with nodes, edges and unobserved set, providing parents, children, ancestors, descendants and edge-removal views.

nodes.name: read_graph
nodes.summary: Reads a graph from a JSON object/string or DOT text, refusing anything else, and returns a checked CausalGraph.

nodes.name: _checked
nodes.summary: Checks declared nodes, edges and unobserved names against size limits, self-loops and cycles before building the graph.

nodes.name: _cycle
nodes.summary: Finds and names a cycle in the graph by depth-first search, if any.

nodes.name: _from_json
nodes.summary: Parses the JSON graph form, requiring declared nodes.

nodes.name: _Dot
nodes.summary: Tokenizer and recursive-descent parser for the strict DOT subset, refusing unsupported syntax with line and column.

nodes.name: deadline_for
nodes.summary: Validates a time limit and converts it into a perf-counter deadline.

nodes.name: run
nodes.summary: Runs an op body, converting Refusal into a blocked result and labelling the outcome through finish with elapsed time.

nodes.name: read
nodes.summary: Reads the graph spec into op state via read_graph.

nodes.name: node_set
nodes.summary: Validates a list of node names against the graph and role, deduplicating them.

nodes.name: effect_nodes
nodes.summary: Validates treatment and outcome as known, observed and distinct nodes.

nodes.name: _second
nodes.summary: Runs DoWhy as the second engine when requested or available and records agreement or disagreement.

nodes.name: d_separated
nodes.summary: Public op: d-separation answer with an open path when not separated, cross-checked with DoWhy.

nodes.name: backdoor_paths
nodes.summary: Public op: every backdoor path with open/blocked status, cross-checked with DoWhy.

nodes.name: adjustment_sets
nodes.summary: Public op: every minimal backdoor adjustment set and its estimand.

nodes.name: instruments
nodes.summary: Public op: every observed instrument, cross-checked with DoWhy identification.

nodes.name: identify
nodes.summary: Public op: identifiability by backdoor, frontdoor or IV with estimand, cross-checked with DoWhy.

nodes.name: CausalResult
nodes.summary: Pydantic model of the causal result envelope fields (state, answer, estimate, refutations, evidence, ids) with completion_state limited to qualified-draft or blocked-escalated.

nodes.name: _limit
nodes.summary: Lowers address-space, CPU and file-size limits on POSIX before candidate code runs.

nodes.name: _compiled
nodes.summary: Instantiates, AST-validates and compiles a candidate with a restricted builtins table, returning the function.

nodes.name: same
nodes.summary: Compares two outcomes for equality, treating numeric and JSON values consistently.

nodes.name: _evaluate
nodes.summary: Handles an evaluate request: runs each control-instantiated candidate on the inputs and returns outcomes.

nodes.name: _fits
nodes.summary: Checks whether a control assignment reproduces every example.

nodes.name: _error
nodes.summary: Scores a control by how many examples it misses, for the hill-climb search.

nodes.name: _search
nodes.summary: Searches hole controls exhaustively when the space is small or by a seeded hill-climb otherwise, returning the first fitting control.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Child entry: reads one JSON request from stdin, applies limits, dispatches evaluate or search, and writes the JSON reply.

nodes.name: HoleKind
nodes.summary: String enum of hole kinds: integer, boolean and string-set.

nodes.name: Hole
nodes.summary: One sketch hole with kind, range or choices, enumerating its values and accepting candidate values.

nodes.name: extract_holes
nodes.summary: Finds ??, ??b and ??{...} holes in sketch source with their spans.

nodes.name: CegisResult
nodes.summary: Result of a CEGIS run with status, program, counterexamples and boundary, mapping to completion_state and the library envelope.

nodes.name: cegis
nodes.summary: Public entry that records the confinement of every candidate run and delegates to the loop.

nodes.name: _cegis
nodes.summary: The loop body: search controls fitting the examples, check on the domain, consult the verifier, add counterexamples, and stop on budget, timeout or refusal.

nodes.name: SearchResult
nodes.summary: Dataclass of a child search reply: control, method, completeness and number tried.

nodes.name: Runner
nodes.summary: Protocol for running candidates: evaluate on inputs and search for fitting controls.

nodes.name: SubprocessRunner
nodes.summary: Runner that sends JSON requests to the g6.cegis._child process under confinement and component_process limits, refusing when isolation is required but unavailable.

nodes.name: Sketch
nodes.summary: Function source with holes: parses holes, checks controls, instantiates source text and serialises to the child wire format, never executing.

nodes.name: TemplateFit
nodes.summary: Result of a template fit with candidate, holdout report and completion state.

nodes.name: _fit
nodes.summary: Fits a numeric family (linear, polynomial, power, exponential, clamp, rational, piecewise-linear, scaled sigmoid) to cases with numpy least squares or scipy curve_fit.

nodes.name: fit_template
nodes.summary: Fits a family on training cases, instantiates the sketch and evaluates it on holdout and a negative control through distillation admission.

nodes.name: TableOracle
nodes.summary: Data-only oracle answering from a table of input/output cases.

nodes.name: InputDomain
nodes.summary: Explicit input domain over named arguments, with integer ranges, size, exhaustive or sampled inputs and a description.

nodes.name: answered
nodes.summary: Calls the oracle on inputs, splitting answered cases from skipped ones where the oracle raised.

nodes.name: Check
nodes.summary: Outcome of checking one candidate: compared, skipped, counterexample and related counts.

nodes.name: check_candidate
nodes.summary: Runs a candidate on answered cases through a Runner and returns the first disagreement with the oracle.

nodes.name: Counterexample
nodes.summary: Verifier answer: an input on which the candidate breaks the spec.

nodes.name: NoCounterexample
nodes.summary: Verifier answer: no input of the encoded domain breaks the spec.

nodes.name: Inconclusive
nodes.summary: Degraded verifier answer with a reason, never read as a pass.

nodes.name: Verifier
nodes.summary: Protocol for an optional second check that finds a counterexample for a candidate.

nodes.name: _term
nodes.summary: Translates a Python AST expression node into an SMT-LIB term within the closed int/bool grammar, raising Untranslatable otherwise.

nodes.name: candidate_term
nodes.summary: Parses candidate source and returns the SMT-LIB term for its single return expression.

nodes.name: domain_constraints
nodes.summary: Encodes an InputDomain as SMT-LIB declarations and range or membership constraints.

nodes.name: _decide
nodes.summary: Maps a Z3 decision to Counterexample, NoCounterexample or Inconclusive, checking the model lies inside the domain.

nodes.name: Z3Verifier
nodes.summary: Verifier asking Z3 via g6.formal for a domain input on which the candidate breaks the spec term.

nodes.name: _bundle
nodes.summary: Handles g6 bundle: lists the catalog or serves the named bundle locally.

nodes.name: _state
nodes.summary: Handles g6 state subcommands: list, snapshot, rollback and export of G6 state snapshots.

nodes.name: _skills
nodes.summary: Handles g6 skills: lists components with skills or installs/updates skill folders into a target directory.

nodes.name: _doctor_report
nodes.summary: Builds and writes the doctor diagnostic report.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Argparse entry point defining every g6 subcommand and dispatching to setup, doctor, registry, discovery, invoke, state, bundle and skills handlers.

nodes.name: doctor.py
nodes.summary: `g6 doctor`: a read-only installation check (Python, package, G6 home, SQLite, extras, keys, model provider, OS isolation backend, component registry and name collisions), each ok/warn/fail with a plain fix; also builds a local, caller-text-stripped error report from a saved traceback with `--report`.
nodes.languageNotes: Parses traceback frames with ast to decide which names are G6 own code without importing any module the traceback names.

nodes.name: setup.py
nodes.summary: `g6 setup`: asks the person, once per computer, whether code may run without an operating-system boundary (recorded in choices.json), optionally saves the host model provider, and registers the g6 MCP server and its skill with Claude and Codex clients.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package marker for the `code` family of extensions (build, check, scan and repair code); the family itself is not a registered component.

nodes.name: _build.py
nodes.summary: Shared bounded build/check plumbing for code extensions: the immutable Artefact file map with provenance, the trusted BuildRegistry of builders and check scripts, running check scripts in core.sandbox, and writing files only under declared roots.
nodes.languageNotes: Frozen dataclasses with __post_init__ validation and MappingProxyType make artefacts immutable after construction.

nodes.name: _roots.py
nodes.summary: Declares and enforces the folders a code extension may read and write (from G6_CODE_CONFIG or code/config.json): resolves paths, refuses anything outside a root, and walks repositories with skipped folders, link checks and stated caps.

nodes.name: _types.py
nodes.summary: Shared reply shapes for code extensions: `answer` builds a qualified-draft envelope and `refuse` a blocked-escalated one, both carrying the cross-surface fields and a stable G6_E_* code; CodeRefused is the exception ops raise to refuse.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Registers the adapt_django component (Django source generation without Django, with sandboxed project checks) and declares its registry metadata: block, sensitive ops, extras and failure modes.

nodes.name: block.py
nodes.summary: AdaptDjangoBlock: the registry/MCP door that builds Django source files, runs Django system and migration checks in the sandbox, and writes files under declared roots, all dry-run by default for sensitive ops.

nodes.name: checks.py
nodes.summary: Defines the two sandboxed Django check scripts (`manage.py check` and `makemigrations --check --dry-run`) for a validated settings module.

nodes.name: generators.py
nodes.summary: Template generators that emit Django models, views, URLs, admin, forms, serializers and settings source from a validated DjangoSpec, packed as an Artefact.

nodes.name: schema.py
nodes.summary: Strict pydantic schema for adapt_django requests: field, model, view and project specs with identifier checks, relation targets and uniqueness rules.

nodes.name: SKILL.md
nodes.summary: Agent skill guide for adapt_django: when to use it, its ops, composition with other components, failure modes it catches, blind spots, requirements, examples and open problems.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Registers the adapt_healing component, which repairs a failing step of Python code and keeps a patch only if it passes held-back tests its proposer never saw; documents the flow and what was not ported from the archive.

nodes.name: block.py
nodes.summary: AdaptHealingBlock: the registry and MCP door for adapt_healing, exposing the sensitive `heal` op and the read-only `check_tests` op, with suggested actions keyed by each G6_E_HEAL_* code.

nodes.name: cases.py
nodes.summary: Parses and runs the two test kinds for a repair in core.sandbox: shown assert statements run whole, and held-back `assert expr == literal` tests whose literal stays in G6 process and is compared after the child returns the value.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses ast.literal_eval on values read back from the child so expected answers are never executed or exposed.

nodes.name: heal.py
nodes.summary: The heal loop: reproduce and triage the failure with g6.triage, ask the injected model caller for a patch for up to three rounds against shown tests, then judge the first passing patch once on held-back tests.

nodes.name: SKILL.md
nodes.summary: Agent skill guide for adapt_healing: when to repair code with it, the heal and check_tests ops, how to read the result, blind spots (the sandbox is not an OS boundary), and examples.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Registers the adapt_library_synthesizer component, which drafts Python from a paper spec and checks independently supplied examples; declares its sensitive ops and pypdf extra.

nodes.name: backend.py
nodes.summary: Model-backed spec extraction and Python module synthesis from paper text through an injected LLM caller, plus example-based check scripts built from caller-supplied oracle examples.

nodes.name: block.py
nodes.summary: AdaptLibrarySynthesizerBlock: the door for paper-to-Python synthesis, with ops to extract a spec, build, run example checks, fetch a paper and write files; every sensitive op is dry-run by default.

nodes.name: ingestion.py
nodes.summary: Bounded paper fetching through core.http with a publication-host allow-list checked at every redirect hop, and PDF text extraction run in the sandbox.

nodes.name: schema.py
nodes.summary: Strict pydantic schema for library synthesis requests: oracle examples, the algorithm spec extracted from a paper, model-returned code, and the block input.

nodes.name: SKILL.md
nodes.summary: Agent skill guide for adapt_library_synthesizer: when to turn a paper method into Python, its six ops, composition, failure modes, blind spots, requirements and examples.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Registers the adapt_webpage component, which builds web pages and design tokens and checks syntax, declared contrast and optional overflow in a browser; declares its tinycss2 and playwright extras.

nodes.name: backend.py
nodes.summary: The WebpageBackend protocol and its deterministic offline TemplateBackend, plus builders that turn page and design-token specs into Artefacts and the BuildRegistry wiring them to their checks.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses typing.Protocol for a structural backend interface rather than an abstract base class.

nodes.name: Check
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass for one doctor result: name, status (ok, warn or fail), detail and a plain-language fix.

nodes.name: _home
nodes.summary: Checks that the G6 home folder exists and is writable, or warns that it can still be created under a writable parent.

nodes.name: _keys
nodes.summary: Reports which names the key file sets (never their values) and any problems reading it.

nodes.name: _host_model
nodes.summary: Checks a host-CLI model provider by locating its program and naming the fix when it is missing.

nodes.name: _model
nodes.summary: Checks the configured G6_LLM_PROVIDER: none, a host CLI, or an API provider with its key and SDK present.

nodes.name: _isolation
nodes.summary: Checks the operating-system confinement backend (core.confine), whether it is required or allowed, and on Linux whether a confined test run starts.

nodes.name: _components
nodes.summary: Imports every registered component module and reports any that fail to load.

nodes.name: _g6_class
nodes.summary: Decides whether a dotted exception name is a class defined in G6 own source by parsing the file with ast, never importing it.

nodes.name: run_checks
nodes.summary: Runs every doctor check in order against the environment and key file and returns the list of Check results.

nodes.name: render
nodes.summary: Renders doctor checks as plain text lines with status markers and fixes.

nodes.name: diagnostic_report
nodes.summary: Builds a local error report from traceback text: exception name, G6-owned frames, versions and platform, with caller text replaced by <caller> or masked through g6.context.redact.

nodes.name: write_report
nodes.summary: Writes a diagnostic report as JSON under $G6_HOME/diagnostics, or only names the path on a dry run.

nodes.name: add_arguments
nodes.summary: Adds the setup command flags: allow/refuse unconfined, model provider, clients and allowed sensitive ops.

nodes.name: isolation
nodes.summary: Asks, or takes from flags, whether code may run without an OS boundary when none is available, and records the choice.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Runs the setup steps in order: creates the G6 home, configures the model provider, then registers the MCP server with clients.

nodes.name: configure_model
nodes.summary: Writes G6_LLM_PROVIDER (claude_code or codex) to the key file atomically through a temporary file, keeping other lines and refusing a symlinked target.

nodes.name: register_clients
nodes.summary: Registers the g6 MCP server through each Claude or Codex CLI found on PATH (started with -P, passing allowed sensitive ops and the model), installs this version of the skill, and prints the first review call or why patch review is off.

nodes.name: plain_path
nodes.summary: Validates a relative artefact file path: plain name segments only, no Windows reserved device names.

nodes.name: _validate_names
nodes.summary: Checks an artefact file map for count limits, case-insensitive duplicates and file/folder name clashes.

nodes.name: Provenance
nodes.summary: Records how an artefact was made (template, caller or model prompt) and validates that exactly one source is given.

nodes.name: Artefact
nodes.summary: Immutable, size-bounded map of generated file names to bytes with its provenance; built from text and described for replies.

nodes.name: CheckResult
nodes.summary: The outcome of one check: name, passed (or None when not run), evidence, reason and code.

nodes.name: Check
nodes.summary: A trusted check script with its refusal code, time and memory limits, and expected oracle values.

nodes.name: BuildRegistry
nodes.summary: Registry of trusted builder and check-script factories by kind; request data cannot replace a checker.

nodes.name: run_checks
nodes.summary: Zips an artefact and runs each check script against it in core.sandbox, parsing a nonce-tagged JSON result into CheckResults.

nodes.name: checked_reply
nodes.summary: Turns check results into an answer (qualified-draft) or, when any check failed, a refuse (blocked-escalated) reply.

nodes.name: write_files
nodes.summary: Writes artefact files under a destination resolved against declared roots, refusing symlinks and paths that escape, with a dry-run mode.

nodes.name: Roots
nodes.summary: Frozen record of the resolved declared roots and where the declaration came from.

nodes.name: parse
nodes.summary: Parses a roots JSON declaration, requiring an object with only absolute root paths (no ~), and refuses the declaration whole when invalid.

nodes.name: load
nodes.summary: Loads the roots declaration from G6_CODE_CONFIG or the state file, returning no roots when none is declared.

nodes.name: under
nodes.summary: Tells whether a resolved path is at or under any declared root.

nodes.name: existing
nodes.summary: Resolves an absolute path an agent names (following .. and links) and refuses it unless it exists under a root.

nodes.name: destination
nodes.summary: Resolves a folder an op would write into and refuses it unless it lies inside a declared root, is new or empty, and has an existing parent.

nodes.name: Walk
nodes.summary: The result of walking a folder: files found plus counts of skipped links, capped files and bytes, said rather than silent.

nodes.name: walk
nodes.summary: Lists source files under a confined folder with suffix filters, skipped directories, file/byte/entry caps and a time limit.

nodes.name: _files
nodes.summary: Iterative directory scan behind walk that skips listed folders, links and junctions and stops at the entry cap or deadline.

nodes.name: read_text
nodes.summary: Reads a confined file as text within a byte limit after re-checking it is under a root.

nodes.name: CodeRefused
nodes.summary: Exception an op raises when it cannot go on, carrying a stable G6_E_* code, the reason, evidence and extra fields.

nodes.name: answer
nodes.summary: Builds a qualified-draft reply with a WarningCard, evidence and the cross-surface envelope fields.

nodes.name: refuse
nodes.summary: Builds a blocked-escalated reply with a WarningCard and a refusal evidence entry for its stable code.

nodes.name: AdaptDjangoBlock
nodes.summary: AIBlock dispatching the ops, help, build, run_checks and write_files ops for Django, turning CodeRefused and input errors into refusals.

nodes.name: checks_for
nodes.summary: Validates the settings module name and returns the sandboxed Django system-check and migration-drift Check scripts.

nodes.name: field_args
nodes.summary: Renders the Django field constructor arguments for one FieldSpec, including relations and options.

nodes.name: models
nodes.summary: Generates models.py source for every model in the spec.

nodes.name: views
nodes.summary: Generates views.py source for the spec views.

nodes.name: admin
nodes.summary: Generates admin.py registrations for the spec models.

nodes.name: settings
nodes.summary: Generates a settings.py that refuses an unset SECRET_KEY, with installed apps and database configuration.

nodes.name: build_django
nodes.summary: Validates a raw DjangoSpec and assembles every generated source file into an Artefact with template provenance.

nodes.name: FieldSpec
nodes.summary: Strict spec for one Django model field: type, options and relation targets.

nodes.name: ModelSpec
nodes.summary: Strict spec for one Django model with its fields and unique field names.

nodes.name: ViewSpec
nodes.summary: Strict spec for one Django view bound to a model.

nodes.name: DjangoSpec
nodes.summary: Strict spec for a Django app: app name, models and views, with name-uniqueness and relation checks.

nodes.name: AdaptDjangoInput
nodes.summary: Block input for adapt_django: op, kind, spec or files, destination, settings module, dry-run and run ids.

nodes.name: AdaptHealingInput
nodes.summary: Pydantic input for adapt_healing: op, code, error, shown and held-back tests, rounds and timeout.

nodes.name: heal_op
nodes.summary: Runs heal for a request and wraps the outcome as a qualified-draft answer with the patch, rounds and held-back verdicts.

nodes.name: check_tests
nodes.summary: Reads the tests and the error without running anything: test forms, held-back tests also shown, and the error triage.

nodes.name: AdaptHealingBlock
nodes.summary: AIBlock door for adapt_healing taking an injected model caller; dispatches heal and check_tests and maps CodeRefused to refusals with suggested actions.

nodes.name: check_bounds
nodes.summary: Bounds each test and the combined shown and held-back input before parsing.

nodes.name: HeldBack
nodes.summary: A parsed held-back test: index, expression the child computes, the expected literal kept in G6 and the expression shape.

nodes.name: shown
nodes.summary: Parses shown tests, requiring each to be a single assert statement.

nodes.name: held_back
nodes.summary: Parses held-back tests of the form assert <expression> == <literal> into HeldBack records, refusing any other form.

nodes.name: expected_literals
nodes.summary: Collects the literals the shown tests expect, used to flag a patch that spells them out.

nodes.name: _run
nodes.summary: Runs a template script with code and cases in core.sandbox and parses its nonce-tagged JSON output.

nodes.name: run_shown
nodes.summary: Runs code with the shown tests in the sandbox and returns each test failure.

nodes.name: judge
nodes.summary: Judges a patch once on held-back tests: the child computes each expression and G6 compares the returned value with the literal it kept.

nodes.name: error_parts
nodes.summary: Splits an error or traceback into its exception type and message from the last Type: message line.

nodes.name: heal
nodes.summary: The full repair loop: reproduce, triage, ask the caller for up to three patches checked on shown tests, flag spelled-out expected literals, and judge on held-back tests.

nodes.name: ask
nodes.summary: Calls the injected LLM caller and extracts JSON from its reply, refusing when no model was given.

nodes.name: extract_spec
nodes.summary: Asks the model to extract an AlgorithmSpec from untrusted paper text.

nodes.name: require_examples
nodes.summary: Refuses synthesis without oracle examples, bounds their total size, and checks that any paper_quote appears verbatim in the supplied paper text.

nodes.name: build_module
nodes.summary: Asks the model to implement the spec, parses the returned source, and packs it with example tests into an Artefact with model provenance.

nodes.name: checks_for
nodes.summary: Builds the sandboxed Check that calls the synthesized module on caller-supplied example inputs, keeping the expected values in G6 rather than in the script.

nodes.name: AdaptLibrarySynthesizerBlock
nodes.summary: AIBlock dispatching backend_capabilities, extract_spec, build, run_checks, fetch_paper and write_files, each sensitive op dry-run by default.

nodes.name: allowed
nodes.summary: Refuses a paper URL whose scheme is not http(s) or whose host is not in the publication allow-list.

nodes.name: PaperClient
nodes.summary: core.http Client subclass that applies the publication allow-list at every checked URL, including redirect hops.

nodes.name: fetch_paper
nodes.summary: Fetches a bounded paper through PaperClient and returns its text, extracting PDF text in the sandbox when needed.

nodes.name: AlgorithmSpec
nodes.summary: Strict spec of an algorithm extracted from a paper: inputs, outputs, steps, invariants, complexity and hyperparameters.

nodes.name: Example
nodes.summary: An independently supplied oracle example: a call and its expected value.

nodes.name: AdaptLibrarySynthesizerInput
nodes.summary: Block input for adapt_library_synthesizer: op, paper text or URL, spec, examples, files, destination and dry-run.

nodes.name: BackendResult
nodes.summary: Frozen result of a webpage backend call: ok flag, HTML, CSS and metadata.

nodes.name: WebpageBackend
nodes.summary: Protocol for webpage backends: capabilities, schema_for and execute with network, CDN and WebGL permission flags.

nodes.name: TemplateBackend
nodes.summary: Deterministic offline backend that builds a page, component, sections or CSS from a WebSpec and refuses any network, CDN or WebGL request.

nodes.name: build_page
nodes.summary: Builds index.html and style.css as an Artefact, wrapping component and section output in a full HTML document.

nodes.name: build_tokens
nodes.summary: Generates colour, typography, spacing, shadow, radius and breakpoint tokens and exports them as CSS, Tailwind or DTCG JSON.

nodes.name: registry
nodes.summary: Creates the BuildRegistry wiring web_page and design_tokens builders to the webpage checks.

nodes.name: block.py
nodes.summary: Registry and MCP door for the adapt_webpage component: AdaptWebpageBlock dispatches build, backend_capabilities, run_checks and write_files ops, returning checked replies or G6_E_* refusals with request_id/run_id.

nodes.name: checks.py
nodes.summary: Fixed check scripts for generated web artefacts: HTML tag-balance parsing, tinycss2 CSS syntax, WCAG contrast of declared pairs and optional Playwright overflow measurement at breakpoints, packaged as sandbox Check objects.
nodes.languageNotes: check_for builds Check scripts from function source via inspect.getsource so the same bodies run inside the sandbox transport.

nodes.name: color_math.py
nodes.summary: Pure colour arithmetic for design tokens: hex/RGB/HSL conversions, shade-scale generation and WCAG relative luminance and contrast ratio.

nodes.name: export.py
nodes.summary: Serialises design tokens to CSS custom properties (with optional dark-mode variant), a Tailwind config JSON and DTCG-shaped JSON, sanitising identifiers and values on the way out.

nodes.name: generators.py
nodes.summary: Deterministic HTML/CSS page generators: builds pages, single components, composed sections and theme CSS from the pattern library, escaping text and sanitising custom CSS.

nodes.name: patterns.py
nodes.summary: Static library of reusable HTML/CSS section templates (hero, features, price tables and similar) and theme definitions used by the page generators.
nodes.languageNotes: Data-only module: large dict literals of HTML strings with {title}/{description} placeholders and matching CSS.

nodes.name: sanitise.py
nodes.summary: Allow-list sanitisers for untrusted CSS and URL inputs (selectors, colours, identifiers, times, easings, angles, lengths, numbers, style blocks, URLs) that fall back to safe defaults.

nodes.name: schema.py
nodes.summary: Pydantic input models for adapt_webpage: DesignToken, contrast Pair, WebSpec, TokenSpec and the AdaptWebpageInput door model that refuses extra fields.

nodes.name: token_sanitise.py
nodes.summary: Sanitisers for design-token output: CSS identifier and value allow-listing, class-suffix derivation and HTML text escaping.

nodes.name: tokens.py
nodes.summary: Generates the non-colour design-token sets: modular typography scale, spacing, shadows, radii and breakpoints as DesignToken lists.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package root for component_creator, the library's scaffolder: re-exports the block, input and spec models and declares the G6 component metadata (family, sensitive ops, failure modes mitigated and introduced).

nodes.name: block.py
nodes.summary: Registry and MCP door for component_creator: ComponentCreatorInput and ComponentCreatorBlock route spec_from_module, spec_from_text, render and check_conformance ops, reading modules under declared roots and writing only when asked.

nodes.name: conformance.py
nodes.summary: Holds a component package to the library's standard by static AST checks of declarations, failure-mode codes, the block's typed input and ops, its skill file and its tests, with execution recorded for installed components.

nodes.name: render.py
nodes.summary: Renders a ComponentSpec into the library's file shape: package __init__ declarations, a block with typed input and refusing handlers, a skill whose Ops match, and a failing test, and writes the file map to a new folder.

nodes.name: spec.py
nodes.summary: Defines the ComponentSpec/OpSpec/FieldSpec models a scaffold is rendered from, and drafts specs either by reading a module's public functions with ast or by asking a caller-supplied model and validating the reply.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package root for design_governance: re-exports the block, input, contract and graph module and declares G6 component metadata (no sensitive ops, mitigates unmanaged_complexity).

nodes.name: block.py
nodes.summary: Registry and MCP door for design_governance: input models (Forbid, Contract, DesignGovernanceInput) and handlers for import_graph, cycles, layer_violations, pass_through and diff_cycles that refuse checks with nothing to check.

nodes.name: graph.py
nodes.summary: Builds a package's import graph from a caller-given file map by AST and analyses it: iterative Tarjan cycles, layer-contract breaches, pass-through wrapper detection and cycle diffs between two versions.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses an iterative Tarjan SCC to avoid raising the interpreter recursion limit.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package root for meta_programming: re-exports analyze, edits, extract, runner and scopes plus the block, and declares component metadata (run_tests sensitive, mitigates fragile_text_edit).

nodes.name: analyze.py
nodes.summary: Reads what a Python module holds from its syntax tree without running it: parse status and location of errors, functions with parameters, decorators and decision counts, classes, imports and __all__.

nodes.name: block.py
nodes.summary: Registry and MCP door for meta_programming: MetaProgrammingInput and handlers for parse, analyze, rename, extract_function and the sensitive sandboxed run_tests op, each edit returned with its checks or refused.

nodes.name: edits.py
nodes.summary: Scope-aware rename and extract-function edits that change only the needed characters, keep comments, and re-parse, compile and compare each result with the expected tree before returning it.

nodes.name: SKILL.md
nodes.summary: Agent skill for adapt_webpage covering when to use it, its four ops, composition (build, review, run_checks, write_files), artefact limits, contrast and overflow failure modes caught, blind spots and examples.

nodes.name: SKILL.md
nodes.summary: Agent skill for component_creator describing when to scaffold or conformance-check a G6 component, its ops, how to read results, failure modes caught, blind spots, needs and examples.

nodes.name: SKILL.md
nodes.summary: Agent skill for design_governance: checking a changed codebase for new import cycles, layer-rule breaches and pass-through wrappers from a file map, with ops, result reading, blind spots and examples.

nodes.name: AdaptWebpageBlock

nodes.summary: Splits evidence items into counted and rejected, keeping each rejection's reason.

nodes.name: _protected
nodes.summary: Applies the protected-paths policy to the touched paths and emits findings when a policy is missing, fails, or a protected path lacks review by someone other than the author.

nodes.name: preflight
nodes.summary: Checks a task and proposed action before acting: shortcuts, diff structure, risk level, protected paths and missing evidence, returning block, needs_review, needs_evidence or proceed_with_caution.

nodes.name: verify_answer
nodes.summary: Checks a drafted answer before reporting done: counted evidence, verifier result, task contract, shortcuts, overclaims and claims without files, returning block, needs_review, revise or pass.

nodes.name: _normal_path
nodes.summary: Normalises a repository-relative path, rejecting absolute paths, drive letters, control characters and parent traversal.

nodes.name: PathExemption
nodes.summary: Frozen pydantic model of a protected-path exemption pattern with a timezone-aware expiry.

nodes.name: ProtectedPathsPolicy
nodes.summary: Frozen pydantic model of the host's protected path patterns and their exemptions.

nodes.name: classify_paths
nodes.summary: Classifies each path as protected, exempt or unclassified by lexical glob matching against the policy.

nodes.name: tighten
nodes.summary: Asks an LLM to review a gate decision and applies only a stricter verdict plus one finding, leaving the deterministic decision standing on any failure.

nodes.name: answer
nodes.summary: Builds a qualified-draft cogarch reply with an amber WarningCard, evidence and request and run ids.

nodes.name: refuse
nodes.summary: Builds a blocked-escalated cogarch reply with a blocked WarningCard and a refusal evidence entry.

nodes.name: StoreBusy
nodes.summary: TimeoutError raised when a named store's lock cannot be acquired within its timeout.

nodes.name: store_lock
nodes.summary: Context manager holding a store's O_EXCL lock file across load, change and save, clearing stale leases and releasing only its own token.

nodes.name: _check_lease
nodes.summary: Refuses a write when the held lease has expired or the lock file has been replaced by another owner.

nodes.name: atomic_write
nodes.summary: Writes text to a unique temporary file in the same folder and atomically replaces the target after checking the lease.

nodes.name: CogArchActrInput
nodes.summary: Strict pydantic input for the ACT-R ops with validators for plain slots, production tests and finite numeric parameters.

nodes.name: add_chunk
nodes.summary: Block op that keeps a chunk in the memory, or records another presentation of an equivalent one, and saves the store.

nodes.name: retrieve
nodes.summary: Block op that retrieves the highest-activation matching chunk with its activation breakdown and latency, or refuses below the threshold, and saves the presentation.

nodes.name: add_production
nodes.summary: Block op that validates and stores a production with its conditions and actions.

nodes.name: run
nodes.summary: Block op that fires productions from a goal until the caller's goal test passes, returning the trace, and saves the store.

nodes.name: reward
nodes.summary: Block op that applies utility learning to productions used since the last reward and saves the store.

nodes.name: CogArchActrBlock
nodes.summary: AIBlock registered as cog_arch_actr; infer loads the named memory under the store lock, runs the op and maps refusals and StoreBusy to blocked-escalated replies.

nodes.name: base_level
nodes.summary: Base-level activation B_i = ln(sum t_j^-d) + beta from presentation ages and decay.

nodes.name: fan
nodes.summary: Counts the fan of each context value across the memory's chunks.

nodes.name: spreading
nodes.summary: Spreading activation from context sources with associative strength S - ln(fan), negative strengths counted as zero.

nodes.name: logistic_noise
nodes.summary: Draws logistic activation noise with mean zero and scale s from a seeded generator.

nodes.name: retrieval_time
nodes.summary: Retrieval latency F * e^(-f * A).

nodes.name: failure_time
nodes.summary: Latency of a retrieval failure F * e^(-f * tau).

nodes.name: utility_update
nodes.summary: Utility learning step U(n) = U(n-1) + alpha * (R - U(n-1)).

nodes.name: Refused
nodes.summary: Exception carrying a stable refusal code and reason raised out of the memory store.

nodes.name: Chunk
nodes.summary: Pydantic model of a declarative chunk: type, slots and presentation times.

nodes.name: Production
nodes.summary: Pydantic model of a production rule with conditions, actions and learned utility.

nodes.name: State
nodes.summary: Pydantic model of a whole persisted memory: chunks, productions and pending production uses.

nodes.name: Params
nodes.summary: Pydantic model of ACT-R parameters (decay, noise, threshold, latency, spreading and utility settings) with manual defaults.

nodes.name: Memory
nodes.summary: One named memory file under G6's state folder, with load, atomic save and a monotonic "now" that never runs behind recorded times.

nodes.name: rng_for
nodes.summary: Returns a seeded random generator for an op so noise is reproducible.

nodes.name: add_chunk
nodes.summary: Adds a chunk to the state or records a new presentation of an equivalent one, within the size caps.

nodes.name: _test
nodes.summary: Tests a buffer's slots against a pattern with variable binding and negated slot tests.

nodes.name: Retrieval
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass result of a retrieval: chunk, activation breakdown, latency and competitors.

nodes.name: retrieve
nodes.summary: Scores every matching chunk with base level, spreading and noise, returns the best above threshold with its latency, and records the presentation.

nodes.name: production_problems
nodes.summary: Lists every structural problem in a production's conditions and actions (unknown buffers, bad slots, unbound variables).

nodes.name: _bindings
nodes.summary: Matches a production's conditions against the buffers and returns its variable bindings, or none.

nodes.name: RunResult
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass result of a production run: goal, trace, whether the goal test passed and why it stopped.

nodes.name: run
nodes.summary: Runs the conflict-resolution cycle: selects the highest-utility matching production with noise, applies its actions and retrieval requests, and stops on the goal test, a step cap or a deadline.

nodes.name: reward
nodes.summary: Applies a reward to every production used since the last reward with the utility-learning equation and clears the pending list.

nodes.name: SKILL.md

nodes.name: __init__.py

nodes.name: adaptation.py

nodes.name: assurance.py

nodes.languageNotes: Frozen dataclasses with __post_init__ validation and SHA-256 manifests; an unkeyed digest detects edits but not malicious reissuance.

nodes.name: CoinFlip
nodes.summary: Biased coin toy world: the agent guesses the coin and earns 1 for a correct guess.

nodes.name: TigerDoor
nodes.summary: Tiger problem toy world: listen for a noisy hint at a cost or open a door for gold or a tiger penalty.

nodes.name: SimpleMaze1D
nodes.summary: Short one-dimensional corridor toy world rewarding the agent for reaching the goal cell.

nodes.name: to_bits
nodes.summary: Encodes an integer as a fixed-width list of bits.

nodes.name: from_bits
nodes.summary: Decodes a list of bits back into an integer.

nodes.name: is_builtin
nodes.summary: Reports whether an environment factory is one of the built-in toy worlds.

nodes.name: register_environment
nodes.summary: Registers a named, callable environment factory from Python; MCP callers can only name registered environments.

nodes.name: unregister_environment
nodes.summary: Removes a registered environment factory by name.

nodes.name: environments
nodes.summary: Lists the names of built-in and registered environments in sorted order.

nodes.name: environment
nodes.summary: Looks up an environment factory by name among registered and built-in environments.

nodes.name: spec_of
nodes.summary: Derives and validates the interaction Spec from an environment's declared bit widths and reward minimum.

nodes.name: episode
nodes.summary: Runs one deadline-bounded episode of a fresh agent on an environment and a seeded random-policy baseline, returning rewards, regret and model size.

nodes.name: Spec

nodes.name: Stopped
nodes.summary: Exception raised when a playout, horizon or time cap is reached, treated as an answer rather than an error.

nodes.name: Planner
nodes.summary: rho-UCT planner over a cloned context-tree model: UCB selection at decision nodes, sampled percepts at chance nodes, random rollouts, every sampled update reverted.

nodes.name: Agent
nodes.summary: Serialisable MC-AIXI-CTW agent holding its spec, CTW model, seed and planning bounds; acts by planning and learns from observed percepts.

nodes.name: CogArchAixiInput
nodes.summary: Pydantic input model for every cog_arch_aixi op, bounding agent shape, planning parameters, episode seeds and time, plus request and run ids.

nodes.name: CogArchAixiBlock
nodes.summary: AIBlock registry and MCP door for cog_arch_aixi, dispatching ops under a store lock and turning refusals into envelope replies.

nodes.name: create
nodes.summary: Creates and saves a new named agent, refusing an existing name and warning when the context depth is shallow.

nodes.name: act

nodes.name: observe

nodes.name: run_episode

nodes.name: OperatorSpec

nodes.name: Problem

nodes.name: CogArchGpsInput
nodes.summary: Pydantic input model for every cog_arch_gps op with fact and unique-name validation and search bounds.

nodes.name: CogArchGpsBlock
nodes.summary: AIBlock registry and MCP door for cog_arch_gps, holding an optional LLM caller for encode and dispatching ops.

nodes.name: _load_set
nodes.summary: Loads a kept operator set by name from G6's state folder, checking its stored digest.

nodes.name: _operators

nodes.name: keep_operators
nodes.summary: Saves a named operator set under G6's state folder, refusing to overwrite a different existing set.

nodes.name: _search

nodes.name: _planned
nodes.summary: Replays a found plan and answers with it only when the replay passes, otherwise refuses with the failing step.

nodes.name: encode
nodes.summary: Asks the configured model to draft a planning problem from a description, parses it into the operator schema, and offers it only with a plan that passed replay.

nodes.name: operators
nodes.summary: Builds immutable Operator records from plain operator dictionaries.

nodes.name: search
nodes.summary: Entry point for bounded means-ends analysis, trying goal orders and returning the found plan.

nodes.name: replay

nodes.name: Operator

nodes.name: Stopped
nodes.summary: Exception naming the depth, node, order or time cap that ended a search.

nodes.name: Found
nodes.summary: Result record of a successful search: the plan and search statistics.

nodes.name: _Search
nodes.summary: Stateful means-ends search achieving goal conjunctions recursively, rechecking each conjunction and enforcing caps on every tick.

nodes.name: Replay
nodes.summary: Result record of a plan replay: success, failing step and reason, and goals left unmet.

nodes.name: ThompsonBernoulli
nodes.summary: Seeded Thompson sampling over Beta posteriors with uniform or structural priors and optional epsilon exploration.

nodes.name: UCB1
nodes.summary: UCB1 bandit trying each arm once in declared order, then picking by mean plus exploration bonus.

nodes.name: BudgetedBandit
nodes.summary: Bandit wrapper behind a hard budget that masks unaffordable arms and commits spending via BoundedAllocator.

nodes.name: Candidate
nodes.summary: Pydantic schema for an experiment candidate: prior, test rates and cost.

nodes.name: Task
nodes.summary: Pydantic schema for a retry task: value, cost, past successes and failures, and Beta prior.

nodes.name: DecisionMakingInput
nodes.summary: Pydantic input model for every decision_making op with bounded tables and fail-closed numeric validation.

nodes.name: _TabularMDP
nodes.summary: Adapter exposing a caller's transition table as the MDP protocol for value iteration.

nodes.name: DecisionMakingBlock
nodes.summary: AIBlock registry and MCP door dispatching each decision op to one library function and wrapping the answer in the envelope.

nodes.name: _bandit_select

nodes.name: BoundedAllocator

nodes.name: GenerativeModel
nodes.summary: Protocol for a generative model: available actions, a sampled step and a terminal test.

nodes.name: UCT
nodes.summary: Seeded, bounded UCT planner with UCB selection, single-node expansion, random rollouts and discounted backup.

nodes.name: value_iteration

nodes.name: _q_value
nodes.summary: Computes an action's Q-value from validated transitions, refusing non-finite values.

nodes.name: Unfinished
nodes.summary: Exception raised when value iteration stops at a cap before converging.

nodes.name: NonFinite
nodes.summary: ValueError subclass naming a non-finite numeric refusal.

nodes.name: MDP
nodes.summary: Protocol for a finite MDP: states, actions, transitions and terminal test.

nodes.name: record_decision
nodes.summary: Appends a decision record with its working to a caller-held ledger.

nodes.name: ExperimentCandidate

nodes.name: PlanNextActionPolicy

nodes.name: Ledger
nodes.summary: Protocol for a caller-held ledger that decision records are appended to.

nodes.name: RetryTask

nodes.name: RetryBudgetPolicy

nodes.name: expected_utility
nodes.summary: Expected utility of a validated outcome distribution under a utility model.

nodes.summary: Runtime-checkable protocol for anything that scores an outcome with a real utility.

nodes.name: LinearUtility
nodes.summary: Linear utility model scaling and offsetting a numeric outcome.

nodes.summary: EVPI: the expected value of learning the true state before acting, over a validated prior and payoff table.

nodes.name: expected_information_gain

nodes.name: expected_improvement

nodes.name: judged_files

nodes.name: FailureModeFinding

nodes.name: MitigationHypothesis
nodes.summary: Hypothesis that a guard change would mitigate a failure mode.

nodes.name: CompositionalFailureModel
nodes.summary: Links observed defects to guard hypotheses without conflating them.

nodes.name: sha256

nodes.name: is_risk
nodes.summary: Checks that a value is a G6 risk level number from R0 to R3 (an int, never a bool).

nodes.summary: Builds the canonical record of what a dossier assesses: standard, artifact manifests, checkers, documentation and producer.

nodes.name: EvidenceArtifact
nodes.summary: Evidence artifact carrying bytes with kind, producer, source reference and claim id, plus digest and manifest.

nodes.name: Check
nodes.summary: Protocol for a checker callable taking bytes and returning a boolean.

nodes.name: FrozenVerifier
nodes.summary: Evaluator-owned checker plus frozen positive and negative controls, passed as trusted Python objects.

nodes.name: ProfessionalAttestation

nodes.name: ReviewAuthenticator
nodes.summary: Protocol for authenticating a professional attestation.
