nodes.summary: Stable G6_E_COMPLEXITY_* error codes: one per op and one for invalid input.

nodes.name: impact.py
nodes.summary: Reverse dependency closure over the CIR: computes the impact cone of changed components with preservation obligations, treating missing edges as uncertainty rather than isolation.

nodes.name: inputs.py
nodes.summary: Typed caller input for the complexity block (requirements, obligations, tree fields) and helpers that build the frozen intent and atlas and validate file-map size.

nodes.name: ir.py
nodes.summary: Frozen typed records of the Complexity Intelligence Representation (snapshot, requirement, obligation, frozen intent, dependency, state, effect, finding, CIR) fingerprinted with G6's canonical ledger digest.

nodes.name: simplify.py
nodes.summary: Proposes advisory simplifications for mutable, derived state the caller marked avoidable, each carrying the normative obligations and regression checks a change must pass.

nodes.name: SKILL.md
nodes.summary: Agent skill for the change-impact map: when to call atlas, impact and simplify before editing a Python package, how to read results, failure modes, blind spots and examples.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package entry for g6.context, which assembles small budget-bounded, provenance-labelled context packets for agent calls; documents and re-exports the retriever, workspace, packet builders, scrubbing and conversation window.

nodes.name: assemble.py
nodes.summary: Context packet assembly: build_packet retrieves, optionally re-ranks, cuts to budget and scores a packet; assemble_packet records conflicts, prunes without dropping the task and rescores; plus subagent packet helpers.

nodes.name: budget.py
nodes.summary: Token-budget floor for context packets: selects repository handles within budget and prunes packet sections in a fixed order while never dropping the task or output contract.

nodes.name: compress.py
nodes.summary: Model-free extractive compression of a context item: keeps whole sentences ranked by word frequency within a token budget and marks the result untrusted.

nodes.name: CognitiveBridgeBlock
nodes.summary: AIBlock exposing the cognitive bridge ops over the registry and MCP; screens the raw read, refuses changed or invalid input with coded refusals and answers from that single read.

nodes.name: CognitiveInput
nodes.summary: Strict pydantic model of one cognitive bridge op call, holding hypotheses, probes, claims, signatures and method variants.

nodes.name: _admit_input
nodes.summary: Admits the outer argument mapping into a typed CognitiveInput, refusing extra fields, wrong kinds and oversized values.

nodes.name: _admit_model_input
nodes.summary: Pre-validator that checks nested model input is plain data of the declared shape before pydantic parsing.

nodes.name: FrozenMap
nodes.summary: Read-only dict subclass used for JSON objects held by the bridge; every write raises.

nodes.name: NotPlainData
nodes.summary: Error raised when a value entering the bridge is not plain JSON data or not of its declared kind, naming the path.

nodes.name: _read_as
nodes.summary: The single leaf/object/array kind test shared by the boundary walker and the claim rule.

nodes.name: result_faults
nodes.summary: Lists why a mapping carrying completion_state is not in the bridge result format.

nodes.name: claims
nodes.summary: Walks a JSON value at any depth and reports every place it claims a reliability state or holds non-JSON data.

nodes.name: unclaimed
nodes.summary: Returns a value only when it claims no state and is plain data, otherwise raises NotPlainData.

nodes.name: affirmed
nodes.summary: The single reading of a yes: True and nothing else.

nodes.name: only_fields
nodes.summary: Admits a mapping only when it carries the allowed and required fields of a format.

nodes.name: refusal
nodes.summary: Builds a blocked-escalated answer with a stable code and a matching warning card.

nodes.name: settled
nodes.summary: Builds the qualified-draft result, or passes through a refusal, with an optional draft warning card.

nodes.name: CritiqueCandidate
nodes.summary: Bounded record of one proposed critique: failure mode, assumption at risk, refutation, suggested method and evidence required.

nodes.name: CritiqueReport
nodes.summary: Record holding critique candidates, serializable to a dict.

nodes.name: LLMMetacognitiveCritic
nodes.summary: Bounded JSON-only LLM critic that proposes critique candidates; its reply is admitted through the bridge boundary and never grants credit.

nodes.name: check_beliefs
nodes.summary: Validates hypotheses and returns their prior beliefs as a normalised mapping.

nodes.name: expected_information_gain
nodes.summary: Mutual information between hypothesis and binary observation under the probe's assumed likelihood model.

nodes.name: InformationGainSelector
nodes.summary: Deterministic probe ranker by expected information gain per cost, with novelty only breaking near-ties.

nodes.name: BayesianUpdater
nodes.summary: Updates beliefs by Bayes' rule given a probe outcome and its stated likelihoods.

nodes.name: StaticProposer
nodes.summary: Proposer returning a fixed set of probes.

nodes.name: LLMProposer
nodes.summary: Model-backed proposer that asks for bounded JSON probes only; observations are left to allowlisted operator tools.

nodes.name: MLAcquisitionSelector
nodes.summary: Drop-in ML selector ranking probes with a caller-supplied trained predictor.

nodes.name: CognitiveAgent
nodes.summary: Bounded propose-select-observe-update agent; tool steps run through G6's checked door and only credited steps enter its history.

nodes.name: LLMIdeaGenerator
nodes.summary: Generates creative IdeaHypothesis suggestions from an LLM, without probabilities, requiring outside review before use.

nodes.name: ScopedAssertion
nodes.summary: Record of one method assertion about a claim bound to an explicit scope and source.

nodes.name: CrossMethodConflictGate
nodes.summary: Reconciles scope-bound assertions through the epistemic integrity adjudicator and blocks on contested, refuted or undetermined findings.

nodes.name: assertions_sha256
nodes.summary: Digest of an assertion set over every field, order-independent.

nodes.name: checked_report
nodes.summary: Admits a reconciliation report with only its format's fields.

nodes.name: findings_state
nodes.summary: Derives the completion state from a reconciliation report by the same rule reconcile uses.

nodes.name: ProblemSignature
nodes.summary: Record of task features the selector matches trials on, including a risk level.

nodes.name: MethodVariant
nodes.summary: Trusted typed way to meet one evidence obligation, naming its engine and op, with a definition digest.

nodes.name: EvaluatedTrial
nodes.summary: Held-out evaluation outcome of a method variant whose provenance must be authenticated by an outside evaluator.

nodes.name: SelectionDecision
nodes.summary: Record of an ordered method variant selection with its completion state.

nodes.name: MetacognitiveMethodSelector
nodes.summary: Contextual UCB selector that orders method variants from admitted trials, with optional bounded exploration for low-risk tasks.

nodes.name: checked_selection
nodes.summary: Admits a selector's decision only when each row is a given eligible variant and required obligations are met.

nodes.name: MetacognitivePlanner
nodes.summary: Joins method selection with the canonical allowlisted MethodRouter to produce a plan.

nodes.name: ClaimIR
nodes.summary: Reviewable research claim statement used as input for method routing; not a checked translation.

nodes.name: MethodPlan
nodes.summary: Plan of claims and solver steps, serializable to a dict.

nodes.name: step_digest
nodes.summary: Identity digest of one planned step over its id, claim, method, component, op, parameters and dependencies.

nodes.name: MethodRouter
nodes.summary: Chooses the smallest matching solver family for each requested evidence obligation and reports missing typed models instead of guessing.

nodes.name: MixedMethodExecutor
nodes.summary: Opt-in executor that runs an approved plan step by step through G6's checked door, refusing tampered plans or unmet prerequisites.

nodes.name: LLMClaimCompiler
nodes.summary: LLM adapter drafting machine-readable research claims that always require review before invocation.

nodes.name: CompiledResearch
nodes.summary: Record of a compiled selection and pinned plan, with its completion state and change detection since compilation.

nodes.name: CognitiveAssuranceOrchestrator
nodes.summary: Compiles, executes and assesses research plans, honouring only compilations, dossiers and reconciliations its own collaborators issued.

nodes.name: compilation_gaps
nodes.summary: The single rule listing why a compiled selection and plan may not run.

nodes.name: evaluated_trace_rows
nodes.summary: Builds adapt_sklearn rows from externally evaluated research episodes, refusing missing or non-numeric outcomes.

nodes.name: sklearn_payload
nodes.summary: Wraps evaluated trace rows into an adapt_sklearn request payload with seed and estimator.

nodes.name: _admit_array
nodes.summary: Admits an array-like value into the bounded walk, checking length and element kinds.

nodes.name: bounded
nodes.summary: Declares size, admission and shape bounds for a record class.

nodes.name: generated
nodes.summary: Generates only an admitted count of items, charging the walker budget before each.

nodes.name: _walk
nodes.summary: Core bounded walker converting any incoming value into plain JSON data while charging depth and size budgets and refusing non-JSON kinds.

nodes.name: _encoded_size
nodes.summary: Computes the escaped encoded size of a value before allocation.

nodes.name: canonical_json
nodes.summary: Bounded canonical JSON encoder that admits escaped size before output allocation.

nodes.name: record_data
nodes.summary: A record's plain representation through the canonical encoder.

nodes.name: publish
nodes.summary: The sole publication step for records, leaves and G6 result envelopes leaving the bridge.

nodes.name: plain
nodes.summary: The one conversion of what enters the bridge: a round trip through the canonical encoder that refuses anything not surviving unchanged.

nodes.name: text
nodes.summary: Admits an identity, name or question as text only.

nodes.name: number
nodes.summary: Admits a number only as an exact int or float, never converted from another kind.

nodes.name: _kind
nodes.summary: Resolves the admission kind of a record field from its type annotation.

nodes.name: _field
nodes.summary: Admits one record field value by its declared kind at record construction.

nodes.name: record
nodes.summary: Decorator making a frozen dataclass whose every field is admitted by its annotated kind where the record is made.

nodes.name: snapshot
nodes.summary: Takes a caller value as plain data, remaking records so the copy shares nothing.

nodes.name: fresh
nodes.summary: A snapshot copy handed to a collaborator.

nodes.name: view
nodes.summary: Renders a value as JSON for the claim rule and digests, records as objects of their fields.

nodes.name: returned
nodes.summary: Takes a collaborator's return as a snapshot the moment it returns and checks it against what was handed out.

nodes.name: json_reply
nodes.summary: Returned-check for a model reply: bounded text parsed as JSON without repeated keys.

nodes.name: digest
nodes.summary: SHA-256 identity of a record or report over every field and its type.

nodes.name: issue
nodes.summary: Records a value as issued by its maker via its digest.

nodes.name: issued
nodes.summary: Checks whether a maker issued a value, matching every field by digest.

nodes.name: ExplicitTree
nodes.summary: Inspectable decision tree with per-row explanation, prediction and dict serialization.

nodes.name: extract_tree
nodes.summary: Transcribes a supported scikit-learn tree estimator into an ExplicitTree, reading every value through the boundary.

nodes.name: distill_blackbox
nodes.summary: Distills a black-box model into a bounded surrogate tree and reports holdout fidelity.

nodes.name: build_atlas
nodes.summary: Parses a file map with ast into a CIR of dependencies, state variables, effects and unknowns, fingerprinted by tree and environment digest.

nodes.name: ComplexityInput
nodes.summary: Pydantic parameters of one complexity op, extending TreeFields.

nodes.name: ComplexityBlock
nodes.summary: AIBlock dispatching atlas, impact and simplify ops and wrapping answers in the reliability envelope.

nodes.name: Impact
nodes.summary: Frozen result of an impact cone: changed and impacted components, preservation obligations and uncertainty.

nodes.name: impact_cone
nodes.summary: Breadth-first reverse dependency closure from changed components, collecting normative obligations and uncertainty.

nodes.name: RequirementIn
nodes.summary: Caller-stated requirement with authority and change relation.

nodes.name: ObligationIn
nodes.summary: Caller-stated obligation of a requirement with its oracle and normative flag.

nodes.name: TreeFields
nodes.summary: Pydantic fields naming a tree to map: file map, package, intent and environment digest.

nodes.name: intent_from
nodes.summary: Builds a FrozenIntent from caller requirements and obligations.

nodes.name: atlas_of
nodes.summary: Builds the atlas of the tree named by TreeFields, raising ValueError with a reason when refused.

nodes.name: declared
nodes.summary: Evidence entry echoing what the caller declared, marked declared_by caller.

nodes.name: files_problem
nodes.summary: Explains why a file map is refused (size or path problems), or returns empty when readable.

nodes.name: Requirement
nodes.summary: Frozen requirement record with authority and relation, validated on construction.

nodes.name: Obligation
nodes.summary: Frozen obligation record linked to a requirement with a normative flag.

nodes.name: FrozenIntent
nodes.summary: Frozen set of requirements and obligations that refuses normative obligations on unconfirmed authority; exposes a fingerprint.

nodes.name: CIR
nodes.summary: The Complexity Intelligence Representation: snapshot, intent, dependencies, state, effects, findings and unknowns, with fingerprint and vector.

nodes.name: Simplification
nodes.summary: Frozen advisory proposal with target, text and required checks.

nodes.name: propose_simplifications
nodes.summary: Proposes narrower owners for mutable derived state marked accidental_avoidable, carrying normative checks.

nodes.name: assemble_packet
nodes.summary: Merges items into a packet, recording conflicts, pruning to budget and rescoring the envelope.

nodes.name: _rerank
nodes.summary: Applies an optional caller re-ranker over masked candidates, keeping keyword order for unnamed indices.

nodes.name: build_packet
nodes.summary: Builds a full context packet for a task: governance, task, components, workspace notes, policy and repository handles within budget.

nodes.name: subagent_packet
nodes.summary: Derives a bounded child packet for a subagent from a parent packet.

nodes.name: synthesize_subagent_results
nodes.summary: Summarises subagent results into one untrusted memory item.

nodes.name: select_within_budget
nodes.summary: Keeps handles in order while their running token estimate stays within budget.

nodes.name: prune_packet
nodes.summary: Drops trailing items section by section in PRUNE_ORDER until the packet fits, never touching protected sections.

nodes.name: _select
nodes.summary: Ranks sentence spans by average word frequency and selects them within the token budget.

nodes.name: compress
nodes.summary: Recursively reduces sentence groups and selects to a token budget, returning an untrusted compressed item.

nodes.name: envelope.py
nodes.summary: Recomputes a context packet's cross-surface envelope (completion_state, warning_card, evidence, scorecard) from its content: token recount, authority conflicts and stale items. An assembled packet is at best qualified-draft, and blocked-escalated when it has no task or its task and output contract exceed the budget.

nodes.name: _metadata_evidence
nodes.summary: Builds evidence entries from a packet's metadata such as skipped retrieval and recorded conflicts.

nodes.name: score_packet
nodes.summary: Recomputes a packet's envelope from its items, handles and merge losers, returning a ContextScorecard with completion state, warning card and evidence.

nodes.name: _card
nodes.summary: Builds the warning card for a given completion state and evidence list.

nodes.name: fuse.py
nodes.summary: Reciprocal-rank fusion of several ranked ContextItem lists (1/(60+rank)), folding near-duplicates into provenance only when numbers and negation agree, then applying the token budget floor.

nodes.name: fuse
nodes.summary: Fuses ranked ContextItem lists by reciprocal rank, folds safe near-duplicates into provenance and applies the token budget cut.

nodes.name: packet.py
nodes.summary: Pydantic data model for context packets: provenance-tagged ContextItems with authority, trust and freshness, repository handles, sectioned ContextPacket with envelope fields, scorecards, token estimation and conflict detection. Item text is scrubbed of secrets on creation and only trusted governance, user-intent or task-contract instructions may instruct.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Pydantic v2 field and model validators with an IntEnum authority ladder to enforce trust rules at construction time.

nodes.name: ContextItem
nodes.summary: One datum with source, authority, kind, trust and freshness; validators scrub text and enforce that only trusted governance/intent/contract instructions may instruct.

nodes.name: RepositoryHandle
nodes.summary: Pointer to a repository file or matching line with masked snippet, loaded on demand through load_handle.

nodes.name: ContextPacket
nodes.summary: Sectioned context bundle for one agent call carrying repository handles, conflicts and the envelope fields produced by score_packet.

nodes.name: find_conflicts
nodes.summary: Finds every key with more than one distinct value across items and reports how the authority-based merge resolves it, including ties.

nodes.name: redact.py
nodes.summary: Pattern-based secret masking (scrub) for well-known token shapes and secret-named assignments, plus helpers that mask e-mails, home and temp folder roots, host names and Python traceback frames for error reports.

nodes.name: secret_spans
nodes.summary: Returns the (start, end) spans in the original text that scrub masks, tracing each sequential rule's mask back to the source text.

nodes.name: mask_paths
nodes.summary: Replaces the temp folder root with <temp> and home folder roots with ~ in text.

nodes.name: rerank.py
nodes.summary: Strict clamp on a model's rerank decision: it may reorder or drop eligible context indices, never add text, and a stale fingerprint or invalid index refuses the whole decision with G6_E_CONTEXT_RERANK_INVALID.

nodes.name: validate_rerank_decision
nodes.summary: Validates a rerank decision against the eligible count and expected fingerprint, returning kept indices or refusing with G6_E_CONTEXT_RERANK_INVALID.

nodes.name: retrieve.py
nodes.summary: Keyword retrieval over configured root directories producing masked file and grep handles, plus load_handle, a non-forgeable read that refuses handles outside the roots or not produced for the query and labels returned text untrusted.

nodes.name: Retrieval
nodes.summary: Keyword candidate set for one query with flags for truncated walks and capped matches.

nodes.name: Retriever
nodes.summary: Walks configured roots for files whose path or lines match query terms, skipping ignored directories and escaping symlinks, and produces masked handles.

nodes.name: LoadedText
nodes.summary: Result of load_handle: masked file text labelled untrusted, with truncation flags and envelope fields.

nodes.name: load_handle
nodes.summary: Reads the file behind a handle, masked and capped at 20,000 characters, refusing malformed, out-of-root or forged handles as blocked-escalated.

nodes.name: SKILL.md
nodes.summary: Agent skill document for the g6.context package: when to use it, the Python API (build_packet, Retriever, load_handle, Workspace, fuse, compress, rerank validation, subagent packets, ConversationWindow) and its stable error codes.

nodes.name: window.py
nodes.summary: ConversationWindow keeps a conversation inside a model's token window, counting system prompt and per-message overhead with an injected counter and margin, trimming oldest turns or compressing them into an untrusted quoted summary note.

nodes.name: WindowReport
nodes.summary: Report of what trim or compress did, with envelope fields; never labelled 'verified' because token counts are estimates.

nodes.name: ConversationWindow
nodes.summary: Holds a conversation that must fit a model window with an output reserve, offering add, fits, trim (oldest first) and compress into an untrusted summary note.

nodes.name: workspace.py
nodes.summary: Workspace holds the context package's on-disk state under one resolved root (memory notes, exemplars, compactions, retrieval logs, scorecards) with path-confined, masked JSON writers and notes read back as untrusted items aged by mtime.

nodes.name: Workspace
nodes.summary: Manages the context state directory: path-confined masked JSON writers for retrieval logs, scorecards and compactions, and reads memory and exemplar notes back as untrusted items.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Side-effect-free kernel package for g6.core that defines the canonical reliability labels (verified, qualified-draft, blocked-escalated) and lazily resolves core names such as AIBlock, BlockContract and Result through a module-level __getattr__.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses PEP 562 module __getattr__ for lazy attribute imports so importing g6.core stays cheap.

nodes.name: adaptation_gate.py
nodes.summary: Local validation and promotion gate for adaptation proposals: a candidate guard must flag pre-registered negative controls and pass positive ones, and the gate grants at most shadow_approved while refusing automated reviewers, edited proposals and protected paths.

nodes.name: AdaptationProposal
nodes.summary: Frozen record of a proposed adaptation with validated fields and a content digest that binds later validation to its exact content.

nodes.name: validate_locally
nodes.summary: Runs a candidate guard on pre-registered negative and positive controls not authored by the proposer and records pass, fail or unknown per control.

nodes.name: decide_promotion
nodes.summary: Promotion gate: unknown verdicts block, failures reject, automated reviewers and protected paths are refused, and the most it grants is shadow_approved.

nodes.name: ai_block.py
nodes.summary: Defines AIBlock, the generic composable unit every G6 component is or wraps, with infer/verify/contract hooks and >> chaining, plus PipelineBlock which runs two blocks in sequence and folds per-stage evidence and the weakest completion state into the result.
nodes.languageNotes: Generic over Input, Output and State TypeVars; operator overloading (__rshift__) builds pipelines.

nodes.name: AIBlock
nodes.summary: Generic base class for every G6 component, declaring infer, verify, bias and contract hooks and >> chaining into pipelines.

nodes.name: PipelineBlock
nodes.summary: Chains two AIBlocks sequentially, running left then right and annotating the result with per-stage evidence, warnings and the weakest completion state.

nodes.name: _stage_evidence
nodes.summary: Builds the evidence record for one pipeline stage's result.

nodes.name: _annotate_result
nodes.summary: Attaches evidence, warning card, completion state and failed stage to a pipeline result.

nodes.name: _stage_state
nodes.summary: Returns the weakest completion state a stage reports, defaulting silence or unknown words to qualified-draft.

nodes.name: _door_state
nodes.summary: Keeps a stage's 'verified' label at the door only when G6's re-checker for the block reproduces the named check.

nodes.name: approval_authority.py
nodes.summary: Server-side approval authority that issues, checks, consumes and revokes approval records so human or oracle approval for regulated operations is no longer asserted by the caller; provides a process-wide singleton and fail-closed operation approval checks.

nodes.name: disclosure_digest
nodes.summary: Domain-separated stable digest of a disclosure notice, empty for blank notices.

nodes.name: ApprovalRecord
nodes.summary: One server-side approval decision with issuer kind, scope, expiry and consumption state, with liveness check and redacted view.

nodes.name: ApprovalAuthority
nodes.summary: Issues, checks, consumes, revokes and purges approval records against a pluggable store, failing closed on mismatched scope or issuer.

nodes.name: get_approval_authority
nodes.summary: Returns the process-wide approval authority, building its store from the environment on first use.

nodes.name: reset_approval_authority
nodes.summary: Drops the process-wide authority so the next call rebuilds it with the current environment.

nodes.name: require_review_approval_record
nodes.summary: Reports whether caller-supplied review-approval dicts are refused, closing the defect where callers asserted their own approval.

nodes.name: normalize_agent_name
nodes.summary: Collapses agent name spellings such as job_lawyer and lawyer to one canonical name.

nodes.name: approval_scope_for_operation
nodes.summary: Derives the canonical approval scope string for an agent and operation shared by every issuer and checker.

nodes.name: check_operation_approval
nodes.summary: Fail-closed check of an approval for one agent operation, optionally consuming it and requiring a human issuer.

nodes.name: approval_store.py
nodes.summary: Backing stores for the approval authority: an in-memory store and a durable, cross-process, append-only SQLite store whose events are hash-chained for tamper evidence, plus configuration that picks one from G6_APPROVAL_DB_PATH.
nodes.languageNotes: SQLite in WAL mode with an append-only, domain-separated hash chain; every mutation is an appended event replayed on read.

nodes.name: entry_hash
nodes.summary: Domain-separated chain hash over the previous hash, approval id, event and payload.

nodes.name: _enable_wal
nodes.summary: Best-effort switch of a SQLite connection to WAL journal mode, waiting for peers holding the lock.

nodes.name: ApprovalStore
nodes.summary: Protocol describing the put, get, consume, revoke, purge and clear operations ApprovalAuthority needs.

nodes.name: InMemoryApprovalStore
nodes.summary: The historical in-memory dict-backed approval store kept as the default behind the store interface.

nodes.name: SqliteApprovalStore
nodes.summary: Durable cross-process approval store where every mutation is an appended, hash-chained event replayed on read, with chain verification and history.

nodes.name: configured_store
nodes.summary: Chooses the approval store for the process-wide authority: SQLite when G6_APPROVAL_DB_PATH is set, in-memory otherwise.

nodes.name: binomial.py
nodes.summary: Exact Clopper-Pearson one-sided bounds on a binomial proportion using only the standard library, found by bisection on the exact binomial tail.

nodes.name: upper_bound
nodes.summary: Exact one-sided Clopper-Pearson upper bound found by bisection on the binomial tail, using closed forms at zero and n successes.

nodes.name: block_contract.py
nodes.summary: BlockContract and related types describing a block's self-declared purpose, outputs, failure modes, reliability card, cost and enforcement points, with registries for preconditions, stop conditions and detectors and dict serialisation that degrades unknown callables to safe stand-ins.

nodes.name: _contract_enforce_mode
nodes.summary: Reads the configured contract enforcement mode from the environment.

nodes.name: _handle_contract_violation
nodes.summary: Raises or logs a contract violation with its error code depending on the enforcement mode.

nodes.name: ComponentReliabilityCard
nodes.summary: Reliability card for a component: failure modes, examples, templates and source tool requirements, with validation.

nodes.name: BlockContract
nodes.summary: Frozen self-declared block contract covering purpose, inputs, outputs, failure modes, cost, state surface and extension points, with human-review level checks and reliability card access.

nodes.name: register_precondition
nodes.summary: Registers a precondition callable by name, usable as a bare or parameterised decorator.

nodes.name: register_stop_condition
nodes.summary: Registers a stop-condition callable by name.

nodes.name: register_detector
nodes.summary: Registers a failure-mode detector by name; registration alone does not make G6 run it.

nodes.name: _unresolved_precondition_factory
nodes.summary: Returns a stand-in precondition for an unknown name that fails closed.

nodes.name: _unresolved_stop_condition_factory
nodes.summary: Returns a stand-in stop condition for an unknown name that never fires.

nodes.name: _unresolved_detector_factory
nodes.summary: Returns a stand-in detector for an unknown name that never fires.

nodes.name: contract_to_dict
nodes.summary: Serialises a BlockContract for cross-process transport, reducing callables to their names.

nodes.name: contract_from_dict
nodes.summary: Reconstructs a BlockContract from its dict form, resolving callable names against local registries and degrading unknown names to safe stand-ins.

nodes.name: choices.py
nodes.summary: Reads and records the person's per-computer choices in $G6_HOME/choices.json, currently whether unconfined code execution is allowed, written only by g6 setup and a bundle's first-run page.

nodes.name: read
nodes.summary: Returns every readable choice by name, or an empty dict when the file is missing or unreadable.

nodes.name: record
nodes.summary: Atomically records the person's answer to one choice with timestamp and how it was made, keeping the other choices.

nodes.name: cloud_consent.py

nodes.languageNotes: Uses contextvars to carry observed sources through a call and cross-process OS file mutexes to order sends against revocation.

nodes.name: Source
nodes.summary: Identity of one data source (scope and identifier) whose sharing with a provider must be granted.

nodes.name: telling_refusals
nodes.summary: Context hook letting a supervising loop observe a withheld send before a wrapper handles the error.

nodes.name: withheld_message
nodes.summary: Builds the refusal message for a withheld send naming only scope identifiers and recipient, never file names or bytes.

nodes.name: boundary_sources
nodes.summary: Joins declared, carried and directory-derived source origins at a process boundary without erasing origin.

nodes.name: bind_output
nodes.summary: Binds a reviewed producer's complete source set to a value and its exact JSON bytes as a provenance receipt.

nodes.name: output_sources
nodes.summary: Returns the sources bound to an output value, or unknown when its receipt is missing or stale.

nodes.name: freeze_output
nodes.summary: Serialises a value once and matches the snapshot to its existing provenance receipt.

nodes.name: write_retained
nodes.summary: Publishes serialised completion bytes and their digest so an interrupted write fails closed.

nodes.name: prompt_sources
nodes.summary: Unions raw-state receipts and observed reads before rendering a prompt, treating missing receipts as unknown.

nodes.name: prompt_state
nodes.summary: Context manager rendering copied values with their complete state receipts so concurrent updates cannot borrow a receipt.

nodes.name: collect_sources
nodes.summary: Context manager that collects every source observed during a block of work.

nodes.name: _validate
nodes.summary: Validates one consent ledger entry's kind, identifier and body while reading the ledger.

nodes.name: _mutex
nodes.summary: Cross-process OS file lock on a named file in the consent folder.

nodes.name: _open
nodes.summary: Opens or creates the consent ledger in its folder.

nodes.name: _locked
nodes.summary: Context manager holding the consent read and write locks so admission and revocation are ordered.

nodes.name: _written
nodes.summary: Context manager exposing the sharing state as last written under the write lock alone.

nodes.name: _append
nodes.summary: Appends one decision or disclosure entry to the consent ledger.

nodes.name: _refuse_unshared
nodes.summary: Admission's single rule: refuse a send unless every source is shared with its recipient.

nodes.name: refuse_unshared
nodes.summary: Takes the admission decision ahead of preparing a send so unshared sends are refused first.

nodes.name: admission
nodes.summary: The one send-time consent check: holds the lock through the send, durably logs the disclosure attempt and refuses sources not granted to the provider.

nodes.name: component_certificate.py
nodes.summary: Reads committed component certificate records without importing or running components: canonical digests, rule tables parsed as syntax, certificate input files including transitively imported g6 modules, signed review checks and state lines for listing and result attribution.
nodes.languageNotes: Parses Python with the ast module to discover rules and transitive imports without executing code.

nodes.name: canonical
nodes.summary: Serialises a value as sorted UTF-8 JSON with LF and no binary floats for published records.

nodes.name: content
nodes.summary: Strips history positions and their digests from a certificate to get the content a reviewer signs.

nodes.name: read_json
nodes.summary: Reads and parses a JSON file, raising a clear error on malformed content.

nodes.name: layout
nodes.summary: Locates a component package's certificate files and checks their presence.

nodes.name: _tiered
nodes.summary: Checks that a rule's kind fixes its allowed level, effect and implementation.

nodes.name: rules_from
nodes.summary: Parses a RULES table from Python source as syntax without importing it, extracting kind, source, effect, level and implementation.

nodes.name: covered
nodes.summary: Determines which graded rules a component's certificate covers within its family.

nodes.name: certificate_dir
nodes.summary: Resolves where a component's certificate inputs live and what input set it inherits by digest.

nodes.name: _imports
nodes.summary: Lists the g6 module files one module imports anywhere, absolute or relative, via AST.

nodes.name: imported
nodes.summary: Computes every g6 module transitively imported by given roots, including package initialisers.

nodes.name: input_files
nodes.summary: Builds the exact set of certificate input files including shared implementation, inherited sets and imported g6 modules.

nodes.name: imported_code
nodes.summary: Returns the input files outside a component's own bases: implementing modules and their imports.

nodes.name: reviewed
nodes.summary: Lists the exact review targets for a component, including its candidate adapter.

nodes.name: source_checks
nodes.summary: Rehashes source clauses and supplied bytes to check cited sources offline.

nodes.name: state_line
nodes.summary: Builds a certificate scope's first line stating its state, why it is no better and which rules hold it at qualified-draft.

nodes.name: signed_review
nodes.summary: Checks a certificate's content digest against the owner's committed qualified-reviewer keys.

nodes.name: inspect
nodes.summary: Reads a component package's current certificate bytes and listing prerequisites and reports its certificate state.

nodes.name: add_evidence
nodes.summary: Appends certificate attribution evidence to a result without changing its completion state.

nodes.name: component_process.py
nodes.summary: Owned child-process execution inside a trusted call window with deadline and operator stop, optionally starting the child through a confine plan, with bounded reply capture for component replies.

nodes.name: window
nodes.summary: Context manager opening a trusted call window with a deadline and operator stop check.

nodes.name: checkpoint
nodes.summary: Checks the current call window, raising on stop or deadline, and returns the remaining seconds.

nodes.name: run_process
nodes.summary: Runs an owned child process with trusted stream handles inside the current window, optionally confined, killing its tree on timeout or stop.

nodes.name: run_contained
nodes.summary: Runs a child with file-backed, size-bounded reply capture including interruption tails.

nodes.name: compose.py
nodes.summary: Explicit, checked composition of registered blocks into a ComposedBlock whose stages map caller fields or previous stage outputs, checking required inputs, wiring, evidence kinds and (in strict mode) preconditions and stop conditions.

nodes.name: ComposedBlock
nodes.summary: AIBlock that runs a checked sequence of registered stages, copying mapped inputs, enforcing contracts and budgets, and producing a door envelope reply.

nodes.name: confine.py
nodes.summary: Operating-system isolation for children that run untrusted code: plans a per-run Windows AppContainer (via ctypes) or Linux bubblewrap sandbox with read-only and read-write grants, starts confined children, and explains refusals with the owner's fix.
nodes.languageNotes: Calls Win32 userenv/advapi32/kernel32 through ctypes to create AppContainer profiles and inspect SDDL access lists; on Linux builds bwrap namespace arguments.

nodes.name: Plan
nodes.summary: The backend chosen to confine one run, or why none can, holding the run's container until release.

nodes.name: allowed_by
nodes.summary: Reports who allowed unconfined execution: the G6_ALLOW_UNCONFINED override or the person's recorded choice.

nodes.name: recording
nodes.summary: Context manager collecting the record of every plan made in the block for evidence.

nodes.name: import_failure
nodes.summary: Explains why a confined child could not import G6 and the owner's one-time grant to fix it.

nodes.name: refusal
nodes.summary: Builds the refusal of a run no backend can confine: what happened, why and what to do.

nodes.name: run_folder
nodes.summary: Context manager creating a fresh temp folder G6 owns so it may grant a confined child access, removed afterwards.

nodes.name: _guarded
nodes.summary: Whether a path is or contains the home folder or G6's own key folder, which is never opened to a container.

nodes.name: interpreter_paths
nodes.summary: Lists folders a Python child needs to read to start: base install, virtual environment and the g6 package folder.

nodes.name: program_paths
nodes.summary: Lists folders an outside program such as SWI-Prolog or Lean reads to start.

nodes.name: _links_out
nodes.summary: Finds folders that links near the top of an installation lead to outside it.

nodes.name: _home
nodes.summary: Reads the base installation a virtual environment's pyvenv.cfg names.

nodes.name: plan
nodes.summary: Plans how one run is confined on this platform, granting only G6-made folders, and records the plan.

nodes.name: child_environment
nodes.summary: Builds a minimal child environment without keys, import hooks, user home or model configuration.

nodes.name: popen
nodes.summary: Starts a confined child through the plan's backend inside the Job Object, mirroring subprocess.Popen's interface.

nodes.name: _rights
nodes.summary: Parses an ACE's rights string into a file rights mask.

nodes.name: _lets_containers_read
nodes.summary: Checks whether an SDDL access list lets ALL APPLICATION PACKAGES read and execute a file.

nodes.name: _unreadable_beneath
nodes.summary: Finds native extensions under folders whose own ACL does not let containers read them.

nodes.name: _Identity
nodes.summary: One run's AppContainer profile name and SID, deleted on close.

nodes.name: _AppContainer
nodes.summary: Windows backend creating per-run AppContainer profiles via ctypes, granting folder access, probing readiness and starting suspended children in the Job Object.

nodes.name: _Child
nodes.summary: A confined child process exposing poll, wait and kill like subprocess.Popen for the process tree.

nodes.name: _BwrapRun
nodes.summary: One run under bubblewrap recording what it reads and writes; nothing is held.

nodes.name: _Bubblewrap
nodes.summary: Linux backend running bwrap unprivileged in new namespaces, probing kernel and AppArmor support and starting children.

nodes.name: bwrap_arguments
nodes.summary: Builds bwrap arguments: new namespaces, own uid/gid, no capabilities, bind mounts for reads and writes.

nodes.name: bwrap_reason
nodes.summary: Explains why bubblewrap cannot confine a run here from probed facts, with the Linux fix.

nodes.name: _apparmor_profile
nodes.summary: Checks whether an AppArmor profile lets a program create user namespaces.

nodes.name: consent_callers.py
nodes.summary: Wraps model callers (host CLIs, SDK clients, urllib senders) so every actual backend send passes the cloud consent admission, resolving each caller's first-hop destination to keep local models local.

nodes.name: CallerWrapper
nodes.summary: Published contract for request-transforming wrappers that expose their sending caller as inner so the guard can wrap it.

nodes.name: sdk_endpoint
nodes.summary: Returns the base endpoint URL of an SDK client.

nodes.name: sdk_destination
nodes.summary: Asks an SDK client's HTTP layer to resolve proxies and mounts to establish the first-hop destination.

nodes.name: _sdk_call
nodes.summary: Context manager marking an admitted SDK call for one client and provider on this thread.

nodes.name: sdk_send
nodes.summary: Guards an SDK resource used directly, checking admission once per enclosing call.

nodes.name: loopback
nodes.summary: Whether a URL's host is a loopback address.

nodes.name: urllib_destination
nodes.summary: Resolves a urllib request's first hop using native proxy handlers without opening a connection.

nodes.name: watched_host
nodes.summary: Returns the provider of a host caller the self-maintenance loop watches, or empty.

nodes.name: backend_supported
nodes.summary: Whether a caller's backend type can be guarded.

nodes.name: destination
nodes.summary: Determines the destination provider of a caller (local, cloud host or SDK), unwrapping wrappers.

nodes.name: _Consent
nodes.summary: Mixin subclass adding admission checks to complete and complete_with_images of a native caller.

nodes.name: _Unknown
nodes.summary: Stand-in caller for an unrecognised backend that refuses every send.

nodes.name: guard
nodes.summary: Returns a guarded form of a caller that runs consent admission on each actual backend send while preserving retry and fallback behaviour.

nodes.name: consent_declarations.py
nodes.summary: Host-code source declarations stating which data scopes each model-calling producer class may send, used by the consent inventory to derive model sources and tool declarations.

nodes.name: Declaration
nodes.summary: Frozen declaration of the producer classes and data source scopes they may send to a model.

nodes.name: consent_registry.py
nodes.summary: GuardedRegistry adapter that passes every model handed through the door's registry through the shared consent guard before dispatch, delegating other registry operations.

nodes.name: GuardedRegistry
nodes.summary: Registry adapter putting every supplied model through the consent guard before invoke, delegating other operations.

nodes.name: contract_decorator.py
nodes.summary: Provides the @block_contract class decorator that attaches a BlockContract (purpose, inputs, failure modes, cost estimate, domain standards, examples) to a component class at import time, plus a reader that falls back to a default contract.
nodes.languageNotes: Python class decorator that sets a class attribute with no registry mutation, mirroring the reliability_tracked/component_maturity pattern.

nodes.name: block_contract
nodes.summary: Decorator factory taking about thirty contract fields, normalising them into tuples, StateSurface, CostEstimate and SourceOpsDescriptor values, and setting the resulting BlockContract on the decorated class.

nodes.name: get_block_contract_attr
nodes.summary: Reads the BlockContract attached to a class, accepting a contract object or a dict, and otherwise builds a minimal contract named after the class.

nodes.name: agents.json
nodes.summary: Failure-mode catalogue for the agents family: eight codes such as unguarded_tool_use, overprivileged_agent and unearned_autonomy with titles and severities, and the autonomy governor planned to guard unearned autonomy.

nodes.name: code.json
nodes.summary: Failure-mode catalogue for the code family (for example handwritten boilerplate, broken existing functionality, ineffective fixes), mapping app_repair as the planned guard.

nodes.name: cogarch.json
nodes.summary: Failure-mode catalogue for the cognitive-architecture family, such as models of human recall that ignore forgetting and interference; no planned guards yet.

nodes.name: core.json
nodes.summary: The largest failure-mode catalogue: the core family of seed and aliased codes (for example unsafe_autonomous_action) with titles and severities, plus planned guards in g6.core.llm and the reliability pipeline.

nodes.name: deploy.json
nodes.summary: Failure-mode catalogue for the deploy family (manual deploy errors, unnoticed drift and similar), naming the observability and AWS deploy packages as planned guards.

nodes.name: domains.json
nodes.summary: Failure-mode catalogue for the domains family (deskilling, illusion of competence, insecure code shipped, leaked secrets and others), mapping domain packages such as training_mode and cybersecurity as planned guards.

nodes.name: embodied.json
nodes.summary: Failure-mode catalogue for the embodied family (infeasible motion plans, incompatible interfaces, unbuildable geometry), with g6.embodied and mesh3d as planned guards.

nodes.name: integrations.json
nodes.summary: Failure-mode catalogue for the integrations family, such as a task sent to a paid or unsuitable model nobody chose; no planned guards.

nodes.name: jobs.json
nodes.summary: Failure-mode catalogue for the jobs family (inconsistent review rules, unreviewed test cases, ungrounded recommendations and many more), mapping job_framework and other job packages as planned guards.

nodes.name: knowledge.json
nodes.summary: Failure-mode catalogue for the knowledge family (incomplete literature search, unreadable sources), with g6.knowledge as a planned guard.

nodes.name: media.json
nodes.summary: Failure-mode catalogue for the media family (misleading charts, poor-fit routes), with g6.media as a planned guard.

nodes.name: memory.json
nodes.summary: Failure-mode catalogue for the memory family (buried observations, context loss), with adapt_memory as a planned guard.

nodes.name: ml.json
nodes.summary: Failure-mode catalogue for the ml family (unsystematic tuning, ill-suited models, confounded gains), mapping the algorithm selector and experiment search as planned guards.

nodes.name: provers.json
nodes.summary: Failure-mode catalogue for the provers family with one code, translated code that behaves differently from the original, planned to be guarded by provers.polyglot.

nodes.name: sources.json
nodes.summary: Failure-mode catalogue for the sources family, such as factual questions answered from model memory instead of a source; no planned guards.

nodes.name: workspace.json
nodes.summary: Failure-mode catalogue for the workspace family, such as losing track of which prompt or spec version produced a result; no planned guards.

nodes.name: allowed_signers
nodes.summary: OpenSSH allowed-signers trust list for qualified component reviewers; currently holds only a comment saying the owner adds each reviewer here, and component certificates read it to check reviewer signatures.

nodes.name: decision_record.py
nodes.summary: Defines the decision lifecycle for G6 action logic: a DecisionState enum from DRAFT through AUTHORISED, EXECUTED and CLOSED, an allowed/prohibited transition table, transition helpers, and a serialisable DecisionRecord.

nodes.name: DecisionState
nodes.summary: String enum of the thirteen decision lifecycle states, from DRAFT and OBJECTIVE_DEFINED through AUTHORISED and EXECUTED to CLOSED, REVISED or ROLLED_BACK.

nodes.name: DecisionRecord
nodes.summary: Dataclass holding a decision's id, current state, objective contract reference and transition history, with a to_dict serialiser.

nodes.name: can_transition
nodes.summary: Reports whether a move between two decision states is allowed, rejecting prohibited shortcuts such as DRAFT to EXECUTED.

nodes.name: advance
nodes.summary: Moves a decision to a new state, raising ValueError on a self-transition or a move the transition table does not allow.

nodes.name: discovery.py
nodes.summary: Progressive component discovery for agents (find, describe, ops): ranks registered components by a transparent token-overlap score over package docstrings, skill descriptions and guarded failure-mode titles read from source without importing them, and describes one component with its ops, failure modes, extras and vetting summary.

nodes.name: find
nodes.summary: Scores every registered component against a query with an IDF-weighted token overlap over its profile text, breaking ties by score then name, and returns the top matches with their scores.

nodes.name: describe
nodes.summary: Builds the full description of one component: registry info, ops, known and mitigated failure modes, program and key descriptions, optional extras with install state, skill text, and vetting summary and certificate.

nodes.name: ops
nodes.summary: Asks a component for its ops through the registry and returns them as a list of strings, or an empty list when the call fails.

nodes.name: _docstring
nodes.summary: Reads a component package's module docstring by parsing its __init__ source with ast, without importing the package.

nodes.name: door.py
nodes.summary: The door rule every G6 surface (MCP g6_invoke, the g6 invoke command, agent tool calls, navigator steps) applies to a component's own claim about its result: `verified` stands only when G6's own re-checker reproduces it, otherwise the result is held at `qualified-draft` with a G6_E_PROMOTION_LAW warning card and every `verified` word in the copy is corrected, within bounded copy budgets.
nodes.languageNotes: Copies results iteratively with explicit visit budgets and a depth cap instead of unbounded recursion, refusing oversized or self-referential answers.

nodes.name: AnswerNotRead
nodes.summary: ValueError raised with a G6_E_RESOURCE_LIMIT code when copying a result would revisit more than ANSWER_VISITS values or reach more than ANSWER_TOTAL values, so nothing of the answer is handed on.

nodes.name: _read
nodes.summary: Returns the child values of a mapping or sequence that the door's result copy must visit.

nodes.name: _past_budget
nodes.summary: Walks a result iteratively, counting repeat visits and total visits, and reports which budget (AGAIN or TOTAL) the copy would exceed.

nodes.name: card
nodes.summary: Keeps a component's own warning card when its code is a valid G6_E_* code, otherwise builds a new card from the given code and message.

nodes.name: state_of
nodes.summary: Normalises a free-text state word to one of the three reliability labels (`verified`, `qualified-draft`, `blocked-escalated`) or None.

nodes.name: said_state
nodes.summary: Reads the strongest completion state a component's result claims for itself from its completion_state or state fields.

nodes.name: held_copy
nodes.summary: Makes a bounded copy of a result in which every value reading as `verified` is replaced by the held state, replacing anything nested past the depth cap with a note and raising AnswerNotRead past the visit budgets.

nodes.name: corrected_result
nodes.summary: Returns the held copy of a result with its own completion state lowered to the door's state when it claimed a stronger one.

nodes.name: door_envelope
nodes.summary: Builds the cross-surface reliability envelope for a claimed state by running G6's door witness for the producer, keeping `verified` only when the re-check reproduces it and attaching a promotion-law warning card otherwise.

nodes.name: blocked_reply
nodes.summary: Turns an error string into a `blocked-escalated` envelope, lifting a leading [G6_E_*] code into the warning card.

nodes.name: producer_of
nodes.summary: Identifies where the code that produced a component's result lives (built-in package and block class) from the registry entry, so the re-checker is picked by origin rather than by name.

nodes.name: door_reply
nodes.summary: The shared reply every invoke door returns: blocks failures, reads the component's claimed state, builds the door envelope and hands on the corrected result, refusing answers too large to copy.

nodes.name: allowed_sensitive
nodes.summary: Reads the set of sensitive component ops the person allowed from an environment setting.

nodes.name: person_model
nodes.summary: Returns the language-model provider the person configured, or an UnusableModel stand-in describing why none is usable.

nodes.name: invoke_checked
nodes.summary: Invokes a component op through the registry behind the door: validates params, applies the sensitive-op allow list and the person's model, maps refusals to blocked envelopes, and returns door_reply's checked envelope.

nodes.name: env.py
nodes.summary: Shared run-mode helpers that canonicalise production mode ("production"/"prod") from an explicit argument or the G6_ENV variable, so callers stop keeping their own copies.

nodes.name: resolve_run_mode
nodes.summary: Resolves the run mode as a lower-cased string, preferring an explicit argument over the G6_ENV environment variable.

nodes.name: is_production_env
nodes.summary: Reports whether the resolved run mode is one of the canonical production forms.

nodes.name: errors.py
nodes.summary: Shared refusal codes every component returns the same way (G6_E_UNKNOWN_OP, G6_E_ISOLATION_UNAVAILABLE, G6_E_SCREEN_RAW_FAILED) and the unknown_op helper that suggests the nearest op.

nodes.name: unknown_op
nodes.summary: Returns a failed Result coded [G6_E_UNKNOWN_OP] that names the closest matching op or lists the component's valid ops.

nodes.name: evidence_grade.py
nodes.summary: Canonical three-level evidence grade (kernel, instrument, model) with crosswalks from ledger oracle kinds, E-levels and verification methods, and the ceiling each grade puts on the completion label; standalone and additive, consumed by nothing yet.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses typing.Literal aliases and lookup tables as a lightweight lattice instead of enums, failing closed to the lowest grade on unknown input.

nodes.name: grade_rank
nodes.summary: Returns the numeric rank of an evidence grade (model < instrument < kernel).

nodes.name: warrants_verified
nodes.summary: Reports whether a grade is the kernel grade, the only one that warrants the `verified` label.

nodes.name: grade_from_oracle_kind
nodes.summary: Maps a claim-ledger oracle kind to its evidence grade, failing closed to model for unknown kinds.

nodes.name: grade_from_e_level
nodes.summary: Maps an E0-E3 evidence level to the canonical grade, defaulting to model.

nodes.name: e_level_from_grade
nodes.summary: Maps a canonical grade back to its E-level.

nodes.name: grade_from_verification_method
nodes.summary: Grades a verification method by what it asserts: a kernel-class method is demoted unless it is independent and names a resolvable artifact a third party can re-check.

nodes.name: max_completion_label
nodes.summary: Returns the strongest completion label a grade allows: `verified` for kernel, `qualified-draft` for instrument, `blocked-escalated` for model.

nodes.name: normalize_completion_label
nodes.summary: Normalises underscore CompletionState spellings (verified_ready, qualified_draft, blocked_escalated) to the hyphenated envelope labels.

nodes.name: evidence.py
nodes.summary: Evidence bundle types used by harness checking: typed claims with risk level, E-grade, epistemic status and disposition, test results, source references, assumptions, provenance-rich evidence records, and the bundle that serialises them.
nodes.languageNotes: Dataclasses validated in __post_init__ against typing.Literal value sets via get_args.

nodes.name: Claim
nodes.summary: A claim with its type, evidence and counter-evidence references, risk level, evidence grade, epistemic status, scope, confidence, disposition and validity window, validated on creation and serialisable.

nodes.name: TestResult
nodes.summary: Record of one test run: name, pass/fail, command and output reference.

nodes.name: SourceRef
nodes.summary: Reference to a source: URI, title, source type and excerpt.

nodes.name: Assumption
nodes.summary: An assumption with its risk and how it would be validated.

nodes.name: EvidenceRecord
nodes.summary: One piece of evidence with stance, independence group, authority, methodology quality, recency, provenance dates, quoted span, conflicts of interest, reproducibility and integrity hash, validated and serialisable.

nodes.name: EvidenceBundle
nodes.summary: The bundle a harness check hands on: claims, tests run, sources, assumptions, open questions, confidence, checker id and time, schema version and evidence records, validated and serialised to a dict.

nodes.name: executor_contracts.py
nodes.summary: Immutable, versioned pydantic wire records for model inference and coding-agent tasks (requests, receipts, usage, permissions, run handles, artifact manifests) plus ModelProvider and CodingAgent protocols; they bind declarations only and carry no execution or acceptance authority.
nodes.languageNotes: Every record subclasses a frozen pydantic Record base that enforces exact schema versions, timezone-aware times and a SHA-256 over its canonical encoding.

nodes.name: _lifecycle
nodes.summary: Validates the lifecycle timestamps of an inference receipt (requested, started, finished) for ordering and consistency.

nodes.name: Record
nodes.summary: Frozen pydantic base for all executor wire records: checks exact schema version, timezone-aware times, JSON encodability, and exposes a canonical SHA-256.

nodes.name: Money
nodes.summary: Wire amount in minor units and currency mirroring workforce Money, explicitly not a budget authority.

nodes.name: ExecutorUsage
nodes.summary: Reported token and cost usage of an execution, with checks that totals and token counts are complete.

nodes.name: ModelIdentity
nodes.summary: Provider and model name pair identifying which model served an inference.

nodes.name: ModelCapabilities
nodes.summary: Declared capabilities of a model provider such as context size and supported settings.

nodes.name: InferenceRequest
nodes.summary: One inference request record with prompt content, model and decoding settings serialized as a settings object.

nodes.name: InferenceReceipt
nodes.summary: Receipt binding an inference request to its output, lifecycle and usage; matching is binding only, not task success.

nodes.name: ExecutionLimits
nodes.summary: Time, token and cost limits declared for an agent execution.

nodes.name: AgentPermissions
nodes.summary: Permissions a coding agent may use, including its write scope over workspace paths.

nodes.name: AgentCapabilities
nodes.summary: Declared capabilities of a coding agent adapter such as tools, languages and cancellation support.

nodes.name: AgentRequirements
nodes.summary: Mandatory declarations a task requires from an agent, kept separate from the permissions it may use.

nodes.name: AgentTask
nodes.summary: A coding-agent task record carrying the goal, workspace, permissions, requirements and limits.

nodes.name: AgentRunHandle
nodes.summary: Correlation handle for one agent run derived from a task; adapters still need authenticated bindings.

nodes.name: AgentStatus
nodes.summary: Observed status of an agent run (state, timestamps, messages).

nodes.name: CancellationReceipt
nodes.summary: Record of a cancellation request and what was observed about the run afterwards.

nodes.name: FileArtifact
nodes.summary: One file produced by an agent with its relative path validation and byte digest, constructible from text.

nodes.name: ArtifactManifest
nodes.summary: Manifest of file artifacts for a run, enforcing unique paths and binding scope to actual bytes.

nodes.name: agent_incompatibilities
nodes.summary: Compares a task's requirements against an agent's declared capabilities and lists mismatches; a match grants neither permission nor qualification.

nodes.name: ModelProvider
nodes.summary: Protocol for a model provider exposing capabilities() and complete(request) returning a receipt.

nodes.name: CodingAgent
nodes.summary: Protocol for a coding-agent adapter: capabilities, execute, status, cancel and artifacts.

nodes.name: extension_points.py
nodes.summary: Declares the T3/self-programming ExtensionPoints a harness puts on its BlockContract and provides the single opt-in gate every surface (MCP, REST) must call before attaching extension code.

nodes.name: ExtensionPoints
nodes.summary: Declaration of a harness's extensibility shape; its mere presence is the harness's opt-in to receiving extensions.

nodes.name: harness_opted_in
nodes.summary: Returns true only when the named harness is a registered component whose contract declares extension points.

nodes.name: extension_targets_opted_in
nodes.summary: Single shared predicate checking that every harness an extension targets has opted in; surfaces call it before mounting extension tools or routes.

nodes.name: failure_modes.py
nodes.summary: Global registry of failure-mode codes for harness contracts, seeded with defaults and loaded from per-family JSON files, plus readers that parse component __init__ declarations of mitigated and introduced modes without importing them.

nodes.name: FailureModeRecord
nodes.summary: One registered failure mode: code, description, title and owning family.

nodes.name: FailureModeRegistry
nodes.summary: Singleton-style registry of failure-mode codes that seeds defaults, loads family JSON files, and reports titles and planned guards.

nodes.name: declared
nodes.summary: Reads a package's __g6_mitigates__/__g6_introduces__ literal tuples from its __init__.py source without importing it.

nodes.name: declarations_in
nodes.summary: Parses failure-mode declaration tuples from __init__.py source text with the AST, never executing it.

nodes.name: declaration_problems
nodes.summary: Lists what is wrong with a component package's failure-mode declarations.

nodes.name: problems_in
nodes.summary: Checks parsed declarations: literal tuples, at least one mitigated mode, and every code registered.

nodes.name: formula.py
nodes.summary: G6's own standard-library expression parser that reads caller formula text into an inert tree under a configurable Dialect, refusing anything outside a strict arithmetic language with stable codes, bounding value sizes, and rendering trees back to canonical text.
nodes.languageNotes: Hand-written tokenizer plus recursive-descent parser with explicit precedence (right-associative ^ binding tighter than unary minus); nothing is evaluated, and a separate bounds pass estimates log2 magnitudes to refuse huge values.

nodes.name: FormulaRefused
nodes.summary: Exception for text the parser will not read, carrying a stable code, reason, field, line and column.

nodes.name: Dialect
nodes.summary: Configuration of one formula language: allowed functions and arities, constants, infinity, comparisons, piecewise and reserved names.

nodes.name: Num
nodes.summary: AST node for an exact number (integer or decimal read as a rational).

nodes.name: Sym
nodes.summary: AST node for a declared symbol.

nodes.name: Const
nodes.summary: AST node for a dialect constant or its infinity.

nodes.name: Neg
nodes.summary: AST node for unary negation.

nodes.name: BinOp
nodes.summary: AST node for a binary arithmetic operator (+ - * / ^) with its source position.

nodes.name: Call
nodes.summary: AST node for a call to a dialect function with its arguments.

nodes.name: Equation
nodes.summary: AST node for a top-level equation between two expressions.

nodes.name: Compare
nodes.summary: AST node for one comparison used only as a piecewise condition.

nodes.name: Pair
nodes.summary: AST node for one (value, condition) pair of a piecewise, with None meaning otherwise.

nodes.name: children
nodes.summary: Returns the child nodes of an AST node for traversal.

nodes.name: free_symbols
nodes.summary: Collects the names of symbols a formula tree uses.

nodes.name: _symbol_name
nodes.summary: Validates one declared symbol name against the dialect's naming rules and reserved names.

nodes.name: declare
nodes.summary: Builds the symbol table an op may use, with optional real/positive/integer assumptions and implicit names.

nodes.name: _tokens
nodes.summary: Tokenizes formula text, refusing strings, attributes, brackets, keywords, dunder names and non-ASCII with located error codes.

nodes.name: _Parser
nodes.summary: Recursive-descent parser over tokens building the expression tree, including calls, piecewise and conditions, with depth limits.

nodes.name: parse
nodes.summary: Public entry point: reads text as one expression or equation of a dialect over declared symbols, or raises FormulaRefused with location.

nodes.name: _Bounds
nodes.summary: Static bounds analysis that estimates the log2 magnitude of subexpressions and refuses values too large to construct.

nodes.name: _decimal
nodes.summary: Converts an integer or terminating decimal literal to an exact value.

nodes.name: render
nodes.summary: Renders a tree as text in G6's canonical form that parse reads back to the same tree.

nodes.name: git_env.py
nodes.summary: Runs git safely inside working copies an agent may have controlled by building a scrubbed environment and command-scope config that disables hooks, filters, drivers, pagers, transports and lazy fetches, and refuses gitlinks.

nodes.name: UnsafeGitConfig
nodes.summary: Raised when G6 cannot switch off programs a repository's git config may name, so git is not run there.

nodes.name: safe_git_env
nodes.summary: Builds a clean git environment: kept variables only, scratch temp, no prompt or transport, empty hooks and program keys disabled via GIT_CONFIG_COUNT.

nodes.name: driver_settings
nodes.summary: Turns the driver query output into settings that empty every configured filter/diff/merge driver, refusing git versions that ignore them.

nodes.name: refuse_gitlinks
nodes.summary: Raises UnsafeGitConfig when an index or HEAD listing contains a gitlink (submodule).

nodes.name: safe_git_args
nodes.summary: Adds --ignore-submodules=all to status and diff git commands.

nodes.name: git_program
nodes.summary: Locates the git executable on PATH via outside.find_program, never in the current folder.

nodes.name: safe_git
nodes.summary: Returns the safe environment for git commands in a workdir after querying drivers and refusing gitlinks.

nodes.name: git_name.py
nodes.summary: Defines GitName, a str subclass for untrusted git-listed paths that refuses accidental conversion to text, and the single quoting rule (shown_name) with its exact inverse for showing names to people or models.

nodes.name: GitNameAsText
nodes.summary: Exception raised when a GitName is turned into text by str, format, % or repr instead of the sanctioned rules.

nodes.name: GitName
nodes.summary: String subclass holding git's own name bytes that blocks implicit text conversion and exposes raw bytes explicitly.

nodes.name: shown_name
nodes.summary: Renders a git path using git's C-style quoting with UTF-8 kept, so every name is one line and distinct bytes give distinct text.

nodes.name: shown
nodes.summary: Shows a GitName by the quoting rule and any other path unchanged.

nodes.name: unquoted_name
nodes.summary: Exact inverse of shown_name that reads a quoted name back to its original bytes.

nodes.name: host_models.py
nodes.summary: Runs the person's own Claude Code or Codex account headless as a tool-less text-completion LLMCaller, in empty per-call folders with a clean environment, stdin prompts and a deadline that kills the whole process tree.

nodes.name: not_approved
nodes.summary: Explains why a host provider named only in the environment starts nothing, since only the key file line is the person's approval.

nodes.name: _folders
nodes.summary: Creates one call's empty work folder and G6 files folder under the state directory, removed afterwards.

nodes.name: _run
nodes.summary: Runs the host program with stdin under a bounded process tree, returning exit code, stdout and stderr, and ending it at the deadline or stop request.

nodes.name: _HostCaller
nodes.summary: Shared base for host callers: locates the program, builds its environment and folders, and runs one bounded completion.

nodes.name: _result
nodes.summary: Extracts Claude Code's JSON result object from what the program printed.

nodes.name: _status_fields
nodes.summary: Pulls an error result's api_error_status and api_error fields as JSON for error messages.

nodes.name: ClaudeCodeCaller
nodes.summary: LLMCaller backed by the person's own Claude Code account, with its argv, command and reply parsing.

nodes.name: CodexCaller
nodes.summary: LLMCaller backed by the person's own Codex account, reading the prompt from stdin.

nodes.name: http.py
nodes.summary: Checked outbound HTTP for components: refuses non-public addresses (including IPv4 embedded in IPv6), pins the resolved address against DNS rebinding, follows redirects itself with header stripping, and enforces whole-request timeouts, body caps, pacing, robots.txt and hashed streaming downloads.
nodes.languageNotes: Standard library only; transport and resolver are injectable for tests, and HTTPS connects to a pinned IP while checking the certificate for the host name.

nodes.name: HTTPError
nodes.summary: Refused or failed request carrying a G6_E_HTTP_* code.

nodes.name: Request
nodes.summary: Prepared request record with method, URL, pinned IP, headers, body and timeouts.

nodes.name: Response
nodes.summary: Final HTTP response with status, headers, body and URL.

nodes.name: Stream
nodes.summary: Reply whose body is read in chunks with an explicit close.

nodes.name: Downloaded
nodes.summary: Result of Client.download: path, size, SHA-256 and final hop address.

nodes.name: system_resolver
nodes.summary: Resolves every address the system resolver gives for a host and port.

nodes.name: check_url
nodes.summary: Validates scheme and host and returns the public addresses the host resolves to, refusing local or non-public ones.

nodes.name: _PinnedHTTPS
nodes.summary: HTTPSConnection subclass that connects to a chosen IP while checking the certificate against the host name.

nodes.name: _prepare
nodes.summary: Builds the pinned connection, Host header and path for one request.

nodes.name: _cutter
nodes.summary: Starts a timer that shuts the socket when the request's overall deadline passes.

nodes.name: stdlib_transport
nodes.summary: Default transport that sends a request to its pinned IP and reads the capped reply within the time limit.

nodes.name: stdlib_stream_transport
nodes.summary: Streaming transport that hands back the body in mebibyte chunks with per-read and overall timeouts.

nodes.name: Client
nodes.summary: Checked HTTP client that resolves and pins hosts, follows redirects safely, paces per host, honours robots.txt and streams hashed downloads.

nodes.name: keys.py
nodes.summary: Reads keys only from the person's $G6_HOME/.env file (re-read on every call), where a key line is the person's approval, and lets extensions declare and require keys with a KeyMissing blocked-escalated failure instead of a fallback.

nodes.name: Key
nodes.summary: Declaration of one key an extension needs: name, purpose, where to get it and whether it spends money.

nodes.name: KeyMissing
nodes.summary: Exception for a key the person has not put in the key file, convertible to a blocked-escalated Result.

nodes.name: path
nodes.summary: Returns the key file path inside the G6 state folder.

nodes.name: _parse
nodes.summary: Parses NAME=value lines with comments, export prefixes and quotes, recording malformed line numbers without text.

nodes.name: read
nodes.summary: Returns every name and value in the key file.

nodes.name: get
nodes.summary: Returns one key value from the key file or None.

nodes.name: present
nodes.summary: Says whether the key file gives a name a value.

nodes.name: require
nodes.summary: Returns a declared key's value or raises KeyMissing.

nodes.name: names
nodes.summary: Lists key names with values, never the values.

nodes.name: problems
nodes.summary: Reports malformed key file lines by number and name, never by value.

nodes.name: ledger.py
nodes.summary: Append-only, hash-chained JSON ledger (in memory or one JSON line per entry on disk) whose verification recomputes every hash, refuses forks from concurrent writers, strict-JSON-only bodies, and supports an expected head anchor and domain validate hooks.

nodes.name: LedgerError
nodes.summary: Raised for a record the ledger refuses to write.

nodes.name: LedgerCorrupt
nodes.summary: Raised for a ledger whose chain or references do not check out; it accepts nothing further.

nodes.name: canonical
nodes.summary: Serializes a value as sorted, compact, strict JSON, refusing NaN, infinities and non-JSON values.

nodes.name: digest
nodes.summary: SHA-256 of a value's canonical JSON.

nodes.name: _verify
nodes.summary: Recomputes body, previous and entry hashes over a chain and applies the domain validate hook to each entry.

nodes.name: _read
nodes.summary: Reads and parses a ledger file line by line with strict JSON and duplicate-key refusal.

nodes.name: _file_head
nodes.summary: Returns the entry hash of a ledger file's last entry, empty for an empty file and None when missing.

nodes.name: ChainLedger
nodes.summary: Hash-chained ledger with append, audit, reload, lookup and verify that refuses writes when another writer extended the file.

nodes.name: llm.py
nodes.summary: The single explicit seam for model calls: the LLMCaller protocol and built-in callers (Ollama, OpenAI-compatible, Anthropic, host sign-ins, fake, fallback, retry, timing), provider_from_env that builds callers from the key file without guessing a paid provider, and JSON/structured-output helpers.
nodes.languageNotes: Callers are structural (Protocol-typed); every built-in notes each send through g6.core.model_calls before the request goes out, and redirects are refused rather than followed.

nodes.name: LLMError
nodes.summary: Error for a model call that failed or is not configured, so callers degrade honestly.

nodes.name: waits
nodes.summary: Returns every Retry-After wait a built-in caller took in the current context, for evidence.

nodes.name: cap_model_label
nodes.summary: Caps a reliability label a model claims for its own answer at qualified-draft and the given ceiling.

nodes.name: LLMCaller
nodes.summary: Protocol for one system plus user prompt in, one completion out.

nodes.name: Image
nodes.summary: Image bytes and media type for a model call, with the media type checked against the bytes.

nodes.name: supports_images
nodes.summary: Says whether a caller can send images to its model.

nodes.name: authorized_completion_tokens
nodes.summary: Total completion tokens one logical call may spend across EmptyRetry attempts.

nodes.name: EmptyRetry
nodes.summary: Wrapper that retries empty completions with an escalating token budget, then raises.

nodes.name: FakeLLM
nodes.summary: Deterministic caller for tests and offline demos that records every call.

nodes.name: TimingLLMCaller
nodes.summary: Wrapper that reports each call's latency, including failed calls.

nodes.name: FallbackCaller
nodes.summary: Tries the listed callers in order, moving on only when one raises LLMError.

nodes.name: NoModel
nodes.summary: Default caller when no model is configured; any use is a named failure.

nodes.name: _retry_after
nodes.summary: Parses a Retry-After header as seconds or a date.

nodes.name: _read_capped
nodes.summary: Reads at most cap bytes of a reply chunk by chunk until a deadline.

nodes.name: _post_json
nodes.summary: POSTs JSON to a model endpoint with no redirects, capped reads, Retry-After handling and a deadline.

nodes.name: _Decoding
nodes.summary: Optional decoding settings (temperature, seed, varying seeds) for paired comparisons.

nodes.name: _NoKey
nodes.summary: Caller for a paid provider with no key that fails by name and sends nothing.

nodes.name: OllamaCaller
nodes.summary: Caller for a local model through Ollama's chat endpoint, free and keyless.

nodes.name: OpenAICompatibleCaller
nodes.summary: Caller for any OpenAI-compatible chat-completions endpoint (OpenAI, OpenRouter, vLLM, LM Studio).

nodes.name: AnthropicCaller
nodes.summary: Caller for Claude through the official anthropic SDK, with image support.

nodes.name: UnusableModel
nodes.summary: Caller for a named model that cannot be used as set; it fails by name with a reason.

nodes.name: provider_from_env
nodes.summary: Factory building the caller named by G6_LLM_PROVIDER (or explicit provider/model), taking keys and host approvals only from the key file and never guessing a paid provider.

nodes.name: extract_json
nodes.summary: Parses the first JSON object or array from a model reply, tolerating fences and prose.

nodes.name: complete_structured
nodes.summary: Calls a model and strictly validates the reply against a pydantic schema with bounded retries.

nodes.name: maturity.py
nodes.summary: Small decorator helpers that tag component classes with a maturity level and reason, declared capabilities, and an observable flag, with matching getters.

nodes.name: component_maturity
nodes.summary: Decorator that marks a component class with a validated maturity level and reason.

nodes.name: get_maturity
nodes.summary: Returns a class's declared maturity level or None.

nodes.name: maturity_reason
nodes.summary: Returns a class's declared maturity reason.

nodes.name: component_capabilities
nodes.summary: Decorator declaring capabilities a component provides.

nodes.name: get_capabilities
nodes.summary: Returns a class's declared capabilities.

nodes.name: observable
nodes.summary: Decorator marking a component as emitting lifecycle events.

nodes.name: is_observable
nodes.summary: Says whether a class is marked observable.

nodes.name: model_calls.py
nodes.summary: Process-wide and per-context counters of language-model calls, with optional observers at each send boundary, context propagation into threads, child-process totals, and attribution of failures to the note they came from.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses contextvars plus a patched thread start to carry an observing scope into work the request starts; the scoped count can under-report but never counts another request.

nodes.name: Note
nodes.summary: Record of one model send at its boundary, made before any observer runs.

nodes.name: _carry_into_threads
nodes.summary: Installs context propagation so threads and pool workers started under an observing scope run in a copy of its context.

nodes.name: note_model_call
nodes.summary: Records that a model is being asked, increments counts and runs scope observers at the boundary.

nodes.name: noting
nodes.summary: Returns the note an observer is currently being run for, or None.

nodes.name: outcome_of
