nodes.summary: Determines which note a failure is the outcome of from its traceback frames.

nodes.name: note_child_model_calls
nodes.summary: Imports a supervised child's separate model-call totals without billing unscoped work.

nodes.name: model_calls
nodes.summary: Returns the process-wide model-call count including imported child totals.

nodes.name: counting
nodes.summary: Context manager counting calls in one context, optionally observing each boundary.

nodes.name: objective_contract.py
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass for the explicit objective required by the action-logic invariant G6-INV-01, with an adequacy check and dict serialization.

nodes.name: ObjectiveContract
nodes.summary: Explicit objective record for action-logic decisions with is_adequate and to_dict.

nodes.name: outside.py
nodes.summary: Declarations and detection of programs and local services a person installs themselves (never bundled), with PATH lookup that skips the current folder, bounded version probes, and the one loopback-only HTTP path to local services that fails as blocked-escalated.

nodes.name: clean_environment
nodes.summary: Returns only base and explicitly kept environment variables that are set.

nodes.name: find_program
nodes.summary: Finds a program as a given path or on PATH, never in the current folder.

nodes.name: OutsideProgram
nodes.summary: Declaration of an outside program or local service: purpose, install steps, licence, cost and how to find it.

nodes.name: Detected
nodes.summary: What detect found for a program, with found true only when it answered.

nodes.name: _run
nodes.summary: Runs a version probe as a bounded child with a clean environment and capped answer.

nodes.name: _command
nodes.summary: Detects a command-type program by finding and probing it with its version arguments.

nodes.name: ServiceError
nodes.summary: Error for a local service call that gave no answer, with a G6_E_* code and blocked-escalated Result conversion.

nodes.name: ServiceReply
nodes.summary: A 2xx reply from a local service with JSON decoding.

nodes.name: service_url
nodes.summary: Resolves a service base URL from its env variable or declaration, loopback HTTP only.

nodes.name: call_service
nodes.summary: Sends one request to a declared local service under a size cap and a whole-call time limit, mapping failures to codes.

nodes.name: _service
nodes.summary: Detects a service-type program by calling its local URL.

nodes.name: detect
nodes.summary: Says whether a declared program is present and answers, under a time limit.

nodes.name: require
nodes.summary: Returns what detect found or a failed Result explaining how to install the program.

nodes.name: process_tree.py
nodes.summary: Owns a child process and every process it starts so kill ends all of them, using a Windows Job Object (with optional memory cap) or a POSIX session process group; cleanup, not a sandbox.
nodes.languageNotes: Calls the Win32 Job Object API through ctypes with no dependency; the child starts suspended so it is in the job before it runs.

nodes.name: ProcessTreeError
nodes.summary: Raised when the process tree cannot be created, adopted or confirmed gone.

nodes.name: _Tree
nodes.summary: A started process and its descendants with a kill that ends them all.

nodes.name: _WinJob
nodes.summary: Windows Job Object wrapper with kill-on-close and optional per-process memory limit, adopting suspended processes.

nodes.name: promotion_custody.py
nodes.summary: Client side of the out-of-process promotion evaluator: spawns an isolated child service that holds the signing key and performs replay-then-sign and verification, so the generator process never holds the key; fails closed on any gap.

nodes.name: custody_configured
nodes.summary: True when an out-of-process evaluator custody service is configured by key path.

nodes.name: _import_roots
nodes.summary: Builds the child's import roots from the person's extra roots and the g6 package root.

nodes.name: _service_env
nodes.summary: Builds a scrubbed environment for the custody child process.

nodes.name: _call_service
nodes.summary: Spawns the custody child for one operation and parses its JSON reply, failing closed.

nodes.name: verify_via_custody
nodes.summary: Out-of-process signature check of a witness; False on any gap.

nodes.name: stamp_replayed_via_custody
nodes.summary: Out-of-process replay-then-sign of a witness, mirroring the in-process contract.

nodes.name: sign_receipt_via_custody
nodes.summary: Out-of-process seal of an execution-receipt core; empty string on any gap.

nodes.name: verify_receipt_via_custody
nodes.summary: Out-of-process seal check for a receipt core; False on any gap.

nodes.name: promotion_evaluator.py
nodes.summary: Independent-replay seam behind the promotion law plus an optional HMAC evaluator signing library: sign/verify/stamp witnesses and receipts, attest G6-authored oracles, register oracle replays, and replay-then-stamp, delegating to custody when configured.

nodes.name: evaluator_configured
nodes.summary: True when an evaluator signing authority (in-process key or custody) is available.

nodes.name: evaluator_key_id
nodes.summary: Non-secret fingerprint naming the current evaluator authority.

nodes.name: _signing_payload
nodes.summary: Builds the bytes binding a signature to a sealed witness digest and execution id.

nodes.name: sign
nodes.summary: HMAC-signs a sealed witness core, raising when no authority is configured.

nodes.name: verify
nodes.summary: Checks a witness signature under the configured key or via custody, failing closed.

nodes.name: stamp
nodes.summary: Returns a copy of a witness signed by the evaluator authority.

nodes.name: _receipt_signing_payload
nodes.summary: Canonical domain-separated bytes for a receipt core.

nodes.name: sign_receipt
nodes.summary: HMAC-seals an execution-receipt core.

nodes.name: verify_receipt
nodes.summary: Checks a receipt seal, failing closed.

nodes.name: sign_authored_oracle
nodes.summary: Attests that a test source is a G6-authored oracle.

nodes.name: verify_authored_oracle
nodes.summary: Checks an oracle attestation against a test source, failing closed.

nodes.name: ReplayOutcome
nodes.summary: Result of an evaluator independently re-running an oracle.

nodes.name: register_oracle
nodes.summary: Registers an independent replay function for an oracle name.

nodes.name: oracle_registered
nodes.summary: Says whether a replay is registered for an oracle name.

nodes.name: replay_reproduces
nodes.summary: Independently re-runs a witness's oracle and checks it reproduces the witnessed execution, failing closed on every gap.

nodes.name: stamp_replayed
nodes.summary: Replays the oracle and stamps only a reproducing result (the de Bruijn mint path), via custody when configured.

nodes.name: protocols.py
nodes.summary: Structural typing Protocols for AIBlock-compatible components (ingest, emit, store, infer, learn, inductive bias) plus the SourceOps capability surface and its pydantic descriptor.

nodes.name: Ingestible
nodes.summary: Protocol for components that accept raw input and return a Result.

nodes.name: Emittable
nodes.summary: Protocol for components that produce output from internal state.

nodes.name: Storable
nodes.summary: Protocol for components that save and load their state.

nodes.name: Inferrable
nodes.summary: Protocol for components that run forward inference on an input.

nodes.name: Learnable
nodes.summary: Protocol for components that update parameters from labelled data.

nodes.name: InductiveBias
nodes.summary: Protocol for components declaring assumptions about their hypothesis space.

nodes.name: ConfigurableBias
nodes.summary: Protocol for components accepting runtime bias updates from the evolution loop.

nodes.name: SourceOpsDescriptor
nodes.summary: Pydantic descriptor of backend-native source operations and constraints, with an allows check and public dict.

nodes.name: SourceOps
nodes.summary: Protocol for backend-native source operations: capabilities, health, read, mutation intent/apply, rollback and degradation.

nodes.name: reading.py
nodes.summary: The one reader for what a check stands on: exact-name stats, SHA-256 digests and a single top-down lister that raise Unreadable on any failure, so nothing ever stands in for an unreadable file or folder.
nodes.languageNotes: Handles Windows name rewriting (nul, trailing dots and spaces) by addressing entries with extended-length paths, and compares stat identities to detect listings changed between reads.

nodes.name: Unreadable
nodes.summary: OSError for a file or folder a check stands on that could not be read or listed whole.

nodes.name: said
nodes.summary: Renders a path for a message, spelling out lone surrogates.

nodes.name: exact
nodes.summary: Maps a path to the form the platform opens as the exact entry its names spell.

nodes.name: _a_callers
nodes.summary: Normalizes a caller-given root, refusing one the platform would reread as a different entry.

nodes.name: sha256_of
nodes.summary: SHA-256 of a file's bytes, raising Unreadable on any failure.

nodes.name: asked
nodes.summary: Stats the exact entry a path spells (lstat or stat), raising on any failure.

nodes.name: linked
nodes.summary: Says whether a stat result is a link or Windows junction.

nodes.name: same
nodes.summary: Says whether two stat answers are of the same entry.

nodes.name: Listed
nodes.summary: A listed name carrying the stat info its entry answered.

nodes.name: walk
nodes.summary: The one top-down lister that lists each folder once and stats every entry itself, raising on any failure.

nodes.name: files_under
nodes.summary: Every regular file at or under a root, sorted, from one listing.

nodes.name: registry.py
nodes.summary: Lazy component discovery for the installed g6 package (component sub-packages, family members and g6.components entry points) with collision tracking, description, and typed invocation of a block's infer op within a parameter visit budget.

nodes.name: OuterBudgetExceeded
nodes.summary: Raised when an op's parameters hold more entries than the visit budget allows.

nodes.name: outer_copy
nodes.summary: Copies the outer parameter mapping within the visit budget, as dict(params) would.

nodes.name: ComponentRef
nodes.summary: Reference to a discovered component: name and module path.

nodes.name: ComponentRegistry
nodes.summary: Discovers components lazily, records name collisions, imports one on demand, describes it and invokes ops through its typed input.

nodes.name: build_typed_input
nodes.summary: Validates raw input against the type annotated on a block's infer parameter.

nodes.name: get_registry
nodes.summary: Returns the process-wide ComponentRegistry singleton.

nodes.name: reliability_envelope.py
nodes.summary: Cross-surface ReliabilityEnvelope carrying the canonical states (verified, qualified-draft, blocked-escalated), warning cards and evidence, and the always-on, down-only kernel promotion law that lets verified stand only when G6's own re-checker reproduces a door-sealed witness.
nodes.languageNotes: Pydantic model validators enforce state-required fields and apply the promotion law on every construction; the re-checker is chosen by the module where producing code lives, not by name.

nodes.name: _witness_content_digest
nodes.summary: Canonical digest of a promotion witness core, failing closed.

nodes.name: g6_module
nodes.summary: Returns the G6 module a class or function really lives in, or empty when it is not G6's own code.

nodes.name: _g6_rechecker
nodes.summary: Returns the replay of G6's own re-checker for an oracle name, or None.

nodes.name: recheck_evidence
nodes.summary: Builds the single evidence entry an envelope promoted by a witness must carry.

nodes.name: door_witness
nodes.summary: Builds and seals a promotion witness at a door for a result a producer returned, or None.

nodes.name: _promotion_verdict
nodes.summary: Computes faults and refutation for a witness by re-running G6's re-check and comparing task, run, evidence and execution identity.

nodes.name: promotion_witness_faults
nodes.summary: Lists every reason a witness does not let verified stand on an envelope.

nodes.name: build_promotion_witness
nodes.summary: Seals a promotion witness naming the oracle, details and execution identity to reproduce.

nodes.name: _evidence_line
nodes.summary: Renders one evidence item as a human-readable line.

nodes.name: WarningCard
nodes.summary: Pydantic warning card with code, message, suggested action, why and next step mirrored for consistency.

nodes.name: EvidenceEntry
nodes.summary: Pydantic evidence item record.

nodes.name: ReliabilityEnvelope
nodes.summary: Envelope model that coerces evidence, enforces fields required by non-verified states, reconciles state fields, and applies the promotion law.

nodes.name: warning_card
nodes.summary: Helper constructing a WarningCard from code, message and suggested action.

nodes.name: envelope_fields
nodes.summary: Builds the dict of cross-surface envelope fields (label, warning card, evidence, request/task/run ids, witness) through ReliabilityEnvelope.

nodes.name: resources.py
nodes.summary: Resource limits a component declares (time, disk, windowed tokens and cost), the usage it counts itself on an injectable clock, and pre-work checks including suite size bounds.

nodes.name: ResourceBounds
nodes.summary: Declared limits on time, disk, tokens per window and cost, each finite and non-negative or None.

nodes.name: ResourceUsage
nodes.summary: Component-counted usage of tokens, cost and disk with timestamps and windowed totals.

nodes.name: check
nodes.summary: Returns the first limit already reached (time, disk, cost, then tokens) or None when work may start.

nodes.name: check_case_bounds
nodes.summary: Refuses oversized test suites by case count and byte size before copying them.

nodes.name: result.py
nodes.summary: Railway-oriented Result type (OK/FAIL Status) returned on every AIBlock edge, with ok/fail constructors, unwrap, map, flat_map and or_else.

nodes.name: Status
nodes.summary: Enum of OK and FAIL result states.

nodes.name: Result
nodes.summary: Generic railway Result wrapping a value or an error string, with combinators for chaining.

nodes.name: risk_policy.py
nodes.summary: Epistemic risk policy gates: a built-in R0-R3 by E0-E3 matrix (never read from a file) mapping risk levels to minimum evidence grades and deciding claim disposition, with an optional W4 grade floor and shadow logging.

nodes.name: load_epistemic_policy
nodes.summary: Returns a fresh copy of the built-in epistemic policy matrix.

nodes.name: minimum_grade_for
nodes.summary: Returns the minimum evidence grade a risk level requires.

nodes.name: grade_meets
nodes.summary: Says whether an actual evidence grade meets a required grade.

nodes.name: _min_e_level
nodes.summary: Returns the stricter of two E-levels by grade order.

nodes.name: _shadow_log_w4_floor
nodes.summary: Records a would-tighten W4 floor decision without changing behaviour.

nodes.name: gate_decision
nodes.summary: Applies the G6-EI-001 gate matrix to a claim given risk, evidence grade, conflicts, approval and rollback.

nodes.name: risk_signals.py
nodes.summary: The single implicit-signal risk classifier: maps the words of a task to a risk level R0-R3 by matching graded signal terms, highest level first, with a non-signal default of R1. Standard library only so the workforce can derive standards without loading the design block.

nodes.name: sandbox.py
nodes.summary: Runs a Python script out of process in a fresh folder under a wall-clock, memory and output bound, confined by an OS backend (bubblewrap or a Windows AppContainer) where available and refused with G6_E_ISOLATION_UNAVAILABLE otherwise unless the person allowed unconfined runs. Returns a ScriptRun with status, outputs, limits and isolation details.
nodes.languageNotes: Combines POSIX rlimits, Windows Job Objects and per-OS confinement backends behind one run_script call; output files are read through O_NOFOLLOW-style handles and fstat checks to avoid symlink escapes.

nodes.name: skills.py
nodes.summary: Locates and parses the SKILL.md files shipped as package data for each component, the using-g6 guide and vendored superpowers skills, and extracts front matter, Ops, API sections and g6-example blocks for tests.

nodes.name: snapshots.py
nodes.summary: Snapshots, lists, rolls back and exports $G6_HOME as zip files, copying SQLite databases through the backup API, refusing unsafe archive members and always excluding the person's key file and stored secrets.

nodes.name: source_check.py
nodes.summary: AST pre-filter for small generated functions run out of process: refuses imports, dangerous builtins, global/nonlocal, underscore attributes and format-based attribute escapes, and defines the small safe builtins table. Shared by g6.cegis and g6.distillation.

nodes.name: special.py
nodes.summary: Pure-Python regularised incomplete beta and gamma functions and their quantiles (DLMF 8.7.1, 8.9, 8.17) using modified Lentz continued fractions and bounded bisection, raising NotConverged rather than returning approximate answers.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses the modified Lentz algorithm for continued fractions with a TINY floor to avoid division by zero.

nodes.name: state_surface.py
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass declaring a harness's persistence scope, query surface and retention, validated against fixed literal vocabularies.

nodes.name: stats.py
nodes.summary: The core statistics block: normal, t, chi-squared and F distribution functions, survival functions and quantiles built on g6.core.special, plus Welch's t test, the pooled two-proportion z test and one-sample sample-size formulas, refusing out-of-domain inputs.
nodes.languageNotes: Computes small tails directly rather than as one minus the other side, and bounds quantile probabilities to [1e-10, 1-1e-10] for accuracy.

nodes.name: stop.py
nodes.summary: Process-wide stop switch engaged in process, by the G6_STOP environment variable, or by a STOP file in $G6_HOME; consulted by the Door, the safety policy engine, the operator loop and harness runs before starting new work (G6_E_STOPPED).

nodes.name: storage.py
nodes.summary: The single root for durable state ($G6_HOME, default ~/.g6) with open_db and state_path, plus the shared path-containment checks (contained, plain_file) that refuse traversal, symlink, junction, network and device paths.

nodes.name: task_contract_verifier.py
nodes.summary: Defines the available-verifier predicate for a task contract's success criteria: a verifier counts if it is a registered verification method, a registered promotion-law oracle, or a human: review marker. Used by intake to escalate critical criteria with no runnable verifier.

nodes.name: validation_gates.py
nodes.summary: Registry of named validation gates in which only human_approval is a real control and the rest are fail-open placeholders; register probes each gate with a null request so is_enforced reports by measurement which gates actually refuse.

nodes.name: vault.py
nodes.summary: The evaluator-only read boundary: a Vault seals held-out answers and hidden tests with a digest and file identities, and guarded_read refuses reads by builders, learners or reviewers, writing incidents to a ledger; results depending on it are reported as unblinded.
nodes.languageNotes: Membership is decided by device/inode identity as well as resolved location, so alternate path spellings or hard links cannot bypass it.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Per-harness registry of verification methods that each return an EvidenceBundle, with register, get, is_empty and list_names.

nodes.name: methods.py
nodes.summary: Reusable verification methods (acceptance criteria, evidence coverage, reliability pipeline self-check, formal methods and CSF checks) that build EvidenceBundles with claims, test results and confidence, registered into the verification registry.

nodes.name: vetting.py
nodes.summary: Implements the vetting protocol that holds components in vetted areas out of the library listing until a current G6 certificate passes: reads each component's __g6_vetting__ declaration from source by AST, checks paths and certificates, and summarises status including optional signed reviews.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package entry for g6.csf, which computes safety bounds and checks on a caller-supplied finite Markov agent model: reachability union bound, finite-trace LTL, bound composition, rollback feasibility and git checkpoints; re-exports the public API of its submodules.

nodes.name: composition.py
nodes.summary: compose_bound: an upper bound on the probability that either of two parts fails, using the Frechet/Boole bound by default and the independence formula only when the caller asserts independence.

nodes.name: ltl.py
nodes.summary: Finite-trace LTL: AST node classes, a bounded recursive-descent parser, a bottom-up evaluator over (subformula, position) and a printer, with length and depth limits and strict boolean trace values.
nodes.languageNotes: Evaluation is dynamic programming over subformulas and trace positions, making cost linear in formula size times trace length instead of exponential recursion.

nodes.name: policy.py
nodes.summary: EpsilonPolicy, a person's approved epsilon cap with a content-bound approval scope, and tighten, which applies a smaller epsilon only under a live human approval from the approval authority.

nodes.name: rollback.py
nodes.summary: Rollback support: rollback_feasibility statically classifies a plan's operations against one vocabulary (unknown means infeasible), and GitCheckpoint snapshots tracked files and performs an opt-in hard reset only at a repository's top level.

nodes.name: schema.py
nodes.summary: The g6.csf model: BoundedAgent, TransitionOutcome and ResourceTriple over a finite Markov chain, with the single validate_transitions validator that refuses unknown states, bad probabilities and incomplete distributions, plus CSF error types and epsilon/id checks.

nodes.name: SKILL.md
nodes.summary: Agent skill for g6-csf covering when and when not to use the safety bounds, its Python API, how to read results, composition with other components, failure modes, blind spots, requirements and worked examples.

nodes.name: smt.py
nodes.summary: Encodes an LTL property against an agent model's positive-probability paths over steps 0..N and asks Z3 for a violating path, re-checking any counterexample with evaluate_ltl; holds is qualified-draft, counterexamples and refusals are blocked-escalated.

nodes.name: trace.py
nodes.summary: Fits a labelled BoundedAgent from observed transition pairs, replacing each safe state's hazard with a Bonferroni-split Clopper-Pearson upper bound and routing unobserved hazard to an added absorbing unsafe state.

nodes.name: classify
nodes.summary: Returns the risk level and reason for a task's text by checking level signal words from R3 down, falling back to the default level.

nodes.name: signals
nodes.summary: Returns the tuple of signal words found in a task's text across all levels.

nodes.name: ScriptRun
nodes.summary: Dataclass result of a sandboxed script run: status, return code, stdout/stderr, collected output files, seconds, limits and isolation details.

nodes.name: isolation_refused
nodes.summary: Tells whether a ScriptRun was refused because no OS isolation backend was available.

nodes.name: interpreter
nodes.summary: Resolves the Python interpreter to run scripts with, honouring an environment override.

nodes.name: memory_limit
nodes.summary: Determines how memory is capped for the child on this operating system and which limit kind applies.

nodes.name: run_script
nodes.summary: Writes the script and input files into a fresh folder, plans OS confinement, runs it with bounded time, memory and output, and returns a ScriptRun describing the outcome or refusal.

nodes.name: _collect_outputs
nodes.summary: Reads plain files the script left in its folder up to a byte limit, refusing directories, links and files outside the folder.

nodes.name: skill_name
nodes.summary: Maps a component name to its installed skill name (g6- prefix, hyphens for underscores).

nodes.name: skill_dir
nodes.summary: Finds a component's skill folder from its registered module's package, without importing the component.

nodes.name: skill_text
nodes.summary: Reads a component's SKILL.md text, if it has one.

nodes.name: components_with_skills
nodes.summary: Lists registered components that ship a SKILL.md.

nodes.name: guide_dir
nodes.summary: Returns the folder of G6's own using-g6 guide skill.

nodes.name: vendor_dir
nodes.summary: Returns the folder holding vendored superpowers skills.

nodes.name: vendored
nodes.summary: Lists the vendored skill folders that contain a SKILL.md.

nodes.name: section
nodes.summary: Extracts the body of a named level-2 section from a skill's markdown.

nodes.name: skill_ops
nodes.summary: Parses the ops listed in a skill's Ops section.

nodes.name: skill_api
nodes.summary: Parses the API entries listed in a skill's API section.

nodes.name: skill_python_examples
nodes.summary: Extracts the Python code blocks from a skill's Examples section.

nodes.name: front_matter
nodes.summary: Parses the simple key: value YAML-like front matter at the top of a SKILL.md.

nodes.name: skill_examples
nodes.summary: Parses g6-example fenced blocks into (op, params) pairs, refusing blocks whose body is not a JSON object.

nodes.name: Snapshot
nodes.summary: Dataclass describing one snapshot zip: name, path, size and file count.

nodes.name: _write
nodes.summary: Writes a zip of $G6_HOME state, copying SQLite databases through the backup API and leaving out secret files unless asked.

nodes.name: snapshot
nodes.summary: Creates a labelled, timestamped snapshot of $G6_HOME in its snapshots folder.

nodes.name: list_snapshots
nodes.summary: Lists existing snapshots with their sizes and file counts.

nodes.name: _safe_members
nodes.summary: Checks every archive member is a relative path without traversal and not a reserved file before extraction.

nodes.name: rollback
nodes.summary: Restores $G6_HOME from a named snapshot after first snapshotting the current state, preserving the key file.

nodes.name: export
nodes.summary: Writes a snapshot of $G6_HOME to an outside target without stored secrets, refusing targets inside G6_HOME.

nodes.name: validate_source
nodes.summary: Parses source and returns why it is refused (imports, forbidden names or attributes, global/nonlocal), or an empty string when it passes.

nodes.name: NotConverged
nodes.summary: ValueError raised when a bounded numerical calculation does not reach its tolerance.

nodes.name: log_beta
nodes.summary: Natural log of the beta function via lgamma.

nodes.name: _beta_fraction
nodes.summary: Modified Lentz evaluation of the incomplete beta continued fraction, raising NotConverged when exhausted.

nodes.name: beta_cdf
nodes.summary: Regularised incomplete beta function I_x(a, b) with domain checks and the symmetry switch for convergence.

nodes.name: gamma_cdf
nodes.summary: Regularised lower incomplete gamma P(a, x) by series or continued fraction depending on x.

nodes.name: gamma_sf
nodes.summary: Regularised upper incomplete gamma Q(a, x), computed directly for accurate small tails.

nodes.name: bisect_quantile
nodes.summary: Inverts a monotone CDF by bounded bisection on a bracket, refusing when the bound is exhausted.

nodes.name: beta_quantile
nodes.summary: Quantile of the beta distribution by bisection on beta_cdf.

nodes.name: gamma_quantile
nodes.summary: Quantile of the gamma distribution, doubling the upper bracket then bisecting on gamma_cdf.

nodes.name: StateSurface
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass of persistence scope, query surface and retention, validating each against the allowed literals.

nodes.name: _invert
nodes.summary: Shared quantile inversion: brackets and bisects a distribution function, with relative or absolute tolerance and bounded doublings.

nodes.name: normal_cdf
nodes.summary: Standard normal CDF, using the upper incomplete gamma for an accurate lower tail.

nodes.name: normal_sf
nodes.summary: Standard normal survival function (upper tail).

nodes.name: normal_ppf
nodes.summary: Standard normal quantile by bisection.

nodes.name: t_cdf
nodes.summary: Student t CDF for any positive degrees of freedom via the incomplete beta.

nodes.name: t_sf
nodes.summary: Student t upper tail.

nodes.name: t_ppf
nodes.summary: Student t quantile by bisection.

nodes.name: chi2_cdf
nodes.summary: Chi-squared CDF via the regularised lower gamma.

nodes.name: chi2_sf
nodes.summary: Chi-squared upper tail via the regularised upper gamma.

nodes.name: chi2_ppf
nodes.summary: Chi-squared quantile by bisection.

nodes.name: f_cdf
nodes.summary: F distribution CDF via the incomplete beta.

nodes.name: f_sf
nodes.summary: F distribution upper tail via the incomplete beta with exchanged arguments.

nodes.name: f_ppf
nodes.summary: F distribution quantile by bisection.

nodes.name: sample_size_normal
nodes.summary: One-sample sample size from the normal formula for given alpha, beta, shift and sides.

nodes.name: sample_size_t
nodes.summary: One-sample sample size from one step of the t iteration at given degrees of freedom.

nodes.name: Welch
nodes.summary: Result of Welch's two-sample t test: t, Welch-Satterthwaite df, standard error, mean difference and two-sided p.

nodes.name: welch_t
nodes.summary: Welch's two-sample t test from summary statistics, with validated inputs.

nodes.name: TwoProportion
nodes.summary: Result of the pooled two-proportion z test: z, both proportions, pooled rate, standard error and two-sided p.

nodes.name: two_proportion_z
nodes.summary: Pooled two-proportion z test without continuity correction (NIST 7.3.3).

nodes.name: SampleSize
nodes.summary: Result of a sample-size calculation: n and the alpha and beta quantiles used.

nodes.name: stop_file
nodes.summary: Path of the STOP file in $G6_HOME.

nodes.name: engage
nodes.summary: Engages the in-process stop with a reason.

nodes.name: release
nodes.summary: Clears only the in-process stop engagement.

nodes.name: engaged
nodes.summary: Returns the reason the stop is engaged (in process, G6_STOP, or a readable or unreadable STOP file), or None.

nodes.name: stopped
nodes.summary: Whether any stop is currently engaged.

nodes.name: PathRefused
nodes.summary: ValueError for a path that leaves its folder or that G6 will not resolve, carrying the reason and an outside flag.

nodes.name: g6_home
nodes.summary: Returns $G6_HOME, defaulting to ~/.g6.

nodes.name: confined_path
nodes.summary: Resolves an absolute caller-named path within one of several trusted roots via contained, raising PathRefused when it is relative or lies in none of them.

nodes.name: state_path
nodes.summary: Returns a resolved path under $G6_HOME, refusing relative parts that escape the state root.

nodes.name: contained
nodes.summary: The one containment check: resolves a path against a folder following .., symlinks and junctions, refusing network and device paths, and returns the resolved path or raises PathRefused.

nodes.name: plain_file
nodes.summary: Checks a path names a plain regular file kept under one name, not a device, link or hard-linked alias.

nodes.name: open_db
nodes.summary: Opens a SQLite database (bare names under $G6_HOME, absolute paths as given, or in memory) with WAL journaling, foreign keys and Row factory.

nodes.name: verifier_available
nodes.summary: Whether a criterion's verifier names a registered verification method, a registered promotion-law oracle, or a human: review marker.

nodes.name: _live_verification_names
nodes.summary: Collects the names currently registered in g6.core.verification.

nodes.name: _promotion_oracle_registered
nodes.summary: Checks whether a name is a promotion-law oracle registered with the promotion evaluator.

nodes.name: _unimplemented_gate
nodes.summary: Builds a fail-open placeholder gate that returns True for every request.

nodes.name: _human_approval_gate
nodes.summary: The one real gate: allows a request only with a live human approval from the approval authority for its scope.

nodes.name: _can_deliver
nodes.summary: Checks by signature binding whether the null request in a given shape can actually reach a gate, treating uninspectable callables as undeliverable.

nodes.name: _null_request_verdict
nodes.summary: Probes a gate with a request that authorises nothing to measure whether it refuses.

nodes.name: register
nodes.summary: Registers a named gate and records by measurement whether it is enforced.

nodes.name: get
nodes.summary: Returns a registered gate callable by name.

nodes.name: is_registered
nodes.summary: Whether a gate name is registered.

nodes.name: is_enforced
nodes.summary: Whether a named gate actually refuses an unauthorised request, as measured at registration.

nodes.name: list_names
nodes.summary: Lists all registered gate names.

nodes.name: list_enforced
nodes.summary: Lists the gate names that are real controls.

nodes.name: AccessDenied
nodes.summary: PermissionError raised when a read of sealed material is refused.

nodes.name: Vault
nodes.summary: Seals directories or files with a digest, read-only manifest and file identities; covers a path by identity or root and detects changes after sealing.

nodes.name: guarded_read
nodes.summary: Reads a file for a role, refusing sealed files and recording an incident in the ledger, reading bytes from the handle that was checked.

nodes.name: blinding_status
nodes.summary: Reports that results resting on the vault are unblinded, because the boundary is an in-process software check rather than OS separation.

nodes.name: register
nodes.summary: Registers a verification method under a non-empty name.

nodes.name: get
nodes.summary: Returns a registered verification method or raises KeyError.

nodes.name: is_empty
nodes.summary: Whether no verification method is registered.

nodes.name: list_names
nodes.summary: Lists registered verification method names.

nodes.name: acceptance_criteria_check
nodes.summary: Evidence bundle claiming the block produced output, with confidence 0.5 or 0.

nodes.name: evidence_coverage_check
nodes.summary: Evidence bundle on whether the output carries evidence or sources.

nodes.name: reliability_pipeline_self_check
nodes.summary: Evidence bundle that passes only when the output's verification report has no failed checks or unchecked items and its completion state is not blocked.

nodes.name: formal_methods_verification
nodes.summary: Evidence bundle recording whether a formal-methods output is present and structured.

nodes.name: csf_verification
nodes.summary: Evidence bundle that passes when a CSF output carries no unsafe or blocked flag.

nodes.name: _source
nodes.summary: Finds a package's __init__.py via its import spec and parses it, returning the AST and the folder holding the top-level package.

nodes.name: declared
nodes.summary: Reads a component's __g6_vetting__ literal from source by AST without importing it.

nodes.name: _path_problem
nodes.summary: Checks a declared register or review path stays inside the package root and exists.

nodes.name: problems
nodes.summary: Lists every reason a vetted component cannot yet be listed (missing or refuted certificate, failing rules, uncaught seeded defects).

nodes.name: status
nodes.summary: Returns reviewed or awaiting for a vetted package based on its declaration, problems and current certificate; no signature is required.

nodes.name: awaiting_review
nodes.summary: Lists vetted components still waiting for their certificate.

nodes.name: certificate
nodes.summary: Returns the certificate view exposed by describe for a package in a vetted area.

nodes.name: summary
nodes.summary: Summarises a component's vetting state, including whether a detached signed review verifies.

nodes.name: compose_bound
nodes.summary: Upper bound on P(either part fails): min(1, e1+e2) for any dependence, or e1+e2-e1*e2 when independence is asserted.

nodes.name: LTLAtom
nodes.summary: LTL atom naming a proposition.

nodes.name: LTLNot
nodes.summary: LTL negation node.

nodes.name: LTLAnd
nodes.summary: LTL conjunction node.

nodes.name: LTLOr
nodes.summary: LTL disjunction node.

nodes.name: LTLNext
nodes.summary: LTL next (X) node.

nodes.name: LTLAlways
nodes.summary: LTL always/globally (G) node.

nodes.name: LTLEventually
nodes.summary: LTL eventually/finally (F) node.

nodes.name: LTLUntil
nodes.summary: LTL until (U) node.

nodes.name: LTLRelease
nodes.summary: LTL release (R) node.

nodes.name: _tokens
nodes.summary: Tokenises an LTL formula, refusing unknown characters.

nodes.name: _Parser
nodes.summary: Recursive-descent LTL parser with precedence levels for or, and, until/release and unary operators, bounded by depth.

nodes.name: parse_ltl
nodes.summary: Parses an LTL formula string into an AST, enforcing length and depth limits.

nodes.name: _nodes
nodes.summary: Lists a formula's subformulas in bottom-up order for evaluation.

nodes.name: _past_end
nodes.summary: Gives each operator's value past the end of a finite trace.

nodes.name: _table
nodes.summary: Fills the (subformula, position) truth table bottom-up over the trace.

nodes.name: evaluate_ltl
nodes.summary: Evaluates an LTL formula at a position of a finite trace of boolean mappings.

nodes.name: ltl_to_str
nodes.summary: Prints an LTL AST back to formula syntax.

nodes.name: EpsilonPolicy
nodes.summary: Frozen policy naming a person's approved maximum epsilon, with an approval scope hashed from its content.

nodes.name: tighten
nodes.summary: Returns the smaller epsilon only when the approval authority shows a live human approval for the policy's scope.

nodes.name: classify_operation
nodes.summary: Classifies an operation name as reversible, irreversible or unknown against OPERATIONS.

nodes.name: RollbackFeasibility
nodes.summary: Result of a rollback feasibility check: operations by class, horizon, snapshot schedule, completion state and envelope.

nodes.name: rollback_feasibility
nodes.summary: Statically checks whether every operation in a plan is reversible, treating unknown operations as infeasible.

nodes.name: GitCheckpoint
nodes.summary: Snapshots tracked files of a top-level git repository and performs a hard reset only when allow_reset is set, through hardened git invocation.

nodes.name: CSFError
nodes.summary: Base CSF error carrying a stable G6_E_* code and message.

nodes.name: CSFInputError
nodes.summary: CSF error for invalid caller input, also a ValueError.

nodes.name: check_epsilon
nodes.summary: Validates an epsilon is a real number in [0, 1].

nodes.name: check_id
nodes.summary: Validates that an identifier is a string, raising CSFInputError otherwise.

nodes.name: _check_states
nodes.summary: Validates the declared states are a non-empty list of unique non-empty strings within MAX_STATES.

nodes.name: TransitionOutcome
nodes.summary: One outgoing transition: next state and probability.

nodes.name: validate_transitions
nodes.summary: The single transition validator: refuses unknown states, unreadable or out-of-range probabilities, rows not summing to 1, and states without outgoing transitions.

nodes.name: ResourceTriple
nodes.summary: Resource bounds N (horizon), T and M with validation.

nodes.name: BoundedAgent
nodes.summary: Typed finite Markov agent model with validated states, transitions, initial and unsafe states, resources and kernel; describe gives its envelope description.

nodes.name: labelled
nodes.summary: Turns a CSF result into a library envelope with a warning card, accepting only qualified-draft or blocked-escalated as its label.

nodes.name: SMTEncoding
nodes.summary: Dataclass holding an SMT encoding of a property against an agent: formula, horizon, variables, assertions and goal.

nodes.name: _formula
nodes.summary: Parses and checks the property formula, refusing atoms that name no state.

nodes.name: agent_to_smt
nodes.summary: Encodes the agent's positive-probability paths over steps 0..N and the negated property as SMT assertions.

nodes.name: _term
nodes.summary: Translates an LTL subformula at a step into a Z3 boolean term over state variables.

nodes.name: SMTCheck
nodes.summary: Result of a Z3 property check: holds, counterexample and its probability, code, reason, completion state and envelope.

nodes.name: _path_probability
nodes.summary: Computes the probability of a counterexample path under the model.

nodes.name: check_z3
nodes.summary: Runs the SMT encoding through g6.formal, re-reads any counterexample with evaluate_ltl, and returns an SMTCheck labelled qualified-draft or blocked-escalated.

nodes.name: FittedAgent
nodes.summary: BoundedAgent fitted from a trace, carrying transition counts and a fit record.

nodes.name: fit_from_trace
nodes.summary: Builds a FittedAgent from (state, next_state) pairs with Clopper-Pearson upper-bounded hazards and an added unobserved unsafe state, refusing empty or thin traces.

nodes.name: verifier.py
nodes.summary: Computes reachability_bound, a Boole's-inequality upper bound on the probability that a caller-modelled Markov agent reaches an unsafe state within N steps, and labels the SafetyReport qualified-draft or blocked-escalated against epsilon.
nodes.languageNotes: Frozen dataclasses carry the per-step hazard terms; the docstring records each archive defect (CSF-006/007/008/013) the port fixed.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package entry point for g6.datalog: documents the strict Datalog evaluated on a pure-Python engine and Z3 that must agree, re-exports DatalogBlock and the four ops, and declares the component metadata (sensitive session ops, mitigated failure modes, the optional z3 extra).
nodes.languageNotes: Module-level dunder attributes (__g6_component__, __g6_block__, __g6_mitigates__) register the package with the G6 component registry.

nodes.name: checks.py
nodes.summary: G6's own pure-Python check of a Datalog model before any answer is reported: closure, well-founded support by rank, and stratified negation, which together show the model is the program's perfect model.

nodes.name: datalog_block.py
nodes.summary: DatalogBlock, the AIBlock registry and MCP door (g6_invoke) to g6.datalog: a strict pydantic DatalogInput dispatches evaluate, query, explain, check and the sensitive session ops, returning the labelled result unchanged.

nodes.name: envelope.py
nodes.summary: Defines g6.datalog's stable G6_E_DATALOG_* codes, the Refusal exception, and finish(), the single place a result is labelled qualified-draft or blocked-escalated with its warning card and evidence.

nodes.name: language.py
nodes.summary: The strict Datalog language of g6.datalog: term, atom, rule and program types, a tokenizer and recursive-descent parser, JSON fact intake, and the arity, safety and stratification checks that refuse a program with line and column.
nodes.languageNotes: Frozen dataclasses model the AST; stratification uses a strongly connected components pass to name a negative cycle.

nodes.name: ops.py
nodes.summary: The four public g6.datalog ops (evaluate, query, explain, check_program): parse, run the semi-naive engine and optionally Z3, require tuple-for-tuple agreement, check the model, and build bounded answers with derivation trees.

nodes.name: schema.py
nodes.summary: DatalogResult, the frozen pydantic result of every g6.datalog op, whose completion_state admits only qualified-draft or blocked-escalated and which carries the cross-surface envelope fields.

nodes.name: seminaive.py
nodes.summary: The pure-Python Datalog engine: semi-naive bottom-up evaluation stratum by stratum, recording each tuple's first derivation as its support, with tuple-count and deadline limits checked while joining.

nodes.name: sessions.py
nodes.summary: Optional SQLite-backed Datalog sessions: session_op asserts or resets facts against a fixed per-session program inside one transaction (dry-run by default) and routes reads through the checked ops.

nodes.name: SKILL.md
nodes.summary: Agent skill guide for g6-datalog: when to use it for questions about what follows from facts and rules, its ops, how to read the result, failure modes it catches, blind spots, needs, examples and open problems.

nodes.name: z3_engine.py
nodes.summary: The second Datalog engine: encodes the program for Z3's Fixedpoint Datalog engine over bit-vector constant codes that keep the comparison order, then reads each relation's answer back into tuples, refusing any unexpected shape.
nodes.languageNotes: Z3 is imported lazily via importlib only when the engine runs, so the package works without the formal extra.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package entry point for g6.debate: documents role-named agents answering in turn through one model with two agreement readings that are not verification, and re-exports the debate loop and agreement API.

nodes.name: agreement.py
nodes.summary: Reads how far a debate's agents agree: a lexical-overlap floor computed by code and an optional model judge, each counting an agent's last usable turn and labelling the result qualified-draft at best.

nodes.name: debate.py
nodes.summary: The debate loop: role-named agents answer a question in turn through one injected LLM caller, with hard round and agent limits checked before any call and failed turns kept as degraded.

nodes.name: SKILL.md
nodes.summary: Agent skill guide for g6-debate: when to have role-named critics challenge a first answer, the Python API, reading the agreement result, failure modes, blind spots and examples.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Family package marker for the deploy extensions (plan, approve, apply, check and roll back a deployment, dry-run by default); declares __g6_family__ and is not itself a component.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package entry point for g6.distillation: documents checking, running and held-out testing of a small distilled solve(x) function, and re-exports the admission and sandbox API with component metadata.

nodes.name: admission.py
nodes.summary: Held-out admission for a distilled candidate: runs it out of process on evaluator-owned cases, refuses training-case leakage, requires a failing negative control, and optionally compares to a baseline with an exact sign test.

nodes.name: sandbox.py
nodes.summary: Bounded out-of-process runner for a generated solve(x): an AST pre-filter plus size bound, then one child via g6.core.sandbox with restricted builtins, JSON-only input and output, and time and memory limits.

nodes.name: SKILL.md
nodes.summary: Agent skill guide for g6-distillation: when a small distilled solve(x) is about to be relied on, the Python API, failure modes, reading the held-out report, blind spots and examples.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Family package marker for the domains extensions (professional standards, duty of care and regulated work, each rule tied to its current source); declares __g6_family__ only.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Family package marker for the embodied extensions (checking robot motion, physics and sensor readings before anything moves); declares __g6_family__ only.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Shared motion package for the embodied family: re-exports the body, world and plan model, the registered plan checks, the motion envelope and the source register, under the rule that every limit is the caller's.

nodes.name: checks.py
nodes.summary: Registered robot-plan checks (joint limits, speed limits, workspace, collision over swept segments, goal) and check_plan, which runs every check and returns the first violation with assumptions and cited rules, or cannot-assess.
nodes.languageNotes: A name-keyed check registry lets sibling modules such as grasp.py add checks that run in every check_plan.

nodes.name: StepHazard
nodes.summary: Frozen record of one step: the probability mass in unsafe states and the running bound up to that step.

nodes.name: SafetyReport
nodes.summary: The union bound vub on the model, whether it meets epsilon and its per-step terms; derives p_unsafe and completion_state and renders the reliability envelope with model and assumptions as evidence.

nodes.name: _unsafe_mass_by_step
nodes.summary: Propagates the state distribution forward step by step and returns the probability mass in unsafe states at each step from 0 to N.

nodes.name: reachability_bound
nodes.summary: Validates the agent and epsilon, sums the per-step unsafe masses into a capped union bound and returns a SafetyReport.

nodes.name: Check
nodes.summary: Result of the model check: what was checked, failures by kind and details, with passed, code and as_dict views.

nodes.name: _Deadline
nodes.summary: Periodic monotonic-clock tick that raises a time-limit Refusal once the deadline passes.

nodes.name: _Lookup
nodes.summary: Lazily built per-relation indexes over the model keyed by bound column positions, used by the matcher.

nodes.name: _matches
nodes.summary: Enumerates the bindings under which a rule body matches the model, joining positive atoms then filtering comparisons and negations.

nodes.name: _variables
nodes.summary: Collects the variable names a rule uses across head and body literals.

nodes.name: check_model
nodes.summary: Runs the closure, support and negation checks on a model and its per-tuple support under a deadline, returning a Check.

nodes.name: _check_step
nodes.summary: Checks one tuple's recorded derivation: rule index, bindings, lower-rank body tuples, comparisons and absent negated atoms from lower strata.

nodes.name: DatalogInput
nodes.summary: Strict pydantic input for one Datalog op (extra fields forbidden) with bounded program, facts, query, engine and time limit fields.

nodes.name: DatalogBlock
nodes.summary: AIBlock subclass marked beta that dispatches ops, help and session ops to g6.datalog and returns the labelled result with component and op.

nodes.name: Refusal
nodes.summary: Exception carrying a G6_E_DATALOG_* code, a reason and optional problems, raised wherever a program or run is refused.

nodes.name: finish
nodes.summary: Builds and re-validates the DatalogResult, choosing blocked-escalated for any code and qualified-draft only when the check passed and engines agreed, with the matching warning card.

nodes.name: _answer_card
nodes.summary: Chooses the amber warning card that says whether both engines or only the pure-Python engine derived the model.

nodes.name: Atom
nodes.summary: A relation applied to terms, with source line and column and its variable set.

nodes.name: Comparison
nodes.summary: A comparison literal between two terms with its operator and position.

nodes.name: Rule
nodes.summary: A head atom and body literals, with views of positive atoms, negations and comparisons.

nodes.name: Program
nodes.summary: A parsed, checked program: facts, rules, queries, arities, strata and recursion info, with defined, undefined and constant views.

nodes.name: _Parser
nodes.summary: Recursive-descent parser over the token stream producing facts, rules and queries, failing with a positioned parse error.

nodes.name: _Arities
nodes.summary: Records the arity each relation is first used with and refuses a second, different arity.

nodes.name: render_value
nodes.summary: Renders a constant back to Datalog text, quoting and escaping strings that are not bare names.

nodes.name: render_tuple
nodes.summary: Renders a relation and row as a ground atom string.

nodes.name: _tokens
nodes.summary: Regex-driven tokenizer yielding positioned tokens and refusing bad characters, oversized integers and malformed numbers.

nodes.name: _string
nodes.summary: Reads a double-quoted string literal with its allowed escapes, refusing unterminated or bad escapes.

nodes.name: _show
nodes.summary: Describes a token for an error message.

nodes.name: _json_facts
nodes.summary: Validates declarative JSON facts (relation names, row lists, value types and sizes) into ground rows.

nodes.name: parse_program
nodes.summary: Parses program text and JSON facts, applies size, arity, safety and stratification checks, and returns a Program or raises a Refusal.

nodes.name: _unsafe
nodes.summary: Finds the safety violations of a rule: unbound head, negated or comparison variables and misplaced anonymous variables.

nodes.name: _stratify
nodes.summary: Assigns strata from the dependency graph's components and refuses negation through recursion with the cycle named.

nodes.name: _components
nodes.summary: Iterative strongly connected components over the relation dependency graph in topological order.

nodes.name: _negative_cycle
nodes.summary: Reconstructs the dependency cycle through a negated edge for the not-stratifiable error message.

nodes.name: parse_goal
nodes.summary: Parses a query goal against a program, checking the relation is known and its arity matches.

nodes.name: _run
nodes.summary: Wraps an op body with a timer, turns a Refusal into a labelled refusal and finishes the result.

nodes.name: _agreement
nodes.summary: Compares the pure-Python and Z3 relations tuple for tuple and raises an engines-disagree refusal on any difference.

nodes.name: _model
nodes.summary: Runs the semi-naive engine, optionally Z3, requires agreement and checks the model before returning it.

nodes.name: _derivation
nodes.summary: Builds a tuple's bounded derivation tree from the recorded support, marking where it was cut.

nodes.name: evaluate
nodes.summary: Op that returns the derived relations (or those named) with their size bounds, labelled by finish.

nodes.name: _answers
nodes.summary: Collects a goal's distinct answers with bindings and derivations under the answer and node budgets.

nodes.name: query
nodes.summary: Op that answers a goal, or every query in the program, with one derivation per distinct binding.

nodes.name: explain
nodes.summary: Op that returns the derivation tree of a ground atom, or that it is not derivable as the model check shows.

nodes.name: check_program
nodes.summary: Op that reports parse, arity, safety and stratification results without evaluating anything.

nodes.name: DatalogResult
nodes.summary: Frozen pydantic result of every op: engines, relations, queries, explanation, report, check, problems and the envelope fields; verified is not an accepted state.

nodes.name: Justification
nodes.summary: How a tuple was first derived: the fact or rule index, bindings and rank.

nodes.name: Model
nodes.summary: The evaluated model: relations as row sets, each tuple's support justification, and the number of rounds run.

nodes.name: _Clock
nodes.summary: Deadline clock checked every few thousand ticks that raises the time-limit refusal.

nodes.name: _Indexes
nodes.summary: Lazily built column indexes over known and delta tuples for joins.

nodes.name: _plan
nodes.summary: Orders a rule body into scans, comparisons and negation filters so each literal runs once its variables are bound.

nodes.name: _bindings
nodes.summary: Generates the variable bindings that satisfy a planned rule body, drawing one atom from the delta when required.

nodes.name: solve
nodes.summary: Evaluates a program stratum by stratum with semi-naive rounds, enforcing the tuple cap and deadline, and returns the Model with supports.

nodes.name: session_op
nodes.summary: Loads or creates a session in SQLite, asserts or resets facts after re-checking the program, or runs a read op on the saved program, honouring dry_run.

nodes.name: available
nodes.summary: Reports whether the z3 module can be imported.

nodes.name: solve
nodes.summary: Public entry that runs the Z3 Datalog engine on a program under the deadline and maps solver errors to refusals.

nodes.name: _solve
nodes.summary: Encodes constants as ordered bit-vector codes, registers relations, adds facts and rules to a Fixedpoint and queries each relation.

nodes.name: _rows
nodes.summary: Reads Z3's disjunction-of-equalities answer back into tuples, refusing any other shape.

nodes.name: _final_positions
nodes.summary: Takes each agent's last usable, non-mock turn as its position and counts the turns ignored.

nodes.name: OverlapResult
nodes.summary: Lexical agreement floor: level, overlap fraction, dominant and dissenting agents, with completion state and envelope.

nodes.name: overlap_agreement
nodes.summary: Computes the lexical-overlap agreement floor over the agents' final positions.

nodes.name: JudgeResult
nodes.summary: A model judge's agreement reading beside the lexical floor; code, not the model, sets the completion state.

nodes.name: _read_reply
nodes.summary: Parses the judge model's JSON reply into a level and reason, refusing malformed output.

nodes.name: judge_agreement
nodes.summary: Makes one extra model call to judge agreement by meaning, falling back to a degraded result on error.

nodes.name: AgentRole
nodes.summary: Enumeration of debate roles such as proposer, critic, devil's advocate and synthesiser.

nodes.name: DebateAgent
nodes.summary: A named agent with its debate role.

nodes.name: Exchange
nodes.summary: One turn: agent name and role, round number, response, evidence kind, degraded flag and error, with a usable property that allows only clean model replies.

nodes.name: Transcript
nodes.summary: The question, context and exchanges so far, with degraded detection and the history text fed to later turns.

nodes.name: _check
nodes.summary: Validates the question, agents and round count against MAX_AGENTS and MAX_ROUNDS before any call.

nodes.name: run_debate
nodes.summary: Runs the rounds of turns through the injected LLM caller, keeping failed turns as degraded with redacted error text.

nodes.name: Candidate
nodes.summary: A frozen distilled candidate: source defining solve(x), origin episode ids, the training case ids it was made from, and a SHA-256 digest of the source.

nodes.name: HoldoutCase
nodes.summary: An evaluator-owned held-out case: id, input and expected output.

nodes.name: HoldoutReport
nodes.summary: Verdict (passed, failed, inconclusive or refused), candidate digest, passed and failed cases, control failures and optional baseline comparison; completion_state is qualified-draft only when passed.

nodes.name: same
nodes.summary: Recursive JSON equality between an output and the expected value, with numbers equal within 1e-9 and booleans compared by identity.

nodes.name: evaluate
nodes.summary: Refuses leaked or empty holdouts, runs the negative and optional positive controls, then the candidate, and returns a HoldoutReport with an optional sign-test baseline comparison.

nodes.name: Run
nodes.summary: Outcome of one input: status ok, error, timeout or refused, with its value or reason and an ok property.

nodes.name: check_source
nodes.summary: Applies the shared AST pre-filter and a size bound to candidate source, returning the problems found.

nodes.name: run_batch
nodes.summary: Runs solve(x) for each input in one bounded child process via g6.core.sandbox and maps outcomes to Runs.

nodes.name: run_sandboxed
nodes.summary: Convenience wrapper that runs a single input through run_batch.

nodes.name: Violation
nodes.summary: One frozen violation: the check and code, its position along the plan, optional time, waypoint and segment, a message and detail.

nodes.name: Case
nodes.summary: Input bundle passed to each check: body, world, plan, goal and work budget.

nodes.name: Outcome
nodes.summary: One check's outcome: violations found, assumptions, rules applied, or a cannot-assess reason.

nodes.name: Check
nodes.summary: A registered check: name, function, rules and declared violation codes.

nodes.name: register_check
nodes.summary: Registers a named plan check after validating its name, rules against the source register and declared codes.

nodes.name: point_first_contact
nodes.summary: Finds the first fraction along a segment at which a moving sphere touches an obstacle sphere.

nodes.name: point_first_exit
nodes.summary: Finds the first fraction along a segment at which a sphere leaves the workspace bounds.

nodes.name: _arm_gap
nodes.summary: Computes the smallest gap between an arm configuration's capsule links and the obstacles.

nodes.name: _arm_segment
nodes.summary: Searches an arm segment for the first configuration that violates a clearance predicate, within the work bound.

nodes.name: _arm_swept
nodes.summary: Checks an arm's swept motion across every segment, returning violations or a cannot-assess when work runs out.

nodes.name: _joint_limits
nodes.summary: Checks each waypoint's joint angles against the body's limits.

nodes.name: _speed_limits
nodes.summary: Checks each timed segment's average linear or joint speed against the body's limits, untimed waypoints being unassessable.

nodes.name: _workspace
nodes.summary: Checks that each segment stays inside the workspace bounds.

nodes.name: _collision
nodes.summary: Checks each whole segment against the obstacles for a point body or an arm.

nodes.name: _goal
nodes.summary: Checks that the last waypoint lies within the goal tolerance.

nodes.name: check_plan
nodes.summary: Validates shapes and ranges, runs every registered check, and returns the first violation, all violations, assumptions and cited rules as a MotionResult, or cannot-assess.

nodes.name: rule_review.json
nodes.summary: Independent reader's review record of every graded motion rule: hashes of the adapter, cases, rules and held sources, plus per-rule findings on whether the register clause is fair, the code matches it and the level is justified.

nodes.name: source_register.json
nodes.summary: Committed source register for the motion checks: one entry per primary source (LaValle Planning Algorithms sections and OpenStax University Physics 6.2) with issuer, URL, licence, retrieval date, SHA-256 hashes, clause in the register's own words and review window.

nodes.name: envelope.py
nodes.summary: Defines the stable G6_E_MOTION_* codes, their suggested actions, and the single labelled MotionResult envelope every motion op returns, with helpers that build qualified-draft answers or blocked-escalated refusals (the envelope has no `verified` state).

nodes.name: MotionResult
nodes.summary: Frozen Pydantic model for one motion op's outcome carrying completion_state (qualified-draft or blocked-escalated), warning_card, evidence, request_id and run_id, with op-specific extra fields allowed.

nodes.name: answer
nodes.summary: Builds a qualified-draft MotionResult with an amber warning card naming what the answer rests on.

nodes.name: refuse
nodes.summary: Builds a blocked-escalated MotionResult with its stable code, the reason in words, a blocked warning card and the code-specific suggested action appended to evidence.

nodes.name: geometry.py
nodes.summary: Pure-Python geometry and kinematics primitives for the motion checks: vector arithmetic, point-to-segment distance, closed-form swept-segment entry into an obstacle's reach, planar chain placement, workspace wall gaps and constant-acceleration and Euler integration steps.

nodes.name: closest_on_segment
nodes.summary: Returns the clamped projection fraction of a point onto a segment, the closest point the distance rule is measured to.

nodes.name: segment_distance
nodes.summary: Euclidean distance from a point to the closest point of a segment, built on closest_on_segment; reused by the certificate adapter.

nodes.name: segment_entry
nodes.summary: Finds in closed form the first fraction along a segment where a moving point comes within reach of an obstacle centre, solving a quadratic via the perpendicular offset to avoid near-tangent cancellation.

nodes.name: chain_points
nodes.summary: Places each joint and the tip of a planar kinematic chain from its base, link lengths and accumulated joint angles.

nodes.name: euler_step
nodes.summary: Advances position and velocity by one explicit Euler step under a given acceleration.

nodes.name: constant_acceleration
nodes.summary: Advances position and velocity by dt under constant acceleration in closed form.

nodes.name: grasp.py
nodes.summary: Grasp check for the motion package: computes each contact's friction margin and compares normal forces with the object's crush limit and the gripper's per-contact or total limit, registering it as a check_plan check and exposing grasp_margin as a standalone op.

nodes.name: contact_margins
nodes.summary: Computes each contact's friction margin: coefficient of static friction times normal force, less the tangential load it must hold.

nodes.name: coefficient_findings
nodes.summary: Names a friction coefficient above the usual 1.0 in the findings without changing the verdict.

nodes.name: grasp_findings
nodes.summary: Checks one grasp for slip, crush and gripper-force violations with the force tolerance, returning violations or cannot-assess reasons when the gripper or its rating is missing.

nodes.name: _grasp_check
nodes.summary: Registered check_plan hook that runs grasp_findings on each waypoint carrying a grasp and reports its first violation.

nodes.name: grasp_margin
nodes.summary: Public op answering for one grasp on its own: validates inputs, runs grasp_findings, and returns a qualified-draft answer or blocked-escalated refusal citing the rules and stale sources.

nodes.name: model.py
nodes.summary: Typed, frozen Pydantic input models for every motion check (joints, gripper, contacts, grasp, point body, planar arm, obstacles, world, waypoints, plan, goal) in SI units with no default limits, plus shape and range problem detectors.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Annotated float aliases (Finite, Positive) and extra="forbid" so a misspelt or invented field is refused instead of ignored.

nodes.name: Joint
nodes.summary: A revolute joint with its own lower/upper angle limits and speed limit, validated so the limits are ordered.

nodes.name: Gripper
nodes.summary: A gripper's maximum force and whether it is rated per contact or on the grasp's total.

nodes.name: Contact
nodes.summary: One grasp contact with its normal force and the tangential force it must hold.

nodes.name: Grasp
nodes.summary: A grasp held at a waypoint: its contacts, coefficient of static friction and the object's crush limit.

nodes.name: PointBody
nodes.summary: A point (single sphere) body such as a mobile base, drone or tool tip, with radius, clearance and top speed.

nodes.name: PlanarArm
nodes.summary: A planar arm of revolute joints whose links are capsules, validated to have one joint per link.

nodes.name: Obstacle
nodes.summary: A spherical obstacle given by centre and radius.

nodes.name: World
nodes.summary: The workspace box bounds and its obstacles, validated as a proper box with a dimensions accessor.

nodes.name: Waypoint
nodes.summary: One plan waypoint: configuration, optional time and an optional grasp it carries.

nodes.name: Plan
nodes.summary: A timed sequence of waypoints to be checked.

nodes.name: Goal
nodes.summary: The plan's target with tolerance, validated to name exactly one target.

nodes.name: shape_problems
nodes.summary: Lists dimension mismatches between plan, world, body and goal so callers can answer cannot-assess.

nodes.name: range_problems
nodes.summary: Collects the names of fields whose lengths or coordinates exceed MAX_EXTENT (the bounds guard), so callers stop with cannot-assess.

nodes.name: sources.py
nodes.summary: Rule provenance for the motion checks: the RULES table naming each rule's source (register entry, caller field or G6's own guard), its level and implementing function, plus loaders and checks over the committed source register and rule review.

nodes.name: Rule
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass describing one rule a check applies: wording, kind (register, caller or own), source, effect, certificate level and implementing function.

nodes.name: register_problems
nodes.summary: Validates the source register: every entry fills all required fields and every rule cites an existing entry.

nodes.name: stale_sources
nodes.summary: Raises a finding for each cited register entry older than its review window as of a given date.

nodes.name: cited
nodes.summary: Returns the citation records (rule, kind and source entries) for the rules a check applied, for inclusion as evidence.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package entry for the adapt_physical_ai extension: documents what the motion checker does and does not port, re-exports the motion models, check_plan, grasp_margin, planners and kinematics, and declares the G6 block, mitigated failure modes and vetting register paths.

nodes.name: block.py
nodes.summary: AdaptPhysicalAIBlock, the registry and MCP door to the embodied family's motion checks: a typed op input and dispatch table mapping check_plan, plan_astar, plan_rrt, forward_kinematics, integrate_step and grasp_margin to their functions, refusing missing data with G6_E_MOTION_CANNOT_ASSESS.

nodes.name: AdaptPhysicalAIInput
nodes.summary: Frozen Pydantic op input in SI units listing every op parameter with bounds; unknown fields such as approved or safety_envelope are refused.

nodes.name: AdaptPhysicalAIBlock
nodes.summary: AIBlock that answers ops/help and dispatches each motion op, refusing with cannot-assess when required fields are missing; beta maturity and never labels a result `verified`.

nodes.name: adapter.py
nodes.summary: Certificate adapter for adapt_physical_ai: converts protocol inputs into motion model objects and measures the real implementation's numeric output for each rule, or whether a guard fires.

nodes.name: guard
nodes.summary: Observes whether a G6 guard (tolerance, work bound, range bounds, force tolerance) fires on a case: 1 when it fires, 0 when it holds.

nodes.name: evaluate
nodes.summary: Runs the implementing motion function for a rule on protocol inputs (distance, swept segments, chain, speed, planners, integration, friction) and returns its measured value.

nodes.name: cases.json
nodes.summary: Known-answer cases for the adapt_physical_ai certificate: per-rule inputs and expected values tied to LaValle and OpenStax clauses (one printed 50-link chain and the 137 N friction example) plus fires/holds/recall cases for G6's own guards.

nodes.name: certificate.json
nodes.summary: Issued component certificate record for g6.embodied.adapt_physical_ai: attested levels, context-only gaps, digest, falsification results, harness and input hashes, independent pass, isolation, issuer state qualified-draft and observations.

nodes.name: checks.json
nodes.summary: Certificate check configuration: producer and authors, the adapter path, and falsification seeds, counts, precision, stated bounds and boundary inputs for each rule.

nodes.name: scope.json
nodes.summary: Scope statement for the adapt_physical_ai certificate listing what was not checked: no signed physical-safety review, property-only LaValle rules, the context-only friction clause, planner and tolerance limits.

nodes.name: CERTIFICATE.md
nodes.summary: Human-readable component certificate for adapt_physical_ai at issuer state qualified-draft: rules by level, the context-only friction gap, an itemised list of what was not checked, and the embedded full JSON record.

nodes.name: falsify.py
nodes.summary: Seeded falsification probe generator for the certificate: produces finite geometry, chain, speed, integration and planning inputs per rule (including near-tangent long segments) and checks each result against the rule's invariants.

nodes.name: generate
nodes.summary: Generates count seeded random inputs for a rule, including the near-tangent segment cases that once hid a penetration.

nodes.name: invariant
nodes.summary: Checks that a rule's measured value satisfies the source's invariants on a generated input.

nodes.name: second_route.py
nodes.summary: Independent second implementation used by the certificate: plain-Python projection, Decimal intersections, 3x3 matrix-product chains, dense-sampling arm sweeps, exhaustive grid search and a complete-path RRT tree to compare against G6's motion functions.

nodes.name: arm_gap
nodes.summary: Computes the smallest gap between a planar arm at configuration q and an obstacle, independently of G6's geometry module.

nodes.name: swept
nodes.summary: Densely samples an arm's motion between two configurations to decide independently whether it collides.

nodes.name: grid
nodes.summary: Independent exhaustive shortest-path search on the same bounded grid as A*, used to compare path lengths.

nodes.name: tree
nodes.summary: Independently written complete-path RRT tree using the same seeded random stream as the planner under test.

nodes.name: evaluate
nodes.summary: Dispatches a rule and inputs to the independent route and returns its value for comparison with the adapter's measurement.

nodes.name: kinematics.py
nodes.summary: Kinematics ops for adapt_physical_ai: planar-arm forward kinematics from the caller's link lengths and one constant-acceleration integration step with the Euler step and its error alongside, both returned as labelled MotionResults.

nodes.name: forward_kinematics
nodes.summary: Returns a planar arm's joint positions and tip at q as a qualified-draft estimate, refusing when the body is not an arm or a joint is outside its limits.

nodes.name: integrate_step
nodes.summary: Advances position and velocity by dt in closed form under constant acceleration and reports Euler's step and its error beside it.

nodes.name: planners.py
nodes.summary: Reference planners for a point body: grid A* in 2-D that blocks each obstacle's whole inflated footprint and a seeded RRT in 2-D or 3-D whose edges are checked whole; every returned path is timed and passed through check_plan.

nodes.name: plan_astar
nodes.summary: Plans an A* path over a bounded grid with no corner cutting, times it at the caller's speed and checks it with check_plan, refusing on invalid input, oversize grids or no path found.

nodes.name: plan_rrt
nodes.summary: Grows a seeded rapidly exploring random tree with goal bias, checking each edge whole, ends at the goal, times the path and checks it with check_plan.

nodes.name: SKILL.md
nodes.summary: Agent skill guide for the G6 motion plan checker: when to use and not use it, its six ops, composition with other components, failure modes caught, blind spots, required data, worked examples and four open problems.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package entry for epistemic integrity: re-exports the deterministic adjudicator types and functions and the EpistemicIntegrityBlock, and declares the G6 component metadata and mitigated failure modes.

nodes.name: adjudicator.py
nodes.summary: Deterministic claim adjudication floor (G6-EI-001): atomises and classifies claims, assigns risk, collapses correlated evidence, grades it E0-E3, detects contested or refuted claims, caps confidence by grade and applies the R0-R3 x E0-E3 fail-closed gate.

nodes.name: AdjudicatedClaim
nodes.summary: Dataclass holding one atomic claim's adjudication: type, risk, evidence grade, status, confidence, disposition and reasons, with to_dict.

nodes.name: AdjudicationResult
nodes.summary: Dataclass holding all adjudicated claims and the overall most-restrictive disposition, with to_dict.

nodes.name: classify
nodes.summary: Classifies an atomic claim as recommendation, opinion, prediction, causal or factual from marker phrases.

nodes.name: assign_risk
nodes.summary: Maps a declared action criticality to a risk level R0-R3, failing closed on unknown values.

nodes.name: collapse_independence
nodes.summary: Groups evidence records that share a source so repeated or correlated evidence counts once.

nodes.name: grade_evidence
nodes.summary: Grades supporting evidence E0-E3 from independent credible groups and primary source types.

nodes.name: certificate_grade
nodes.summary: Derives an evidence grade from certificate-style verification methods on records via grade_from_verification_method.

nodes.name: detect_contested
nodes.summary: Marks a claim contested when credible independent evidence opposes it.

nodes.name: adjudicate_claim
nodes.summary: Runs the full lifecycle for one atomic claim: classify, scope and numeric/causal checks, risk, evidence grade, contest detection, confidence ceiling and the risk x evidence gate to a disposition.

nodes.name: adjudicate
nodes.summary: Atomises a message, adjudicates each claim and combines them into an AdjudicationResult with the most restrictive disposition.

nodes.name: component_metadata.yaml
nodes.summary: Component metadata for epistemic_integrity: Apache-2.0 licence, reliability-platform owner, spec docs path, related components, high risk level, no allowed autonomy and stateless rollback.

nodes.name: epistemic_integrity_block.py
nodes.summary: EpistemicIntegrityBlock: a thin AIBlock over the deterministic adjudicator that validates the message and caller evidence dicts into EvidenceRecords and returns per-claim grades and dispositions with llm_used false.

nodes.name: EpistemicIntegrityInput
nodes.summary: Frozen Pydantic input for the adjudicate op: message, action criticality, evidence dicts and human-approval/rollback flags; unknown fields are refused.

nodes.name: _to_records
nodes.summary: Converts caller evidence dicts to EvidenceRecords, raising on unknown keys or refused values so a misspelt stance is never silently dropped.

nodes.name: EpistemicIntegrityBlock
nodes.summary: AIBlock answering ops/help and adjudicate, refusing with G6_E_EPISTEMIC_INTEGRITY_* codes when the message is empty or evidence is invalid; beta, held at qualified_draft.

nodes.name: honesty.py
nodes.summary: Registered honesty detector adjudication_at_tests for epistemic_integrity: flags output where a claim has evidence grade E0 yet an unlabelled ALLOW disposition, the floor's own invariant being broken.

nodes.name: detect_unsupported_claim_allowed
nodes.summary: Returns true when any claim in the output pairs evidence_grade E0 with disposition ALLOW.

nodes.name: markers.py
nodes.summary: Finds English lexical markers (uncertainty, refusal, agreement, disagreement, hedging, safety, confidence) in text and returns their exact spans with a local negation flag, as a hint with no alignment score.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package barrel for g6.evidence, the certificate issuer, re-exporting issue, verify, grounding, record and the certificate data types from certificate.py.

nodes.name: certificate.py
nodes.summary: The single certificate issuer that decides a mission's completion state (verified, qualified-draft or blocked-escalated) from checks, negative controls and receipts on the exact artifact bytes under the A4 grounding rule, and re-decides a certificate offline in verify.
nodes.languageNotes: Frozen dataclasses with __post_init__ validation model checks, receipts and controls; certificates are hashed as canonical JSON.

nodes.name: mapping.py
nodes.summary: The evidence mapping table: one Row per evidence kind fixing artefact, model, standard, check, environment, negative control, independence, order and scope, and promote/issue_records that turn source records into issuer inputs or refuse them with stable G6_E_EVIDENCE_* codes.
nodes.languageNotes: strict_json uses json.loads hooks (object_pairs_hook, parse_constant) to reject repeated keys, NaN and infinities.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package barrel for g6.formal, re-exporting the Z3 bridge and depth operations, the pure-Python DPLL, Belnap four-valued logic, contracts, the envelope, recheck, solve and FormalBlock.

nodes.name: contract.py
