nodes.summary: Checks a contract of up to 32 SMT properties with mandatory non-vacuity and joint consistency inside one deadline, aggregating G6's own property checks into a four-valued result.

nodes.name: envelope.py
nodes.summary: The one place a g6.formal result is labelled: apply_envelope sets completion_state, warning card and evidence from the result alone and never gives verified; also defines the Refusal exception and the stable G6_E_FORMAL_* codes.

nodes.name: facade.py
nodes.summary: Provides solve, which answers one typed LogicalQuery with either the Z3 or pure-Python DPLL backend and refuses fields naming any other engine, and solver_support, which probes which backends work here.

nodes.name: formal_block.py
nodes.summary: FormalBlock, the registry and MCP door (g6_invoke) to g6.formal: each op calls one public function of the package and returns its labelled result with component and op; refusals come back as blocked-escalated results, never raised errors.
nodes.languageNotes: Pydantic input model with forbidden extra fields stops callers from naming other engines or declaring a confidence.

nodes.name: four_valued.py
nodes.summary: Pure-Python Belnap four-valued logic (true, false, both, neither) with connectives, formula evaluation, truth tables and modal frames with frame-condition checks and necessity/possibility evaluation.
nodes.languageNotes: TruthValue overloads ~, & and | on two evidence bits (support_for, support_against).

nodes.name: proof_artifacts.py
nodes.summary: recheck reruns every query recorded in a proof artifact on the installed solver and confirms each query is the one its statement gives, never raising for a tampered artifact.

nodes.name: propositional.py
nodes.summary: Pure-Python DPLL SAT solver for Boolean formulas: a recursive-descent parser for operator and function syntax, CNF conversion by distribution with size bounds, and check_propositional returning a labelled result.
nodes.languageNotes: Hand-written precedence-climbing parser with right-associative implication; DPLL uses unit propagation and pure-literal elimination.

nodes.name: schema.py
nodes.summary: Pydantic models for g6.formal's typed input (LogicalQuery) and labelled results (FormalResult, OptimumResult, CoreResult, CountResult, TermResult, FourValuedResult, ValidityResult) plus ProofArtifact and SolverCheck; completion_state cannot be verified.

nodes.name: z3_bridge.py
nodes.summary: Z3 checks on a closed SMT-LIB grammar with caller-declared sorts: satisfiability, validity with vacuity and assumed-conclusion detection, entailment and counterexamples, with each decision recorded as rerunnable queries.
nodes.languageNotes: Z3 is imported lazily inside load_z3 so the package works without it, returning G6_E_FORMAL_SOLVER_UNAVAILABLE.

nodes.name: z3_depth.py
nodes.summary: Deeper Z3 operations on the closed SMT-LIB input: lexicographic optimise, minimal unsat cores, simplify, quantifier elimination, model counting and equivalence, each answer checked again on fresh solvers.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package barrel for g6.goal_engine, which declares a goal as a tree of subtasks with guardrails, checkpoints, resource bounds and breakpoints and reads those controls against executor reports without executing anything.

nodes.name: block.py
nodes.summary: GoalEngineBlock, the registry and MCP door to goal_engine's propose_goal_tree op: a caller-configured model proposes subgoals breadth first through the mc-goal-decompose prompt, bounded to at most 100 calls, and the tree stays a proposal.

nodes.name: codes.py
nodes.summary: Defines the stable G6_E_GOAL_* error codes and helpers that build the warning card and evidence entries every goal_engine result carries.

nodes.name: controls.py
nodes.summary: evaluate_controls reads every guardrail, checkpoint, resource bound and breakpoint in force at a plan node (inherited root first) against one executor Observation, emitting pause requests; release_pause accepts only a live human-issued approval for the exact scope.

nodes.name: decomposition.py
nodes.summary: Bounded, proposal-only goal decomposition: GoalTree holds a deterministic hierarchy with dotted ids and propose_goal_tree runs a provider-neutral breadth-first proposer, listing budget failures instead of cropping silently.

nodes.name: goal_tree.py
nodes.summary: Compatibility shim re-exporting GoalNode, GoalTree, ProposalResult and propose_goal_tree from decomposition.py.

nodes.name: plan.py
nodes.summary: build_plan_tree turns the subtasks a GoalSpec declares into a PlanTree with dotted-path node ids, generating no subtask and reporting every rejected or depth-truncated node with a code.

nodes.name: SKILL.md
nodes.summary: Skill guide for the epistemic_integrity component: deterministic claim adjudication that grades declared evidence (E0-E3), collapses shared lineages, caps confidence and applies a risk-by-evidence gate, with ops, result reading, failure modes and blind spots.

nodes.name: SKILL.md
nodes.summary: Skill guide for g6.evidence, the certificate issuer: when to call issue, verify and grounding, how to read completion states and gaps, composition, failure modes and blind spots.

nodes.name: SKILL.md
nodes.summary: Skill guide for g6.formal: deciding entailment, satisfiability, counterexamples, equivalence, conflicts and small optima with Z3, the DPLL and four-valued/modal logic, with ops, result labels, examples and blind spots.

nodes.name: markers
nodes.summary: Returns spans per marker category, checking at most three preceding words in the clause for negation.

nodes.name: CertificateRefused
nodes.summary: ValueError raised when issuer inputs contradict one another or the mission, listing every problem.

nodes.name: Control
nodes.summary: A negative control: a seeded defect for one predicate run against one version of a check's code.

nodes.name: Check
nodes.summary: Frozen description of a check (kind, author, predicates, freeze time, code hash) with validation on construction.

nodes.name: Receipt
nodes.summary: A recorded result of running a check on an artifact, validated on construction.

nodes.name: Artifact
nodes.summary: The artifact under judgement: its bytes digest and producer.

nodes.name: PredicateStatement
nodes.summary: One predicate's four-valued (support, refute) statement on a certificate, with a verified accessor and dict form.

nodes.name: Certificate
nodes.summary: The issued certificate: completion state, predicate statements, gaps, checks, receipts and rerun list, serialisable as canonical JSON.

nodes.name: MissionFacts
nodes.summary: The mission values the issuer needs: hash, predicates, gates, broken soundness obligations, cost bound and catalogue hash.

nodes.name: grounding
nodes.summary: Names each reason a check is not A4-grounded for a predicate on an artifact (empty when it is).

nodes.name: record
nodes.summary: Writes observed controls and receipts into the ledger so issue can resolve them by id and hash.

nodes.name: _resolver
nodes.summary: Builds the ledger resolution lookup matching records by kind, id and body hash.

nodes.name: catalogue_sha
nodes.summary: Hashes the op/effect/class catalogue a mission was judged against.

nodes.name: digest_of
nodes.summary: Computes a certificate's sha256 over its canonical JSON without the digest field.

nodes.name: _refusals
nodes.summary: Collects every contradiction between the issuer's inputs and the mission that forces a refusal.

nodes.name: issue
nodes.summary: Public entry: issues the certificate for an artifact under mission facts or raises CertificateRefused listing every problem.

nodes.name: _issue
nodes.summary: Core issuing logic: assigns each predicate a Belnap value from grounded receipts, applies gates and obligations, and decides the completion state with every gap named.

nodes.name: verify
nodes.summary: Checks a certificate body against artifact bytes and its internal consistency, then re-decides it offline and names every inconsistent field.

nodes.name: _decided_again
nodes.summary: Runs issue again on what a certificate records and names each field of the result that differs.

nodes.name: Row
nodes.summary: One evidence kind's mapping row: what identifies each part of its records and what it may become in the issuer's terms.

nodes.name: PromotionRefused
nodes.summary: ValueError for a record missing a part its kind's row requires, carrying a code per part.

nodes.name: CheckBinding
nodes.summary: An evaluator receipt's custody binding: request, task, predicate and digests of artefact, standard, fixture and evaluator.

nodes.name: UnreadableBinding
nodes.summary: Marker for a custody binding that is present but does not parse, always refused as BINDING_UNREADABLE.

nodes.name: About
nodes.summary: What a record is about, each part read once, preferring its custody binding.

nodes.name: SourceRecord
nodes.summary: One receipt as its source gives it, with controls and observed positions, constructible from a custody binding.

nodes.name: Issued
nodes.summary: Result of issue_records: the certificate, the ledger it rests on and each refused record.

nodes.name: strict_json
nodes.summary: Parses JSON strictly, rejecting repeated keys, NaN, infinities and non-finite numbers.

nodes.name: read_binding
nodes.summary: The single reader of a custody binding stored as text; returns None when absent and UnreadableBinding when malformed.

nodes.name: id_of
nodes.summary: Builds an id from ordered parts as canonical JSON or its SHA-256 digest.

nodes.name: check_id_of
nodes.summary: Derives the check id named by a custody binding from its task and every bound digest.

nodes.name: bound_parts
nodes.summary: Reads what a bound record is about from its binding and lists each given field that disagrees.

nodes.name: read_about
nodes.summary: The shared reader of what a record is about, used by both this module and ECHA's custody accessor.

nodes.name: about
nodes.summary: Returns what a record is about and each of its fields that disagrees with its custody binding.

nodes.name: problems
nodes.summary: Lists every part a record lacks for its kind's row or states differently from what the issuer would be handed, as (code, detail) pairs.

nodes.name: issuer_kind
nodes.summary: Returns the issuer kind for a record, demoting checks written by the artefact's producer to partial falsifiers.

nodes.name: promote
nodes.summary: Turns one SourceRecord into the issuer's Check and Receipt, or raises PromotionRefused naming every missing or conflicting part.

nodes.name: caveat_of
nodes.summary: Turns a non-promoted record that observed a failure into the issuer's caveat input under a given id.

nodes.name: _fresh
nodes.summary: Returns an id not already taken, suffixing a count when needed.

nodes.name: _merged
nodes.summary: Merges two records of the same check into one, or None when they disagree about the check.

nodes.name: issue_records
nodes.summary: Promotes records, writes controls, receipts and provenance into a fresh ledger, and issues the certificate with every refused record listed.

nodes.name: _gate
nodes.summary: Names the issuer gate a receipt failed for a predicate when read alone.

nodes.name: receipt_roles
nodes.summary: For each receipt of a certificate, gives the role the issuer assigns it alone per predicate and the gate it missed.

nodes.name: environment_sha256
nodes.summary: Digest naming a run's environment record via the ledger's canonical JSON.

nodes.name: render_markdown
nodes.summary: Renders the mapping table as the Markdown page in the design docs.

nodes.name: ContractResult
nodes.summary: Four-valued result type for a contract check, adding a note.

nodes.name: check_contract
nodes.summary: Checks up to 32 SMT properties with non-vacuity and joint consistency in one deadline; T needs all properties supported, a counterexample gives F, an unavailable or vacuous check gives N.

nodes.name: Refusal
nodes.summary: Exception for a check that cannot yield a usable decision, carrying a stable code and reason.

nodes.name: apply_envelope
nodes.summary: Labels a formal result with state, warning card, evidence and ids from what it records; refusals and refuted claims become blocked-escalated, decisions qualified-draft.

nodes.name: _card
nodes.summary: Builds the warning card for a labelled formal result.

nodes.name: _evidence
nodes.summary: Builds the evidence entries a labelled formal result carries.

nodes.name: solve
nodes.summary: Answers one LogicalQuery (or mapping) with the z3 or propositional DPLL backend.

nodes.name: _refused
nodes.summary: Builds the labelled refusal result for an invalid or disallowed query.

nodes.name: solver_support
nodes.summary: Reports each backend and whether it works here, probing Z3 with one trivial query.

nodes.name: FormalInput
nodes.summary: Pydantic input for every FormalBlock op; fields no op has are refused.

nodes.name: FormalBlock
nodes.summary: AIBlock component that decides a logic question exactly through g6.formal and says what the answer rests on; never verified.

nodes.name: TruthState
nodes.summary: Enum of Belnap's four values T, F, B and N.

nodes.name: TruthValue
nodes.summary: Two evidence bits for a claim with Belnap connectives (not, and, or, implies, iff), parsing and conversion from evidence statements.

nodes.name: ModalFrame
nodes.summary: Enum of modal frames (alethic, epistemic, deontic, temporal) a claim is read under.

nodes.name: claim_state
nodes.summary: Maps a four-valued claim to a completion state held below verified: only T is a draft.

nodes.name: _eval
nodes.summary: Recursively evaluates a parsed formula tree under four-valued connectives.

nodes.name: evaluate
nodes.summary: Returns the four-valued value of a formula given each atom's value.

nodes.name: truth_table
nodes.summary: Computes the formula's value for every T/F/B/N assignment of its atoms, bounded in atom count.

nodes.name: _frame
nodes.summary: Reads worlds and their accessibility successors from caller input.

nodes.name: _properties
nodes.summary: Checks each frame condition and the first worlds where it fails.

nodes.name: check_frame
nodes.summary: Reports which conditions of a modal frame a Kripke frame meets, with a witness per missed one.

nodes.name: modal_evaluate
nodes.summary: Evaluates necessity (meet) or possibility (join) of a formula at a world over a Kripke frame, optionally checking the frame first.

nodes.name: recheck
nodes.summary: Reruns every recorded query of a proof artifact and confirms each matches its statement and gets the same answer, returning (ok, reason).

nodes.name: FormulaTooLarge
nodes.summary: ValueError for a formula past the pure-Python path's size bounds.

nodes.name: _tokens
nodes.summary: Tokenises a Boolean formula into atoms, operators and parentheses.

nodes.name: _Parser
nodes.summary: Recursive-descent parser for Boolean formulas with IFF, right-associative IMPLIES, OR, AND and NOT precedence.

nodes.name: parse
nodes.summary: Parses a formula into its tree, raising ValueError or FormulaTooLarge.

nodes.name: to_text
nodes.summary: Renders a formula tree as canonical function-form text that round-trips through parse.

nodes.name: _or
nodes.summary: Distributes OR over CNF clause sets with a clause bound.

nodes.name: _cnf
nodes.summary: Converts a formula (or its negation) to CNF clauses.

nodes.name: _dpll
nodes.summary: DPLL search with unit propagation and pure-literal elimination.

nodes.name: _solve
nodes.summary: Parses a formula with assertions, builds CNF and runs DPLL to a satisfying assignment.

nodes.name: dpll_solve
nodes.summary: Bare decision procedure returning a satisfying assignment or None, with no label.

nodes.name: decide
nodes.summary: Answers sat or unsat for one canonical query, used by recheck.

nodes.name: artifact_queries
nodes.summary: Rebuilds the statement and query an artifact's assumptions give, refusing non-canonical fields.

nodes.name: check_propositional
nodes.summary: Decides whether a formula and every assertion are satisfiable via the pure-Python DPLL and returns a labelled result.

nodes.name: SolverCheck
nodes.summary: One query as the solver read it and the solver's answer.

nodes.name: ProofArtifact
nodes.summary: Records what was asked, of which solver and version, through which queries and with which answers, so recheck can rerun them.

nodes.name: _Labelled
nodes.summary: Base Pydantic model for labelled formal results carrying completion state, warning card, evidence and ids, with certificate and note helpers.

nodes.name: FormalResult
nodes.summary: A satisfiability decision with optional model.

nodes.name: OptimumResult
nodes.summary: A lexicographic optimum result, optimal only when bound and attainment both pass on fresh solvers.

nodes.name: CoreResult
nodes.summary: An unsat core result with minimality confirmed on fresh solvers.

nodes.name: CountResult
nodes.summary: A model count enumerated up to a cap, exact or a lower bound.

nodes.name: TermResult
nodes.summary: A Z3-rewritten term reported equivalent only after a fresh solver decides the equality valid.

nodes.name: FourValuedResult
nodes.summary: A Belnap evaluation, truth table or modal frame property result.

nodes.name: ValidityResult
nodes.summary: A premises-entail-conclusion decision with vacuity and assumed-conclusion flags.

nodes.name: LogicalQuery
nodes.summary: One satisfiability question for solve, refusing unknown fields such as backend names or declared confidence.

nodes.name: load_z3
nodes.summary: Imports the z3 module lazily, refusing with G6_E_FORMAL_SOLVER_UNAVAILABLE when absent.

nodes.name: z3_version
nodes.summary: Returns the installed Z3 version string.

nodes.name: _parse
nodes.summary: Parses SMT-LIB text into nested tuples after a character check.

nodes.name: _term
nodes.summary: Reads one SMT-LIB term in canonical spacing, unwrapping a bare assert.

nodes.name: _sort
nodes.summary: Canonicalises a declared sort (Int, Real, Bool, String, BitVec, Array) or returns None.

nodes.name: _sorts
nodes.summary: Validates and canonicalises the caller's symbol-to-sort declarations.

nodes.name: _check_query
nodes.summary: Refuses any query outside the closed grammar of declare-const, assert and one final check-sat.

nodes.name: _value
nodes.summary: Converts a Z3 model value to a plain Python value.

nodes.name: run_query
nodes.summary: Decides one closed-grammar query with a fresh Z3 solver, returning answer, model and unknown reason.

nodes.name: artifact_queries
nodes.summary: Rebuilds the statement and queries an artifact's fields give, refusing non-canonical ones.

nodes.name: check_sat
nodes.summary: Checks satisfiability of a formula plus assertions over declared variables, returning a model when sat.

nodes.name: _validity
nodes.summary: Shared validity procedure: checks premise consistency, assumed conclusions and UNSAT of premises plus negated conclusion.

nodes.name: check_validity
nodes.summary: Decides whether premises entail a conclusion, flagging vacuous premises and assumed conclusions and returning counterexamples.

nodes.name: check_entailment
nodes.summary: Checks whether a entails b via check_validity.

nodes.name: find_counterexample
nodes.summary: Finds a model of the constraints in which a claim is false, or reports it holds.

nodes.name: _parsed
nodes.summary: Reads canonical terms over declared sorts into Z3 expressions through the closed grammar.

nodes.name: _objectives
nodes.summary: Validates optimisation objectives as minimise/maximise pairs.

nodes.name: _number
nodes.summary: Builds an SMT-LIB numeral of a sort for a bound, or None for an open side.

nodes.name: _bounds
nodes.summary: Turns {name: [lower, upper]} into constraints on declared Int and Real symbols.

nodes.name: _optimum
nodes.summary: Runs Z3 Optimize with objectives in lexicographic priority and returns values, bounds and model.

nodes.name: _confirm_optimum
nodes.summary: Confirms an optimum's bound and attainment each on a fresh solver.

nodes.name: optimise
nodes.summary: Computes the lexicographic optimum of objectives under constraints and bounds, confirmed on fresh solvers.

nodes.name: _named
nodes.summary: Validates named assertions for unsat-core extraction.

nodes.name: _core
nodes.summary: Gets Z3's unsat core of named assertions.

nodes.name: _shrink
nodes.summary: Minimises a core by dropping each member and keeping it only when the rest is satisfiable.

nodes.name: unsat_core
nodes.summary: Finds a minimal core of named assertions that cannot hold together, confirmed on fresh solvers, or a model when they can.

nodes.name: _rewrite
nodes.summary: Shared rewrite procedure for simplify and quantifier elimination that reports a result only once equivalence is decided.

nodes.name: simplify
nodes.summary: Returns Z3's simplified form of a term once (= term result) is decided valid.

nodes.name: eliminate_quantifiers
nodes.summary: Returns a quantifier-free equivalent of a formula via Z3's qe tactic, confirmed equivalent.

nodes.name: _enumerate
nodes.summary: Enumerates up to cap models, blocking each once found.

nodes.name: count_models
nodes.summary: Counts assignments satisfying a formula and assertions up to a cap, exact when a fresh solver rules out others.

nodes.name: check_equivalence
nodes.summary: Decides whether two formulas or terms are equivalent wherever premises hold, via check_validity.

nodes.name: GoalEngineInput
nodes.summary: Pydantic input for GoalEngineBlock's propose_goal_tree op; unknown fields are refused.

nodes.name: _subgoals
nodes.summary: Extracts subgoals from the first JSON object in a model reply, raising ValueError for any other shape.

nodes.name: _proposer
nodes.summary: Builds the bounded proposer callable that prompts the configured model through the prompt catalogue.

nodes.name: GoalEngineBlock
nodes.summary: AIBlock component exposing bounded goal-tree proposals over MCP; never verified.

nodes.name: card
nodes.summary: Builds a WarningCard for a state with its code, reason and next step.

nodes.name: evidence
nodes.summary: Builds one evidence entry with code, meaning and recording function.

nodes.name: ControlResult
nodes.summary: One guardrail or checkpoint read against an observation: status, message and reason.

nodes.name: PauseRequest
nodes.summary: An active breakpoint at a node that blocks work until an approval for its exact scope is presented.

nodes.name: ControlReport
nodes.summary: What the controls in force at a node say about one observation, with may_proceed and its envelope.

nodes.name: _scope_chain
nodes.summary: Returns the node chain from root down to a node id, or None when absent.

nodes.name: _results
nodes.summary: Evaluates a list of guardrail or checkpoint specs against an observation.

nodes.name: evaluate_controls
nodes.summary: Reads every control in force at an observation's node and builds the ControlReport with pause requests.

nodes.name: release_pause
nodes.summary: Returns the approval record that releases a pause, accepting only a live human-issued approval for its scope and run.

nodes.name: GoalNode
nodes.summary: A node of a proposed goal tree with dotted id, goal text and depth.

nodes.name: ProposalResult
nodes.summary: Result of a bounded proposal: the tree, budget failures and whether it completed.

nodes.name: GoalTree
nodes.summary: Deterministic bounded goal hierarchy with dotted ids, traversal, goal-stack generation, visualisation and conversion to a GoalSpec.

nodes.name: _parse
nodes.summary: Parses a proposer's reply into a list of subgoal strings.

nodes.name: propose_goal_tree
nodes.summary: Provider-neutral breadth-first decomposition through an injected proposer, listing budget failures rather than cropping.

nodes.name: PlanNode
nodes.summary: One declared goal kept in the plan.

nodes.name: DroppedNode
nodes.summary: A declared goal left out of the plan with its subtree size and code.

nodes.name: PlanTree
nodes.summary: The declared plan, its dropped nodes and its envelope.

nodes.name: _problem
nodes.summary: Returns the code for a declared subtask that must be dropped (blank goal and similar), or None.

nodes.name: _walk
nodes.summary: Walks the declared subtasks in pre-order, collecting kept, rejected and depth-truncated nodes.

nodes.name: _summary
nodes.summary: Builds the warning card code, message and next step for a built plan.

nodes.name: build_plan_tree
nodes.summary: Builds the PlanTree from a GoalSpec's declared subtasks, reporting every rejected and truncated node.

nodes.name: predicates.py
nodes.summary: Registry of named predicates that read an executor Observation and return pass, fail or unknown for goal-engine guardrails and checkpoints, with built-ins for resource limits, metric thresholds and CSF hazard estimates; an unknown is never a pass.
nodes.languageNotes: Factories are validated with inspect.signature before registration, and the parameter mapping is frozen with MappingProxyType so a predicate cannot mutate its params.

nodes.name: ControlError
nodes.summary: ValueError subclass carrying a stable goal-engine error code for invalid controls and predicate failures.

nodes.name: usage_within
nodes.summary: Builds a predicate that fails when a reported usage figure exceeds its limit and is unknown when a limited figure is not reported.

nodes.name: _metric
nodes.summary: Shared factory for metric_above/metric_below: validates the metric name and finite threshold and returns a predicate that is unknown when the metric is missing.

nodes.name: _csf_hazard
nodes.summary: Factory for the csf_hazard predicate: compares the observed action against fixed per-action hazard estimates, failing actions with no estimate.

nodes.name: register_predicate
nodes.summary: Registers a named predicate factory after checking the name, callability and single-parameter signature, refusing silent overrides.

nodes.name: list_predicates
nodes.summary: Returns the sorted names of all registered predicates.

nodes.name: resolve
nodes.summary: Looks up a predicate by name and builds it from params, raising ControlError with a stable code for unknown names or bad params.

nodes.name: run
nodes.summary: Runs a predicate on an observation and normalises its return (verdict, bool, or verdict-reason pair) to a verdict, mapping anything else or an exception to unknown.

nodes.name: schema.py
nodes.summary: Pydantic models for the goal a caller declares (GoalSpec with resource bounds, guardrails, checkpoints, breakpoints and subtasks) and the Observation an executor reports, with strict finite numbers and unknown keys rejected.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Annotated pydantic field types with strict=True and allow_inf_nan=False so a NaN limit cannot silently never trip.

nodes.name: ResourceBoundsSpec
nodes.summary: Optional token, time and disk limits for a node, exposing them as a usage-key to limit mapping.

nodes.name: GuardrailSpec
nodes.summary: A named guardrail that applies a registered predicate with params to a node and everything below it; the reserved resource_bounds name is refused.

nodes.name: CheckpointSpec
nodes.summary: A named checkpoint that evaluates a predicate at a node with a description.

nodes.name: BreakpointSpec
nodes.summary: A named breakpoint where a person must approve before the node proceeds.

nodes.name: GoalSpec
nodes.summary: The declared goal tree node with context, constraints, controls, subtasks and success criteria; enforces unique control names and provides a stable SHA-256 digest.

nodes.name: Observation
nodes.summary: What an executor reports for a node: the node, the action, usage figures and metrics that predicates read.

nodes.name: SKILL.md
nodes.summary: Agent skill guide for g6.goal_engine covering when to use it, its ops (including propose_goal_tree), Python API, result reading, failure modes, blind spots and examples for checking declared controls against executor reports.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package entry point for g6.graph_reasoning, documenting the annotated-logic-over-graphs engine in the style of PyReason and re-exporting its ops, checks, language and result types.

nodes.name: checks.py
nodes.summary: G6's independent pure-Python check of a graph-reasoning interpretation for closure, support and soundness, with its own variable-by-variable matcher, run before any answer is reported; also checks conflicts.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses fractions.Fraction for exact rational interval arithmetic and bisect to find intervals established at a strictly lower rank, preventing circular support.

nodes.name: Check
nodes.summary: Frozen result of a check: which properties were checked, the failures found and details, with a passed flag and dict view.

nodes.name: _Clock
nodes.summary: Deadline clock that ticks periodically and raises a Refusal when the time limit passes.

nodes.name: _value
nodes.summary: Computes an annotation function (average, average_lower, maximum, minimum, product) over bounds exactly with Fractions.

nodes.name: _Matcher
nodes.summary: The checker's own grounding matcher: indexes edges, orders a rule's variables and enumerates groundings variable by variable under the deadline.

nodes.name: _Head
nodes.summary: Accumulates groundings, atoms and held flags for one rule head and derives qualified and candidate atoms per clause.

nodes.name: _heads
nodes.summary: Groups a rule's groundings by head binding into _Head entries, recording which clause atoms hold.

nodes.name: _fires
nodes.summary: Decides whether a rule fires for a head, applying count and percentage thresholds to qualified versus candidate atoms.

nodes.name: _Session
nodes.summary: One checking session over a model, interpretation and histories: implements the soundness, closure and support checks and step-by-step validation of fact and rule steps.

nodes.name: check_solution
nodes.summary: Checks a solved interpretation for soundness, closure and support and returns a Check.

nodes.name: check_conflict
nodes.summary: Checks a reported conflict: the atom's interval matches its history, the emptying step is a valid application, and the two intervals do not intersect.

nodes.name: engine.py
nodes.summary: Pure-Python fixpoint engine for g6.graph_reasoning: evaluates rules stratum by stratum over exact rational intervals, records each tightening step as a certificate, and stops on conflicts or grounding and time limits.
nodes.languageNotes: Semi-naive evaluation: after the first round only head groundings that read a changed atom are recomputed.

nodes.name: Step
nodes.summary: One recorded tightening of an atom: rank, interval, rule or fact, head bindings, witnesses and the body intervals read.

nodes.name: Conflict
nodes.summary: A tightening that would empty an atom's interval: the atom, its interval before and the offending step.

nodes.name: Solution
nodes.summary: Engine output: final bounds, per-atom step histories, rounds, groundings count, any conflict and the strata.

nodes.name: _Clock
nodes.summary: Deadline clock that ticks periodically and raises a Refusal when time runs out.

nodes.name: _structure
nodes.summary: Enumerates a rule's groundings against the graph structure clause by clause, enforcing the global grounding cap and deadline.

nodes.name: annotate
nodes.summary: Applies a named annotation function to a list of intervals using exact Fraction arithmetic.

nodes.name: _group
nodes.summary: Groups a rule's structural groundings by head binding for evaluation.

nodes.name: _fire
nodes.summary: Evaluates one rule over its groups at the current bounds, producing head steps where clauses and thresholds hold.

nodes.name: _witnesses
nodes.summary: Selects the full groundings that witness a firing, limited to what the step needs.

nodes.name: solve
nodes.summary: Runs the stratified fixpoint over a model to a Solution, intersecting head intervals round by round and reporting a conflict instead of resolving it.

nodes.name: envelope.py
nodes.summary: Stable G6_E_GRAPH_REASONING_* codes and finish(), the single place a graph-reasoning result is labelled qualified-draft or blocked-escalated with its warning card and evidence; it never produces verified.

nodes.name: Refusal
nodes.summary: Exception carrying a graph-reasoning code, reason and problems, used to refuse a model or run before an answer is built.

nodes.name: finish
nodes.summary: Builds the labelled GraphReasoningResult: blocked-escalated with no interpretation when a code is set, otherwise qualified-draft with an engine-specific warning card, evidence, request and run ids.

nodes.name: _answer_card
nodes.summary: Chooses the warning card for an evaluated answer based on which engines ran and why PyReason did not.

nodes.name: graph_reasoning_block.py
nodes.summary: GraphReasoningBlock, the registry and MCP door for g6.graph_reasoning, mapping typed reason/query/explain/check ops to the package functions and returning their labelled results unchanged.

nodes.name: GraphReasoningInput
nodes.summary: Strict pydantic input for the block: op, program, graph, facts, labels, atom, engine and time limit, refusing unknown fields.

nodes.name: GraphReasoningBlock
nodes.summary: AIBlock subclass that dispatches each graph-reasoning op to one public function and returns its labelled envelope.

nodes.name: language.py
nodes.summary: Parser and checker for the annotated-logic-over-graphs language (nodes, edges, interval facts, rules, thresholds, annotation functions) and its JSON form, refusing malformed, unsafe or non-stratifiable models with coded line/column problems.
nodes.languageNotes: Hand-written tokenizer and recursive-descent parser with exact decimal-to-Fraction numbers; stratification uses strongly connected components over label dependencies.

nodes.name: Clause
nodes.summary: One body clause of a rule: label, variables, interval and optional count or percentage threshold.

nodes.name: Rule
nodes.summary: A parsed rule with head, fixed interval or annotation function and clauses; exposes its kind and body variables.

nodes.name: Model
nodes.summary: A parsed and checked model: graph nodes and edges, facts, rules, label arities and strata; lists derived labels.

nodes.name: show
nodes.summary: Renders an exact Fraction as written: a terminating decimal when it has one, otherwise a fraction such as 1/3.

nodes.name: show_interval
nodes.summary: Renders an interval as a [lower, upper] string.

nodes.name: as_floats
nodes.summary: Converts an exact interval to a pair of floats.

nodes.name: render_name
nodes.summary: Renders a node or label name, quoting it when it is not a plain identifier.

nodes.name: render_atom
nodes.summary: Renders an atom as label(args) text.

nodes.name: render_clause
nodes.summary: Renders a rule clause with its interval and threshold as text.

nodes.name: render_rule
nodes.summary: Renders a whole rule back to language text.

nodes.name: _tokens
nodes.summary: Tokenizer for the language: names, quoted strings, numbers, punctuation and comments, with line and column positions.

nodes.name: _string
nodes.summary: Reads a double-quoted node name with its escapes, refusing unterminated strings.

nodes.name: _show
nodes.summary: Describes a token in plain words for parse error messages.

nodes.name: _Parser
nodes.summary: Recursive-descent parser over the token stream for node and edge declarations, facts, rules, clauses, bounds and thresholds.

nodes.name: _Arities
nodes.summary: Tracks each label's arity and refuses a label used with two arities.

nodes.name: _json_graph
nodes.summary: Reads the JSON graph form (nodes and edges) with validation.

nodes.name: _json_facts
nodes.summary: Reads the JSON facts form for node and edge labels with optional bounds.

nodes.name: parse_model
nodes.summary: Parses program text plus optional JSON graph and facts into a checked Model, refusing bad intervals, arity clashes, unknown labels, vacuous clauses, unsafe rules and size violations.

nodes.name: _stratify
nodes.summary: Orders labels into strata so annotation functions and percentage thresholds read only final labels.

nodes.name: _components
nodes.summary: Computes strongly connected components of the label dependency graph.

nodes.name: _not_stratifiable
nodes.summary: Builds the refusal for a model whose annotation function or percentage threshold reads a label depending on its own head.

nodes.name: parse_atom
nodes.summary: Parses a single ground atom such as popular(alice) against a model for query and explain.

nodes.name: ops.py
nodes.summary: The four public ops of g6.graph_reasoning (reason, query, explain, check_model): parse, run the pure-Python engine and optional PyReason cross-check under a time limit, check the interpretation, and return one labelled result.

nodes.name: _run
nodes.summary: Runs an op body with timing, turning a Refusal or any exception into a coded outcome so nothing raises through the surface, and labels it through finish().

nodes.name: _conflict
nodes.summary: Renders a conflict with both sides' derivations for the result.

nodes.name: _evaluate
nodes.summary: Runs the engine, checks the solution or conflict, and when allowed runs PyReason and compares the two engines' intervals.

nodes.name: _derivation
nodes.summary: Builds an atom's derivation tree down to the facts from step histories, bounded in size.

nodes.name: _with_solution
nodes.summary: Shared path for query and explain: parse, evaluate, then build the answer from the solution.

nodes.name: reason
nodes.summary: Returns the final interpretation of every atom (or named labels) whose interval is not unknown, checked and labelled.

nodes.name: query
nodes.summary: Returns the interval of one atom with the steps that set its lower and upper bounds.

nodes.name: explain
nodes.summary: Returns why an atom's interval holds as a derivation down to the facts, or why it stayed unknown.

nodes.name: check_model
nodes.summary: Parses and reports parse, safety, stratification and size results and whether PyReason could cross-check, without evaluating.

nodes.name: pyreason_engine.py
nodes.summary: Optional PyReason second engine: decides whether a model is inside the fragment PyReason evaluates the same way, translates it with renamed identifiers, registers G6's own numba annotation functions, runs it under a lock and compares intervals.
nodes.languageNotes: PyReason is imported lazily via importlib to contain its side effects (NUMBA_CACHE_DIR, stdout prints); annotation functions are numba-compiled and registered by name.

nodes.name: _forest
nodes.summary: Checks whether a rule body's variables linked by edge clauses form a forest, which PyReason evaluates exactly.

nodes.name: _function_reads
nodes.summary: Checks how an annotation function's clauses read non-head variables and derived labels.

nodes.name: outside_fragment
nodes.summary: Lists the reasons a model falls outside the fragment PyReason evaluates as G6 does (thresholds, cyclic bodies, unsafe function reads, no rules).

nodes.name: Translation
nodes.summary: The model as PyReason text: node and label renamings, edges, facts, rules and the annotation functions to register.

nodes.name: translate
nodes.summary: Translates a parsed model into PyReason text and a networkx graph with every identifier renamed so no caller text reaches PyReason.

nodes.name: g6_average
nodes.summary: Numba-compiled average annotation function registered with PyReason.

nodes.name: g6_average_lower
nodes.summary: Numba-compiled average_lower annotation function registered with PyReason.

nodes.name: g6_maximum
nodes.summary: Numba-compiled maximum annotation function registered with PyReason.

nodes.name: g6_minimum
nodes.summary: Numba-compiled minimum annotation function registered with PyReason.

nodes.name: g6_product
nodes.summary: Numba-compiled product annotation function registered with PyReason.

nodes.name: _captured
nodes.summary: Context manager that captures PyReason's warnings and standard output, deduplicated and ANSI-stripped, into a list for the result.

nodes.name: unavailable_reason
nodes.summary: Returns why PyReason cannot be used here, or an empty string when it imports.

nodes.name: available
nodes.summary: Reports whether PyReason is usable.

nodes.name: load
nodes.summary: Imports PyReason on demand, raising a Refusal when it is unavailable.

nodes.name: version
nodes.summary: Returns the installed PyReason version string.

nodes.name: solve
nodes.summary: Runs a translated model through PyReason for one timestep under a lock and reads every final interval back, with elapsed time.

nodes.name: compare
nodes.summary: Compares PyReason intervals with G6's within the tolerance and reports disagreements.

nodes.name: schema.py
nodes.summary: Defines GraphReasoningResult, the frozen pydantic result of every graph-reasoning op, whose completion_state admits only qualified-draft or blocked-escalated.

nodes.name: GraphReasoningResult
nodes.summary: Frozen result model carrying operation, engines, interpretation, answer, explanation, report, check, conflict, problems, code and the reliability envelope fields.

nodes.name: SKILL.md
nodes.summary: Agent skill guide for g6.graph_reasoning covering when to use interval reasoning over graphs, its four ops, how to read results, failure modes, blind spots and worked examples.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package entry point for g6.grounding, documenting lexical claim checking, corroboration by source lineage, staleness and coverage, and re-exporting their public functions and types.

nodes.name: claims.py
nodes.summary: check_claim and check_claims: match each claim to the best source sentence by content-term coverage, flagging negation flips and conflicting numbers, labelled qualified-draft or blocked-escalated, with an optional stricter-only judge.

nodes.name: ClaimCheck
nodes.summary: Frozen result of one claim check: status, completion state, coverage, source, sentence, conflicts and judge info, with a dict view.

nodes.name: split_claims
nodes.summary: Splits a draft into checkable sentence claims.

nodes.name: _containing
nodes.summary: Finds source sentences containing the claim's content terms.

nodes.name: _best_sentence
nodes.summary: Picks the source sentence with the highest share of the claim's content terms.

nodes.name: check_claim
nodes.summary: Checks one claim against sources: quoted, supported, partial, conflict (negation or number mismatch) or not_found, with an optional judge that can only make it stricter.

nodes.name: check_claims
nodes.summary: Splits text into claims, retrieves passages once and checks each claim.

nodes.name: coverage.py
nodes.summary: coverage(): counts per claim of a draft the independent source lineages that support or contradict it, bounded in text and source size, labelled qualified-draft only when every claim rests on two or more lineages with no contradiction.

nodes.name: CoverageReport
nodes.summary: Result of a coverage run: per-claim corroboration, counts, completion state, warning card and caller weights, with a dict view.

nodes.name: coverage
nodes.summary: Runs corroboration on each claim of a draft and labels the draft by the worst claim (contested, unsupported, thin sources).

nodes.name: _bounded
nodes.summary: Refuses drafts or sources over the byte, claim or passage caps before any search.

nodes.name: grounding_block.py
nodes.summary: GroundingBlock, the registry and MCP door for g6.grounding, checking caller-supplied claims or drafts against in-memory source text via check_claim, check_claims and coverage with no network.

nodes.name: GroundingInput
nodes.summary: Strict pydantic input for the block: op, claim or text, sources, top_k and weights.

nodes.name: GroundingBlock
nodes.summary: AIBlock subclass that builds a TextRetriever from the supplied sources and dispatches check_claim, check_claims and coverage, labelling the result and refusing with stable codes.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package marker for optional grounding reviewers; importing it loads no model.

nodes.name: nli.py
nodes.summary: Explicitly injected NLI reviewers: NLIJudge adapts an LLMCaller to the stricter-only judge callable, and LocalNLICaller runs a local cross-encoder NLI classifier behind the LLMCaller interface.

nodes.name: NLIJudge
nodes.summary: Callable judge that asks an LLMCaller for an entails/contradicts/neutral verdict as strict JSON and raises a coded error on malformed replies.

nodes.name: LocalNLICaller
nodes.summary: LLMCaller subclass backed by a locally provisioned sentence-transformers cross-encoder (safetensors, CPU, no download or remote code), returning the verdict JSON NLIJudge expects and refusing truncated, tied or non-finite results.

nodes.name: lineage.py
nodes.summary: corroboration(): groups passages that support or contradict a claim by source lineage (web host or corpus) and returns SUPPORTED, ASSERTED, CONTESTED or UNVERIFIABLE, a lexical proxy whose best state is qualified-draft.

nodes.name: CorroborationReport
nodes.summary: Result of corroboration: status, completion state, supporting and opposing lineages and passages, with a dict view.

nodes.name: _lineage
nodes.summary: Derives a passage's lineage key from its source label: a web host, else the corpus it came in with.

nodes.name: corroboration
nodes.summary: Counts supporting and opposing source lineages for a claim using per-passage lexical checks and assigns the epistemic status.

nodes.name: retrieval.py
nodes.summary: The Retriever protocol, Passage type and a dependency-free BM25 TextRetriever over caller-supplied text or a folder, plus tokenising, light stemming and content-term helpers shared by grounding.

nodes.name: tokens
nodes.summary: Lower-cases text and splits it into word and number tokens.

nodes.name: stem
nodes.summary: Light suffix stripper so plural and past forms match their base.

nodes.name: content_terms
nodes.summary: Returns stemmed tokens with stopwords removed, keeping negators.

nodes.name: Passage
nodes.summary: A retrieved chunk of source text with its source label, score and scale, provenance and the source-declared published_at date.

nodes.name: Retriever
nodes.summary: Runtime-checkable protocol for any corpus: search(query, top_k) returning passages.

nodes.name: TextRetriever
nodes.summary: Stdlib BM25 retriever over chunked texts, built from a mapping of texts or a folder of files.

nodes.name: SKILL.md
nodes.summary: Agent skill guide for g6.grounding covering when to check drafts against held documents, the check_claim, check_claims and coverage ops, Python-only corroboration and staleness, result reading, failure modes and blind spots.

nodes.name: staleness.py
nodes.summary: check_staleness(): ages each passage from the publication date its source declares, classing it fresh, stale, expired or unknown with caller-chosen thresholds and no assumed freshness for undated sources.

nodes.name: SourceAge
nodes.summary: Age record for one source: status, declared publication date and age in days.

nodes.name: StalenessReport
nodes.summary: Collection of SourceAge rows with counts, an all_fresh flag and a dict view.

nodes.name: _parse_date
nodes.summary: Parses an ISO 8601 year, month, date or datetime into a date, counting partial dates from their first day.

nodes.name: check_staleness
nodes.summary: Classifies each passage by age against warn and expire thresholds, treating undated, unreadable or future dates as unknown.

nodes.name: tripwire.py
nodes.summary: A small tripwire that flags source text phrased like instructions to an AI model, after NFKC normalisation and removal of invisible characters; a hit means a person should look, and no hit establishes nothing.

nodes.name: instruction_signals
nodes.summary: Returns the names of instruction-like phrasings matched in normalised text, empty when none matched.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package entry point for g6.guards, advisory scanners that flag prompt-injection and prompt-extraction phrasings in text and safety smells in source code, re-exporting PatternGuard, detect_extraction_attempt and scan_source.

nodes.name: patterns.py
nodes.summary: Advisory substring tripwires that fold case and whitespace to flag listed safety-subversion and system-prompt-extraction phrasings, plus a bounded personal-data scanner (SSN, email, phone, card shapes) that returns redacted findings; every verdict is a suggestion that authorizes nothing.

nodes.name: SKILL.md
nodes.summary: Skill guide for the g6-guards package: when to use the advisory prompt-injection, extraction and personal-data tripwires and the source-smell scanner, its Python API, blind spots, failure modes and examples.

nodes.name: source_scan.py
nodes.summary: Advisory review aid that runs regular-expression rules line by line over Python source, with string literals and comments blanked by the tokenizer, to flag code that quietly defeats a safety chain.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses the tokenize module to blank string and comment tokens before regex matching, falling back to raw lines when tokenizing fails.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: The harness spine and public package entry: defines Check and Standard and runs a standard through intake, plan, execution, adjudication and memory, returning the reliability envelope with gaps, next action and certificate; also reports recurring failures and fail rates.

nodes.name: assertions.py
nodes.summary: Builds ordinary harness Checks from declarative JSON assertions: resolves field paths over JSON output without invoking attributes, compares values, and assembles check suites with explicit overrides.

nodes.name: behaviour_question.py
nodes.summary: Turns open behaviour choices into one question for the person: builds and validates Candidates from the caller or from base-versus-patch differential observations, ranks and chooses one, renders the behaviour form and reads the person's answer back.

nodes.name: behaviour_runner.py
nodes.summary: G6's isolated observation runner: writes a confined working folder from a copy's manifest, launches one interpreter with a G6-owned result channel, reads back exactly one bounded observation frame and compares the outcome in G6's own process.
nodes.languageNotes: Implements a total frame reader with strict prefix/trailer checks and checks NTFS alternate streams so a folder carries nothing beyond its manifest.

nodes.name: completion_hook.py
nodes.summary: Claude Code hook entry point for the completion loop: on UserPromptSubmit it binds the task and base commit for the session, and on Stop it advances the loop and returns its continue/stop decision to the host.

nodes.name: completion_loop.py
nodes.summary: The completion loop: when a coding agent claims it is finished, runs scouts' hidden probes and a cross-family critic's review-until-clean rounds against the work, feeds failures back in the same session until the work holds or the stop rule fires, and writes the report and self-improvement failure row.

nodes.name: confirmed_checks.py
nodes.summary: Enforces the person's confirmed expectations on the patch under review: compiles each confirmed expectation into its example.v1 check, runs it on the tree and records one result per expectation.

nodes.name: confirmed_expectation.py
nodes.summary: Semantics of a person's confirmed answer: canonical-JSON Question, Answer and ConfirmedExpectation records identified by digest, and the immutable ExpectationStandard that supersedes rather than overwrites on contradiction.
nodes.languageNotes: Records are held as canonical JSON bytes and every field read is a fresh decoded copy, using a descriptor-based _Field to keep instances immutable.

nodes.name: completion_harness.json
nodes.summary: Prompt harness for the completion loop's L9 generation: the scout, hidden scouts, fixer, repair, critic, critic-note and review-ask templates, plus a 'trained' slot that training may only add to.

nodes.name: executable_scenario.py
nodes.summary: Immutable executable Scenario record, independent of question and answer formats, that builds and digests the exact interpreter program a check runs with only the person's option supplied, with save and load helpers.

nodes.name: memory.py
nodes.summary: SQLite-backed harness memory in $G6_HOME/harness.db recording failed checks per task family, failing output hashes, runs and evaluations as facts read at plan time.

nodes.name: observation_contract.py
nodes.summary: Shared exception language for the synchronous outcome adapter and the isolated bootstrap: decides whether a raised exception type is observable.

nodes.name: patch_report.py
nodes.summary: Renders a patch review's readable Markdown report as a pure function of the assessment's decided fields: headline, reproduced findings, requirement status, decisions and next steps, plus completion-loop and review-loop sections.

nodes.name: patch_review.py
nodes.summary: Reference application that assesses an AI-written Python patch against stated requirements: runs the checks confined at the patch and base commit, detects test weakening, runs verification search, the formal path and confirmed expectations, and returns exactly one technical outcome with evidence.

nodes.name: question_store.py
nodes.summary: Per-task append-only, hash-chained store of the behaviour questions G6 asked and the answers received, with a question budget, answer rules and the derived expectation standard.

nodes.name: readiness.py
nodes.summary: Measures readiness from the harness's own observations: evaluates candidate and baseline executors on reserved held-out cases after freezing checks, and reports the latest paired batch.

nodes.name: requirement_evidence.py
nodes.summary: Adapter that expresses the patch review's evidence in the certificate issuer's terms: builds source records for each requirement's checks and runs, and states why a requirement or confirmed expectation is not counted.

nodes.name: SKILL.md
nodes.summary: Skill guide for the g6-harness package: when to run a Standard through the harness, its Python API (Check, Standard, Memory, run, run_steps, failure counts, readiness), blind spots and examples.

nodes.name: standard_publication.py
nodes.summary: Context-local task-store guard entered at confirmed evidence issuance, so an MCP review holds the current task standard through issuance and raises when it was superseded.

nodes.name: verification_controller.py
nodes.summary: Bounded, fail-closed adaptive experiment scheduler: keeps a confined run's observation only when bound to the exact artifact, checker and environment digests with a matching receipt, and orders checks by severity-weighted coverage per cost.

nodes.name: verification_formal.py
nodes.summary: Verification search's formal path: checks state-invariant obligations, runs bounded model checking and induction on the stated model, replays traces on the real code, and runs Z3 symbolic searches whose counterexamples are re-run confined.

nodes.name: verification_proposer.py
nodes.summary: Verification search's proposer: asks a model for check templates and free-form checks under strict schemas and size limits, treating every reply as untrusted data, and records each exchange; includes the study callers for V10.

nodes.name: GuardVerdict
nodes.summary: Advisory verdict of a phrase scan: BLOCK or NO_MATCH decision, matched patterns, evidence excerpts and surface; never ALLOW.

nodes.name: _scan
nodes.summary: Core scanner that folds case, apostrophes and whitespace and collects every listed phrase found with an excerpt around it.

nodes.name: PatternGuard
nodes.summary: Subversion-phrase scanner for user input, planner output and action arguments; records that a scan ran for path-coverage tests.

nodes.name: detect_extraction_attempt
nodes.summary: Scans untrusted input for listed system-prompt-extraction phrasings and returns an advisory verdict.

nodes.name: PersonalDataFinding
nodes.summary: One personal-data match holding only its kind, redacted preview and SHA-256 hash.

nodes.name: PersonalDataScan
nodes.summary: Result of a personal-data scan with findings, completeness, reason, flagged state and suggested decision.

nodes.name: scan_personal_data
nodes.summary: Bounded advisory scan for SSN, email, phone and card-shaped values; refuses oversized text and suggests BLOCK when incomplete.

nodes.name: StaticFinding
nodes.summary: One source-scan finding: rule, reason, line number, original line and path.

nodes.name: SourceScan
nodes.summary: Findings of one source text with lines scanned and whether strings were blanked.

nodes.name: scan_source
nodes.summary: Applies every rule to the blanked code lines and reports each finding with its original line.

nodes.name: Check
nodes.summary: One acceptance criterion with its predicate, author, evidence kind and known-bad/known-good controls; exposes a stable key and code digest.

nodes.name: Standard
nodes.summary: A goal with its checks, context sources, gates, family and optional plan and success criteria.

nodes.name: run
nodes.summary: Runs one standard and returns the library envelope with gaps, next action and certificate.

nodes.name: _run
nodes.summary: Main pipeline body: intake, plan, execute, adjudicate checks, record memory and build the envelope with receipts.

nodes.name: run_steps
nodes.summary: Runs trusted executors in order under the same checks and stop rules, stopping at the first blocked-escalated step.

nodes.name: value_report
nodes.summary: Reports the first two failed checks, critical first, in stable standard order.

nodes.name: failure_counts
nodes.summary: Counts failed-check occurrences by check or family from memory.

nodes.name: fail_rate
nodes.summary: Share of recorded attempts that blocked for one family; no denominator for legacy failure-only history.

nodes.name: resolve_field
nodes.summary: Resolves JSON object keys, list indices and list.count without invoking attributes or methods.

nodes.name: check_field
nodes.summary: Builds a caller-authored Check over JSON output where missing fields and malformed comparisons fail.

nodes.name: confirm_suite
nodes.summary: Assembles a check suite keeping all built-ins unless an entry carries an explicit boolean override.

nodes.name: CandidateRefused
nodes.summary: ValueError naming why a candidate lacks required parts or its outcomes do not compete, with a code.

nodes.name: require_probe
nodes.summary: Admits only an observation record naming G6's own runner probe digest.

nodes.name: encoded
nodes.summary: The one encoding of an outcome's value shared by the probe and example.v1.

nodes.name: competition
nodes.summary: Checks that outcome A's compiled check rejects B and vice versa, else returns a code and reason.

nodes.name: Candidate
nodes.summary: One candidate behaviour choice held as canonical text, with citation, evidence, scenario, competing outcomes and settlement, read as fresh copies.

nodes.name: quoted_path
nodes.summary: Percent-encodes a file path so it is inert data in an evidence line.

nodes.name: with_support
nodes.summary: Adds evidence lines citing passages of the person's own indexed files to a candidate.

nodes.name: settled_by
nodes.summary: Finds evidence that the task text already names an outcome literally; evidence only, decides nothing.

nodes.name: caller_candidates
nodes.summary: Validates the calling agent's proposed candidates: verbatim citation, repository evidence and statable competing outcomes.

nodes.name: observed
nodes.summary: Converts a differential observation into an example.v1 outcome, or None when it cannot be stated exactly.

nodes.name: differential_candidates
nodes.summary: Derives candidates from behaviour_changed activities of differential.v1 checks with change intent.

nodes.name: ranked
nodes.summary: Orders candidates by priority: unsettled first, then the caller's, then given order.

nodes.name: choose
nodes.summary: Picks the single candidate G6 asks about.

nodes.name: plan
nodes.summary: Describes the candidates with source and rank, the chosen one and the unknowns.

nodes.name: caller_text
nodes.summary: Places caller text in a labelled field, losslessly escaped as an ASCII JSON string.

nodes.name: shown_call
nodes.summary: Renders a question's call with positional and sorted keyword arguments in the one encoding.

nodes.name: shown_outcome
nodes.summary: Renders an outcome with its value in the one encoding.

nodes.name: form
nodes.summary: Builds the behaviour form message and elicitation schema the person sees for a question.

nodes.name: Reading
nodes.summary: What a dialog result says: ANSWERED or PENDING, why, the answer and whether one more question was allowed.

nodes.name: read
nodes.summary: Reads the person's answer out of an MCP elicitation result, accepting only a valid choice and name.

nodes.name: ExecutableSource
nodes.summary: String subclass carrying compiler custody of executable text in the host, outside the Python text and JSON.

nodes.name: expanded
nodes.summary: Decodes a compact portable reproduction for inspection without granting execution authority.

nodes.name: _exception_observation
nodes.summary: Records a caught exception's type first with bounded diagnostics so missing diagnostics cannot erase the observation.

nodes.name: Activity
nodes.summary: Dict subclass holding process-local probe custody while serialising only the activity's fields.

nodes.name: write_probes
nodes.summary: Publishes observation custody separately after the exact reply bytes are saved.

nodes.name: read_probes
nodes.summary: Reads published probe custody; missing, damaged or foreign custody admits no observations.

nodes.name: probe_sha256
nodes.summary: Digest identifying G6's own runner probe.

nodes.name: _import_roots
nodes.summary: Chooses import roots: held scenario roots first, then an example's resolved ordered roots.

nodes.name: read_frame
nodes.summary: Total reader for exactly one bounded, recognised observation frame with no prefix or trailing bytes.

nodes.name: finish
nodes.summary: Compares the observation in G6's own process; the child's exit status supplies no support or failure.

nodes.name: bindings
nodes.summary: Reads only G6's generated literal slots of a proposed check without executing it.

nodes.name: located
nodes.summary: Resolves a path against held scenario roots or an example's resolved file root.

nodes.name: request
nodes.summary: Builds the child request with only setup and inputs; the chosen outcome stays in G6's process.

nodes.name: example_text
nodes.summary: Renders a portable pytest reproduction that uses the same fresh interpreter and comparison as enforcement.

nodes.name: _made
nodes.summary: Writes the child's folder from the copy's manifest, exactly the listed files as new regular files.

nodes.name: _streams
nodes.summary: Enumerates alternate data streams on each file and folder beyond a file's unnamed stream.

nodes.name: run
nodes.summary: Runs one confined interpreter in a G6-written folder with a G6-created channel, re-reads the folder afterwards and returns the observation.

nodes.name: folder
nodes.summary: Returns a session's state folder.

nodes.name: current
nodes.summary: Returns the folder of the session's current loop.

nodes.name: _again
nodes.summary: Arms a new loop after one ended or the base commit moved, settling owed rows first.

nodes.name: on_prompt
nodes.summary: UserPromptSubmit handler: records the task and base commit and optionally runs scouts before the fix.

nodes.name: on_stop
nodes.summary: Stop handler: advances the completion loop and tells the host to continue or stop.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Command-line entry dispatching the prompt or stop hook from JSON on stdin.

nodes.name: Harness
nodes.summary: The loop's prompt text, each part with what training added to it.

nodes.name: harness
nodes.summary: Loads the harness JSON, refusing training changes other than additions to instructions.

nodes.name: ProbeRun
nodes.summary: One run of a probe set with pytest's own per-case counts so console output cannot hide failures.

nodes.name: split_failures
nodes.summary: Splits failing cases into regressions versus what the fix still owes.

nodes.name: failures_of
nodes.summary: Lists failing ids and the text the agent reads, regressions first, capped.

nodes.name: with_critic
nodes.summary: Prefixes failures with the critic's rule, reasons and test when its test failed.

nodes.name: asks
nodes.summary: Detects whether the agent's reply asks a question by punctuation outside quoted code.

nodes.name: critic_report
nodes.summary: Parses the critic's reply into rule, verdict, reasons and test.

nodes.name: scout_gate
nodes.summary: Checks a scout's probes against G6's own count of declared dimension combinations.

nodes.name: ToolSession
nodes.summary: Claude Code session running under the person's own account with scout tools, a clean environment and a bounded run.

nodes.name: scout_host
nodes.summary: Returns the scouts' session when the key file approves Claude Code.

nodes.name: critic_host
nodes.summary: Returns Codex as the cross-family reviewer when the key file approves it.

nodes.name: _read
nodes.summary: Reads a probe set's per-file pytest outcomes into one ProbeRun.

nodes.name: run_set
nodes.summary: Runs probe files on the tree or base commit, each in its own confined copy without network, within a deadline.

nodes.name: _scout
nodes.summary: Runs one scout session, gates its probes at the base commit and allows one retry.

nodes.name: Shown
nodes.summary: A patch as the reviewer reads it: raw text, masked text and whether masks hid shown names.

nodes.name: Seen
nodes.summary: A text as a reader is shown it, with mask cut positions per row.

nodes.name: _seen
nodes.summary: The single rule for what a reader is shown of a text and where its secret masks fall.

nodes.name: _shown
nodes.summary: Builds the patch text the reviewer reads from held file bytes only, with masks and mode lines.

nodes.name: run_critic
nodes.summary: Runs the cross-family critic once on the finished patch and stores its test.

nodes.name: review_round
nodes.summary: One review-until-clean round: a fresh review, then each review's test run alone on the patch.

nodes.name: WorkingTree
nodes.summary: CEGIS candidate standing for the agent's working tree.

nodes.name: Repairs
nodes.summary: CEGIS adapter over the agent's work: search is the agent told what failed, evaluate is the probes.

nodes.name: Step
nodes.summary: Next loop step: CONTINUE with agent text, STOP with report, or WAIT.

nodes.name: read_report
nodes.summary: Reads a completed report only against the digest held in its checked state.

nodes.name: source_refs
nodes.summary: Returns the inputs a saved run used, leaving legacy origins unknown.

nodes.name: _failure_row
nodes.summary: Builds the run's FailureRecord row for the self-improvement loop.

nodes.name: _write_row
nodes.summary: Appends the owed row to the failures file exactly once per run and clears it from state.

nodes.name: _review_end
nodes.summary: Ends the review-until-clean loop with findings above the patch review, then the row.

nodes.name: prepare
nodes.summary: Runs scouts before the fix at a session's first task when configured, returning what the agent is told.

nodes.name: settle
nodes.summary: Delivers every failure row any run still owes.

nodes.name: advance
nodes.summary: One hook step of the loop for the working tree against base, with session locking.

nodes.name: _advance_inner
nodes.summary: One loop step with the session held: reads state, runs probes or reviews, and decides continue, stop or wait.

nodes.name: patch_result
nodes.summary: Reads every patch run: an observed failure decides; anything short of all passes prevents support.

nodes.name: normal_reading
nodes.summary: Single reading that decides enforcement and every issuer summary.

nodes.name: record_error
nodes.summary: Appends a failed step's outcome without altering earlier observations.

nodes.name: run
nodes.summary: Runs each confirmed expectation of the standard as its example.v1 check on the patch and returns one result each.

nodes.name: Unconfirmed
nodes.summary: ValueError meaning nothing was confirmed.

nodes.name: ContradictsStandard
nodes.summary: ValueError raised when an expectation contradicts the standard and must start a superseding standard.

nodes.name: normative
nodes.summary: Whether a provenance may be normative; a model's hypothesis never is.

nodes.name: _Field
nodes.summary: Descriptor exposing a record field as a fresh decoded copy and refusing assignment.

nodes.name: _Record
nodes.summary: Base for canonical-JSON-backed records with equality, hashing and pickling by bytes.

nodes.name: _shown
nodes.summary: Validates that a record is a question G6 shows: outcomes of its own scenario, scope, citation and artefact digest.

nodes.name: Question
nodes.summary: A behaviour question record G6 made, held as canonical JSON bytes with its digest and options.

nodes.name: Answer
nodes.summary: What the person chose for one question, held as canonical JSON bytes.

nodes.name: ConfirmedExpectation
nodes.summary: A person's confirmed answer binding question and answer bytes to one derived example.v1 check.

nodes.name: confirm
nodes.summary: Builds the expectation a person's chosen option confirms, or raises Unconfirmed.

nodes.name: latest_confirmed
nodes.summary: Returns the last recorded confirmation per called scenario, by record order.

nodes.name: ExpectationStandard
nodes.summary: Immutable standard of confirmed expectations with revision and supersession, exposing predicates and facts.

nodes.name: Scenario
nodes.summary: Immutable executable scenario that resolves names, builds its interpreter program and comparison, digests it and runs admission checks.

nodes.name: save
nodes.summary: Persists a scenario record.

nodes.name: load
nodes.summary: Loads a stored scenario record, refusing missing or invalid ones.

nodes.name: Memory
nodes.summary: SQLite store of failed checks, failing outputs, runs and evaluations with query helpers for failure counts.

nodes.name: observable_exception
nodes.summary: Decides whether an exception type, including BaseException subclasses, is observable when raised by the call.

nodes.name: _issuer
nodes.summary: Renders the evidence issuer's reading of a requirement with its checks' evidence kinds.

nodes.name: code
nodes.summary: Renders a value as one inert Markdown code span, cut and fenced so nothing is read as Markdown or HTML.

nodes.name: _findings
nodes.summary: Renders reproduced findings, integrity problems first, then each failed check with its requirement.

nodes.name: _base_words
nodes.summary: Explains what the stated checks' run at the base commit shows about exercising the change.

nodes.name: _steps
nodes.summary: Renders the next steps section of the report.

nodes.name: _confirmed
nodes.summary: Renders each expectation the person confirmed, as the behaviour form shows it.

nodes.name: render
nodes.summary: Renders the full report from an assessment's decided fields alone.

nodes.name: _loop_lines
nodes.summary: Renders what the completion loop's probes did without claiming the patch is right.

nodes.name: findings
nodes.summary: Splits review findings into fixed and still open across runs.

nodes.name: _review_lines
nodes.summary: Renders what the review-until-clean loop found, fixed and left open.

nodes.name: completion_report
nodes.summary: Builds the completion loop's report above the patch review it stopped on.

nodes.name: safe_render
nodes.summary: Renders the report or a fallback line when rendering fails.

nodes.name: Requirement
nodes.summary: Pydantic model of a stated requirement with id, text, checks, provenance and kind.

nodes.name: GateAdapterInput
nodes.summary: Pydantic input model for the coding gate adapter.

nodes.name: GateAdapter
nodes.summary: AIBlock mapping G6's own test runs to the coding gate's evidence items, each citing its receipt.

nodes.name: _runner_changes
nodes.summary: Finds changed test-runner configuration files and pytest sections.

nodes.name: _inputs
nodes.summary: Normalises requirements, intent assumptions, proposed checks, template instances and search settings.

nodes.name: phases_of
nodes.summary: Immutable per-phase reading of a run's test outcomes.

nodes.name: body_of
nodes.summary: Yields a body result only for a complete, ordered phase pattern.

nodes.name: observation
nodes.summary: Translates one check's verdict entry into what the issuer reads.

nodes.name: at_base_observations
nodes.summary: Each stated check's observation in the run at the base commit.

nodes.name: _verdicts
nodes.summary: Derives each check's verdict in one run from pytest per-test outcomes by phase.

nodes.name: _requirement
nodes.summary: Computes a requirement's status from its stated and structural checks.

nodes.name: _diff_files
nodes.summary: Splits a diff text into per-file parts with old and new paths.

nodes.name: review_patch
nodes.summary: Public entry: assesses the working tree's patch against base on stated requirements and returns one outcome; never accepts claimed results or authorises a merge.

nodes.name: _assess
nodes.summary: The main assessment pipeline: integrity, confined runs, verification search, formal path, confirmed expectations and outcome decision.

nodes.name: _run_again
nodes.summary: Re-runs new-behaviour checks that passed on the patch and failed at base, as the issuer's control.

nodes.name: _at_base
nodes.summary: Runs the passed stated checks against the base commit's code to see whether they exercise the change.

nodes.name: _on_base
nodes.summary: Replays failing derived test files at base: a defect only when it passed there.

nodes.name: _reply
nodes.summary: Builds the review reply envelope with assessment, requirement evidence, confirmed evidence and report.

nodes.name: StoreUnreadable
nodes.summary: Error for a task store whose chain does not check out or cannot be opened.

nodes.name: AnswerRefused
nodes.summary: ValueError for an answer to an unasked or already answered question.

nodes.name: BudgetSpent
nodes.summary: ValueError when no question is left in the task's budget.

nodes.name: task_identity
nodes.summary: Digest of the repository's resolved top folder and the task text.

nodes.name: default_budget
nodes.summary: Reads G6_QUESTIONS_PER_TASK, refusing unreadable values.

nodes.name: _kind_rules
nodes.summary: Validation rules for each ledger entry kind given the entries before it.

nodes.name: Asked
nodes.summary: A question G6 asked: case record, rule, candidate, time and number on the task.

nodes.name: State
nodes.summary: Snapshot of a task's store: asked questions, answers, showings, extra allowance and budget.

nodes.name: TaskQuestions
nodes.summary: One task's hash-chained question store: ask, show, answer, reserve and allow more under a lock.

nodes.name: evaluate_cases
nodes.summary: Reserves held-out cases after freezing checks and runs candidate and baseline executors on them.

nodes.name: readiness_report
nodes.summary: Reports readiness from the latest standard and latest paired case batch only.

nodes.name: observed_runs
nodes.summary: Lists the other patch runs that observed stated checks with each check's verdict.

nodes.name: positions
nodes.summary: Ledger positions of the base-commit run and the run again.

nodes.name: standard_sha256
nodes.summary: Digest of the review's standard from each assessed requirement as stated.

nodes.name: records_for
nodes.summary: Builds the issuer's mission facts, artefact and one source record per check and observing run.

nodes.name: _not_counted
nodes.summary: Explains in words why the issuer does not count a requirement.

nodes.name: codes
nodes.summary: Reads the issuer's own codes for an uncounted predicate from structured fields.

nodes.name: assess
nodes.summary: Produces assessment.requirement_evidence: the issuer's certificate and each requirement's statement.

nodes.name: _confirmed_not_counted
nodes.summary: Explains why the issuer does not count a confirmed expectation.

nodes.name: confirmed_evidence
nodes.summary: Issues a certificate statement for each confirmed expectation under the expectation standard.

nodes.name: StandardSuperseded
nodes.summary: RuntimeError raised when the task no longer requires the standard the review ran.

nodes.name: observing
nodes.summary: Context manager installing the task-store guard for the executing review.

nodes.name: counting
nodes.summary: Context manager holding the current task standard through evidence issuance.

nodes.name: Experiment
nodes.summary: One schedulable check experiment with cost, severity and hypotheses.

nodes.name: RunObservation
nodes.summary: One confined run as its record says: digests, outcome, isolation backend, network flag and receipt.

nodes.name: from_run
nodes.summary: Builds an observation from a repo_tests run record, never from caller claims.

nodes.name: receipt_matches
nodes.summary: Whether G6's receipt store holds the receipt for the artifact digest.

nodes.name: ExperimentState
nodes.summary: Scheduler state: artifact, checker and environment digests, budget, open hypotheses and observations.

nodes.name: next_experiment
nodes.summary: Greedy selection by severity-weighted new coverage per cost with stable tie-break.

nodes.name: reduce_observation
nodes.summary: Keeps or refuses an observation by digest binding, isolation, network and receipt checks.

nodes.name: order_checks
nodes.summary: Orders review checks the way the selector would run them.

nodes.name: rebase
nodes.summary: Moves old observations to history when the artifact changes.

nodes.name: Formal
nodes.summary: Record of the formal path: one record per state_invariant.v1 instance and each symbolic search.

nodes.name: _bounded
nodes.summary: Bounded model checking of the invariant with each found trace excluded on re-asks.

nodes.name: _induction
nodes.summary: Inductive proof attempt of the invariant restricted to mapped actions.

nodes.name: _judge
nodes.summary: Reads a replay's results to name traces that broke the invariants on the real code.

nodes.name: run
nodes.summary: Runs obligations, search and replay compilation for each applicable state_invariant.v1 instance, then symbolic searches.

nodes.name: _relation_search
nodes.summary: Builds spec, candidate and domain for a relation instance on the patch's function.

nodes.name: _symbolic
nodes.summary: Runs Z3Verifier on relation and differential instances and compiles counterexamples into confined re-run checks.

nodes.name: symbolic_id
nodes.summary: Collision-free reserved id for an instance's symbolic re-run.

nodes.name: finish
nodes.summary: Fills each replay's correspondence from its run into records, activities and defects.

nodes.name: annotate
nodes.summary: Marks requirements named by model-only results without changing their status.

nodes.name: RepositoryContext
nodes.summary: The repository context every proposer request holds: requirements, diff and changed files, cut to fit.

nodes.name: context
nodes.summary: Builds the size-bounded JSON repository context for the proposer.

nodes.name: repository_context
nodes.summary: Builds the proposer's context for a repository against base on its own.

nodes.name: OverLimit
nodes.summary: LLMError for a request or reply past one call's size limit.

nodes.name: _Limits
nodes.summary: Wraps the model caller to enforce input and output limits and keep every attempt.

nodes.name: Proposals
nodes.summary: What the proposer added: template instances, free-form checks, questions, activities and exchanges.

nodes.name: default_caller
