nodes.summary: Returns the default model caller for the proposer.

nodes.name: _state_schema
nodes.summary: The state_invariant.v1 bindings schema as the proposer shows it.

nodes.name: boundary
nodes.summary: Explains why no operating-system boundary can confine proposed checks, or empty when one can.

nodes.name: Proposer
nodes.summary: One review's proposer: asks a model for templates, instances, scenarios and checks under strict schemas, recording refusals.

nodes.name: _RecordedMessages
nodes.summary: Messages wrapper recording each response's usage and model.

nodes.name: RecordingClient
nodes.summary: Anthropic client wrapper with recorded messages and no beta surface.

nodes.name: StudyCaller
nodes.summary: Caller used by the V10 study arms: an unchanged AnthropicCaller without fallbacks on a recording client.

nodes.name: verification_search.py
nodes.summary: Verification search for G6's patch review: maps a caller's intent contract onto review requirements, validates and places caller-proposed checks, runs each confined at the base commit and on the patch, classifies results, measures test adequacy by mutation and builds the completion report every reply carries.

nodes.name: verification_templates.py
nodes.summary: Verification search part 3: reviewed, versioned higher-order check templates (example, relation, access rule, differential, state invariant, forbidden dependency) whose data-only instances are validated, resolved statically against the tree under review and compiled into pytest checks or a static import-contract check.
nodes.languageNotes: Templates embed pytest source as fixed text and inject bindings as one ascii literal; names are resolved by reading module ASTs, never importing the tree under review.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package marker for the workflow record (design section 17): documents that G6 keeps a local, per-project record of its own review activity and reports outcome, obstacle, next check and its own cost, with no model or network calls.

nodes.name: _store.py
nodes.summary: One hash-chained, lock-guarded file of the workflow record: admits writes only when the record is switched on, refuses links and truncated chains, and offers whole-file writes and entry-level deletion.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a contextmanager-held sidecar lock plus a kept head hash so a truncated hash chain is detected as unreadable.

nodes.name: adapters.py
nodes.summary: Adapters that write event boundaries from G6's own review, loop, step, tool-call and dialog paths into the workflow record, swallowing their own failures so recording never changes or slows a review.

nodes.name: decisions.py
nodes.summary: Durable store of the person's adopt, dismiss and reopen decisions about suggestions, keyed by intervention identity, with the fixed reasons a dismissed intervention is shown again.

nodes.name: diagnose.py
nodes.summary: Coding-workflow diagnosis adapter that names constraint hypotheses only from observed blocking dependencies or repeated patterns, always with an alternative explanation and a discriminating check, records predictions and reassesses them later.

nodes.name: feedback.py
nodes.summary: Optional feedback question flow: opt-in handling, volunteered feedback, a weekly per-project invitation reserved before the dialog opens, and the rules that decide when G6 may ask 'Did this make your work easier?'.

nodes.name: friction.py
nodes.summary: Counts G6's own friction on a task from its recorded events (questions, form time, approvals, tool calls and retries, provider calls, wall and waiting time), leaving unobserved values as None and naming them missing.

nodes.name: lifecycle.py
nodes.summary: Local inspection export, person-written corrections, policy-driven expiry and deletion of a project's workflow record, leaving minimal deletion receipts and never altering recorded events.

nodes.name: manifest.py
nodes.summary: Frozen decision manifest for section 17 measurements: lists what blocks a manifest, freezes it to a digest, and decides admit, repair or hold per row from results using point or exact binomial thresholds.

nodes.name: obstacle.py
nodes.summary: Derives the person's stated outcome and the receipt-backed obstacles G6 can show (failing accepted check, integrity block, pending question, refused run, unsent review), and offers one bounded next check.

nodes.name: policy.py
nodes.summary: The workflow record's storage policy: retention days per file kind, receipt fields, every file name the record uses, deletion semantics, and the environment switch that turns collection on.

nodes.name: record.py
nodes.summary: Project-scoped, hash-chained workflow record under the G6 home: identities for project, task, run and event, the Event and Ref models that hold only codes, counts, times and digests, and the ProjectRecord store.

nodes.name: SKILL.md
nodes.summary: Agent skill for the g6-workflow record: explains what the local record holds and does not hold, how it is switched on, and the rules an agent must follow when inspecting, correcting or deleting it.

nodes.name: suggest.py
nodes.summary: Suggestion policy producing zero to three optional actions in a published fixed order (receipt-backed actions, discriminating checks, do nothing), each with a wording-independent intervention identity.

nodes.name: view.py
nodes.summary: The narrow view appended after the mandatory review report: stated outcome, one obstacle or 'observation is insufficient', a next check, suggestions, feedback eligibility and G6's own cost, gated by view level and consent.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Family package marker for the integrations extensions that talk to outside systems such as databases, queues and model routers; the family itself is not a component.

nodes.name: _boundary.py
nodes.summary: Shared boundary helpers for integration extensions: a Refusal error with code and action, a JSON value validator with node, string and size budgets, and a reply builder.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Component registration for the RQ integration: exposes AdaptRQBlock, RQInput and register_function and declares the component's mitigated and introduced failure modes, sensitive ops, outside programs and extras.

nodes.name: _payload.py
nodes.summary: Bounded reads of RQ job records from Redis that avoid RQ's unrestricted restore path: size-capped decompression, hash reads, job parsing, recovery validation and safe result decoding.

nodes.name: block.py
nodes.summary: AdaptRQBlock, the G6 component for an operator-owned Redis queue: enqueues only operator-registered functions with JSON arguments, reports job and worker status, and recovers failed jobs, dry-run by default.
nodes.languageNotes: Pydantic models with extra='forbid' and model validators bound every input before any Redis call.

nodes.name: config.py
nodes.summary: Operator-side registration of trusted importable functions for RQ jobs, outside-program declarations for Redis and the worker, and lazy loading of the optional rq and redis modules.

nodes.name: SKILL.md
nodes.summary: Agent skill for the g6-adapt-rq integration: when to use and not use the bounded RQ client, its nine ops, and the operator setup it depends on.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package entry for the database integration: documents the six operator-declared database ops (query, explain, execute, list_tables, describe_table, get_schema) and re-exports its modules.

nodes.name: IntentMapping
nodes.summary: Result holder for intent mapping: the caller's then the intent's requirements, scope assumptions, and unknowns.

nodes.name: intent_contract
nodes.summary: Parses a value into an IntentContract, refusing unknown fields so a misspelt field cannot silently drop an obligation.

nodes.name: requirements_from_intent
nodes.summary: Maps an intent contract's success criteria, non-goals and failure criteria onto review requirements, merging duplicates and naming unmapped fields as unknowns.

nodes.name: ProposedCheck
nodes.summary: Pydantic model of a caller-proposed check: id, requirement id, intent, file, source and test.

nodes.name: _file_problem
nodes.summary: Returns why a proposed check's file path is not allowed (conftest, config, path traversal, excluded folders), or empty when it is.

nodes.name: proposed_checks
nodes.summary: Validates the review's proposed checks against limits and normative requirement ids, raising a ValueError naming the offending check.

nodes.name: placements
nodes.summary: Computes each check's hash-named placement folder in the copies, refusing links, files or existing folders on the way.

nodes.name: reproduce
nodes.summary: Builds the plain pytest command that reproduces one of G6's confined runs of a check from the top of a tree copy.

nodes.name: ExecutionSnapshot
nodes.summary: Dict subclass holding the sparse snapshot plus a separately versioned full executable-byte record of the change.

nodes.name: _copy_manifest
nodes.summary: Records the raw bytes of every file a review copy will execute, before any execution, under the review deadline.

nodes.name: _run_check
nodes.summary: Runs one check confined in a scratch copy either on the patch or at the base commit, choosing the ordinary executor or G6's observation runner.

nodes.name: reading
nodes.summary: Interprets one run of a check into passed, failed, error or not-run, with failure detail, refused-access and collection-error handling.

nodes.name: _differences
nodes.summary: Lists the inputs a probe observed differently at the base commit and on the patch, as canonical JSON text.

nodes.name: _stable
nodes.summary: Removes probe differences that the base commit itself reproduced inconsistently on a second run.

nodes.name: classify
nodes.summary: Combines a check's runs on the patch and at base with its intent into a single result and detail.

nodes.name: Origin
nodes.summary: Describes where a searched check came from: a free-form caller proposal or a template instance.

nodes.name: search
nodes.summary: Runs every proposed check twice under the review deadline, on the patched tree and at the base commit, and collects activities, findings and questions.

nodes.name: _guarded
nodes.summary: Turns a run into an error when it loaded a module the change touches from outside the tested tree, otherwise returns its reading.

nodes.name: _found
nodes.summary: Builds a finding's reason, reproduction and next action, or a question when a check also fails at base.

nodes.name: annotate
nodes.summary: Attaches proposed checks and their results to the requirements they name without changing requirement status.

nodes.name: search_config
nodes.summary: Validates the review's search settings with defaults for search and proposer options.

nodes.name: _run_mutant
nodes.summary: Runs selected tests confined and offline against a scratch copy with one module replaced by a mutant.

nodes.name: measure_adequacy
nodes.summary: Measures how adequate the requirement tests are by running them against mutants of the changed code.

nodes.name: completion
nodes.summary: Assembles the completion report every review reply carries from evaluated requirements, receipts, runs, skipped work and defects.

nodes.name: Inapplicable
nodes.summary: Exception raised when the tree under review gives a template instance nothing to apply to.

nodes.name: literal_problem
nodes.summary: Explains why a value is not JSON data a template binding may hold, or returns empty.

nodes.name: RelationBindings
nodes.summary: Bindings model for relation.v1: function, inputs and a metamorphic relation such as round trip, idempotence, invariance or monotonicity.

nodes.name: AccessBindings
nodes.summary: Bindings model for single-step access_rule.v1: allowed and refused request cases and the refusal form.

nodes.name: StateInvariantBindings
nodes.summary: Bindings model for state_invariant.v1: constructor, abstract state model, operations, observations and the invariant.

nodes.name: AccessStepsBindings
nodes.summary: Bindings model for multi-step access_rule.v1: named grant, share and revoke steps checked as a state invariant.

nodes.name: access_model
nodes.summary: Converts multi-step access-rule bindings into the state_invariant.v1 bindings G6 models them as.

nodes.name: TemplateInstance
nodes.summary: Pydantic model of a data-only template instance with id, template, requirement id, intent, bindings and provenance.

nodes.name: Tree
nodes.summary: Read-only view of the tree under review from git's file listings on the working tree and base commit, never importing it.

nodes.name: _module_file
nodes.summary: Finds the file a dotted module name resolves to on a side, following the runs' import path order.

nodes.name: _top_level
nodes.summary: Finds the statement that last binds a name at a module's top level and whether a star import exists.

nodes.name: resolve
nodes.summary: Resolves a dotted binding name to a built-in or a top-level module name on a side, or raises Inapplicable.

nodes.name: _parameters
nodes.summary: Builds an inspect.Signature from a function's AST definition, optionally skipping the first parameter.

nodes.name: _signature
nodes.summary: Reads the parameters a call of a resolved target binds against, refusing asynchronous functions.

nodes.name: _example
nodes.summary: Applies example.v1 bindings to the tree: resolves names and checks each case's call arguments.

nodes.name: _relation
nodes.summary: Applies relation.v1 bindings to the tree, resolving the function and transformation names.

nodes.name: _replayable

nodes.name: _state_invariant

nodes.name: compile_text

nodes.name: TemplateDefinition

nodes.name: bindings_help
nodes.summary: Describes a template's bindings, required first, with one valid instance.

nodes.name: _refused_bindings
nodes.summary: Builds a BindingsRefused error listing missing and misnamed bindings with likely intended names.

nodes.name: template_instances
nodes.summary: Validates a review's template instances against their templates and normative requirement ids.

nodes.name: instance_digest
nodes.summary: Computes the SHA-256 that cites an instance from its template id, version, text digest and bindings.

nodes.name: Prepared
nodes.summary: A review's prepared template instances: compiled checks with placements and origins, structural instances and activities.

nodes.name: compiled_check
nodes.summary: Compiles one instance into a proposed check placed in the tree copy, with its origin.

nodes.name: prepare
nodes.summary: Checks each instance against the tree and compiles and places the applicable ones before anything runs.

nodes.name: _unsupported
nodes.summary: Lists import-linter configuration options G6 does not implement, which make an instance inapplicable.

nodes.name: _ini
nodes.summary: Parses an INI-style import-linter configuration into root packages, contracts and options.

nodes.name: _toml
nodes.summary: Parses a TOML import-linter configuration into root packages, contracts and options.

nodes.name: _declared
nodes.summary: Finds the first import-linter configuration on a side of the tree and what it holds.

nodes.name: _read_contracts
nodes.summary: Reads layers and forbidden contracts from an import-linter configuration whose options G6 implements.

nodes.name: _package_files

nodes.name: _matches
nodes.summary: Matches a dotted module name against an import-linter ignore pattern part by part.

nodes.name: _matched
nodes.summary: Finds the contract layers and forbidden pairs that match modules of an import graph, and unmatched prefixes.

nodes.name: _counted
nodes.summary: Collects the package imports a contract counts, by importing module in target and line order.

nodes.name: _reached
nodes.summary: Breadth-first search for modules reachable from a start through allowed modules, with the shortest import chain.

nodes.name: _breaches
nodes.summary: Computes a contract's breaches in an import graph and the prefixes it left out.

nodes.name: _unexercised
nodes.summary: Explains why a patch could not have broken a contract, so it is reported as vacuous.

nodes.name: structural
nodes.summary: Runs forbidden_dependency.v1 statically on base and working tree import graphs and reports the breaches the patch adds.

nodes.name: admit
nodes.summary: The record's on switch at the one place a workflow file is opened for writing; raises RecordOff when collection is off.

nodes.name: RecordOff
nodes.summary: Exception carrying G6_E_WORKFLOW_RECORD_OFF when the workflow record is switched off.

nodes.name: _Open

nodes.summary: Guard deciding that fewer than two lines were named, which produces a gap note.

nodes.name: category_fit
nodes.summary: Picks the first all-hours line whose remit categories overlap the fired categories, other than the one named first.

nodes.name: online_service
nodes.summary: Returns the first online-kind service for a region, or None.

nodes.name: _pick
nodes.summary: Chooses the services to name: the emergency line first, then all-hours phone lines up to the limit with a category fit, plus an online service.

nodes.name: named_services
nodes.summary: Returns the services named in a crisis response for a covered region view.

nodes.name: response_gaps
nodes.summary: Lists gaps in a region's named services, such as too few lines or no online service.

nodes.name: problematic_language
nodes.summary: Returns the register's problematic phrases that occur as whole words in the text.

nodes.name: stale_line
nodes.summary: Returns a sentence saying the shown numbers may be out of date when the directory or a source is past its review window, failing safe if the register cannot be read.

nodes.name: response
nodes.summary: Composes the safe-messaging crisis response: emergency call-now line, named services with how to reach them, staleness note, and help, hope and others-too sentences.

nodes.name: help_not_first
nodes.summary: Response check: true when the first line is not the call-now line naming the emergency service.

nodes.name: unreachable
nodes.summary: Response check: finds service lines that lack hours or a way to reach them.

nodes.name: outside_words
nodes.summary: Response check: returns words outside G6's reviewed vocabulary and the directory's own words.

nodes.name: listed_words
nodes.summary: Response check: re-runs the crisis scan over the response minus service names and looks for category names.

nodes.name: sensational
nodes.summary: Response check: true if the response holds an exclamation mark or the words suicide/suicidal outside service names.

nodes.name: no_seek_help
nodes.summary: Response check: true when the seek-help sentences are missing.

nodes.name: no_hope
nodes.summary: Response check: true when the hope sentence is missing.

nodes.name: no_others
nodes.summary: Response check: true when the sentence telling a worried person they can contact the services is missing.

nodes.name: response_problems
nodes.summary: Runs every response check on composed text and returns the names of those that fail.

nodes.name: _answer
nodes.summary: Composes the response, runs the response checks, and returns a blocked-escalated CareResult with the response, or withholds it with a response-refused code.

nodes.name: crisis_result
nodes.summary: Builds the crisis CareResult for an op: dated directory view, cited sources, stale note, named services and gaps, with the crisis code.

nodes.name: check_failed
nodes.summary: Builds the check-failed crisis result used when the trigger could not run, treating it as a possible crisis.

nodes.name: Match
nodes.summary: Frozen record of a crisis term matched in a field, with its category.

nodes.name: Excepted
nodes.summary: Frozen record of a term occurrence discounted because it sat inside an exception phrase.

nodes.name: CrisisFinding
nodes.summary: Result of a scan: whether it fired, the matches, excepted hits and fields scanned, with an evidence() view.

nodes.name: CrisisLock
nodes.summary: Per-run in-memory lock that keeps the first crisis record per subject and has no release method.

nodes.name: load
nodes.summary: Reads and parses the packaged directory.json.

nodes.name: emergency_first
nodes.summary: Sort key that is true for emergency-kind entries so they come first.

nodes.name: too_old
nodes.summary: Returns whether an entry's age exceeds the 180-day staleness window.

nodes.name: lookup
nodes.summary: Returns a region's (or every region's) entries, emergency first, with ages, a stale flag and a note covering stale and uncovered regions.

nodes.name: CareResult
nodes.summary: Frozen pydantic model of one duty-of-care op outcome carrying completion_state, warning_card, evidence, request_id and run_id; it has no verified state.

nodes.name: answer
nodes.summary: Builds a qualified-draft CareResult with an amber warning card naming what it rests on.

nodes.name: refuse
nodes.summary: Builds a blocked-escalated CareResult with its stable code, reason and blocked warning card.

nodes.name: get
nodes.summary: Loads one instrument's JSON definition by name.

nodes.name: catalogue
nodes.summary: Lists every shipped instrument with its licence state and the reason unsettled ones are refused.

nodes.name: licence_unsettled
nodes.summary: Guard returning whether an instrument's licence state is not settled.

nodes.name: to_a_person
nodes.summary: Returns the item rule (PHQ-9 item 9) that sends a non-zero answer to a person, or None.

nodes.name: unanswered
nodes.summary: Returns a missing-input or out-of-range code and reason when the answers do not fit the form, else None.

nodes.name: score
nodes.summary: Scores an instrument's responses as the form adds them, returning a ScoreOutcome that is a total, a refusal or a crisis.

nodes.name: ScoreOutcome
nodes.summary: Frozen outcome of scoring: kind (score, refused, crisis), instrument, code, reason, total, item scores and source.

nodes.name: Rule
nodes.summary: Frozen description of one rule the code applies: its source (register entry, caller, or G6), effect, level and implementing function.

nodes.name: register
nodes.summary: Loads the packaged source_register.json.

nodes.name: entries
nodes.summary: Returns the register's entries keyed by source id.

nodes.name: problematic_phrases
nodes.summary: Reads the language guide's problematic phrases from its register clause.

nodes.name: register_problems
nodes.summary: Checks register entries for missing fields, clause-hash mismatches, malformed SHA-256 digests and bad dates, and the rule table for unknown sources or own rules without an allowed effect.

nodes.name: stale_sources
nodes.summary: Returns findings for register entries past their review window as of a given date.

nodes.name: DutyOfCareInput
nodes.summary: Frozen pydantic input for a duty-of-care op (op, fields, instrument, responses, region, subject, run_id, request_id) that forbids unknown fields.

nodes.name: _Call
nodes.summary: What a crisis answer needs from a call: op, valid ids and covered region, with named() and ids() helpers.

nodes.name: _fire
nodes.summary: Engages the run lock when the call names a run and subject and returns the crisis result.

nodes.name: _flatten
nodes.summary: Walks raw parameters within depth, leaf and character bounds into scannable fields of keys and leaves, raising past the bounds.

nodes.name: _covered_region
nodes.summary: Normalises a raw region value to a covered region code or None.

nodes.name: _screen
nodes.summary: Handles the screen op: refuses missing fields, scans them, and answers no-listed-words or the crisis/check-failed result.

nodes.name: _score
nodes.summary: Handles the score op: refuses a missing instrument or unreadable data, and returns a score-computed answer, refusal or crisis result.

nodes.name: _instruments
nodes.summary: Handles the instruments op: lists instruments with licence states or refuses if data cannot be read.

nodes.name: _directory
nodes.summary: Handles the directory op: returns the dated directory view or refuses for unreadable data or an uncovered region.

nodes.name: DutyOfCareBlock
nodes.summary: Registered AIBlock component that runs screen_raw before typed validation (crisis lock, raw crisis scan, raw PHQ-9 item 9) and then dispatches ops; never returns verified.

nodes.name: _edited
nodes.summary: Applies a case's edit (swap, move or drop lines, drop a rule sentence, strip hours or reach, add words) to a composed response.

nodes.name: _named
nodes.summary: Observes the named-lines guards (few_services, online_service, category_fit) through the directory lookup and named services.

nodes.name: _held
nodes.summary: Rearranges a region's directory entries as a case says (reversed, emergency second, or without the emergency number), leaving other regions as held.

nodes.name: _emergency_first
nodes.summary: Observes the emergency_first guard by temporarily swapping directory.load for a rearranged copy and checking whether lookup still puts an emergency entry first.

nodes.name: evaluate
nodes.summary: Certificate entry point: dispatches a rule and input to the implementing function and returns its numeric observation.

nodes.name: falsify.py
nodes.summary: Property-test generator for the duty_of_care certificate: seeds PHQ-9 and GAD-7 answer vectors (valid, short, off-scale, overlong, with an item raised by one) and states the invariants the scorer must hold, including the item-9 crisis result (-2) and refusal (-1).

nodes.name: generate
nodes.summary: Produces a seeded list of PHQ-9 or GAD-7 answer cases cycling through valid, missing, off-scale and overlong vectors, optionally naming an answered item to raise by one.

nodes.name: invariant
nodes.summary: Checks an observed scorer value against the form rules: the total equals the item sum within range, crisis and refusal codes are returned where due, and raising one item raises the total by exactly one.

nodes.name: scope.json
nodes.summary: The duty_of_care certificate's scope statement: a not_checked list of everything its checks do not cover, from the lack of qualified clinical review and the crisis trigger's whole-word limits to the PHQ-9/GAD-7 property-check encoding and the in-memory crisis lock.

nodes.name: second_route.py
nodes.summary: An independent second implementation of the PHQ-9 and GAD-7 totals written from the forms alone with no imports, used by the certificate to cross-check the shipped scorer (crisis -2, refusal -1).

nodes.name: outcome
nodes.summary: Returns the item-sum total for one answer list, or the crisis code when PHQ-9 item 9 is non-zero, or the refusal code for a wrong count or an off-scale answer.

nodes.name: evaluate
nodes.summary: Certificate entry point that scores a case's answers and, when the case names an item to raise, also scores the raised vector and returns both.

nodes.name: SKILL.md
nodes.summary: Agent skill for the duty_of_care job: screening a person's words for a fixed list of English crisis phrases (blocked-escalated with G6_E_DUTY_OF_CARE_CRISIS), PHQ-9/GAD-7 scoring as the form prints it, and a dated helpline directory, with ops, composition, failure modes, blind spots and examples.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package marker for the knowledge family of extensions (fetch, convert, chunk, index and search documents, treating retrieved text as data); declares __g6_family__ and is not itself a component.

nodes.name: _html.py
nodes.summary: Standard-library HTML-to-text reader for the knowledge family: turns a page into the paragraphs a person would see, skipping hidden elements, closing implied tags, and reporting what it could not read.
nodes.languageNotes: Subclasses html.parser.HTMLParser and keeps its own element stack to model implied end tags without a third-party parser.

nodes.name: _Reader
nodes.summary: HTMLParser subclass that tracks an element stack, implied closes and hidden subtrees, accumulates visible text into blocks, collects the title and lists dropped content.

nodes.name: read_html
nodes.summary: Feeds HTML to the reader and returns the title, the visible text as paragraphs, and what was left unread.

nodes.name: html_to_text
nodes.summary: Convenience wrapper returning only the readable text of an HTML page.

nodes.name: _index.py
nodes.summary: Shared index contract for the knowledge family: the Hit and Searched result types with typed outcomes (ok, empty, unavailable, failed), the Index protocol and Retrieves mixin that make every index a g6.grounding retriever, and the IndexBackends registry that discovers backends by name.
nodes.languageNotes: Backend discovery reads each package's __g6_index_backends__ literal with ast.literal_eval before importing it, so no member imports another to find its backend.

nodes.name: IndexRefused
nodes.summary: Exception raised when an index backend cannot be opened, carrying a code and details.

nodes.name: Hit
nodes.summary: One passage a search found with its score, the scale that score is on and its rank; converts to a g6.grounding passage.

nodes.name: Searched
nodes.summary: Typed search outcome (ok, empty, unavailable, failed) with hits, reason, counts searched and total, and evidence, so a backend failure is never reported as no match.

nodes.name: Added
nodes.summary: Result of adding passages to an index: ids added, ids already known and evidence.

nodes.name: Removed
nodes.summary: Result of removing passages: ids removed and ids missing.

nodes.name: IndexUnavailable
nodes.summary: Runtime error raised by search when a backend did not answer, so a retriever's empty list always means nothing matched.

nodes.name: Index
nodes.summary: Protocol every index backend implements: add, find, search, remove and status, plus backend name and score scale.

nodes.name: Retrieves
nodes.summary: Mixin giving an index the g6.grounding retriever search method on top of find, raising IndexUnavailable for a backend that did not answer.

nodes.name: bad_k
nodes.summary: Validates top_k and returns a failed Searched outcome when it is not a positive integer, else None.

nodes.name: ranked
nodes.summary: Sorts scored passages best first and wraps the top_k as ranked Hit objects on the given scale.

nodes.name: IndexBackend
nodes.summary: Description of an index backend (summary, scale, local or network, persistent, writable, readiness) with an opener for an index on it.

nodes.name: declares_backends
nodes.summary: Reads a package's __init__ source with ast to find its literal __g6_index_backends__ names without importing it.

nodes.name: IndexBackends
nodes.summary: Registry of index backends by name: lazily discovers declaring packages through the component registry, registers, describes and opens backends, refusing unknown or unready ones.

nodes.name: _reply.py
nodes.summary: Builds the reply every knowledge op returns inside the cross-surface envelope (completion_state, warning_card, evidence, request_id, run_id), as a qualified answer with an amber warning card naming untrusted-text risks or a blocked refusal with a G6_E_* code.

nodes.name: answer
nodes.summary: Composes a successful knowledge reply with an amber warning card whose risks note instruction-like signals found in the returned texts.

nodes.name: refuse
nodes.summary: Composes a blocked refusal reply with a warning card carrying a validated G6_E_* code, message and suggested action.

nodes.name: _store.py
nodes.summary: Content-addressed byte store for the knowledge family under $G6_HOME/knowledge/fetched/<sha256>, written atomically and read back only when the bytes still hash to their name, with a side record of where and when each body was fetched.

nodes.name: KeptError
nodes.summary: ValueError raised for a bad hash name or a kept body whose bytes no longer match it.

nodes.name: KeptOriginError
nodes.summary: KeptError subclass for problems with a kept body's origin record.

nodes.name: kept_path
nodes.summary: Validates a SHA-256 hex name and returns its path under the state folder.

nodes.name: _write
nodes.summary: Writes bytes atomically through a temp file and os.replace, removing the temp on failure.

nodes.name: keep
nodes.summary: Stores bytes under their SHA-256 (once) and appends the fetch origin (final URL, requested URL, time) to the origins record; returns the hash.

nodes.name: origins
nodes.summary: Reads and validates the list of fetch origins recorded for a kept body.

nodes.name: kept
nodes.summary: Returns a kept body's bytes, None when absent, or raises KeptError when its bytes no longer hash to its name.

nodes.name: _types.py
nodes.summary: Shared data model of the knowledge family: Source (where text came from, hashed and dated), Document and Passage (exact spans with ids bound to their source), both marked untrusted, plus hashing, timestamp and untrusted-text helpers.
nodes.languageNotes: Pydantic validators bind each Passage id to a hash of its source, document and offsets, and forbid trust from being passed in as input.

nodes.name: sha256_hex
nodes.summary: Hex SHA-256 of bytes or UTF-8 text.

nodes.name: now
nodes.summary: Current UTC instant formatted to the family's fixed second-precision string.

nodes.name: instant
nodes.summary: Parses the family's instant string into an aware datetime, rejecting other formats.

nodes.name: Source
nodes.summary: Pydantic model of where text came from: URI, SHA-256, retrieval time, provenance, licence and publication date, with a constructor from bytes.

nodes.name: _Untrusted
nodes.summary: Base model that fixes trust to untrusted and refuses any trust value supplied as input.

nodes.name: passage_id
nodes.summary: Deterministic passage id: SHA-256 over source, document hash and start/end offsets.

nodes.name: Passage
nodes.summary: Untrusted span of a document with exact offsets whose id must match its source and span; converts to a g6.grounding passage.

nodes.name: Document
nodes.summary: Untrusted converted text with its Source, media type, converter and unread parts, whose hash must match its text; cuts passages by offset.

nodes.name: passage_problems
nodes.summary: Lists ways a passage does not match a document (id, hash or text at its offsets).

nodes.name: untrusted_note
nodes.summary: Returns a note when a text carries instruction-like signals per the grounding tripwire, for warning cards.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package entry for the ctx_colbert extension: ranks one call's passages by meaning down a ladder of rungs (ColBERT, sentence embeddings, BM25), declares component metadata (block, sensitive ops, extras, failure-mode codes) and the colbert index backend.

nodes.name: block.py
nodes.summary: CtxColbertBlock, the registry and MCP door to ctx_colbert: validates search and rungs ops, builds a corpus from passed passages or texts, ranks them, and replies in the envelope naming the rung used and refusing BM25 when dense ranking is required.

nodes.name: CtxColbertInput
nodes.summary: Pydantic input for ctx_colbert ops: query, passages or texts, top_k, preferred rung, requires_dense, request_id and run_id.

nodes.name: _search
nodes.summary: Runs a search op: refuses empty queries or corpora over the size limit, ranks the corpus, refuses a lexical-only answer when dense is required, and returns hits with rung and skipped-rung evidence.

nodes.name: CtxColbertBlock
nodes.summary: AIBlock subclass that dispatches ctx_colbert ops through its ops table and returns envelope results.

nodes.name: persistent.py
nodes.summary: Persistent ColBERT index (design 12.3): token vectors in SQLite keyed by passage id and pinned to one model, added incrementally in transactional batches under a memory limit, and scored by late interaction over a bounded candidate set, with a named BM25 lexical fallback.
nodes.languageNotes: Vectors are packed with struct into SQLite blobs; the encoder is injected as a Protocol so the store is independent of the library route chosen.

nodes.name: Encoder
nodes.summary: Protocol for the injected token-vector encoder: readiness and encode.

nodes.name: maxsim
nodes.summary: Late-interaction score: sum over query tokens of the best dot product with any passage token.

nodes.name: PersistentColbertIndex
nodes.summary: Retrieves-based index keeping ColBERT token vectors in SQLite under a model pin; adds only new passages in batches, refuses oversized candidate sets, and reports unavailable when the encoder cannot run.

nodes.name: lexical_fallback
nodes.summary: Ranks passages with the BM25 rung, labelled as a lexical fallback and never as meaning.

nodes.name: open_for
nodes.summary: Opens a PersistentColbertIndex for a store path, pin and encoder.

nodes.name: readiness.py
nodes.summary: Model pinning and readiness for a persistent ColBERT store (design 12.3): the ModelPin a store is bound to, file hashing, and a check of whether this machine holds the pinned model files to run it.

nodes.name: ModelPin
nodes.summary: Pydantic record of the model a store is pinned to, with a stable digest.

nodes.name: file_sha256
nodes.summary: Streams a file to compute its SHA-256.

nodes.name: ready
nodes.summary: Checks that the pinned model's files exist locally with matching hashes and returns why not when they do not.

nodes.name: retrieve.py
nodes.summary: Ranks one call's passages down the ladder of rungs, recording which rung ranked and why others were skipped, and provides the in-memory colbert index backend over that ranking.

nodes.name: Ranked
nodes.summary: Result of a ranking: the Searched outcome, the rung that ranked and the rungs skipped with reasons.

nodes.name: rank
nodes.summary: Tries the requested or default rungs in order, skips ones not ready, refuses non-finite scores, and returns ranked hits on the winning rung's scale, or a refusal when dense ranking is required but only BM25 is available.

nodes.name: ColbertIndex
nodes.summary: In-memory Retrieves index backend holding passages for one object and ranking them with rank on find.

nodes.name: rungs.py
nodes.summary: Registry of ranking rungs for ctx_colbert: ColBERT late interaction via PyLate, sentence embeddings, and g6.grounding BM25, each reporting readiness without loading or downloading; dense rungs accept only complete safetensors weights already in the Hugging Face cache.
nodes.languageNotes: Refuses pickle weight formats and loads with local_files_only and use_safetensors so the library is never asked to fetch or unpickle.

nodes.name: Weights
nodes.summary: Describes a model repository's expected weights (repo, files, minimum size, licence) and how to get or convert them.

nodes.name: RungUnavailable
nodes.summary: Runtime error raised when a rung cannot score.

nodes.name: hub_cache
nodes.summary: Locates the person's Hugging Face hub cache folder.

nodes.name: cached
nodes.summary: Finds a complete safetensors snapshot of a repository in the local cache, rejecting incomplete downloads, undersized files and pickle-only weights, and says why when not found.

nodes.name: maxsim
nodes.summary: ColBERT maxsim: sum over query token vectors of the best cosine with any passage token vector.

nodes.name: Rung
nodes.summary: Protocol for a ranking rung: name, scale, ready() and score().

nodes.name: ColbertRung
nodes.summary: Rung scoring by PyLate ColBERT token vectors and maxsim from cached colbertv2.0 weights.

nodes.name: EmbeddingsRung
nodes.summary: Rung scoring by sentence-transformers cosine similarity from cached all-MiniLM-L6-v2 weights.

nodes.name: Bm25Rung
nodes.summary: Always-available lexical rung scoring with g6.grounding's BM25 TextRetriever.

nodes.name: Rungs
nodes.summary: Name-keyed registry of rungs with register, unregister, get, names and readiness descriptions.

nodes.name: finite
nodes.summary: True when a score is a finite number.

nodes.name: SKILL.md
nodes.summary: Agent skill for ctx_colbert ranking: when to rank passages by meaning, the search and rungs ops, how to read which rung ranked, failure modes, blind spots, required extras and cached weights, and examples.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package entry for the ctx_contexthub extension: keeps a named documentation registry with per-document retrieval dates and time to live, refusing stale copies; declares component metadata (mitigates stale_context_used, introduces prompt_injection).

nodes.name: block.py
nodes.summary: CtxContexthubBlock, the registry and MCP door to documentation registries: dispatches sync, search, get, notes, note and registries ops to the hub and wraps results in the envelope, refusing documents past their time to live.

nodes.name: CtxContexthubInput
nodes.summary: Pydantic input for ctx_contexthub ops: registry name, source address or folder, query, document id, note text, time to live and ids.

nodes.name: _sync
nodes.summary: Runs the sync op through the hub and reports documents read, kept and stale.

nodes.name: _search
nodes.summary: Runs a BM25 search over a registry's kept entries and returns them with their dates.

nodes.name: _get
nodes.summary: Returns one kept document and its separate notes, refusing a copy past its time to live and flagging instruction-like text.

nodes.name: CtxContexthubBlock
nodes.summary: AIBlock subclass that routes ctx_contexthub ops through its action table and converts HubError into refusals.

nodes.name: hub.py
nodes.summary: Documentation registry as a source: reads a context-hub registry.json and DOC.md files from a named address (through knowledge_fetcher's guarded fetch) or folder, keeps each document with its retrieved_at and time to live under the state folder, and serves BM25 search, freshness-checked get and separate caller notes.

nodes.name: HubError
nodes.summary: Exception carrying a G6_E_* code and details for registry failures.

nodes.name: clock
nodes.summary: Current UTC time, patchable for tests.

nodes.name: Read
nodes.summary: One thing read from a source: its bytes as text and its Source record.

nodes.name: fetch_through_fetcher
nodes.summary: Fetches an address via the registered knowledge_fetcher component (checked redirects, private addresses refused, body cap) and returns a Read or a HubError.

nodes.name: read_folder
nodes.summary: Reads a file from a local registry folder, refusing paths that escape it.

nodes.name: locate
nodes.summary: Resolves a registry address or folder and returns the reader for its files.

nodes.name: Target
nodes.summary: Where a registry lives: address or folder and the reader for it.

nodes.name: Entry
nodes.summary: One registry entry: id, name, tags, description, version and document path.

nodes.name: _write
nodes.summary: Atomically writes the kept registry JSON.

nodes.name: parse_registry
nodes.summary: Parses context-hub registry.json into entries, choosing language and version variants and rejecting malformed records.

nodes.name: registry_stated
nodes.summary: Extracts what the registry states about itself (name, version, dates).

nodes.name: check_name
nodes.summary: Validates a registry name.

nodes.name: load
nodes.summary: Loads the kept state of a named registry.

nodes.name: Synced
nodes.summary: Outcome of a sync: entries read, kept, failed and stale.

nodes.name: sync
nodes.summary: Reads a registry and each entry's DOC.md, keeps each document with its own retrieved_at and time to live, and lets documents not reread keep their earlier date.

nodes.name: freshness
nodes.summary: Computes whether a kept document is past its time to live and its age.

nodes.name: search
nodes.summary: BM25 search over kept entries by name, tags, description and content.

nodes.name: notes_for
nodes.summary: Returns the caller notes kept on an entry.

nodes.name: get
nodes.summary: Returns a kept document as a Document with whether it is stale and its age.

nodes.name: add_note
nodes.summary: Appends a dated caller note to an entry, never into the document.

nodes.name: registries
nodes.summary: Lists kept registries with their sources and counts.

nodes.name: SKILL.md
nodes.summary: Agent skill for the ctx_contexthub documentation registry: syncing a named registry, searching and getting documents with their dates, the time-to-live refusal, notes, failure modes, blind spots and examples.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package entry for the ctx_elastic extension: read-only search over a person's own Elasticsearch with fields checked against the mapping; declares the Elasticsearch outside service, optional key, sensitive ops and the elastic index backend.

nodes.name: block.py
nodes.summary: CtxElasticBlock, the registry and MCP door to the person's Elasticsearch server: dispatches search, get_doc, count and mapping ops and returns envelope replies with field and shard evidence.

nodes.name: CtxElasticInput
nodes.summary: Pydantic input for ctx_elastic ops: index, query, fields, exact filters, document id, top_k and ids.

nodes.name: _search
nodes.summary: Runs an Elasticsearch search, reporting partial shard answers and returning hits as untrusted passages.

nodes.name: CtxElasticBlock
nodes.summary: AIBlock subclass that routes ctx_elastic ops through its action table and turns ElasticError into refusals.

nodes.name: elastic.py
nodes.summary: Read-only client for an Elasticsearch server the person runs, via g6.core.outside: builds queries from typed parts, checks every field against the index mapping (refusing unknown fields, exact filters on analysed text and nested fields), and returns search hits, documents, counts and mappings as family passages.

nodes.name: ElasticError
nodes.summary: Exception with a G6_E_* code and details for Elasticsearch failures.

nodes.name: check_index
nodes.summary: Validates an index name.

nodes.name: check_field
nodes.summary: Validates a field name.

nodes.name: _call
nodes.summary: Sends one request to the Elasticsearch outside service with the optional key and returns the parsed body or raises.

nodes.name: _failure
nodes.summary: Maps a transport or HTTP failure to an ElasticError with a stable code.

nodes.name: flatten
nodes.summary: Recursively flattens a mapping's properties into dotted field names with their types, marking nested fields.

nodes.name: mapping
nodes.summary: Fetches an index mapping and returns its flattened fields.

nodes.name: checked_fields
nodes.summary: Checks requested search and filter fields against the mapping and refuses ones that cannot match, naming what the mapping holds.

nodes.name: _text_of
nodes.summary: Extracts the text of the chosen fields from a hit source.

nodes.name: _hit_passage
nodes.summary: Converts an Elasticsearch hit into a family Passage with its Source.

nodes.name: search
nodes.summary: Runs a typed multi_match search with exact filters after checking fields, and returns a Searched outcome with es_bm25 scores, totals and partial-shard evidence.

nodes.name: get_doc
nodes.summary: Fetches one document by id as a family Document.

nodes.name: count
nodes.summary: Counts matching documents with checked filters.

nodes.name: ElasticIndex
nodes.summary: Read-only Retrieves index backend over a cluster index and chosen fields; refuses add and remove.

nodes.name: managed.py
nodes.summary: The managed Elasticsearch index G6 keeps per project (g6-knowledge-v1-<project>): its canonical passage record encode/decode with hash and identity checks, a typed query body, and a read-only ManagedElasticIndex that never serves a record failing its checks.

nodes.name: index_name
nodes.summary: Derives the managed index name for a project, rejecting bad project names.

nodes.name: encode
nodes.summary: Encodes a Passage into the canonical managed record with hashes, offsets, registration and generation.

nodes.name: decode
nodes.summary: Rebuilds and checks a Passage from a hit: document id equals passage id, text hash and passage-id derivation match.

nodes.name: query_body

nodes.name: envelope.py
nodes.summary: Stable G6_E_LEAN_* codes, the Refusal exception, and finish(), the single place a g6.lean result is labelled qualified-draft or blocked-escalated with its warning card and evidence.

nodes.name: Refusal
nodes.summary: Exception carrying a stable G6_E_LEAN code and reason; raised anywhere in g6.lean and turned into a blocked-escalated result.

nodes.name: labelled
nodes.summary: Runs a unit of work, times it, and converts its outcome or any Refusal into a labelled result through finish().

nodes.summary: Builds the one labelled LeanResult from what Lean reported, choosing the completion state, warning card and evidence and re-validating through the schema.

nodes.name: _decide
nodes.summary: Decides whether a run earns its pass card: Lean ran, the kind is theorem, axioms are standard and any expected statement matched.

nodes.name: _proof_card

nodes.name: LeanInput

nodes.name: normalise
nodes.summary: Collapses whitespace so statements printed by Lean can be compared.

nodes.name: Layout
nodes.summary: Records where each G6 check command sits in the built file and maps file lines back to the caller's lines.

nodes.name: parse_check
nodes.summary: Extracts name and statement from a #check answer.

nodes.name: parse_kind
nodes.summary: Extracts the declaration kind from a #print answer.

nodes.name: parse_axioms
nodes.summary: Extracts the axiom list from a #print axioms answer.

nodes.name: parse_version
nodes.summary: Extracts the Lean version and target from a #version answer.

nodes.name: parse_version_flag
nodes.summary: Extracts version fields from lean --version output.

nodes.summary: Reads each of G6's answers only from the message on its own line, checks markers, theorem kind, sorry, axioms and expected statement, and returns a pass or a blocking code.

nodes.summary: Ordered pipeline: limits, source screen, statement screen, declaration check, build file, run Lean, judge; stops at the first failure.

nodes.name: lean_version
nodes.summary: Runs lean --version and reports which Lean would check a proof, without checking anything.

nodes.summary: Starts Lean under component_process limits, captures capped output and refuses on time, output or isolation failures.

nodes.name: _characters

nodes.name: _options

nodes.name: _imports

nodes.name: _closing

nodes.name: _attributes
nodes.summary: Refuses attributes outside the allowed list.

nodes.name: _sorted
nodes.summary: Orders and de-duplicates findings by position.

nodes.summary: Runs every source check and returns positioned refusals, each with its own G6_E_LEAN code.

nodes.summary: Screens an expected statement so it is a single term safe to place in G6's example line.

nodes.summary: Finds the end of a Lean string literal, honouring escapes.

nodes.name: header_lines
