nodes.name: render_addendum
nodes.summary: Renders matching theories into a PromptAddendum with a fixed header and the ids applied.

nodes.name: build_addendum
nodes.summary: Reads active theories from a TheoryStore and renders the addendum for a task.

nodes.name: with_addendum
nodes.summary: Prepends a rendered addendum to a task prompt.

nodes.name: baselines.py
nodes.summary: Off-by-default baselines a learned strategy is compared against (T0 proposes nothing; TemplateStrategy proposes one theory for the most frequent failure code) and a markdown skill renderer for bundles.

nodes.name: T0Strategy
nodes.summary: Null strategy that proposes no theories, so a run is a plain paired evaluation of the raw agent.

nodes.name: TemplateStrategy
nodes.summary: Each cycle classifies failures and proposes one template theory for the most frequent uncovered failure code.

nodes.name: render_skill
nodes.summary: Renders a theory into a size-capped markdown SkillDocument.

nodes.name: bundle.py
nodes.summary: Portable harness bundles: export chosen theories and artifacts with a review and a sealing digest, and import them back only as zero-evidence candidates after a leakage check and a regex tripwire scan.

nodes.name: scan_text
nodes.summary: Runs the injection-tripwire regular expressions over a text.

nodes.name: leakage_attestation
nodes.summary: Checks theory texts against the caller's forbidden answer terms as whole words, returning not_applicable when none are given.

nodes.name: export_bundle
nodes.summary: Writes the requested non-retired theories, artifacts and review to a bundle directory with a manifest digest.

nodes.name: CandidateBundle
nodes.summary: Result of an import: candidate theories, artifacts, review, scan findings and leakage status, with completion_state and envelope helpers.

nodes.name: import_bundle
nodes.summary: Reads a bundle, refuses a missing manifest or a digest mismatch, rescans texts and returns every theory as a fresh candidate.

nodes.name: dataset_builder.py
nodes.summary: Builds learning Datasets from JSONL files using common input/expected key names, and splits, samples, merges or filters them.

nodes.name: DatasetBuilder
nodes.summary: Static helpers: from_jsonl, split, sample, merge and filter over Dataset objects.

nodes.name: failure_classifier.py
nodes.summary: Heuristic, model-free failure classification of task results into codes such as TIMEOUT, TOOL_ERROR and WRONG_FORMAT, plus the protocol a custom classifier implements.

nodes.name: FailureClassifier
nodes.summary: Protocol for a classifier mapping a TaskResult to a FailureAnalysis.

nodes.name: DefaultClassifier
nodes.summary: Applies ordered heuristics (timeout, tool error, no output, format, partial match, depth, domain) and returns every code that fires.

nodes.name: method_kind.py
nodes.summary: Adapters that present a learning strategy as a heuristic method variant of g6.cognitive_bridge: variant and trial fields as plain data, and an admission hook that credits a trial only from receipts that re-read from kept evidence.

nodes.name: variant_fields
nodes.summary: Builds MethodVariant fields for a strategy artefact, keyed by the SHA-256 of its bytes.

nodes.name: trial_fields
nodes.summary: Builds EvaluatedTrial fields from one pair receipt.

nodes.name: admit_trial
nodes.summary: Returns an admission hook that reloads the ledger and admits a trial only when audit() credits its receipt.

nodes.name: observer.py
nodes.summary: Learning-run events dispatched to observers (logging, JSONL file, callback); an observer that raises is recorded as an ObserverFailure while the others still run.

nodes.name: ObserverFailure
nodes.summary: Record of an observer that raised: event type, observer index and the error.

nodes.name: LearningEvent
nodes.summary: Frozen event from a learning run: type, payload and timestamp.

nodes.name: LearningObserver
nodes.summary: Protocol for an observer receiving learning events.

nodes.name: LogObserver
nodes.summary: Observer that writes events to a Python logger.

nodes.name: JsonlObserver
nodes.summary: Observer that appends events as JSON lines to an explicit path.

nodes.name: CallbackObserver
nodes.summary: Observer that forwards events to a caller-supplied function.

nodes.name: EventEmitter
nodes.summary: Dispatches each event to every observer and records, rather than silences, failures.

nodes.name: ooda.py
nodes.summary: ObservationResult, what a learning strategy sees each cycle: one arm's results on the whole training set with accuracy and pass/fail counts.

nodes.name: ObservationResult
nodes.summary: Frozen results of the current harness on every training instance, with accuracy, n_passed and n_failed.

nodes.name: paired_eval.py
nodes.summary: PairedEvaluator runs a baseline and a strategy arm on the same instances, records a PairReceipt per case in a ChainLedger with SHA-256-addressed kept evidence, and credits a strategy only from receipts that can be rebuilt and rescored from that evidence.
nodes.languageNotes: Treats a ledger row as a claim, not evidence: credit requires re-deriving the pair and score from content-addressed kept bytes.

nodes.name: _block
nodes.summary: Renders a strategy artefact into its frozen instruction block for a task when its trigger matches.

nodes.name: Applied
nodes.summary: Result of applying a strategy: the prompt, the rendered block and whether it applied.

nodes.name: apply
nodes.summary: Puts one frozen strategy instruction in front of a task prompt and changes nothing else.

nodes.name: Arm
nodes.summary: One arm of a pair: prompt digest, reply, success, time, cost and status (including refused or interrupted).

nodes.name: PairReceipt
nodes.summary: Ledger body for one case: both arms, strategy and evidence digests, with completeness and credit helpers.

nodes.name: receipts
nodes.summary: Reads PairReceipts from a ChainLedger after verifying the chain.

nodes.name: Evidence
nodes.summary: Content-addressed store of kept bytes beside a ledger: put writes under SHA-256 with fsync, get re-hashes on read.

nodes.name: _keeping
nodes.summary: Keeps the task, prompts, oracle, replies and verdicts of a case in Evidence and returns their digests.

nodes.name: _arm_again
nodes.summary: Rebuilds and rescores one arm from kept evidence and the strategy store to check a receipt.

nodes.name: _why_not
nodes.summary: Explains why a receipt fails to read again (missing, changed or mismatched bytes, or a different score).

nodes.name: audit
nodes.summary: Checks every receipt against the kept evidence and returns which credit and why the others do not.

nodes.name: credited
nodes.summary: Returns only the receipts that audit credits.

nodes.name: PairedEvaluator
nodes.summary: Runs baseline and candidate arms with the same agent, judge and budget in a seeded order, checks the prompts differ only by the strategy block, and appends receipts to the ledger.

nodes.name: paired.py
nodes.summary: Paired outcomes of the same instance with and without a theory: per-pair credit and ArmComparison with wins, losses, lift and an exact one-sided sign test.

nodes.name: PairedOutcome
nodes.summary: One instance's baseline and adapted pass/fail outcome.

nodes.name: credit
nodes.summary: Names what one pair says: confirmed, disconfirmed or no discriminating evidence.

nodes.name: sign_test
nodes.summary: Exact one-sided binomial sign test p-value from wins and losses.

nodes.name: ArmComparison
nodes.summary: Aggregates paired outcomes on one instance set: counts, accuracies, lift, one-sided p-value and dict export.

nodes.name: promotion.py
nodes.summary: promote() decides whether a candidate theory may be recommended for activation on held-out paired evidence bound to that theory, with minimum pairs, discordant pairs and a sign-test threshold; a person then accepts it.

nodes.name: HeldOutEvidence
nodes.summary: Held-out paired evidence bound to a theory id and text digest, with wins, losses, dict and digest.

nodes.name: PromotionPolicy
nodes.summary: Thresholds for promotion: minimum pairs, minimum discordant pairs and alpha.

nodes.name: PromotionDecision
nodes.summary: Decision record with recommendation, faults, statistics and the evidence it was made on, plus envelope helpers.

nodes.name: promote
nodes.summary: Checks the evidence against the policy and returns a promote or hold recommendation, at best qualified-draft.

nodes.name: _faults
nodes.summary: Lists every reason the evidence fails: wrong theory, not held out, overlap with training, too few pairs, or a non-significant sign test.

nodes.name: runner.py
nodes.summary: Runs a g6.learning training measurement: each cycle a strategy proposes theories, each is credited only from paired with/without arms on the same training instances, and the frozen harness is then measured read-only against the raw agent on a held-out set. Reports are qualified-draft when finished and blocked-escalated on refusal, budget or agent failure.

nodes.name: schema.py
nodes.summary: Data types for g6.learning: task instances, datasets, agent traces and replies, scored task results, failure analyses, theories with Bayesian posterior strength, prompt addenda, skill documents and person review records.
nodes.languageNotes: Frozen dataclasses with __post_init__ validation and SHA-256 digests give theories and addenda content-derived identities.

nodes.name: scoring.py
nodes.summary: Instance-keyed scoring of an agent answer (normalized exact, token F1 or judge rubric) and the call wrapper that turns an LLMCaller or plain callable into an AgentReply with a trace; scores 0 rather than guessing when no expected answer or judge exists.

nodes.name: seeds.py
nodes.summary: Defines 16 first-party seed hints and loads them into a TheoryStore scope as unmeasured candidate theories with condition-key triggers.

nodes.name: SKILL.md
nodes.summary: Agent skill document for g6.learning covering when to use it, the Python API (run_learning, compare_arms, promote, TheoryStore, seeds, bundles), failure modes it catches, reading results, blind spots, examples and open problems.

nodes.name: strategies.py
nodes.summary: Defines the LearningStrategy protocol and T3Strategy, which proposes one of seven fixed hint templates for each failure code seen in failing training results that the store scope does not yet cover.

nodes.name: strategy.py
nodes.summary: Content-addressed strategy artefacts: a heuristic instruction with trigger, template, mapping, implementation and config whose identity is the SHA-256 of its canonical bytes, plus a write-once file store that re-hashes on resolve.

nodes.name: theory_store.py
nodes.summary: Scoped SQLite store of candidate, active and retired theories: candidates enter with zero evidence, credit comes only from append-only paired outcomes, and activation requires a person-accepted promotion decision rechecked against the store policy.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package entry for g6.llm_router, an integrations-family extension that picks a language model for a cognitive task from a committed table, local first with fallbacks and dated cost estimates; re-exports the router API and declares component metadata, sensitive ops and mitigated failure modes.

nodes.name: advice.py
nodes.summary: Table-only router ops returning labelled RouterResult answers: list tasks, rank models for a task, build a local-first route with fallback chain (optionally tilted by recorded outcomes), supervision chains, model profiles, dated cost estimates with stale-price flags, and outcome recording and stats.

nodes.name: model_profiles.json
nodes.summary: Committed table of 47 model profiles (18 local Ollama, 29 OpenRouter) with hand-assigned scores for cognitive tasks, modalities, context windows, cost levels and per-million-token prices dated 2026-08-16.

nodes.name: envelope.py
nodes.summary: Stable G6_E_ROUTER_* codes and the RouterResult model every router op returns, with answer() building qualified-draft results and refuse() building blocked-escalated refusals with suggested actions.

nodes.name: llm_router_block.py
nodes.summary: LLMRouterBlock, the registry and MCP g6_invoke door to g6.llm_router: a typed op input validated per op and an AIBlock that dispatches each op to the package function, marking network and machine-changing ops as sensitive.

nodes.name: outcomes.py
nodes.summary: SQLite outcome store under the G6 home recording how models did on tasks, plus the bounded Thompson-sampling rule that lets recorded outcomes tilt a route score by at most 0.05.

nodes.name: providers.py
nodes.summary: Sensitive router ops that reach outside the process: list, pull and delete local Ollama models via g6.core.outside, and fetch and compare the OpenRouter catalogue and prices via g6.core.http, all returning labelled results.

nodes.name: registry.py
nodes.summary: Cognitive task enums and the CognitiveTaskRegistry over the committed model_profiles.json table, mapping tasks to ranked models and models to tasks, modalities and prices (unknown prices kept as None).

nodes.name: router.py
nodes.summary: TaskRouter turns an advice.route result into a consent-guarded FallbackCaller over g6.core.llm callers for the allowed providers, never handling keys itself.

nodes.name: SKILL.md
nodes.summary: Agent skill document for g6.llm_router describing when to use the router, its ops, composition, failure modes, how to read results, blind spots, requirements, examples and open problems.

nodes.name: supervision.py
nodes.summary: Cost-level supervision policy: a model supervises a cheaper one only with at least its task score and a higher level (or same level and higher score), with specialist overrides and refusal of unknown models.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: The g6-mcp stdio server: builds a FastMCP server exposing discovery, invoke and compose tools, patch review, missions, behaviour confirmation, self-improvement, meta-harness, cloud-sharing consent, Context Engine and workflow-record tools, all replies inside the library envelope with sensitive ops gated by G6_MCP_SENSITIVE.
nodes.languageNotes: Tools are declared as nested closures inside builder functions, so one 490-line function registers the meta-harness tool family.

nodes.name: behaviour.py
nodes.summary: Implements g6_confirm_behaviour: picks one behaviour question candidate for a task, shows it through the client elicitation dialog, records the person answer in the task question store, and supplies the confirmed standard that later g6_review_patch runs enforce.

nodes.name: cloud_consent.py
nodes.summary: Client-dialog grants and the final MCP reply boundary for cloud coding clients: captures source provenance of tool returns, requests per-source and per-provider sharing grants, withholds unconsented content, and registers the g6_cloud_* and g6_disclosures tools.

nodes.name: composition.py
nodes.summary: Data-only MCP composition: validates a JSON list of component stages and inputs and runs them through g6.core.compose, returning an enveloped reply or a blocked reply.

nodes.name: consent_controls.py
nodes.summary: Host-code helpers that bind explicit disclosure controls to a reply: public program instructions, host-supplied controls with retained source origins, and refusals preserving their constant code.

nodes.name: consent_transport.py
nodes.summary: Admission at the MCP session transport handoff: wraps the session stream so each outbound tool response is checked against source tickets and the consent ledger, under the ledger lock, before it is sent.
nodes.languageNotes: Monkey-patches the MCP session stream with a proxy object (__getattr__ delegation) so admission runs at the last point before data leaves the process.

nodes.name: BudgetExceeded
nodes.summary: Exception raised when a learning run exceeds its agent-call or USD budget.

nodes.name: _Budget
nodes.summary: Tracks agent calls and cost during a run and raises BudgetExceeded before or after a call that crosses a limit.

nodes.name: CycleRecord
nodes.summary: Per-cycle record of accuracy, failure breakdown, proposed and measured theories, and the current harness.

nodes.name: LearningReport
nodes.summary: What a learning run measured, with harness, held-out comparison and per-theory evidence; derives completion_state from its code and renders the reliability envelope.

nodes.name: run_arm
nodes.summary: Runs one arm: builds each prompt afresh with the rendered theory addendum, calls the agent under the budget, and scores every instance.

nodes.name: compare_arms
nodes.summary: Runs the raw agent and the agent with a frozen theory set on the same instances and returns an ArmComparison.

nodes.name: run_learning
nodes.summary: Main training loop: refuses unsafe datasets, iterates cycles of propose, paired measure and admit into the harness, then measures the frozen harness on the held-out set and finishes the report.

nodes.name: _measure_holdout
nodes.summary: Measures the frozen harness against the raw agent on held-out instances and each harness theory alone for promotion evidence, writing nothing to the store.

nodes.name: _refusal
nodes.summary: Returns the refusal code and reason when a run lacks an agent, data, holdout, expected answers or judge, or when the training split is protected or overlaps the holdout.

nodes.name: _admit
nodes.summary: Adds new proposals as store candidates and selects the unmeasured theories, capped by max_theories, to measure this cycle.

nodes.name: TaskInstance
nodes.summary: One task with hidden expected output or rubric and metadata; derives a stable id from content and exposes score mode, judge need and scorability.

nodes.name: Dataset
nodes.summary: Named collection of task instances with a split label; rejects duplicate instance ids.

nodes.name: AgentTrace
nodes.summary: Trace of one agent call: tool calls, turns, cost, duration, error and prompt hash.

nodes.name: AgentReply
nodes.summary: An agent output paired with its trace.

nodes.name: TaskResult
nodes.summary: Scored outcome of one instance: actual output, pass flag, score, signals and trace.

nodes.name: FailureAnalysis
nodes.summary: Failure codes and primary code assigned to one failing instance with signals and context.

nodes.name: Theory
nodes.summary: A learned prompt hint keyed by failure code and trigger, with prior, confirmations, disconfirmations, posterior strength, lifecycle status, scope and proposer.

nodes.name: posterior_strength
nodes.summary: Computes a theory posterior strength from confirmations, disconfirmations and a prior.

nodes.name: PromptAddendum
nodes.summary: Rendered hint text with the theory ids it contains and a content digest.

nodes.name: SkillDocument
nodes.summary: Skill content attached to a theory.

nodes.name: ReviewRecord
nodes.summary: Person review record with reviewer id, time, scope summary and residual risk notes; refuses empty fields.

nodes.name: score_output
nodes.summary: Scores an answer against the expected text by normalized exact match or token F1.

nodes.name: score_instance
nodes.summary: Scores an output for a TaskInstance using its mode, routing rubric modes to the judge and scoring 0 when there is nothing to score against.

nodes.name: call_agent
nodes.summary: Calls an LLMCaller or plain callable with a prompt and normalises the result into an AgentReply with timing trace.

nodes.name: _read_judge_score
nodes.summary: Parses and validates a judge JSON reply into a finite score, raising on malformed replies.

nodes.name: _judge
nodes.summary: Asks the judge model to grade an answer against the expected text or rubric and returns its score.

nodes.name: _token_f1
nodes.summary: Token-level F1 between actual and expected answers.

nodes.name: load_seed_heuristics
nodes.summary: Adds the 16 first-party seed hints to a store scope as unmeasured candidates with ids seed:<scope>:<name>.

nodes.name: LearningStrategy
nodes.summary: Protocol for a strategy that proposes theories to measure each cycle from current observations and the store.

nodes.name: T3Strategy
nodes.summary: Proposes a template theory for each uncovered failure code in failing results plus the scope existing candidates.

nodes.name: StrategyError
nodes.summary: ValueError carrying a stable G6_E_STRATEGY_* code for artefact or store refusals.

nodes.name: _trigger_ok
nodes.summary: Validates a trigger against the addendum grammar: always, key:value, or condition_keys with a JSON list.

nodes.name: StrategyArtefact
nodes.summary: Frozen strategy definition validated on creation, serialised to canonical JSON bytes whose SHA-256 is its identity, and round-trip checked on load.

nodes.name: seed_artefacts
nodes.summary: Builds StrategyArtefacts from the first-party seeds, scoped as search or decomposition.

nodes.name: StrategyStore
nodes.summary: Write-once content-addressed file store for strategy artefacts that fsyncs on put and re-hashes bytes on resolve.

nodes.name: TheoryStore
nodes.summary: Scoped SQLite store of theories: adds candidates without overwriting, records paired outcomes once per instance, recomputes strength, retires weak theories, and activates only on a person-accepted promotion decision.

nodes.name: _row_to_theory
nodes.summary: Converts a SQLite row into a Theory dataclass.

nodes.name: _priced
nodes.summary: Builds a qualified-draft answer with price date, age and stale-price card when prices are older than the threshold.

nodes.name: list_tasks
nodes.summary: Lists the cognitive tasks with their kind of work and how many models score each.

nodes.name: models_for_task
nodes.summary: Ranks committed-table models for a task with filters for providers, locality and minimum score, giving the reason for each rank.

nodes.name: _tilted
nodes.summary: Applies the bounded outcome tilt from the outcome store to candidate scores once enough outcomes exist.

nodes.name: route
nodes.summary: Builds a local-first route with an ordered fallback chain from allowed providers and installed models, optionally tilted by recorded outcomes.

nodes.name: supervision_chain
nodes.summary: Builds a chain from the cheapest worker upward where each model can check the one below, refusing when no supervisor exists.

nodes.name: model_profile
nodes.summary: Returns one model committed profile with the tasks it scores.

nodes.name: estimate_cost
nodes.summary: Estimates a call cost from committed prices with their date and age, refusing when the price is variable or unknown.

nodes.name: record_outcome
nodes.summary: Records a caller-reported model outcome for a task in the outcome store.

nodes.name: outcome_stats
nodes.summary: Counts recorded outcomes per model for a task, including verdict disagreements and human corrections, ranking nothing.

nodes.name: RouterResult
nodes.summary: Frozen pydantic result every router op returns, carrying completion_state, warning_card, evidence, request_id and run_id beside op fields.

nodes.name: answer
nodes.summary: Builds a qualified-draft RouterResult whose amber card says what the answer rests on.

nodes.name: refuse
nodes.summary: Builds a blocked-escalated RouterResult with its stable code, reason and suggested action.

nodes.name: LLMRouterInput
nodes.summary: Typed pydantic input for router ops that forbids unknown fields and checks each op has the fields it needs.

nodes.name: LLMRouterBlock
nodes.summary: AIBlock exposing the router ops through the registry, returning help, op lists or the op labelled result.

nodes.name: polarity
nodes.summary: Reads a reviewer verdict coarsely as pass, fail or unread.

nodes.name: tilts
nodes.summary: Draws seeded Beta samples per model from success and failure counts and returns bounded score tilts.

nodes.name: OutcomeStoreError
nodes.summary: Raised when the outcome store cannot be opened, read or written.

nodes.name: OutcomeStore
nodes.summary: SQLite store of model outcomes under the G6 home, capped in rows, recording reports and fallback failures and computing counts and stats.

nodes.name: is_model_name
nodes.summary: Checks a value is a well-formed model name.

nodes.name: _ollama
nodes.summary: Calls the local Ollama service through g6.core.outside with time limit and size cap.

nodes.name: catalogue_client
nodes.summary: Builds the guarded g6.core.http client used to fetch the OpenRouter catalogue.

nodes.name: list_local_models
nodes.summary: Lists models installed in the local Ollama server as a live-answer result.

nodes.name: pull_model
nodes.summary: Downloads a model into the local Ollama server.

nodes.name: delete_model
nodes.summary: Removes a model from the local Ollama server.

nodes.name: parse_price
nodes.summary: Parses a catalogue price string into a per-token Decimal-backed float, rejecting malformed values.

nodes.name: fetch_openrouter_catalogue
nodes.summary: Fetches OpenRouter live models and prices and compares them with the committed table without writing to it.

nodes.name: UseCase
nodes.summary: Enum of broad kinds of work grouping cognitive tasks.

nodes.name: CognitiveTask
nodes.summary: Enum of the cognitive tasks a model can be ranked for.

nodes.name: Modality
nodes.summary: Enum of input and output modalities a model supports.

nodes.name: ModelProfile
nodes.summary: One model profile with provider, level, context, modalities, task scores and prices, where unknown prices read as None.

nodes.name: CognitiveTaskRegistry
nodes.summary: Indexed registry of model profiles answering which models suit a task, best model for a use case, filters by provider and updates.

nodes.name: table
nodes.summary: Loads and caches the committed model_profiles.json table via importlib.resources.

nodes.name: default_registry
nodes.summary: Returns the registry built from the committed table.

nodes.name: build_caller
nodes.summary: Builds the g6.core.llm caller for one provider and model of the table.

nodes.name: TaskRouter
nodes.summary: Routes a cognitive task to a model chain and builds a consent-guarded FallbackCaller that tries each model in order.

nodes.name: get_tier
nodes.summary: Returns a model cost level from the registry, raising KeyError for unknown models.

nodes.name: ModelTier
nodes.summary: IntEnum of cost levels, from free local models to the most expensive paid ones.

nodes.name: Specialist
nodes.summary: A specialist model that supervises a task workers up to a level.

nodes.name: SupervisionResult
nodes.summary: Result of a supervision pick with serialisation.

nodes.name: SupervisionPolicy
nodes.summary: Decides which model can supervise another by level, tool complexity and task score, with specialist overrides, and builds supervision chains.

nodes.name: describe_reply
nodes.summary: Builds the g6_describe reply with the component description and which of its sensitive ops this server allows.

nodes.name: invoke_reply
nodes.summary: Builds the g6_invoke reply by parsing params and calling the shared checked door through a guarded registry, gating sensitive ops.

nodes.name: _quiet
nodes.summary: Turns off the FastMCP update check and project .env reading before import unless the person chose otherwise.

nodes.name: build_server
nodes.summary: Creates the FastMCP server, installs the cloud-consent boundary, registers knowledge, discovery, invoke and compose tools, meta-harness tools and workflow tools.

nodes.name: _metaharness_tools
nodes.summary: Registers patch review, review-until-clean, mission, behaviour, improvement and meta-harness tools whose approvals ask the person through client elicitation.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Console entry point that builds and runs the g6-mcp server.

nodes.name: bound
nodes.summary: Checks a saved review is bound to the given task, repository and tree digest.

nodes.name: identity_of
nodes.summary: Derives the task identity used to bind questions and reviews.

nodes.name: _review_candidates
nodes.summary: Collects behaviour question candidates from a finished, bound patch review where base and patch disagreed.

nodes.name: _with_knowledge
nodes.summary: Augments candidates with cited passages from the Context Engine sources shared with the client.

nodes.name: _designated
nodes.summary: Picks the designated question for a task, preferring a pending one.

nodes.name: _reply
nodes.summary: Builds the enveloped reply for a question status with next-step guidance.

nodes.name: confirm
nodes.summary: The g6_confirm_behaviour flow: chooses a candidate, records it within budget, elicits the person answer through the client dialog and records who answered.

nodes.name: enforced
nodes.summary: Returns the confirmed behaviour standard a patch review must enforce, or refuses when the store is unreadable.

nodes.name: reviewed
nodes.summary: Runs a queued patch review with the standard read at execution time and binds the saved reply to the task identity.

nodes.name: public_tool
nodes.summary: Decorator marking a tool as returning host program instructions or opaque consent metadata, never source content.

nodes.name: _source_function
nodes.summary: Wraps a tool function to capture source provenance of its return before FastMCP serialises it.

nodes.name: client_provider
nodes.summary: Identifies the cloud provider of the MCP client from its session.

nodes.name: request_grant
nodes.summary: Asks the person in the client dialog whether to share a source with the client provider and records the grant.

nodes.name: withheld_reply
nodes.summary: Builds a blocked reply that withholds content not consented for the provider.

nodes.name: protect_reply
nodes.summary: Admits a reply under the consent policy for its sources and provider or replaces it with a withheld reply.

nodes.name: _matches_return
nodes.summary: Checks the rendered tool reply is the frozen return, read through one serialisation.

nodes.name: install
nodes.summary: Installs FastMCP middleware that captures provenance and hands each response to the consent transport admission.

nodes.name: register
nodes.summary: Registers the g6_cloud_grant, g6_cloud_revoke, g6_cloud_grants and g6_disclosures tools.

nodes.name: StageInput
nodes.summary: Strict pydantic schema for one composition stage: component, op, input mapping and params.

nodes.name: CompositionInput
nodes.summary: Strict pydantic schema for a 1-32 stage composition and its caller inputs.

nodes.name: compose_reply
nodes.summary: Validates a composition payload, runs it through g6.core.compose and returns its enveloped result or a blocked reply.

nodes.name: public_instructions
nodes.summary: Binds a reply as public program instructions with no source data.

nodes.name: host_controls
nodes.summary: Binds explicitly supplied host controls to a reply while keeping its source origins.

nodes.name: refused_send
nodes.summary: Preserves a host refusal constant code and envelope ids as shareable controls.

nodes.name: consent_form
nodes.summary: Context manager marking that the sharing dialog being sent is public control content.

nodes.name: provider
nodes.summary: Identifies the provider of a session via cloud_consent.client_provider.

nodes.name: call_body
nodes.summary: Serialises a tool result into the MCP CallToolResult JSON body.

nodes.name: Ticket
nodes.summary: Provenance ticket for an outbound reply: sources, provider, supplied ids, body hash and optional job and control.

nodes.name: prepare
nodes.summary: Attaches a source ticket to the outbound reply context for admission at the transport.

nodes.name: _refused
nodes.summary: Builds the replacement response sent when transport admission refuses a reply.

nodes.name: _Stream
nodes.summary: Proxy over the session write stream that admits each response under the consent ledger lock before sending.

nodes.name: _Session
nodes.summary: Session wrapper whose response send goes through transport admission.

nodes.name: install
nodes.summary: Installs the admission stream on an MCP session, returning whether it was installed.

nodes.name: consent.py
nodes.summary: Client-mediated consent over MCP: builds the one dialog text from what an act binds, sends it through MCP elicitation, and turns a declined, cancelled or unavailable dialog into a stable refusal. It never infers a human identity.

nodes.name: question
nodes.summary: Writes the dialog text from what an act binds: the question, every bound field, and how to agree or refuse.

nodes.name: elicit
nodes.summary: Sends a question through the client's MCP elicitation dialog and returns its action, content and any unavailability.

nodes.name: request_consent
nodes.summary: Asks the person for a yes or no through elicit and returns a Consent record of how the dialog ended.

nodes.name: refusal
nodes.summary: Builds the stable refusal reply for a dialog that ended without agreement, with a code per ending and what did not happen.

nodes.name: Consent

nodes.name: improve.py
nodes.summary: Implements the g6_improve_* MCP tools that start, stop, act on and report the self-improvement loop: each start is consented in the client dialog, runs the runner as its own process with an allow-listed environment, and every reply is read back from the folder records and stop files.
nodes.languageNotes: Long chains of small helpers that each re-read on-disk state, so every reply is derived from a fresh reading rather than from in-memory assumptions.

nodes.name: refused
nodes.summary: Returns the refusal for starting the runner unless the host allows the sensitive operation.

nodes.name: _root
nodes.summary: Resolves the loop folder named or the default beside G6's state folder.

nodes.name: _stands_alone
nodes.summary: Checks whether a path names one absolute place regardless of the working directory, used for child interpreter and import paths.

nodes.name: _settings
nodes.summary: Reads and checks the loop folder's settings file, raising a bad-settings error when unusable.

nodes.name: _refusal
nodes.summary: Builds every dialog or start refusal from the stop reading it rests on, so no refusal hides a stop in force.

nodes.name: _failed
nodes.summary: Turns any failure of a dialog or start into a refusal from a fresh reading.

nodes.name: _cannot_start
nodes.summary: Determines why nothing may start on a folder: stop in force, not a loop folder, live runner, no enrolment or changed domain file.

nodes.name: _terms
nodes.summary: Builds the binding of a start from one stop reading and the settings: the fields the dialog shows and the start records.

nodes.name: asked
nodes.summary: Returns what the person reads before the runner starts and the binding it is built from, or a blocked reply.

nodes.name: _dialog
nodes.summary: Writes the start question and its binding from a reading and the checked settings.

nodes.name: _environment_path
nodes.summary: Admits a local directory for the child environment only when it is absolute, existing and free of control characters.

nodes.name: _environment
nodes.summary: Builds the loop child process environment from an allow-list of checked local directories.

nodes.name: _watch
nodes.summary: Watches a spawned runner until it gets past opening its folder or ends, reporting how.

nodes.name: _revoke
nodes.summary: Ends a start whose record did not land as approved by writing a stop through the proper writer.

nodes.name: start
nodes.summary: Records who started the loop and launches the runner on the binding the person agreed to, re-checking that it still stands.

nodes.name: _start_on_record
nodes.summary: Reads back whether the start written with an identity stands and is in force.

nodes.name: _start_as_recorded
nodes.summary: Shapes the reply to a start attempt from what the folder holds now.

nodes.name: _cannot_act
nodes.summary: Explains why a person's act (enrol, resume, demote) cannot be put to them on the folder as it stands.

nodes.name: asked_act
nodes.summary: Returns what the person reads before an enrol, resume or demote act and its binding, or a blocked reply.

nodes.name: act
nodes.summary: Performs the person's agreed act in a separate process if its binding still stands, then reads the result back.

nodes.name: _run_act
nodes.summary: Runs an act in its own process on the runner's interpreter and import path, exchanging JSON over stdin and stdout.

nodes.name: _record_said
nodes.summary: Writes the sentence describing what a read-back found on record, missing or unknown.

nodes.name: _read_back
nodes.summary: Reads back what the folder holds of a person's act and the sentence that says it.

nodes.name: _recognised
nodes.summary: Parses the reply line of an act's output and checks it has the expected shape.

nodes.name: _read_act
nodes.summary: Interprets an act process's exit status and reply into a qualified draft or a refusal.

nodes.name: _stop_entry_on_record
nodes.summary: Reads the complete bytes written with a stop's identity, treating partial or foreign bytes as absent.

nodes.name: _stop_before
nodes.summary: Finds the start a stop is ending, by reading records by complete bytes and identity.

nodes.name: _stop_on_record
nodes.summary: Reads each part of a stop independently so one unreadable part never erases another receipt.

nodes.name: _stop_reply
nodes.summary: Builds the stop's envelope reply from library builders without drawing fresh entropy.

nodes.name: _stop_read_back
nodes.summary: Reads the post-write receipt of a stop, including its note and runner metadata.

nodes.name: stop
nodes.summary: Denies first, establishes the canonical stop for the loop, then reports independently read parts.

nodes.name: status
nodes.summary: Reports where the loop stands from its files, writing nothing, with the stop reading first.

nodes.name: _unread_status
nodes.summary: Builds the status reply when something past the stop reading cannot be read.

nodes.name: register
nodes.summary: Registers all g6_knowledge_* tools on an MCP server: add, sources, search, context, passage, revoke, job, count, paths, refresh and delete.

nodes.name: confirm

nodes.name: package_root

nodes.name: guidance

nodes.name: inputs

nodes.name: RegistrationError

nodes.name: review_binding.py

nodes.name: BoundReply
nodes.summary: Dict subclass carrying process-local custody that the JSON encoder deliberately excludes.

nodes.name: review_loop.py

nodes.name: _asked
nodes.summary: Binds or checks the session's repository, task and base commit fixed by its first call.

nodes.name: _step
nodes.summary: Runs one completion loop step for an MCP job and shapes its envelope.

nodes.name: step
nodes.summary: Runs a loop step while retaining the run's saved origins and never rebinding old report content.

nodes.name: review_reply.py

nodes.name: review
nodes.summary: Runs review_patch for an MCP job, naming what may reach an enclosing door.

nodes.name: save
nodes.summary: Saves the whole reply as owner-only JSON under reviews/<job id>.json with a custody binding.

nodes.name: _shorten

nodes.name: finish

nodes.name: workflow.py

nodes.name: _noted
nodes.summary: Adds a workflow note to a reply when its record could not be written, keeping sources intact.

nodes.name: attach
nodes.summary: Attaches the task's workflow view to a reply after the report, leaving the report text first and unchanged.

nodes.name: _viewed
nodes.summary: Returns a reply with the task view attached, or unchanged when the view is off or unbuildable.

nodes.name: finishing
nodes.summary: Wraps the compact review finish step with the workflow record and the task view.

nodes.name: stepped
nodes.summary: Wraps one completion loop step with the record of where it stands.

nodes.name: install
nodes.summary: Adds middleware recording each tool call that names a repository and task, using arguments and time only.

nodes.summary: Writes inspection.json of what G6 recorded about its own review work in the repository.

nodes.summary: Applies the person's corrections.json to the recorded workflow entries.

nodes.summary: Runs ffprobe with the confinement and returns its format and streams account.

nodes.name: streams
nodes.summary: Summarises ffprobe output into format names, length and the first video and audio streams.

nodes.name: _sound
nodes.summary: Decodes the first sound stream to WAV and measures it with the WAV inspector rule.

nodes.name: _frames
nodes.summary: Samples video frames through ffmpeg to check they decode and are not blank.

nodes.name: inspect_av
nodes.summary: Measures a sound or video file against requested formats, streams, frame size, fps, rate, channels and duration.

nodes.name: inspect_media
nodes.summary: Routes a WAV to the WAV inspector and anything else to inspect_av.

nodes.name: _dsp.py
nodes.summary: NumPy signal processing shared by the audio extensions: WAV load and PCM write without clipping, biquad filters, resampling, BS.1770-4 loudness, true peak, pitch (YIN), tempo, spectrum, and dynamics (compressor, gate, limiter, de-esser, spectral noise reduction).
nodes.languageNotes: Pure NumPy implementations of standard audio algorithms (RBJ biquads, Kaiser windowed-sinc resampling, ITU-R BS.1770-4 gating) with explicit sample-count limits checked before allocation.

nodes.name: numpy
nodes.summary: Returns NumPy or raises a media error saying how to install the audio extra.

nodes.name: load
nodes.summary: Loads a WAV as float64 frames by channels with its rate and layout.

nodes.name: fits
nodes.summary: Refuses a result over the maximum sample count before it is allocated.

nodes.name: full_scale
nodes.summary: Checks whether every sample is within full scale.

nodes.name: wav_bytes
nodes.summary: Encodes samples as 16, 24 or 32-bit PCM WAV with optional TPDF dither, refusing clipping.

nodes.name: biquad
nodes.summary: Designs one second-order filter section from the RBJ cookbook.

nodes.name: impulse_response
nodes.summary: Computes the impulse response of cascaded biquad sections from their poles.

nodes.name: convolve
nodes.summary: Convolves frames with an impulse response by FFT, keeping the causal part.

nodes.name: filtered
nodes.summary: Applies cascaded filter sections to a signal by convolution.

nodes.name: high_band
nodes.summary: Extracts the band above a frequency with a zero-phase windowed-sinc high-pass.

nodes.name: resample
nodes.summary: Resamples by band-limited Kaiser windowed-sinc interpolation with sample limits.

nodes.name: kweighting
nodes.summary: Builds the BS.1770 K-weighting filters at a sample rate.

nodes.name: loudness
nodes.summary: Computes integrated loudness in LUFS per BS.1770-4.

nodes.name: peak_envelope
nodes.summary: Computes each sample's four-times oversampled true peak across channels.

nodes.name: true_peak
nodes.summary: Returns the largest true peak of a signal.

nodes.name: measure
nodes.summary: Measures length, rate, channels, peaks, RMS, loudness, crest factor, DC offset and stereo correlation.

nodes.name: correlation
nodes.summary: Computes the phase correlation of a stereo pair.

nodes.name: mono
nodes.summary: Averages channels to mono.

nodes.name: note_name
nodes.summary: Returns the nearest equal-tempered note and cents offset for a frequency.

nodes.name: pitch
nodes.summary: Estimates fundamental frequency with YIN over the loudest stretch.

nodes.name: stft
nodes.summary: Computes a short-time Fourier transform.

nodes.name: _onsets
nodes.summary: Computes positive spectral flux per frame in bounded memory blocks.

nodes.name: tempo
nodes.summary: Estimates beats per minute from onset envelope autocorrelation.

nodes.name: silences
nodes.summary: Finds stretches whose 10 ms RMS stays below a threshold for a minimum length.

nodes.name: spectrum
nodes.summary: Computes a Welch spectrum with strongest peaks, centroid, roll-off and band energies.

nodes.name: _smooth
nodes.summary: Smooths a gain target with attack and release times.

nodes.name: compress
nodes.summary: Applies a feed-forward RMS compressor across linked channels.

nodes.name: gate
nodes.summary: Applies a noise gate with hold and release.

nodes.name: limit
nodes.summary: Applies a look-ahead true-peak limiter to a ceiling.

nodes.name: de_ess
nodes.summary: Lowers the high band while its short RMS is above a threshold.

nodes.name: _gated
nodes.summary: Lowers STFT bins below a noise profile and rebuilds by overlap-add.

nodes.name: reduce_noise
nodes.summary: Spectral gating noise reduction from a noise span or the quietest frames.

nodes.name: inspect_svg

nodes.name: version_observations

nodes.name: read_pack

nodes.name: pool.py

nodes.name: promotion.py

nodes.name: propose.py

nodes.name: DevFailure

nodes.name: ModelStrategy

nodes.name: EditStrategy

nodes.name: network
nodes.summary: Builds a torch nn.Sequential from the resolved layer list (linear, activation, dropout), refusing unknown layer kinds.

nodes.name: _predict
nodes.summary: Runs the model without gradients on the given rows, counts rows with non-finite outputs and decodes class indices or regression values.

nodes.name: train
nodes.summary: Seeded minibatch SGD training with early stop on a non-finite loss, optional patience-based weight selection on a validation part, gradient-norm notes, a finite-weight check, predictions and optional weight saving.

nodes.name: predict
nodes.summary: Rebuilds the network, loads G6's kept weights and predicts the job's rows, reporting broken outputs.

nodes.name: child_main
nodes.summary: Child entry point: reads job.json, runs train or predict with warnings captured, times the run and writes result.json, turning any exception into a named error.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package entry for the adapt_sklearn ml extension: re-exports AdaptSklearnBlock and the estimator catalogue, and declares component metadata (block name, failure modes mitigated, the ml extra, and vetting pointers to the source register and the independent rule review).

nodes.name: block.py
nodes.summary: AdaptSklearnBlock, the registry and MCP door to adapt_sklearn: ops fit_eval, rank and estimators run leakage and split checks, fit out of process on a self-made training split, and score on held-out rows against a baseline with intervals, at best qualified-draft.

nodes.name: SklearnInput
nodes.summary: Pydantic input model for adapt_sklearn ops: rows, target, features, task, seed, estimator and params, rank candidates and folds, predict rows, timeout and request/run ids.

nodes.name: AdaptSklearnBlock
nodes.summary: AIBlock subclass that answers ops and help, dispatches fit_eval, rank and estimators through _run, and returns refusals as results rather than raised errors.

nodes.name: _spec
nodes.summary: Builds a DatasetSpec from the input, turning pydantic validation errors into an MLError naming the first bad field.

nodes.name: _fit_evidence
nodes.summary: Collects the fit evidence (estimator, parameters, timings and isolation) from a child run result.

nodes.name: _fit_eval
nodes.summary: fit_eval op: prepares and checks the data, encodes rows, fits the resolved estimator in the bounded child, measures held-out score against a baseline and assembles the labelled answer with rules and predictions.

nodes.name: _meta_features
nodes.summary: Summarises the dataset (row and feature counts, numeric share, missing share, class balance) as meta-features reported with rank results.

nodes.name: _rank
nodes.summary: rank op: cross-validates distinct candidate estimators inside the training rows only, sorts them by mean fold score, then scores the best once on held-out rows; excluded candidates are reported.

nodes.name: adapter.py
nodes.summary: Certificate adapter shared by adapt_sklearn and adapt_automl: invokes the real ml family implementation (_fit, make_split, metrics) per rule and projects numeric observations, with guards reporting 1 when they fire and 0 when they hold.

nodes.name: fitted_preparation
nodes.summary: Records the preprocessing pipeline G6 fits on training rows, to compare its fitted transformation across different held-out rows.

nodes.name: fold_groups
nodes.summary: Assigns each row a group id by splitting row indices into the requested number of folds.

nodes.name: ranked
nodes.summary: Runs the rank path (_fit._rank) on one dummy candidate and returns its sorted fold scores.

nodes.name: folded
nodes.summary: Returns the sorted fold assignment G6 produces for grouped rows.

nodes.name: searched
nodes.summary: Runs the cross-validated search on the training part, optionally with different held-out rows, to show held-out rows never change fold scores.

nodes.name: refused
nodes.summary: Calls a guard and returns 1 if it raises an MLError with one of the expected codes, 0 if it holds.

nodes.name: evaluate
nodes.summary: Per-rule dispatcher: builds DatasetSpecs and splits from rule inputs and returns the numeric observation (split sizes, fold contents, metric values, guard firing) for each certificate rule.

nodes.name: cases.json
nodes.summary: Source-cited certificate cases for adapt_sklearn rules (held_out, stratified, grouped, accuracy, r2, mae, rmse and more): inputs, expected values and quotes from the scikit-learn 1.9 documentation's printed examples, marked printed or author-computed.

nodes.name: certificate.json
nodes.summary: Issued component certificate record for g6.ml.adapt_sklearn: rule levels and attestations, falsification observations, harness and input digests, isolation, independent pass, not-checked list, printed values, source register and review bindings.
nodes.languageNotes: A machine-generated record of about 30,000 lines; CERTIFICATE.md is its human-readable rendering.

nodes.name: CERTIFICATE.md
nodes.summary: Human-readable component certificate for g6.ml.adapt_sklearn at issuer state qualified-draft: rules by level (computes, property, guard) with the independent reader's attestations, what was not checked, and the full record.

nodes.name: checks.json
nodes.summary: Certificate harness configuration: names the producer and case authors, the adapter module, the refusal class (MLError), falsification seeds, count and precision, and boundary inputs per rule.

nodes.name: falsify.py
nodes.summary: Seeded falsification probes shared by adapt_sklearn and adapt_automl: generates random size, imbalance, grouping, constant-target and held-out perturbation inputs per rule and checks invariants on the observed values.

nodes.name: generate
nodes.summary: Produces a seeded list of random inputs for a named rule (split sizes, class imbalances, groups, metric vectors).

nodes.name: invariant
nodes.summary: Checks that an observed value satisfies the rule-specific invariant for the generated input (sizes sum, partitions disjoint, metric bounds).

nodes.name: scope.json
nodes.summary: Declares the certificate's not_checked scope for adapt_sklearn: which rules are property-checked rather than value-checked, G6's own thresholds, and what orchestration lies outside the numerical certificate.

nodes.name: second_route.py
nodes.summary: Independent second route for the certificate, shared with adapt_automl: recomputes each rule with counts, Decimal arithmetic and numpy array algebra without any estimator library, so its values can be compared with the adapter.

nodes.name: fold_mae
nodes.summary: Computes each fold's mean absolute error of predicting the other folds' target mean, sorted.

nodes.name: evaluate
nodes.summary: Per-rule independent computation of split sizes, stratified counts, metrics (accuracy, r2, mae, rmse, balanced accuracy) and baselines.

nodes.name: rule_review.json
nodes.summary: Independent reader's review of every graded adapt_sklearn rule: per-rule clause fairness, code match, source hash and findings, with the method, re-bound notes and a statement that the review raises no label.

nodes.name: estimators.py
nodes.summary: adapt_sklearn's estimator catalogue held as data: each named estimator's scikit-learn class per task, caller-settable parameters with ranges, fixed parameters and scaling, plus operator registration limited to sklearn classes; anything that looks like code is refused.

nodes.name: Param
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass describing one caller-settable parameter (int, float, choice or bool, with bounds) that checks a value and describes itself.

nodes.name: Estimator
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass naming an estimator, its sklearn class per task, its parameters, fixed values and scaling, with a describe method.

nodes.name: register_estimator
nodes.summary: Adds an operator-defined estimator to CATALOGUE after checking its name and that each class path lies under sklearn.

nodes.name: unregister_estimator
nodes.summary: Removes an estimator from CATALOGUE by name.

nodes.name: resolve
nodes.summary: Resolves a caller's estimator name, task and params against the catalogue, refusing dotted paths as untrusted code, unknown names and out-of-range parameters.

nodes.name: SKILL.md
nodes.summary: Agent skill for g6-adapt-sklearn: when to use and not use it, its ops, composition, failure modes caught (leakage, repeated rows, imbalance), reading results, blind spots, requirements, examples and open problems.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package entry for g6.model_checking: documents and re-exports symbolic Z3 model checking (check_invariant, prove_invariant, check_deadlock, reachable) and TLA+ TLC/SANY ops, and declares component metadata including Java as an outside program and the formal extra.

nodes.name: checks.py
nodes.summary: G6's re-check of every symbolic model-checking answer: traces are checked state by state on fresh Z3 solvers and unsat claims are decided again in a second Z3 context, with each failure named so finish can block a refuted answer.

nodes.name: Clock
nodes.summary: Deadline tracker shared by the search and the re-check, refusing time limits that are too long and reporting seconds and milliseconds left.

nodes.name: _Report
nodes.summary: Accumulates named re-check results and queries, records failures, and serialises the report as a dict.

nodes.name: _states
nodes.summary: Converts a trace into per-state equalities fixing every variable to its traced value.

nodes.name: _trace_checks
nodes.summary: Checks a trace step by step (init, transitions, distinct states, invariant break, no successor or goal) with one fresh-solver query each.

nodes.name: _fresh
nodes.summary: Decides a set of terms on a freshly built solver in a separate context.

nodes.name: _claim_checks
nodes.summary: Re-decides claims of no violation, all paths ending or k-inductiveness in a second Z3 context built from canonical text.

nodes.name: recheck
nodes.summary: Runs the trace and claim re-checks for a search outcome and returns the report.

nodes.name: recheck_trace
nodes.summary: Public re-check of a caller-supplied trace of a given kind against a model, within a time limit.

nodes.name: encoding.py
nodes.summary: Reads a symbolic state model through g6.formal's closed SMT-LIB grammar and encodes it for Z3 with per-step variable copies, so terms cannot carry commands and search and re-check can run in separate contexts.

nodes.name: Model
nodes.summary: Canonical parsed model: variables with sorts, init, transition and invariant terms, with next-state sorts and a summary.

nodes.name: Encoding
nodes.summary: Builds the model in its own Z3 context with a variable copy per step, giving step, invariant, target, path, distinctness and state terms used by BMC, k-induction and re-check.

nodes.name: z3_module
nodes.summary: Loads Z3 through g6.formal, refusing with a named code if it is unavailable.

nodes.name: read_model
nodes.summary: Validates and parses a model mapping or StateModel: variable names and sorts, limits, and every term through the closed grammar, returning a Model.

nodes.name: _value
nodes.summary: Converts a Z3 model value to a JSON-safe Python value for trace reporting.

nodes.name: literal
nodes.summary: Builds an SMT-LIB literal for a sort from a traced value, refusing values that do not fit the sort.

nodes.name: equalities
nodes.summary: Builds equality terms fixing a state's variables (optionally next-state copies) to their values.

nodes.name: envelope.py
nodes.summary: Stable G6_E_MODEL_CHECK_* codes and finish, the single place a model-checking result is labelled: refusals and violations become blocked-escalated, re-checked answers qualified-draft with a warning card stating their reach; never verified.

nodes.name: Refusal
nodes.summary: Exception carrying a G6_E_MODEL_CHECK code and reason, raised to refuse an op and turned into a blocked-escalated result.

nodes.name: labelled
nodes.summary: Runs an op body with timing, turning a Refusal into a finished blocked-escalated result with request and run ids.

nodes.name: finish
nodes.summary: Builds the labelled ModelCheckResult from engine, verdict, code, depth, trace and recheck, deciding completion_state and warning card.

nodes.name: _decide
nodes.summary: Chooses completion state and code from engine, verdict and re-check outcome; a failed re-check becomes CERTIFICATE_REFUTED.

nodes.name: _card
nodes.summary: Writes the warning card text and code stating how far an answer reaches (bounded, all paths end, k-induction, TLC's verdict).

nodes.name: model_checking_block.py
nodes.summary: ModelCheckingBlock, the registry and MCP door to g6.model_checking: a typed input that forbids unknown fields and a dispatch table mapping each op to the symbolic or TLC/SANY function; TLC and SANY ops are marked sensitive.

nodes.name: ModelCheckingInput
nodes.summary: Pydantic input for model-checking ops (model, goal, depth, time limit, TLA+ spec, module, config, invariants, constants, workers, heap) with extra fields forbidden.

nodes.name: ModelCheckingBlock
nodes.summary: AIBlock subclass that answers ops and help and runs the requested op through the dispatch table, returning its labelled result with component and op.

nodes.name: schema.py
nodes.summary: Pydantic schemas for g6.model_checking: the typed symbolic StateModel and the single labelled ModelCheckResult whose completion_state admits only qualified-draft or blocked-escalated.

nodes.name: StateModel
nodes.summary: Symbolic state model: variables with sorts, init and transition SMT-LIB terms and named invariants, with extra fields forbidden.

nodes.name: ModelCheckResult
nodes.summary: One op answer: engine, verdict, depths, k, trace and trace kind, re-check report, completion_state, warning_card, evidence and request/run ids.

nodes.name: SKILL.md
nodes.summary: Agent skill for g6-model-checking: when to check a state machine for invariants, deadlocks and reachability, when to use formal, csf or optimisation instead, ops, reading results, composition, blind spots, requirements and examples.

nodes.name: symbolic.py
nodes.summary: The four symbolic model-checking ops over Z3: bounded model checking for invariants, k-induction with distinct-state paths, deadlock search and goal reachability; vacuous models are refused and every answer is re-checked before labelling.

nodes.name: Outcome
nodes.summary: Dataclass holding a search outcome: verdict, depths reached, k, trace, trace kind, violated invariants and whether all paths end.

nodes.name: _check
nodes.summary: Runs one solver check within the clock, mapping unknown and timeouts to named refusals.

nodes.name: _bmc
nodes.summary: Bounded model checking loop that unrolls the transition step by step looking for an invariant break, deadlock or goal, and notes when every path ends early.

nodes.name: _k_induction
nodes.summary: k-induction from k=1 to depth: base case for counterexamples and induction step over distinct states, returning k_inductive, violated or not inductive.

nodes.name: _prepare
nodes.summary: Validates depth and time limit, reads the model, builds the Encoding and refuses vacuous init or transition before any search.

nodes.name: _reason
nodes.summary: Writes the human-readable reason for an outcome.

nodes.name: check_invariant
nodes.summary: Public op: bounded model checking of the invariants to depth, returning a labelled result with any counterexample trace.

nodes.name: prove_invariant
nodes.summary: Public op: k-induction proof attempt of the invariants up to depth.

nodes.name: check_deadlock
nodes.summary: Public op: searches for a reachable state with no successor within depth.

nodes.name: reachable
nodes.summary: Public op: searches for a trace to a state meeting the goal within depth.

nodes.name: tlc_output.py
nodes.summary: Pure-Python parser for TLC -tool and SANY output: reads nested message frames, decides TLC's verdict only when message and exit code agree (failing closed to unrecognised), and turns TLA+ values in traces into JSON.

nodes.name: _Reader
nodes.summary: Recursive-descent reader over TLA+ value tokens producing sets, sequences, records, functions and model values as JSON.

nodes.name: _frames
nodes.summary: Splits TLC -tool output into nested @!@!@STARTMSG/ENDMSG frames with codes and severities.

nodes.name: _assignments
nodes.summary: Collects a trace state's variable assignments, joining multi-line values.

nodes.name: parse_tlc_output
nodes.summary: Parses TLC output and exit code into verdict, counts, depth, version, errors and structured trace states.

nodes.name: _verdict
nodes.summary: Maps TLC message codes and exit code to a verdict only when they agree; anything else is unrecognised.

nodes.name: _sany_errors
nodes.summary: Extracts SANY's parse, semantic and level errors for the module.

nodes.name: parse_sany_output
nodes.summary: Parses SANY output and exit code into a clean or error verdict with its errors.

nodes.name: _string
nodes.summary: Decodes a TLA+ string literal token with its escapes.

nodes.name: parse_value
nodes.summary: Reads one TLA+ value text into JSON, falling back to {"text": ...} for anything unread.

nodes.name: tlc.py
nodes.summary: Runs TLA+ TLC and SANY out of process from a user-supplied tla2tools.jar pinned by SHA-256 on Java 11+: fresh run directory, minimal environment, time limit, output cap, process-tree kill and OS confinement where available.

nodes.name: jar_release
nodes.summary: Reads the jar manifest to tell a 1.7 release from a main-line build, which decides which flags TLC and SANY get.

nodes.name: _module
nodes.summary: Checks the module name against the spec's header and standard module names.

nodes.name: _config
nodes.summary: Builds the TLC config text from specification, invariants, properties and constants, refusing malformed names.

nodes.name: _jar
nodes.summary: Resolves the jar path and pinned digest from G6_TLA2TOOLS_JAR and G6_TLA2TOOLS_SHA256, refusing a missing jar or digest.

nodes.name: _java
nodes.summary: Finds the java program from G6_JAVA or PATH, refusing if absent.

nodes.name: _stage
nodes.summary: Copies the jar into the run directory while hashing it, refusing a digest mismatch so the bytes that run are the bytes checked.

nodes.name: _execute
nodes.summary: Launches Java through component_process and confine with time limit, output cap, heap and minimal environment, recording isolation.

nodes.name: _run_tool
nodes.summary: Prepares a fresh run directory, writes spec and config files, stages the jar and runs TLC or SANY, cleaning up afterwards.

nodes.name: _tlc_reason
nodes.summary: Writes the reason text for a TLC run from its verdict and first errors.

nodes.name: tlc_check
nodes.summary: Public sensitive op: model-checks a TLA+ spec with TLC and returns TLC's verdict, counts and trace as a labelled result.

nodes.name: sany_parse
nodes.summary: Public sensitive op: SANY syntax, semantic and level check of a spec, nothing model-checked.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package entry for g6.navigator: re-exports op cards from parameter contracts and plan checking/running (check_plan, run_plan) against the registry, contracts and authority rule, and records what was not ported from the archive's navigator.

nodes.name: authority.py
nodes.summary: Applies the workforce planner's authority rule to the ops a plan names: an op below class A1 is refused, and an op that can act externally or irreversibly is refused below A2, using the shipped census bound to each contract's digest.

nodes.name: catalog.py
nodes.summary: Builds one op's card from its ParamContract and its component's own help line: purpose, maturity, authority class, parameters, side effect, cost and example, trimmed to a fixed character budget.

nodes.name: plan.py
nodes.summary: Statically checks a plan of G6 op calls against the registry, parameter contracts, authority rule and effect budget, reporting every problem with a stable G6_E_* code, and runs a plan through an injected executor only when the whole plan passes; results are qualified-draft at best.

nodes.name: SKILL.md
nodes.summary: Agent skill guide for g6.navigator covering when to check a multi-step op plan before running it, the Python API, how to read the result, failure modes caught, blind spots and examples.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package entry for g6.operator, a simulation-first outer loop for a venture with budgeted ticks and a person-decided approval queue; re-exports the queue, loop, router, gates and store APIs and documents what the operator never does (send, post, pay, deploy).

nodes.name: gates.py
nodes.summary: Pure-function stop checks for a venture's monthly model and cash budgets: exact number and text conversion, cap lookup, overspend comparison with float slack, and the stop and spend-refusal reasons; a missing or invalid budget is a stop, never no limit.

nodes.name: loop.py
nodes.summary: One operator tick: reserves the task's cost against the month's budget with the stop check, runs it on an executor, judges the output with the caller's checks from the operator's own record, and routes outward drafts through action gating and draft checks into the approval queue.

nodes.name: queue.py
nodes.summary: The approval queue for outward drafts and proposed tasks: drafts enter as proposed and leave only by a named reviewer's approve, reject or mark_sent decision recorded append-only, with optional decoy drafts that measure reviewer attention, task ranking and opt-in model task proposals.

nodes.name: router.py
nodes.summary: Deterministic draft checks with no model call (recipient list, quote witness, price floor, secret scan, spend amount) plus shadow-mode learned guards; a draft is blocked-escalated when a check fails and qualified-draft otherwise.

nodes.name: SKILL.md
nodes.summary: Agent skill guide for g6.operator covering task ranking by declared estimates, optional model decomposition into a review queue, budgeted task ticks, the Python API, failure modes, blind spots and examples.

nodes.name: store.py
nodes.summary: The operator's durable SQLite state: owner-scoped ventures, append-only evidence and decision tables enforced by triggers, a monthly spend ledger with reservations checked against caps in one immediate transaction, and provider-week spans on a monotonic UTC clock.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses SQLite triggers to make evidence and ledger tables append-only, and BEGIN IMMEDIATE transactions so concurrent tickers cannot both pass a cap.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package entry for g6.optimisation, solving linear, integer, constraint, routing, flow and scheduling problems on OR-Tools and non-linear ones on SciPy, re-exporting every solve function and documenting that each answer is checked before it is reported.

nodes.name: checks.py
nodes.summary: G6's own pure-Python checks of optimiser answers: LP duality certificates, infeasibility via the least-violation programme, unboundedness via an improving ray, integer and CP feasibility, negative-cycle optimality for assignment and min-cost flow, cut equality for max flow, and route, job-shop and knapsack validation.

nodes.name: combinatorial.py
nodes.summary: Knapsack on OR-Tools' multidimensional branch-and-bound solver and job-shop scheduling on CP-SAT interval variables, with size limits and each answer checked before it is reported.

nodes.name: engine.py
nodes.summary: Shared machinery for every optimisation op: lazy OR-Tools import that suppresses the SWIG DeprecationWarning crash, input parsing into problem models, time and size limits, and run(), which turns an op's work or refusal into a labelled result.

nodes.name: envelope.py
nodes.summary: Stable G6_E_OPTIM_* codes and finish(), the single place an optimisation result is labelled blocked-escalated or qualified-draft, with warning cards stating what G6 checked and what still rests on the solver or search.

nodes.name: networks.py
nodes.summary: Linear sum assignment, maximum flow and minimum-cost flow on ortools.graph, and vehicle routing with capacities and time windows on OR-Tools' routing library, each answer checked and routing reported as not proven optimal.

nodes.name: nonlinear.py
nodes.summary: Box-bounded non-linear search with SciPy: objectives are JSON expression trees walked by G6's own bounded interpreter, minimise runs multistart local methods and global_search runs differential evolution or a registered backend, and every answer is re-evaluated, gradient-checked and probed for lower neighbours.
nodes.languageNotes: Replaces eval of caller formulas with a JSON expression tree, a parser and two independent evaluators (an interpreter and compiled closures) so the search and the check use separate code paths.

nodes.name: optimisation_block.py
nodes.summary: OptimisationBlock, the registry and MCP door to g6.optimisation: a typed input model refuses unknown fields and each op calls one public solve function and returns its labelled envelope unchanged.

nodes.name: programmes.py
nodes.summary: Linear programmes on GLOP and mixed-integer ones on SCIP through OR-Tools MathOpt, and constraint models on CP-SAT; G6 decides infeasible or unbounded itself with checked certificates and reports integer optimality with the solver's gap.

nodes.name: schema.py
nodes.summary: Declarative pydantic inputs for g6.optimisation (variables, linear constraints, arcs, tasks and each problem model, which validate that their pieces fit together) and OptimResult, whose completion_state admits only qualified-draft or blocked-escalated.

nodes.name: SKILL.md
nodes.summary: Agent skill guide for g6.optimisation listing its ops, when to call a solver instead of reasoning out a schedule or allocation, how to read the result and its certificate, failure modes, blind spots and examples.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package entry for g6.prolog, which queries a restricted-syntax Prolog program on an out-of-process SWI-Prolog with time, memory and output limits and re-checks every answer; re-exports query, prove and the block, schema and envelope.

nodes.name: driver.pl
nodes.summary: G6's fixed SWI-Prolog driver module: reads the caller's program clause by clause, refuses directives and clauses outside the restricted syntax and allow-list, runs the goal under time and inference limits, and prints nonce-prefixed JSON records for check, query and recheck modes.
nodes.languageNotes: A Prolog module (g6_driver) that never consults the caller program; clauses are read with read_term/3 and asserted into a separate g6_program module, and library(sandbox) safe_goal/1 adds a second check.

nodes.name: driver.py
nodes.summary: Writes the request.json G6 hands to driver.pl and parses the driver's nonce-prefixed JSON records, refusing any output that is not one complete, well-formed run.

nodes.name: shipped_authority
nodes.summary: Builds the library's default authority reading from the CENSUS table, counting a row only for the exact contract digest it was read for.

nodes.name: measured
nodes.summary: Returns an op's authority class from a reading, or None when the reading gives nothing on the A0-A4 ladder.

nodes.name: judge
nodes.summary: Returns None when an op is cleared by the authority rule, else a Finding saying why (not cleared, or acts below A2).

nodes.name: Finding
nodes.summary: Dataclass for one authority refusal: its stable code and reason.

nodes.name: contract_for
nodes.summary: Looks up the ParamContract declared for a component op.

nodes.name: listed_ops
nodes.summary: Lists the ops a component's own block names, through g6.core.discovery.

nodes.name: ops_of
nodes.summary: Returns every op of a component named by a contract or by its block.

nodes.name: purpose
nodes.summary: Returns the component's own help line for an op, capped at PURPOSE_CHARS, or empty when none is given.

nodes.name: card
nodes.summary: Assembles one op's card (purpose, maturity, authority class, parameters, side effect, cost, example), or None when no contract or block names the op.

nodes.name: _fit
nodes.summary: Trims a card to CARD_CHARS by dropping the example, then optional parameter types, then their names.

nodes.name: _plain
nodes.summary: Makes a JSON-safe copy of an answer for a result that crosses a surface.

nodes.name: Issue
nodes.summary: One plan problem: the step it belongs to, a stable code and the reason in words.

nodes.name: StepCheck
nodes.summary: How one plan step was judged, with its issues, serialisable for a surface.

nodes.name: PlanReport
nodes.summary: check_plan's answer: valid only when no step has a problem, with state qualified-draft or blocked-escalated and a warning card.

nodes.name: _check_step
nodes.summary: Judges one step: registered and loadable component, declared and non-sensitive op, args fitting the contract, the authority rule and the effect budget.

nodes.name: check_plan
nodes.summary: Checks every step of a plan before anything runs and returns a PlanReport listing each problem with its step and code.

nodes.name: StepRun
nodes.summary: One executed step: ok or failed, with its answer or why it failed.

nodes.name: PlanResult
nodes.summary: run_plan's answer: the check it ran first, every step it ran, and the state of the whole run.

nodes.name: _run_step
nodes.summary: Runs one checked step through the executor and classifies the outcome as ok or failed (raised, Failure, block or error).

nodes.name: run_plan
nodes.summary: Runs a plan step by step through an injected executor only after check_plan passes it, stopping at the first failed step.

nodes.name: kind_of
nodes.summary: Names a value's class for a message without letting a caller's class render itself, raise or run long.

nodes.name: exact_number
nodes.summary: Converts a value to an exact finite float, refusing bools, texts and anything that is not plainly a number.

nodes.name: exact_text
nodes.summary: Converts a value to a plain str, refusing anything that is not exactly a string.

nodes.name: amount_of
nodes.summary: Reads a non-negative spend amount from a value.

nodes.name: cap_of
nodes.summary: Reads one account's monthly cap from a venture's caps, treating a missing or invalid cap as unknown.

nodes.name: over
nodes.summary: Tells whether a total passes its cap, allowing a tiny floating-point slack.

nodes.name: total
nodes.summary: Sums a sequence of amounts exactly with math.fsum.

nodes.name: stop_reason
nodes.summary: Returns why a venture must stop (status, unknown budget or overspend on either account), or None.

nodes.name: spend_refusal
nodes.summary: Returns why a given spend on an account may not start, or None when it fits under the cap.

nodes.name: Task
nodes.summary: One task a tick runs: id, description, the cost to reserve and the caller's checks.

nodes.name: ExecutionResult
nodes.summary: An executor's output, its outward draft proposals and its reported cost.

nodes.name: Executor
nodes.summary: Protocol for an executor: an actor name and execute(task) returning an ExecutionResult.

nodes.name: SimulatedExecutor
nodes.summary: Replays scripted results by task id or from a function of the task, with no model, shell, file or network access.

nodes.name: gate
nodes.summary: Runs g6.action_gating.evaluate_action on an outward draft declared as an external action by the drafting actor.

nodes.name: tick
nodes.summary: Runs one budgeted operator tick: stop-and-reserve, execute, judge with checks from the operator's record, settle cost, and queue gated drafts as proposed.

nodes.name: QueueError
nodes.summary: Error for a queue decision that cannot be made, carrying a sentence a person can act on.

nodes.name: ActionQueue
nodes.summary: Owner-scoped approval queue: enqueues drafts and task proposals as proposed, records approve/reject/mark_sent decisions by a named non-drafting reviewer, plants optional decoys, and promotes shadow guards.

nodes.name: Estimate
nodes.summary: Pydantic estimate whose source is mandatory; the source is context, not proof of accuracy.

nodes.name: TaskProposal
nodes.summary: A stored task proposal: a task draft with its id and creation time.

nodes.name: rank
nodes.summary: Ranks tasks by value times likelihood over effort, then oldest first, using declared estimates only by default.

nodes.name: propose_tasks
nodes.summary: Decomposes a goal into task proposals with an explicitly injected model caller and stores them as internal proposals, never outward actions.

nodes.name: Finding
nodes.summary: One draft-check finding: name, status (pass, fail, not_measured, n/a) and reason.

nodes.name: Guard
nodes.summary: A learned draft check that runs in shadow until a person promotes it in the approval queue; carries a source hash.

nodes.name: Context
nodes.summary: What the draft checks may compare against: allowed contacts, a price floor and the guards to run.

nodes.name: Routed
nodes.summary: The outcome of routing a draft: state, code, findings and which checks fired.

nodes.name: _witness
nodes.summary: Checks that an attributed quote in a draft is a substring of the evidence the draft cites.

nodes.name: route
nodes.summary: Runs every built-in check and guard on a draft and returns a Routed outcome; never verified.

nodes.name: utc
nodes.summary: Normalises any instant entering the store to UTC so two renderings of one instant compare equal.

nodes.name: utc_clock
nodes.summary: Wraps a caller clock so every reading it gives is a UTC instant.

nodes.name: stored_amount
nodes.summary: Reads an amount back from the ledger as a finite non-negative number, raising on anything unreadable rather than reading zero.

nodes.name: _name
nodes.summary: Converts a name entering the store to a plain str once, through gates.exact_text.

nodes.name: append_only
nodes.summary: Generates SQLite triggers refusing UPDATE, DELETE and REPLACE over an existing key on a table.

nodes.name: Held
nodes.summary: One reservation on a provider's weeks: amount reserved, amount charged once settled, and settlement time.

nodes.name: BudgetRefused
nodes.summary: Raised when a spend may not start: venture stopped, budget unknown or cap would be exceeded.

nodes.name: OperatorStore
nodes.summary: Opens the operator SQLite database (default $G6_HOME/operator.db), runs schema scripts and transactions, and hands out owner scopes.

nodes.name: OwnerScope
nodes.summary: One owner's view of the store: ventures, append-only evidence, the monthly ledger with reserve/settle, provider-week spans and reading times.

nodes.name: Check
nodes.summary: The result of checking an optimiser answer: what was checked, failures found, tolerance and any optimality certificate.

nodes.name: _feasibility
nodes.summary: Lists every bound and constraint of a linear problem that the given values break, within scaled tolerance.

nodes.name: check_feasible
nodes.summary: Checks that values meet every bound and constraint of a linear problem.

nodes.name: check_mip
nodes.summary: Checks a mixed-integer answer: feasibility, recomputed objective and the solver's bound on the correct side.

nodes.name: check_lp
nodes.summary: Checks a linear optimum with its duals: feasibility, recomputed reduced costs, dual feasibility and no duality gap.

nodes.name: elastic
