nodes.name: stop_lock
nodes.summary: The lock shared by a stop's writer and a start's reading of the stop state.

nodes.name: _stop_held
nodes.summary: Why the stop lock refuses an admission: held past the wait by a stop being written or one that could not write its record.

nodes.name: admission
nodes.summary: The decision every path that admits loop work takes: the stop reading plus the stop lock, so a stop being written refuses admission.

nodes.name: stop_standing
nodes.summary: Why this folder is stopped, or an empty string, from stop_in_force.

nodes.name: stop_to_lift
nodes.summary: The STOP file's and canonical stops' part of what a start binds when it lifts a stop.

nodes.name: what_stops
nodes.summary: Code and reason for what stops work on a given start, decided again from stop_in_force's reading.

nodes.name: enrolment_changed
nodes.summary: Why the enrolment on record differs from the one a start agreed to, or an empty string.

nodes.name: file_digest
nodes.summary: SHA-256 of a file, or empty when there is no file, pinning what a person enrolled.

nodes.name: stops_asked
nodes.summary: Counts the stops the journal holds, from stop_in_force's reading.

nodes.name: _durably
nodes.summary: Appends rows to a file on a fresh line and flushes to disk before returning.

nodes.name: _last_byte
nodes.summary: Reads the last byte a file holds through a read-only handle.

nodes.name: flush_journal
nodes.summary: Context manager that flushes the stop journal to disk via the caller's own handle and yields its file identity.

nodes.name: _establish_stop
nodes.summary: Writes a canonical stop with G6's own id and time, falling back to the directory as the independent gate if a write fails.

nodes.name: stop_entries
nodes.summary: The exact STOP entry and counted journal line for one written stop identity.

nodes.name: ask_to_stop
nodes.summary: Public Python API to stop the loop, preserving cancellation once the canonical gate stands.

nodes.name: ask_to_stop_receipt
nodes.summary: Managed stop entry that returns its own StopReceipt even under cancellation.

nodes.name: _ask_to_stop
nodes.summary: Writes a stop: the canonical record, the journal line and the STOP file under the stop lock, so the first reason stands and repeats are safe.

nodes.name: note_refusal
nodes.summary: Appends a request a classifier or permission refused to an append-only file so it is never sent again.

nodes.name: refused_requests
nodes.summary: Digests of each request note_refusal kept.

nodes.name: refusal_rows
nodes.summary: Reads each whole refusal row, skipping rows a crash cut short and raising on unreadable files.

nodes.name: record_stop
nodes.summary: Notes a stop in the records so a start no longer stands once the STOP file is gone; never raises.

nodes.name: end_start
nodes.summary: Durably ends a start that a stop ended, writing through ask_to_stop beside any stopped row.

nodes.name: runner_lock
nodes.summary: The OS lock a runner holds for its whole life; a second runner is refused.

nodes.name: runner_alive
nodes.summary: Whether a runner holds the folder's lock, writing nothing while looking.

nodes.name: beat_holding
nodes.summary: Writes the heartbeat while holding the runner lock, returning False when another holds it.

nodes.name: beat
nodes.summary: Writes the heartbeat whole via swap, retrying briefly when a Windows reader holds the file.

nodes.name: heartbeat
nodes.summary: Reads the folder's last heartbeat.

nodes.name: UserSignal
nodes.summary: Validated aggregate user signal: cohort, task success, time-to-value, satisfaction, friction, accessibility, consent and observation flags.

nodes.name: ExperienceSummary
nodes.summary: Aggregate experience metrics with state, covered cohorts and stated limitations.

nodes.name: summarize_experience
nodes.summary: Summarises consented, independently observed signals into an ExperienceSummary, or insufficient_evidence below the minimum sample.

nodes.name: experience_obligations
nodes.summary: The obligations for collecting and acting on consented user feedback.

nodes.name: allowed_source
nodes.summary: Whether a maintenance change may touch a path: inside the safe source globs and outside protected parts, files and adaptation-gate hits.

nodes.name: BudgetPolicy
nodes.summary: Validated daily token budget policy per provider for maintenance cycles.

nodes.name: MaintenanceTicket
nodes.summary: Validated maintenance ticket with evidence, allowed files, tests and token estimate.

nodes.name: Reservation
nodes.summary: A token reservation made against the budget book.

nodes.name: Plan
nodes.summary: The ranked plan of tickets selected within a budget.

nodes.name: BudgetBook
nodes.summary: One-worker append-only budget and outcome book on a chain ledger, reserving and settling tokens per day and provider.

nodes.name: rank_tickets
nodes.summary: Deterministically ranks tickets and selects those that fit the remaining budget for a day and provider.

nodes.name: ProviderWindow
nodes.summary: A provider's weekly allowance window with placement in the week, next day and week end.

nodes.name: read_settings
nodes.summary: Reads the loop folder's settings.json, raising ValueError on a malformed file.

nodes.name: windows_from
nodes.summary: Builds the provider windows a settings file declares, rejecting none, nonsensical or duplicate ones.

nodes.name: windows_by_provider
nodes.summary: Indexes windows by provider, rejecting a provider named twice.

nodes.name: target
nodes.summary: Pacing target for day d of a provider's week: allowance x d / 7.

nodes.name: ceiling
nodes.summary: Pacing ceiling for day d: allowance x min(1, d / 5) less the owner's reserve.

nodes.name: figure_of
nodes.summary: The one check of a figure an account reports: a finite number from zero to a maximum, or None.

nodes.name: AccountReading
nodes.summary: A validated reading of a provider account's use at a moment.

nodes.name: standing
nodes.summary: The one rule for whether an account reading still holds at a moment.

nodes.name: Admission
nodes.summary: Validated decision on whether a session may start under the pacing ceiling.

nodes.name: _used
nodes.summary: What a week has used from overlapping reservations and the account's own figure, taking the larger.

nodes.name: BudgetMeter
nodes.summary: Meters provider weeks against the operator store: reads accounts, decides admission under the ceiling, reserves, settles and recovers reservations.

nodes.name: Gate
nodes.summary: Protocol for the loop's one check on a send about to leave a watched caller.

nodes.name: UsageUnavailable
nodes.summary: Raised when a provider tool gives no usable reading.

nodes.name: _Delivery
nodes.summary: Private delivery copies of a request's input files, released with the send.

nodes.name: Request
nodes.summary: An admitted immutable host-model request and its canonical encoding, of which only the digest is persisted.

nodes.name: Send
nodes.summary: Immutable record of one send as the loop let it out, with its identity and whether its caller is watched.

nodes.name: ProviderStop
nodes.summary: LLMError a watched caller raises for a provider-reported stop, carrying G6's code and the send record.

nodes.name: _Watched
nodes.summary: Mixin for watched host callers that releases sends whose program never answers when the call ends.

nodes.name: WatchedClaude
nodes.summary: Claude Code host caller as the loop calls it, checked as it sends, raising G6 codes for stops in its JSON result.

nodes.name: WatchedCodex
nodes.summary: Codex host caller as the loop calls it, printing JSON events and raising G6 codes for stops or failed turns.

nodes.name: AccountReader
nodes.summary: The BudgetMeter's read_account: refreshes and hands back the provider tool's latest standing reading between ticks.

nodes.name: _ran
nodes.summary: Runs a program contained in its own folder with a clean environment and reads how it ended.

nodes.name: read_limits
nodes.summary: Reads one rate-limits answer from a program speaking codex app-server's protocol.

nodes.name: codex_limits
nodes.summary: What Codex reports of the account, from its own program.

nodes.name: limit_ends
nodes.summary: When the limit a failed request hit ends, from G6's own leading code, or None.

nodes.name: refused_by
nodes.summary: Returns the classifier or permission stop code a failure carries, deciding only from G6's own leading codes.

nodes.name: claude_said
nodes.summary: What Claude Code's JSON result says stopped the turn, in G6's own words.

nodes.name: _codex_kind
nodes.summary: Which known stop kind a Codex error event is.

nodes.name: _reply_events
nodes.summary: Total JSON/JSONL read of a reply, keeping earlier events when a later read fails.

nodes.name: _read_reply
nodes.summary: Total native-format read of a host reply, including the bound Claude reader.

nodes.name: _event_outcome
nodes.summary: Gives every native result event an explicit state.

nodes.name: _reply_outcome
nodes.summary: One ordered rule over native events: refusal persists and only a later completion clears a wait.

nodes.name: codex_said
nodes.summary: What Codex's JSON events say stopped the turn, in G6's own words.

nodes.name: plain_text
nodes.summary: Owns the underlying text of a string, bypassing subclass rendering hooks.

nodes.name: _text_bytes
nodes.summary: Encodes request text to bytes for digesting.

nodes.name: request_digest
nodes.summary: Digest a refused model request is known by when no host input can be seen.

nodes.name: request_identity
nodes.summary: Digest of a host request's launch arguments and input, the identity a refusal is keyed on.

nodes.name: _windows_files
nodes.summary: Windows-specific helpers for opening input files by handle.

nodes.name: _open_input
nodes.summary: Opens an input once without following the final link and judges ancestors by the handle's final path.

nodes.name: _final_path
nodes.summary: The opened object's OS path name, never a re-resolution of its spelling.

nodes.name: _file_identity
nodes.summary: File identity from the admitted open: volume serial and file id on Windows, device and inode elsewhere.

nodes.name: _output_identity
nodes.summary: Identity of an existing output or an uncreated slot under its opened parent.

nodes.name: _output_place
nodes.summary: Places a not-yet-created output where its nearest existing opened parent lives.

nodes.name: _host_input
nodes.summary: Reads the host identity format and the exact file bytes it names together, once.

nodes.name: telling_stops
nodes.summary: Context in which watched callers ask the loop's gate before sending and report stops to it first.

nodes.name: _sending
nodes.summary: Last step before a watched caller's program starts: the gate lets it out or keeps it in and records the send.

nodes.name: _forget
nodes.summary: Releases a send's own record once its outcome is known.

nodes.name: _stopped
nodes.summary: Tells the loop what the provider said of a send, then raises it as the request's failure.

nodes.name: _released
nodes.summary: Releases sends of a call that ended without a reply.

nodes.name: _complete_host
nodes.summary: The owned completion path for host callers: hooks before admission, the consent sharing check, then launch.

nodes.name: _remember_host
nodes.summary: Remembers which owned route a host caller was constructed for.

nodes.name: _native_host_note
nodes.summary: Requires owned launch data for a borrowed native completion.

nodes.name: launch_record
nodes.summary: The immutable launch a note is about, supplied only by the owned path.

nodes.name: loop_tick
nodes.summary: Context marking that a loop tick of this process is open.

nodes.name: _note_launch
nodes.summary: Last step before an owned launch starts, after the consent sharing check.

nodes.name: _check_observation
nodes.summary: Checks an observation of a host reply before classification.

nodes.name: _classify_reply
nodes.summary: The one reply decision: refusal first, then unread or unfinished replies, stops, failures and answers.

nodes.name: _check_seam
nodes.summary: Checks that a host caller's hooks run before admission and its completion and launch are final.

nodes.name: _new_host
nodes.summary: Chooses the dormant cleanup wrapper for a host caller at construction.

nodes.name: read_stops
nodes.summary: Enables the observer selected at construction without changing a live caller's class.

nodes.name: watched
nodes.summary: Whether a sender reads its program's output itself.

nodes.name: _window
nodes.summary: Converts one window of the tool's reply to plain values: percentage, length and reset time.

nodes.name: _reset
nodes.summary: When a converted window resets, where that can be believed.

nodes.name: limits_reading
nodes.summary: Turns a provider's reported limits into a meter reading in the meter's unit, or None when they do not read.

nodes.name: BenchmarkCase
nodes.summary: One named input with an equality assertion, where explicit None is an expected value.

nodes.name: run_cases
nodes.summary: Runs trusted code on each asserted case and returns a RunSummary; missing assertions make the run unevaluable.

nodes.name: ScopeVerdict
nodes.summary: Enum of scope verdicts: allow, hitl, block.

nodes.name: ChangeScope
nodes.summary: A proposed change as data: target component and changed or deleted paths.

nodes.name: ScopeDecision
nodes.summary: Scope verdict with every reason as a G6_E_ code and path.

nodes.name: classify_change_scope

nodes.name: _fold

nodes.name: _answers

nodes.name: disclosed

nodes.name: reads_its_artifact

nodes.name: Run

nodes.name: RunLedger

nodes.name: outcome_of

nodes.name: person_option

nodes.name: decide

nodes.name: mode_of

nodes.name: escalation

nodes.name: retry_codes

nodes.name: certificates_enabled

nodes.name: readiness_enabled

nodes.name: attention

nodes.name: trace
nodes.summary: Reconstructs one of the owner's missions into its P0 fields, task class and environment.

nodes.name: _candidates

nodes.name: assemble

nodes.name: _cost

nodes.name: _failure

nodes.name: _recovery

nodes.name: _human

nodes.name: stages

nodes.name: elicits

nodes.name: _retrieve

nodes.name: _execute

nodes.name: _verify_progress

nodes.name: _reconfigure

nodes.name: _adjudicate

nodes.summary: SQLite store for plan units with dependencies, cycle checks, ownership, transitions and event logs.

nodes.name: SKILL.md
nodes.summary: Agent skill for g6.workforce with 11 sections: when to use frozen-standard coding missions, the Python API (bind, allow_execution, create_coding_mission, confirm, submit_patch, certificate, repo_tests.run), what a person approves, failure modes caught, blind spots, requirements, examples and open problems.

nodes.name: truth.py
nodes.summary: Decides what a seed venture may truthfully claim: a claim holds only when the test truth.json binds it to exists and passes in a sealed, confined subprocess, and assertive unbound shapes (certified, approved by, used by N, N%) are extracted as false claims. Also hosts the isolated pytest runners (run_isolated, run_suite) and pytest tally parsing used by the workforce test bench.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a thread-local MutableMapping (_LastRun) so concurrent test runs on different threads each read only their own last-run diagnostics.

nodes.name: verify.py
nodes.summary: Independent verification for workforce results: derives its own pytest run set from git changes, detects weakened tests by AST comparison (removed or guarded asserts, early returns, new skips), checks cited files/tests/symbols exist, and validates result.json shape and queued outward actions, returning Verdict objects with failure-kind codes.
nodes.languageNotes: Leans on Python's ast module to compare test functions before and after a change rather than diffing text.

nodes.name: view.py
nodes.summary: Builds the read-only ResultView of a mission as its owner sees it: the answer from final outputs, the trust state with checks in plain words, problems from failure classes, disagreeing checks as interpretations, evidence with provenance, and cost. Deterministic so two processes render the same mission identically.

nodes.name: wakes.py
nodes.summary: Manages what a waiting mission waits for (timer, inbox file, chat submission, approval decision, retry) and what wakes it, persisting armed/fired/dropped wake rows in SQLite with triggers that make each wake arm once and end once, and firing a whole waiting episode in one compare-and-set transaction.
nodes.languageNotes: Embeds SQLite DDL with BEFORE UPDATE/DELETE triggers to enforce append-only, end-once wake semantics at the database level.

nodes.name: workers.py
nodes.summary: Defines workers as bounded execution policies: a WorkerSpec formed from a JSON template and narrowed field by field under the mission's RuntimePolicy ceiling, refusing any widening and never producing an empty allowlist.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package marker for the workspace family of extensions (shared files and versioned libraries); declares the family name and is not itself a component.

nodes.name: _coordination.py
nodes.summary: Coordinates several agents in one workspace folder: an OS-backed exclusive mutex file, per-path locks with hashed tokens and time-to-live (expired locks may be taken over and logged), and an append-only JSONL log of refused writes and takeovers.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses platform-specific OS file locking (kernel32 LockFileEx through ctypes on Windows, fcntl.flock elsewhere) so the OS releases the mutex on process death rather than by age.

nodes.name: _envelope.py
nodes.summary: Defines the workspace family's stable G6_E_WORKSPACE_* and G6_E_LIBRARY_* codes, the action text for each refusal, and the labelled WorkspaceResult every op returns (qualified-draft answers or blocked-escalated refusals, never verified).

nodes.name: _files.py
nodes.summary: Implements the Workspace folder shared by the family: every caller path is contained against the root as part of each read and write, writes are atomic with re-checked parent folders and optional expect_sha256 stale-write checks under the coordination mutex, and backups, restores and clean-up are guarded gzip tar operations that default to dry runs.
nodes.languageNotes: Defends against TOCTOU link swaps by re-resolving an opened file's real folder before replacing, and uses tarfile's data filter on restore.

nodes.name: _ops.py
nodes.summary: Shared helpers for workspace members' ops: run an act on a task's Workspace converting refusals and OS errors into blocked-escalated results, build observation evidence, and read a UTF-8 file with its SHA-256.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package entry for the align_prompt_library extension, a versioned append-only library of prompts, specs and eval sets addressed by content SHA-256; re-exports the block, ops and library and declares component metadata (sensitive ops, mitigated and introduced failure modes).

nodes.name: _entry.py
nodes.summary: Defines the frozen CatalogueEntry dataclass for one shipped prompt (name, stage, mode, step, purpose, source, template) with its content digest and dict form.

nodes.name: block.py
nodes.summary: AlignPromptLibraryBlock, the registry and MCP door for the prompt library: a strict pydantic input refusing unknown ops/fields, dispatching each op to the ops module and marking put/retire/rollback/install_catalog as sensitive.

nodes.name: catalogue.py
nodes.summary: The single prompt catalogue G6 ships, combining the cognitive-bootstrap and metacognition entries; lists and renders entries by work mode and pipeline step and installs them into the library as candidate templates without overwriting a person's own prompts.

nodes.name: cognitive_prompts.py
nodes.summary: Static catalogue data: the fourteen cognitive-bootstrap meta-prompts from pull request #4, each tied to a work mode and pipeline step, with placeholders rewritten into the library's {{x}} form.

nodes.name: library.py
nodes.summary: The append-only versioned Library on g6.core.ledger: put, get, history, search, render (strict one-pass placeholder fill), rollback as a new version and retire as a tombstone, with chain and library rules (no version gaps, fixed kind, digest equals content SHA-256) checked on every open.

nodes.name: metacognition.py
nodes.summary: Static catalogue data: metacognition and critical-thinking prompts from pull request #6, each sharing a common guard preamble and tied to a work mode and pipeline step (never the gate step).

nodes.name: ops.py
nodes.summary: Operation functions of the prompt library (put, get, history, search, render, retire, rollback, catalogue, install_catalog), each opening the Library and returning a labelled WorkspaceResult with stable G6_E_LIBRARY_* codes.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package entry for the shared_workspace extension that lets several agents share one workspace folder with first-write-wins semantics and stale writes refused; re-exports block and ops and declares component metadata.

nodes.name: block.py
nodes.summary: SharedWorkspaceBlock, the registry and MCP door for the shared workspace extension, validating a strict typed input and dispatching to read/write/lock/unlock/locks/conflicts ops.

nodes.name: ops.py
nodes.summary: Shared-workspace ops: read with SHA-256, write requiring the version read (expect_sha256) so the first write wins and stale writes are refused and logged, path locks with tokens, and listings of locks and conflicts.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package entry for the workspace_manager extension that gives each agent task its own contained workspace folder; re-exports Workspace, block and ops and declares component metadata.

nodes.name: block.py
nodes.summary: WorkspaceManagerBlock, the registry and MCP door for the workspace manager, validating a strict typed input and dispatching contained/read/files/status/write/backup/restore/cleanup ops (the changing ones sensitive).

nodes.name: SKILL.md

nodes.summary: Agent skill guide for the G6 shared workspace with 11 sections: when to use it and not, its ops, alone and composed use, failure modes it catches, reading the result, blind spots, needs, examples and open problems.

nodes.name: _LastRun

nodes.name: Truth

nodes.name: Verdict

nodes.name: _test_functions

nodes.name: cited

nodes.name: _has_test

nodes.name: queued_action

nodes.name: _said

nodes.summary: Releases the OS exclusive lock on the mutex file.

nodes.name: WorkspaceRefused
nodes.summary: Exception carrying a stable workspace code, its reason and details, turned into a blocked-escalated result by the ops.

nodes.name: WorkspaceResult
nodes.summary: Pydantic labelled result with completion state limited to qualified-draft or blocked-escalated, warning card, evidence and request/run ids.

nodes.name: answer
nodes.summary: Builds a qualified-draft WorkspaceResult with a warning card naming what it rests on.

nodes.name: refuse
nodes.summary: Builds a blocked-escalated WorkspaceResult with the refusal code, reason and suggested action.

nodes.name: Workspace
nodes.summary: A contained workspace folder for one task or a caller-chosen root: path containment, read, list, status, atomic write with stale-write and lock checks, locks, backups, restore and clean-up, all dry-run by default for changes.

nodes.name: check_task
nodes.summary: Validates a task id as a plain name.

nodes.name: check_backup
nodes.summary: Validates a backup archive name.

nodes.name: sha256_bytes
nodes.summary: Returns the SHA-256 hex digest of bytes.

nodes.name: sha256_file
nodes.summary: Returns the SHA-256 hex digest of a file read in chunks.

nodes.name: _open_directory
nodes.summary: Opens a directory handle without following links (O_NOFOLLOW on POSIX, a Windows handle otherwise) for device/inode re-checks.

nodes.name: _checked_listing
nodes.summary: Lists an opened directory only if its device and inode still match the checked one, rejecting links at every depth.

nodes.name: _remove
nodes.summary: Removes a tree, deleting links themselves rather than following them and rechecking each directory before listing and each child operation.

nodes.name: _replace
nodes.summary: Calls os.replace, retrying for up to a second while a Windows reader still holds the target open.

nodes.name: run
nodes.summary: Runs an act on a task's Workspace, turning WorkspaceRefused into a blocked-escalated result and OS errors into OP_FAILED; never raises.

nodes.name: seen
nodes.summary: Builds an observation evidence entry naming the workspace by label, never by machine path.

nodes.name: read
nodes.summary: Reads a workspace text file as UTF-8, truncated to max_chars, with the SHA-256 a writer cites when writing it back.

nodes.name: CatalogueEntry
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass for one catalogue prompt with a digest property and to_dict including its placeholders.

nodes.name: AlignPromptLibraryInput
nodes.summary: Strict pydantic input for the prompt library ops, forbidding extra fields and bounding every field.

nodes.name: AlignPromptLibraryBlock
nodes.summary: AIBlock exposing the prompt library: answers ops/help, checks required fields per op, and dispatches to the ops module, returning the labelled result.

nodes.name: entries
nodes.summary: Lists catalogue entries filtered by work mode and step.

nodes.name: entry
nodes.summary: Looks up one catalogue entry by name.

nodes.name: render
nodes.summary: Fills a catalogue entry's template through the library's strict one-pass fill.

nodes.name: install
nodes.summary: Stores every catalogue entry in the library under a prefix as candidate templates, leaving names that hold a person's own prompt untouched.

nodes.name: digest_of
nodes.summary: Returns the SHA-256 digest of a record's content, the address a run cites.

nodes.name: placeholders
nodes.summary: Lists the {{name}} placeholders in a template.

nodes.name: fill
nodes.summary: Fills a template's placeholders in one pass, refusing missing or extra values and capping the expanded size.

nodes.name: _rules
nodes.summary: The library's ledger validation hook: no version gaps, a name keeps its kind, digests match content, and rollbacks cite real versions.

nodes.name: Library
nodes.summary: Append-only versioned library over a chain ledger with get, history, search, render, put, rollback and retire, appending under the coordination lock.

nodes.name: put
nodes.summary: Op storing a new version of a prompt, spec or eval set and returning its version and digest.

nodes.name: get
nodes.summary: Op reading one version by name, version number or digest.

nodes.name: history
nodes.summary: Op listing every version of a name, tombstones included.

nodes.name: search
nodes.summary: Op finding the latest version of names whose name, content or metadata match a query.

nodes.name: render
nodes.summary: Op filling a stored template's placeholders strictly and returning the text with digests.

nodes.name: retire
nodes.summary: Op adding a tombstone for a name; every version stays readable.

nodes.name: rollback
nodes.summary: Op adding a new version holding an earlier version's content.

nodes.name: catalogue
nodes.summary: Op listing the prompt catalogue's entries for a mode and step.

nodes.name: install_catalog
nodes.summary: Op installing the catalogue into the library as candidate templates, reporting names left alone.

nodes.name: SharedWorkspaceInput
nodes.summary: Strict pydantic input for shared workspace ops, forbidding extra fields.

nodes.name: SharedWorkspaceBlock
nodes.summary: AIBlock exposing the shared workspace ops through the registry and MCP door.

nodes.name: read
nodes.summary: Op reading a shared workspace file with its SHA-256.

nodes.name: write
nodes.summary: Op writing a file only if its current version matches expect_sha256 (first write wins), a dry run unless asked.

nodes.name: lock
nodes.summary: Op taking or renewing a token lock on a path for a time-to-live.

nodes.name: unlock
nodes.summary: Op releasing a path lock with its token.

nodes.name: locks
nodes.summary: Op listing live and expired locks in a workspace.

nodes.name: conflicts
nodes.summary: Op listing refused writes and lock takeovers from the append-only coordination log.

nodes.name: WorkspaceManagerInput
nodes.summary: Strict pydantic input for workspace manager ops, forbidding extra fields.

nodes.name: WorkspaceManagerBlock
nodes.summary: AIBlock exposing the workspace manager ops through the registry and MCP door.

nodes.name: ops.py
nodes.summary: The public ops of the workspace_manager component: contained, read, files, status, write, backup, restore and cleanup, each acting on one task's workspace folder under the G6 home and returning a WorkspaceResult envelope (qualified-draft or blocked-escalated). The four file-changing ops are dry runs unless dry_run is false.
nodes.languageNotes: Each op defines a nested act(ws) closure and hands it to a shared _ops.run runner, so path checks, refusals and the envelope are applied in one place.

nodes.name: SKILL.md
nodes.summary: Agent skill for the G6 workspace manager: when to use per-task workspace folders, the eight ops, MCP use with the sensitive-op allow list, failure modes caught, how to read results, blind spots, examples and open problems.

nodes.name: candidates.py
nodes.summary: Fixed, seeded workload (synthetic corpus and queries) and the candidate registry for the context engine's persistent-meaning (ColBERT) spike under protocol 05; candidates report readiness without loading weights and report unavailable rather than zero.

nodes.name: report.py
nodes.summary: Builds the protocol-05 results table and decision for the ColBERT spike: every grid cell stays in the denominator, pins and frozen thresholds are compared, and the cheapest candidate inside the envelope on every platform wins, else "none: repair and rerun".

nodes.name: run.py
nodes.summary: Runs one cell group of the ColBERT spike (one candidate at one corpus size on this platform), measuring latency percentiles, peak RSS and recall, and writing a result even when the candidate is unavailable; loads only cached weights and reaches no network.

nodes.name: frozen.py
nodes.summary: Shared helper for context-engine measurement rows: reads the frozen JSON block from a protocol file, compares threshold and label digests against the ones pinned in each harness, and refuses or reports a mismatch; also provides finite-number and labeller-independence checks.

nodes.name: planner_pairs.py
nodes.summary: Row 07 harness pairing the context engine's search planner against the lexical route alone and a fixed fusion of ready routes, on the same published generation with equal budgets; unready routes are reported evidence_pending, and the result is admitted only against frozen thresholds.

nodes.name: retrieval_baseline.py
nodes.summary: Row 03 lexical harness comparing the context engine's FTS5 search with a plain substring scan over the same walked files, scoring recall at 5 and 10, unsupported citations and returns on no-answer queries, deterministically and offline.

nodes.name: freeze.py
nodes.summary: Standard-library helper for frozen measurement files: canonical JSON digests, a write-once freeze that refuses different content, digest-bound reads, and retirement that keeps a replaced file beside its successor with a reason.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package marker for the meta-harness frontier programme's study code (data, pool ledger, workflows and development-round runner), labelling its results as development rather than validation.

nodes.name: data.py
nodes.summary: Fetches and records the frontier programme's datasets outside the repository: copies or downloads files, unpacks named archive members safely, pulls rows from the Hugging Face datasets-server API, and writes SHA-256s with licences and sources to MANIFEST.json.

nodes.name: h_prompts.json
nodes.summary: Hand-written (arm H) task prompts for the frontier programme's six workflows (GSM8K, MASSIVE, SciFact, MBPP, ARC, banking77), labelled as AI-written and unbriefed.

nodes.name: ledger.py
nodes.summary: Pool ledger for the frontier programme: collects every case id already drawn by registered studies and development rounds, and draws fresh, seeded splits so no case is used by two studies.

nodes.name: round.py
nodes.summary: Runner for one development round of the meta-harness frontier programme: draws splits before any model call, measures arms A, B, H, G, D, DG and F per workflow on the dev-eval split, tunes meta-harness arms, and writes rows, tuning records, a scoreboard and README, with a canary on the reflector.
nodes.languageNotes: Each workflow appends hashed rows to rows/<key>.jsonl as measured, so a rerun skips finished work and the scoreboard is always recomputed from rows alone.

nodes.name: workflows.py
nodes.summary: The frontier programme's six meta-train workflow specs (GSM8K, MASSIVE, SciFact and MBPP reused from V6b, plus ARC-Challenge and banking77), each with oracle, normaliser, feedback, case pools and an edit space, and a builder that turns a round's splits into a metaharness Workflow.

nodes.name: ledger.py
nodes.summary: Ledger and root-cause analysis of the Codex reviews of G6's own code: parses review reports into one row per finding, uses git blame to place later findings against earlier repairs, and counts classes, effects and class recurrence against a shuffle baseline.
nodes.languageNotes: Design-error classes and their checks are kept as data (CLASSES, CHECKS) so the review loop can add, measure and drop checks.

nodes.name: RCA.md
nodes.summary: Root-cause analysis of why 15 review loops of G6's own code did not converge: counts 222 reproduced findings by design-error class, round and blame location, names three root causes, and states predicted effects of process changes plus the analysis's limits.

nodes.name: PROTOCOL.md
nodes.summary: Protocol for version 2 of the six-case synthetic patch-review engineering trial, comparing a stated-checks baseline with G6's patch review and fixing each case's expected outcome, what to record, and the confinement requirement.

nodes.name: run.py
nodes.summary: Runs the synthetic patch-review engineering trial with no model calls: builds six fixture git repositories, calls review_patch on each, records outcome, reason codes, checks and cost, and summarises acceptances, detections and refusals; rejects unconfined results.

nodes.name: exchanges.json
nodes.summary: Recorded request and reply exchanges from the proposer smoke run, grouped by fixture case (codec, cli, notes, pipeline, mathx, wallet), kept for the gaming scan.

nodes.name: record.json
nodes.summary: Record of the proposer smoke run: model, price, dollar cap and spend, settings, per-review calls, tokens, seconds, and what the model proposed, what applied and what was refused.

nodes.name: run.py
nodes.summary: One smoke run of the verification proposer: G6's patch review with search on through claude-haiku-4-5 over six planted-defect fixtures, under a hard $10 stop priced from provider usage, writing record.json and exchanges.json.

nodes.name: measure.py
nodes.summary: Offline measurement of the question slice: a deterministic simulated maintainer that answers from the gold fix (an upper bound), and counts of unnecessary questions, missed questions, harmful answers and person time per cohort.

nodes.name: cases.json
nodes.summary: Eight labelled customer messages (refund, delivery, other) used as test cases for the routing fixture's synthetic classifier.

nodes.name: classify.py
nodes.summary: A deliberately weak keyword classifier (refund, delivery, other) that serves as the synthetic repository for routing validation.

nodes.name: contained
nodes.summary: Reports whether a path stays inside the task's workspace once resolved (.., links followed) and where, reading and writing nothing.

nodes.name: read
nodes.summary: Reads a text file from the task's workspace, cut at max_chars, with the SHA-256 of the whole file.

nodes.name: files
nodes.summary: Lists each plain file in the workspace with path, bytes and SHA-256 (up to MAX_LISTED) and the links skipped.

nodes.name: status
nodes.summary: Reports whether the workspace exists, its files and bytes, whether it holds a .git folder, and its backups.

nodes.name: write
nodes.summary: Writes a text file inside the task's workspace; a dry run unless dry_run is false.

nodes.name: backup
nodes.summary: Creates a gzip tar archive of the workspace's plain files in its backups folder; a dry run by default.

nodes.name: restore
nodes.summary: Restores a backup's files after checking every member, backing up what it replaces; a dry run by default.

nodes.name: cleanup
nodes.summary: Removes the task's workspace folder and its backups, which cannot be undone; a dry run by default.

nodes.name: corpus
nodes.summary: Generates a deterministic synthetic passage corpus of a given size from a fixed vocabulary and seed.

nodes.name: Candidate
nodes.summary: Dataclass describing one spike candidate: id, summary, a readiness probe and its adapter.

nodes.name: cell_problems
nodes.summary: Lists why one grid cell fails: missing result, unavailable or failed run, missing or non-finite measures, or a measure outside the frozen limits.

nodes.name: pin_problems
nodes.summary: Checks that every run records a complete set of required pins and that all runs share the same pins.

nodes.name: decide
nodes.summary: Builds the full candidate x size x platform table and picks the cheapest candidate inside the envelope everywhere, or refuses with reasons when thresholds, pins or missing cells fail the frozen bar.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: CLI entry that loads result files, prints the decision and table, and exits non-zero unless a candidate was chosen.

nodes.name: peak_rss
nodes.summary: Returns the process's peak resident memory in bytes, via resource on POSIX or psutil elsewhere.

nodes.name: measure
nodes.summary: Builds passages from the synthetic corpus, ranks each query with the candidate, and returns latency percentiles, recall at 10, peak RSS and ingest time.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: CLI entry that pins platform and protocol thresholds, measures a ready candidate or records it unavailable, and writes the result JSON.

nodes.name: problem
nodes.summary: Compares a protocol's frozen thresholds and label-file digest with the pinned ones and returns the mismatch as a reason, or None.

nodes.name: check
nodes.summary: Exits with SystemExit when the frozen thresholds or labels differ from the pinned ones; otherwise returns the pinned block for inclusion in results.

nodes.name: run
nodes.summary: Builds the synthetic corpus, publishes one engine generation, and runs the planner, lexical and fixed-fusion arms over every labelled query with equal access and limits, refusing when information or budget differ.

nodes.name: admitted
nodes.summary: Lists the reasons a row-07 result cannot be admitted: dependent labeller, non-finite measures, wrong frozen pins, or arms that saw different information.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: CLI entry that checks frozen thresholds and labels, runs the paired arms in a temporary folder, and writes the admitted result.

nodes.name: substring_scan
nodes.summary: Baseline ranker that orders files by how many query words they contain, then by frequency, then by path.

nodes.name: run
nodes.summary: Builds and walks the synthetic corpus, runs the engine's FTS5 search and the substring baseline per labelled query, and scores recall at 5 and 10, unsupported citations and no-answer returns.

nodes.name: admitted
nodes.summary: Lists the reasons a row-03 result cannot be admitted, such as a dependent labeller, non-finite scores or wrong frozen pins.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: CLI entry that checks frozen thresholds and labels, runs both arms in a temporary folder, and writes the result.

nodes.name: FrozenError
nodes.summary: ValueError raised when a frozen file would change or does not match the digest that binds it.

nodes.name: freeze
nodes.summary: Writes a value once and returns its canonical digest, refusing to overwrite an existing file with different content.

nodes.name: bound
nodes.summary: Returns the JSON at a path only when its canonical digest (optionally with masked fields) equals the expected one; otherwise raises FrozenError.

nodes.name: retire
nodes.summary: Moves a frozen file aside under a digest-suffixed name with a reason of at least 20 characters, deleting nothing.

nodes.name: Dataset
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass describing a dataset's licence, citation, source files, archive members to unpack, and optional datasets-server rows.

nodes.name: _get
nodes.summary: HTTP GET with three retries and growing pauses, for the rate-limited rows API.

nodes.name: _unpack
nodes.summary: Extracts only the named members of a tar archive through tarfile's data filter, refusing links and paths outside the folder.

nodes.name: _rows
nodes.summary: Downloads every row of each split from the datasets-server API in pages, writing one JSON object per line and refusing a short split.

nodes.name: fetch
nodes.summary: Puts a dataset into data_root by copying from a source folder or downloading, unpacking named members, and recording each file's SHA-256 with licence and sources in MANIFEST.json.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: CLI entry that fetches the named datasets (or all) and prints their manifest entries.

nodes.name: draw
nodes.summary: Draws seeded, fresh splits of given sizes from a pool after removing every id already used, raising when too few remain.

nodes.name: draw_splits
nodes.summary: Reads the round's splits.json and draws any missing workflow's splits from the pool ledger, writing them before anything else runs.

nodes.name: Tap
nodes.summary: Call-counting canary around the reflector that records, as hashes, any forbidden held-out snippet appearing in a prompt, plain or JSON-escaped.

nodes.name: measure_profile
nodes.summary: Measures a workflow profile on a set of cases via metaharness run_case and returns one row per case.

nodes.name: measure_direct
nodes.summary: Arm A: one direct model call per case with the default system prompt and no harness, returning rows with everything released.

nodes.name: Rows
nodes.summary: Append-only rows/<key>.jsonl store of one row per arm and case, tracking which cases each arm has finished.

nodes.name: tune_arm
nodes.summary: Tunes one meta-harness arm in its own workspace with the reflector or random edits, spending the confirmation split once, records the TuningRun and returns its head profile.

nodes.name: run_workflow
nodes.summary: Runs a design's arms on one workflow's dev-eval cases, each from a freshly loaded model, including tuned arms and the B2 repeat control.

nodes.name: scoreboard
nodes.summary: Recomputes the round's per-workflow and pooled numbers from the rows and tuning files alone.

nodes.name: repeats
nodes.summary: Counts, per workflow, how many of arm B's outputs the second B measurement repeated exactly.

nodes.name: readme
nodes.summary: Renders the round's README.md table from the scoreboard, labelled development, not a validation.

nodes.name: code_digest
nodes.summary: Returns the SHA-256 of the metaharness method's Python code so a hand edit shows in the round record.

nodes.name: run_round
nodes.summary: Runs every requested workflow of a round, then writes the scoreboard and README.

nodes.name: devcheck
nodes.summary: Measures dev successes per workflow for arm A and arm B under the default system prompt and two alternatives.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: CLI entry with draw, devcheck and run subcommands, wiring Ollama-backed callers, the reflector, hand-written prompts and digests into a round.

nodes.name: FrontierSpec
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass for one frontier workflow: dataset, task, checks, pipeline steps, oracle, normaliser, prompts, case pools, feedback and examples, with its edit space and the every-component-on profile (arm G).

nodes.name: distinct_pool
nodes.summary: Returns a workflow's sorted case pool keeping only the first id of each repeated input, so the same text never lands in two splits.

nodes.name: build
nodes.summary: Builds a metaharness Workflow for one round from a spec's dev, selection and confirmation splits, caller, objectives and evidence policy.

nodes.name: scifact_cases
nodes.summary: Loads SciFact claims with their cited abstracts as SuiteCases for the given ids.

nodes.name: arc_cases
nodes.summary: Loads ARC-Challenge questions with lettered options as SuiteCases for the given ids.

nodes.name: findings
nodes.summary: Reads every "## Finding" section of every review report under the roots into one row per finding, and lists reports that held none.

nodes.name: blamed
nodes.summary: Uses git blame to place each later finding's newest cited line against the commit its review read: last repair, earlier repair, or code the first review read.

nodes.name: by_chance
nodes.summary: Shuffles each loop's class labels across its findings, keeping rounds, to give the chance distribution of class recurrence after a repair.

nodes.name: analysis
nodes.summary: Counts findings by class, effect and round, classes met again after a repair, and later findings in the last repair's lines, without printing finding text.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: CLI entry that, given review roots, writes findings.jsonl and lines.jsonl; given none, prints the analysis and chance baseline from the labelled rows in the output folder.

nodes.name: row
nodes.summary: Turns G6's patch-review reply for one case into a trial row: outcome, per-stage reason codes, requirement statuses, checks run and skipped, confinement and cost.

nodes.name: summarise
nodes.summary: Counts acceptances (correct and false), detections, refusals and tool errors across the trial rows.

nodes.name: run
nodes.summary: Builds each fixture case as a git repository, runs review_patch with the stated requirements, and collects rows and the summary.

nodes.name: repo
nodes.summary: Creates a temporary git repository from base files, commits them, then writes the patch files as uncommitted working-tree changes.

nodes.name: DollarStop
nodes.summary: Wraps the study caller with a hard spending stop: before each call it refuses if money spent plus the call's maximum cost would pass the cap, and it prices each call from provider usage.

nodes.name: summary
nodes.summary: Builds one review's record: calls, tokens, dollars and seconds, plus what the model proposed, what applied and what was refused.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Runs every fixture case through review_patch with search on under the dollar cap, then writes record.json and exchanges.json.

nodes.name: outcome_instances
nodes.summary: Returns each outcome's example.v1 instance for a question's scenario, which the simulated maintainer runs on the gold fix.

nodes.name: measure
nodes.summary: Counts unnecessary questions, missed questions, harmful answers and person time over a cohort of cases, each with its denominator.

nodes.name: classify
nodes.summary: Labels a message refund, delivery or other by keyword match.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Describes the synthetic classify fixture repository: classify.py labels short messages as refund, delivery or other, and cases.json holds invented labelled cases it partly gets wrong.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: The synthetic notes fixture repository for the routing trials: a README with no code that carries a deliberate spelling mistake for negative (no-tool-call) tasks.

nodes.name: policy.txt
nodes.summary: Invented access-control facts and rules (team membership, management chains, folder ownership, bans) used as the rules fixture for the routing trials' logic/rules route.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Short README for the synthetic rules fixture repository, pointing to policy.txt as its invented access rules.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Describes the synthetic shop fixture repository whose shop.prices.total adds up (quantity, unit_price) order lines.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Empty package marker (licence header only) for the synthetic shop fixture package.

nodes.name: prices.py
nodes.summary: Synthetic order-total function for the shop fixture; it intentionally lacks the negative-quantity check its test expects, giving the review route a real failing test to find.

nodes.name: test_prices.py
nodes.summary: Pytest requirement tests for the shop fixture: totals add the lines, and a negative quantity must raise ValueError (which prices.total does not yet do).

nodes.name: frozen.json
nodes.summary: Pins the SHA-256 digests of the routing bars (gates.json) and of the development task list; nothing runs or is scored on files that differ from these pins.

nodes.name: gates.json
nodes.summary: The routing-trial bars (format g6.routing_gates/1): minimum positive completion and Wilson lower bound, maximum unnecessary-call and malformed-call rates, minimum missing-tool recovery, the release rule and the final cohort shape.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Guide to the routing trials instrument: what the frozen task list, bars, scorer, runner, trial server and fixtures are, how scores are read only from kept event logs, what is sent to which provider under consent, how to run, and what is still owed (state evidence_pending).

nodes.name: run.py
nodes.summary: Runner for the routing trials: binds tasks to digests of routes, skill and g6 package, launches one fresh Claude Code or Codex session per task behind G6's consent check with an isolated G6 home, keeps each session's event log by digest, parses client events into transcripts, and re-reads kept logs to score and release.
nodes.languageNotes: Loads score.py and ../freeze.py by file path via importlib (spec_from_file_location) rather than as packages, so the scorer stays standard-library only and loadable by tests.

nodes.name: score.py
nodes.summary: Offline, deterministic scorer for the routing trials: validates task lists and gate files, judges each task's transcript (calls in order, final states, malformed or unnecessary calls, missing-tool recovery), tallies per route and client with Wilson bounds, and decides the release reading against pinned bars.

nodes.name: server.py
nodes.summary: The MCP server a routing-trial session gets: builds one of G6's own registered servers with the task's withheld tools removed (from a private module copy), and serves only when the imported g6 package digest matches the one the runner bound.
nodes.languageNotes: Re-executes a module from its file spec under a private name to obtain a server object whose tool registry can be pruned without touching the product module.

nodes.name: tasks.json
nodes.summary: The frozen development cohort for the routing trials (format g6.routing_tasks/1): per-route digests plus an every-route digest, and one positive, negative and missing-tool task per route with prompt, fixture, withheld tools, expected calls and budgets.

nodes.name: derive_pairs.py
nodes.summary: Builds Study V1's population by assigning VitaminC claim/evidence pairs to five strata (quoted, paraphrased, negated, wrong_figure, near_topic) by a frozen rule and sampling per stratum with a fixed seed.

nodes.name: run.py
nodes.summary: Study V1 runner: scores claim/source pairs with G6's check_claim, a BM25 relevance baseline and an optional LLM NLI arm, and reports per-stratum endpoints with Wilson and cluster-bootstrap intervals and sign tests.

nodes.name: SMOKE_FIXTURE_NOT_EVALUATION_DATA.csv
nodes.summary: Five-row smoke fixture in Study V1's pairs format (pair_id, stratum, claim, source, label), one row per stratum; explicitly not evaluation data.

nodes.name: tune_relevance.py
nodes.summary: Tunes the Study V1 relevance baseline's BM25 threshold on development pairs only, picking the observed score that maximises balanced accuracy.

nodes.name: extract_calls.py
nodes.summary: Study V2 population extractor, run in a separate AgentDojo environment: writes every benchmark ground-truth tool call as a JSON line labelled user or injection with its context prompt.

nodes.name: mapping.py
nodes.summary: Frozen mapping from each AgentDojo tool to the facts a tool registry would declare (class, reversibility, reach, external, backend, target), the G6-side adapter for Study V2.

nodes.name: run.py
nodes.summary: Study V2 runner: labels extracted calls, runs the G6 action gate (declared and unknown facts), an allow-list baseline and an optional LLM judge, and reports missed-harm and false-escalation endpoints with intervals, sign tests and a verdict.
nodes.languageNotes: Loads the frozen mapping.py by file path with importlib so the mapping file is used exactly as frozen.

nodes.name: SMOKE_FIXTURE_NOT_EVALUATION_DATA.jsonl
nodes.summary: Four-line smoke fixture in Study V2's extracted-call format: two benign banking user calls and two injection-task calls (a read and a payment to an attacker); not evaluation data.

nodes.name: analyze.py
nodes.summary: Study V6 analysis: from the runner's rows computes paired endpoints between arms, Holm-adjusted sign tests, cluster-bootstrap intervals, a planted-gain survival control, contamination and oracle checks, and the rule-ordered verdict; writes analysis.json and a CSV.

nodes.name: pilot.py
nodes.summary: Development pilot (not a study) probing which extra G6 pipeline steps (example retrieval, majority vote, claim conflict, second-pass verify, test-and-repair loop) lift MASSIVE, SciFact and MBPP over static G6 using the V6 runner.

nodes.name: _shown
nodes.summary: Digests what the MCP servers show for each tool (description and input schema) so route digests change when the served surface changes.

nodes.name: route_digests
nodes.summary: Computes the per-route digests (anchor, members, root-skill section, detail files, served tool surface) plus the every-route digest covering the rest of the skill, server instructions and fixtures.

nodes.name: _final_runs
nodes.summary: Reads final_runs.jsonl beside the gate file into records, refusing any line that is not a record.

nodes.name: load_tasks
nodes.summary: Loads and validates a task list, refusing it when any route digest changed, when the final cohort is not bound in gates.json, or when a development task is not the pinned list's own.

nodes.name: _events
nodes.summary: Parses a client's JSON-lines output into a list of event dicts, skipping lines that are not objects.

nodes.name: _state
nodes.summary: Extracts a G6 completion state from a tool result's content parts when present.

nodes.name: parse_claude

nodes.summary: One container where an arm or G6's check works, with its sidecar and cleanup.

nodes.name: Tally
nodes.summary: Tracks what Claude Code's stream-json said: model calls, usage and the result, with cost estimates.

nodes.name: sample.py
